Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance (Connected Products) 

Location: United States (Remote) 

Business Unit: Cyber Security  

 

Imagine your customer is a leading industrial component manufacturer, specializing in top-notch manufacturing and transportation equipment. You have ambitious goals: to streamline processes, ensure top-quality security for your client’s products, and assure cybersecurity. That’s where you come in.  Our analysis will bridge any gaps across design, engineering, SDLC and technical control testing, and regulatory readiness, helping clients meet requirements such as the EU CRA, IEC 62443, and other product security standards.

With our expertise in testing, inspection and independent security validation services, you will assist your client in raising their cyber resilience like never before. Your success story? It's written in client readiness and satisfaction, secure products, and audit-defensible evidence. Now also imagine the same story, but for products such as vehicles, medical devices, ships, IoT products, network equipment, software products, etc. Doesn’t it sound like an exciting mission?  

 

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity provides cybersecurity services covering people, organization,  technology, of products, and connected ecosystems. 

 

We have reputable clients and they request expertise to increase their level of cybersecurity, and regulatory readiness.

Role Overview 

The Senior Consultant – Product Security & Compliance is a doer role responsible for delivering product security and compliance engagements while supporting the growth of Bureau Veritas’ Cyber Security services across North America. 

This role focuses on helping clients translate regulatory requirements for North American customers, into practical, engineering-aligned product security controls, harmonized with frameworks across sectors with current compliance standards and frameworks 

The individual will work across industrial, IoT, embedded, software, medical technology, transportation, and cloud-connected product environments, supporting execution of engagements, development of repeatable offerings, and business development activities. 

Key Responsibilities

 

1. Client Engagement Delivery 

  • Execute and support delivery of product security consulting engagements, including: 
    • Product security maturity assessments 
    • CRA, IEC 62443, IoT security, automotive, medical device,- standards and regulatory readiness and gap assessments 
    • Threat modeling, abuse case analysis, and product risk assessments 
    • Secure architecture review and security requirement definition for connected products 
    • Secure product development lifecycle (PDL/SDL) and technical product technical requirements implementation support 
    • Product security, maturity modelling, scoring, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps 
  • Translate regulatory and standard requirements into engineering actions, test cases, control frameworks, and evidence expectations 
  • Produce structured, audit-defensible deliverables aligned to BV methodologies 

2. Regulatory Harmonization & Product Security Compliance 

  • Apply and operationalize product cybersecurity regulatory frameworks across engagements 
  • Support harmonization and implementation across product security regulations and standards, including: 
  • Regulatory Standards and Frameworks: 
    • EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)  
    • NIS2 Directive 
    • Relevant North American IoT security initiatives (e.g., NIST, FCC, and related connected-device security expectations) 
  • Secure Development Lifecycle & Process Standards: 
    • IEC 62443-4-1 
    • NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
    • OWASP SAMM 
    • ISO/IEC 27034  and secure software engineering practices 
  • Technical Security Requirements & Baselines: 
    • EU Common Criteria 
    • IEC 62443-4-2 
    • ETSI EN 303 645 (IoT security) 
    • NIST IoT cybersecurity guidance 
    • OWASP ASVS and API security frameworks 
  • Software Supply Chain & SBOM: 
    • SBOM standards and formats (SPDX, Cyclone-DX) 
    • NIST supply chain risk management guidance 
  • Sector-Specific Frameworks (as applicable): 
    • ISO/SAE 21434 and UNECE R155/R156 (automotive) 
    • FDA and MDCG cybersecurity guidance (medical devices) 
    • ISO 14971 (medical risk management) 
  • Develop and use: 
    • Control mappings, and CRA/IEC/sector-specific requirement crosswalks 
    • Evidence matrices, assessment checklists, and regulatory traceability models 
    • Compliance scoring models, maturity models, heatmaps, and remediation roadmaps 
    • Help clients move from regulatory interpretation → implementation → verification → readiness 

3. Product Security Engineering & Architecture Support 

  • Support clients in securing connected product architectures, including: 
    • Embedded systems and firmware, device operating systems, and product interfaces 
    • Industrial and IoT devices, network equipment, and operational technology components 
    • Software applications, APIs, and web management interfaces 
    • Cloud-connected product backends, and supporting infrastructure 
  • Contribute to: 
    • Threat models 
    • Security architecture definitions 
    • Identity, communication, and data protection strategies 
  • Assist in defining aligned technical product security requirements and validation criteria mapped to EU CC, CRA, IEC 62443, OWASP, NIST, ETSI, and sector-specific expectations 

4. Security Verification & Validation Support 

  • Contribute to product and system-level security validation activities, 
  • Support development of test cases, validation frameworks and evidence packages aligned to regulatory and standard requirements 
  • Help structure outputs into certification and regulations ready evidence packages 

5. Business Development (Seller-Doer Expectation) 

  • Support growth of product security, and regulatory compliance  services through: 
    • Client discussions, technical solutioning and discovery workshops 
    • Proposal development and response support 
    • Participation in discovery workshops and scoping sessions 
  • Help position BV as a trusted partner for product security, CRA readiness, and connected-product assurance 
  • Contribute to service offering development and reusable artifacts 

6. Capability Development & Team Contribution 

  • Contribute to building repeatable product security, and compliance methodologies and templates 
  • Support development of: 
    • Regulatory aligned frameworks 
    • Product security assessment models 
    • Testing and validation structures 
  • Mentor junior consultants and support team knowledge development 
  • Collaborate with global BV teams and technical specialists 

Required Experience 

Core Experience 

  • 6–10 years of experience in cybersecurity with exposure to product security, industrial systems, embedded systems, or connected devices 
  • Experience working in consulting or client-facing delivery roles 
  • Hands-on involvement in security assessments, risk analysis, vulnerability management, or architecture engagements 

Technical Competencies

  • Understanding of: 
    • Threat modeling and risk assessment methodologies 
    • Secure development lifecycle (SDL) concepts 
    • Product and system security architecture 
    • Software supply chain security (SBOM, SCA) 
  • Knowledge of various laws and regulations related to cyber product security, as well as the current developments in this area.  
  • Exposure to security testing techniques across device, firmware, application, hardware, or system layers is a strong plus 

Consulting & Personal Attributes 

  • Strong structured problem-solving, evidence review, and documentation skills 
  • Ability to balance technical depth with client communication, and engineering practicality 
  • Results-oriented with a seller-doer mindset, and ability to support business development 
  • Comfortable working across multiple industries, product types, and stakeholder groups 
  • Willingness to travel for onsite engagements as needed 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience delivering IEC 62443, IoT security, automotive cybersecurity, medical-device cybersecurity,
  • Experience in technical operations of areas such as SBOM, PSIRT, standards and regulatory readiness, 
  • Experience creating control mappings, evidence matrices, requirement crosswalks, assessment checklists, report templates, or regulatory-readiness frameworks 
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 certificates, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent practical experience are helpful but not mandatory 

WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM US?  

We are an organization with a strong focus on technical cybersecurity, delivering high-quality technical services in the field of digital security. You will be part of a team of motivated international specialists, where knowledge exchange is highly valued.  

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we provide an environment for you to develop your talents and stimulate your professional growth. Together, we work to safeguard the security and integrity of valuable data while facing the challenges of the ever-evolving digital world. Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity is a fast-growing company with ambitious goals. You will have the opportunity to grow along with us and shape your career allowing you to become an expert in your field.  

In terms of content, we offer you a diverse portfolio of exciting clients and projects. We are part of Bureau Veritas, which means that international opportunities are expanding, both for project work and for advancing your career.

jobs.description:
About PrePass

PrePass® is North America's most trusted weigh station bypass and toll management platform. We’re transforming how the transportation industry operates—creating solutions that keep trucks moving safely, efficiently, and compliantly. This means making bold decisions and building systems that support not only fleets but the broader economy. It all starts with enabling commercial vehicles to keep rolling with seamless toll management, weigh station bypass, and safety solutions. It’s what we do best, and we do it to meet the demands of the road every day.

That’s why people join us: our solutions are implemented in real-time, on highways and interstates across the nation, helping fleets go farther, faster. This work challenges and rewards, presenting complex problems that need ambitious answers. We hire bold thinkers with a heart for impact, a passion for progress, and the optimism to shape the future of transportation.

About the Role

As PrePass scales from a bypass-and-tolling provider into a unified compliance ecosystem, the complexity of delivering software has grown dramatically. Multiple product lines, a newly acquired codebase, state agency integrations, and partner marketplace commitments all compete for engineering capacity. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to bring structure, predictability, and cross-team alignment to how we plan, execute, and ship.

This is a high-visibility role working at the intersection of engineering, product, and operations — someone who can translate roadmap ambitions into realistic delivery plans and hold the organization accountable to them.

Problems You'll Help Solve

Unpredictable Release Cadence

Teams building across bypass, tolling, compliance, and hardware-integrated systems operate on different rhythms. Create and maintain a structured release calendar to reduce surprises for customers, state agency partners, and internal stakeholders.

Engineering Capacity Visibility

Leadership needs to make portfolio-level tradeoffs (new integrations vs. platform stability vs. compliance features) but lacks a consistent view of what teams are working on and when it will land.

Cross-Team Dependency Management

A delay in any one integration/update/tool can block multiple teams. Dependencies need owners and visibility.

Essential Responsibilities

Program Planning & Delivery

  • Own the integrated delivery roadmap across PrePass product lines: bypass, toll management, safety alerts, INFORM analytics, and compliance.
  • Establish and maintain a dependable release schedule, coordinating across engineering, product, QA, and operations.
  • Drive program kickoffs, milestone reviews, and retrospectives — creating accountability without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Translate product roadmap priorities into phased, executable plans with clear owners, timelines, and risk mitigations.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Map and track cross-team dependencies, escalating blockers before they become delays.
  • Facilitate alignment between engineering teams.

Visibility & Reporting

  • Build and maintain program dashboards that give engineering leadership and the CTO a real-time view of delivery health.
  • Produce clear, concise executive status updates — surfacing risks, decisions needed, and milestone progress without noise.
  • Define and track engineering KPIs: cycle time, release frequency, defect escape rate, and on-time delivery percentage.

Process Improvement

  • Identify and eliminate recurring sources of delay — unclear requirements, late dependency discovery, incomplete acceptance criteria.
  • Standardize Agile ceremony practices across teams to improve sprint predictability and retrospective follow-through.
  • Lead post-incident reviews on missed releases, building a culture of blameless learning.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of program or project management experience in a software product company.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving release predictability across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong command of dependency mapping, risk management, and critical path analysis.
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to non-technical executives and external partners.
  • Proficiency with Agile methodologies and tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent).

Bonus Points For

  • Background in transportation, logistics, fleet technology, or regulatory compliance software.
  • Experience managing integrations with third-party telematics or marketplace platforms.
  • Exposure to post-acquisition integration programs.
  • Familiarity with .NET / Azure cloud environments (enough to understand engineering discussions, not to code).

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

  • Published and socialized an integrated program calendar covering all active product lines through end of year.
  • Identified the top 3 recurring sources of delivery delay and proposed mitigation plans.
  • Established a weekly program health report used by the CTO and product leadership.

Benefits

How We Will Take Care of You

  • Robust benefit package that includes medical, dental, and vision that start on date of hire.
  • Paid Time Off, to include vacation, sick, holidays, and floating holidays.
  • 401(k) plan with employer match.
  • Company-funded “lifestyle account” upon date of hire for you to apply toward your physical and mental well-being (i.e., ski passes, retreats, gym memberships).
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program.
  • Voluntary benefits, to include but not limited to Legal and Pet Discounts.
  • Employee Assistance Program (available at no cost to you).
  • Company-sponsored and funded “Culture Team” that focuses on the Physical, Mental, and Professional well-being of employees.
  • Community Give-Back initiatives.
  • Culture that focuses on employee development initiatives.

Join Us

At PrePass, our mission drives us.

We invest in relationships. We challenge ourselves to innovate and improve. We win together. Simply put, we live our Core Values.

Ready to help move the transportation industry forward? Join us and let’s drive progress—together.

jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. OCD affects over 181 million people globally and is ranked by the World Health Organization as one of the top 10 most disabling conditions. Despite this, over 90% of people with OCD are unable to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis—earning it the nickname “the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Members can access licensed mental health professionals with specialized training in OCD, receive video-based teletherapy, and engage with tech-enabled tools and moderated communities for continuous support.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world—and we’re just getting started.

About the Role

This is a 100% REMOTE OPPORTUNITY!

This is not a traditional, transactional customer service or call center role. As a Member Advocate (Intake Specialist), you are the critical bridge between a person suffering in silence with OCD and the life-changing evidence-based Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy they desperately need.

When a potential member calls NOCD, they aren't just looking to schedule an appointment—they are often sharing their deepest anxieties, fears, and vulnerabilities with you. Your job is to sit in empathy with them, deeply listen to their experience, and build instant trust. At the same time, you are an advocate who must confidently navigate their hesitations, handle complex objections, and guide them to make a life-changing commitment: scheduling their first therapy session before the call ends.

This role requires a rare combination of exceptional emotional intelligence and a goal-oriented, consultative sales mindset. You will be held to clear key performance indicators (KPIs) centered on enrollment conversion rates, because every conversion represents a life saved from OCD.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities):

  • Conduct Elevated Consultative Intake Conversations: Make outbound calls to individuals seeking help, guiding them from a place of vulnerability to a place of action.
  • Empathic Deep Listening & Value Messaging: Listen to highly sensitive accounts of OCD symptoms with an empathetic ear, and clearly articulate how NOCD’s specialized ERP therapy can help them regain control of their lives.
  • Navigate Complex Objections: Confidently address common barriers to care (e.g., financial concerns, scheduling hesitations, fear of starting therapy) using advanced objection-handling techniques to keep the member moving forward.
  • Drive Enrollment Conversions: Own the entire initial relationship with the goal of connecting the member to care and scheduling their first session by the end of the initial contact.
  • Implement Feedback: Openly receive and rapidly implement regular coaching from leadership regarding call quality, metric tracking, and conversational delivery.

Who Thrives Here (Preferred Backgrounds): We find that the professionals who excel in this role don't come from high-volume, resolution-focued customer service. Instead, they usually have a unique blend of human-centric interviewing and goal-driven conversion experience. You will be a strong fit if you have a background in:

  • Intake / Investigative Interviewing: Experience handling highly sensitive client stories while needing to qualify and "close" the client for the firm.
  • Crisis Hotlines / Peer Support Specialist / Treatment Coordinator: Deeply trained in active listening, de-escalation, and holding space for raw human emotion, combined with a desire to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Consultative Inside Sales / Admissions: Experience in high-consideration sales (like higher education admissions or medical counseling) where your success relies entirely on building deep trust and overcoming heavy emotional or financial objections.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a consultative sales, enrollment, or high-stakes intake environment where you were measured against performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Exceptional emotional stamina and the ability to pivot seamlessly from a deeply empathetic emotional conversation to a structured enrollment close.
  • Superb communication skills—able to speak about complex mental health topics with authority, clarity, and warmth.
  • Technologically nimble; able to manage multiple software platforms, scheduling systems, and communication channels simultaneously in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Communications, or a related field is strongly preferred.

Why Work for NOCD

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. With an inclusive culture and ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life. At NOCD, you will:

  • Help scale one of the fastest-growing specialty behavioral health organizations in the world.
  • Work directly with operational, clinical, product, and business leaders to solve meaningful challenges at scale.
  • Use data, technology, and critical thinking to drive measurable improvements in member outcomes and business performance.
  • Contribute to a mission that helps people reclaim their lives from one of the world's most disabling mental health conditions.
  • Build your career in a high-growth environment where ownership, innovation, and execution are valued and rewarded.
  • Play a role in shaping the future of NOCD as we expand beyond OCD into additional behavioral health specialties.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, NOCD is the place for you.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and a 401K plan with a Company Match.
  • Employee Assistance Programs, including Mental Health, Wellness, Financial, Legal, and Pet Insurance
  • Generous PTO policy with 11 observed company holidays
  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Current Shift-

  • Off Tues/Wed
    • 12:30 PM-9:00 PM CST on weekdays
    • 9:00 AM- 5:30 PM CST on weekends

jobs.excerpt: Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director) Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast) Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it?
jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

GURU, Catalyst2 and UKDedicated are managed hosting specialists, delivering exceptional dedicated and cloud services to drive booming online businesses. We work with agencies, SMBs and industry-leading organisations through our strong customer-focused UK brands.

We’re part of team.blue, an ecosystem of 60+ successful PaaS and SaaS brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.5 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.

Are you ready to share your passion for tech and join our UK team?

What we do

We make succeeding online as easy as it can be for our customers. We:

  • Provide 5-star rated hosting services

  • Keep our products accessible and industry-leading

  • Offer a diverse range of products to allow customers to grow

  • Are customer-obsessed, offering multi-channel exceptional support

Job description

We're seeking a Systems and Escalations Engineer to join our UK technical team under group brands that include Catalyst2, GURU Cloud and UKDedicated - someone who brings passion for tech and experience in hosting.

This is a fast-paced and varied technical hands-on role involving escalated internal and customer support matters, provisioning new services, managing systems and mentoring other support team members.

Location: completely remote (UK-based only) or working hybrid from our Worcester, Reading or Hemel Hempstead offices.

Training: you will be given complete training and support.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing escalated in-depth 3rd line support to our customers. Primarily by email/ticketing, phone to a lesser extent.

  • Supporting our internal 1st & 2nd line support teams with technical escalations.

  • Deploying new customer services.

  • System administration, ongoing management and upgrades and liasing with vendors.

Required skills & experience

  • Minimum 2 years of strong hosting experience, especially with cPanel and WHM, with hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting the underlying Linux servers via the command line (CLI), not just through the cPanel/WHM interface. Plesk is a plus.

  • Excellent technical knowledge of WordPress and other CMS/Ecommerce web apps.

  • Understanding of key internet protocols and technologies.

  • Able to demonstrate and apply a process-driven and security-focused mindset.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills.

The following would be advantageous

  • Saltstack, Ansible or other configuration management/orchestration tools.

  • Experience of: Windows Server, IIS, MySQL, Magento, VLANs/networking and Firewalls.

  • Understanding around programming languages such as PHP, Python and shell scripting.

  • Technical qualifications and/or degree-level education.

jobs.description:
Overview

Drive Enterprise Growth. Shape the Future of Healthcare.

About Carenet Health

Carenet Health is a San Antonio based healthcare engagement company, and we are growing fast. For more than 30 years we have helped health plans, health systems and healthcare companies engage their members and patients at every step of their journey. Today we serve more than 500 clients, we have grown 500%, and we have delivered 18 straight years of profitability. We operate multiple nearshore and offshore locations alongside our U.S. teams. Our services span member and patient engagement, contact center and BPO services, clinical support and nurse advice, telehealth, advocacy and navigation, patient access and scheduling, and digital and AI-enabled engagement. With Invene and Orbita now part of Carenet, we also bring healthcare data, AI and conversational technology to the table.

Why This Role Exists

We are growing. 2027 is a step change for Carenet, and we are adding executive sales talent who open doors and keep opening them. We are making a real investment in this role, and in you. In return, we are looking for the best talent in the industry: sellers who build relationships every day. This role owns new logo and expansion growth with national and regional health plans.

The Engine Behind You

You will not be selling alone. Carenet has invested heavily in building a growth engine around every seller.

  • Marketing: A dedicated Marketing team, a refreshed brand and website, targeted campaigns and a calendar of industry events, all built to put you in front of the right buyers.
  • Sales Development: An SDR team that works with you 1:1 and provides outbound calling support on your accounts, with an expectation of at least 2 net new meetings per week on your calendar.
  • Deal support: Sales Engineering, executive sponsorship and a Deal Desk that helps you shape and win large pursuits.

Who We Are Looking For

Your network.

You already know the people who run member experience, operations and quality at health plans. You have relationships with Chief Customer and Member Experience Officers, VPs of Member Services, Stars and Quality leaders, Medicaid and Medicare operations leaders, and procurement at national and regional plans. These are people who see you as a leader and a champion of their business.

Your work ethic.

You have grit. You keep going through a long and demanding sales journey. You are always on offense: you build your own pipeline, you do not wait for leads, and you bring the next idea to the client before they ask. You are intellectually curious. You learn the client's business, the market and our solutions deeply enough to have a different conversation than everyone else in their inbox. You take ownership of your number and your word. You are a trusted advisor.

What You Will Do

  • Build and execute a territory plan across national and regional health plans: Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, Blue plans and commercial.
  • Open new logos and expand within existing health plan clients.
  • Lead large, RFP-driven, multi-year pursuits for member engagement and contact center services (domestic and offshore), Stars and quality outreach, medication adherence, nurse advice and care management support, Medicaid redetermination and digital engagement.
  • Build multi-threaded executive relationships, become the partner a plan calls before an RFP exists, and build account strategies for large clients.
  • Bring deals to Deal Desk early and shape the win strategy with the executive team.
  • Work with your SDR, Marketing and Sales Engineering to build pipeline through targeted campaigns and events.
  • Keep Salesforce and HubSpot current and forecast accurately every week.

How You Will Be Successful

  • Bookings (ACV) against an annual quota, set each year
  • Qualified pipeline created and coverage against your number
  • Executive meetings held with decision makers
  • Forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Growth of your relationships into multi-threaded account relationships

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales to health plans, with BPO, outsourcing, member engagement, contact center or care management services strongly preferred
  • Experience closing multi-year deals with large, complex buying committees
  • Working knowledge of Medicare Advantage Stars, Medicaid and member experience economics
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • A track record of exceeding quota, with results you can show
  • Comfort running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs
  • Regularly working deals that exceed $5M in annual revenue
  • Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or the ability to get there fast

How We Hire

Our process looks at the whole picture: your talent, experience, network, relationships and account leadership. In your second interview, bring a written network plan: 25 named relationships at organizations in this segment, their title, how you know them, and how you would turn each into a first meeting. We will walk through it together. It tells us more than a resume.

Carenet Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

As the Accounts Payable Specialist, you’ll help keep our financial operations accurate, timely, and well controlled by owning key activities across the accounts payable cycle for Paleovalley and Wild Pastures. You’ll work across a multi-entity, inventory-driven environment to process vendor bills, resolve discrepancies, maintain clean vendor records, and support accurate month-end reporting in Acumatica.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing order to high-volume details, following issues through to resolution, and partnering closely with Accounting, Supply Chain, Operations and our vendor community.

What You’ll Do

  • Ensure timely and accurate vendor bill processing in Acumatica across multiple entities, ensuring bills are recorded in the correct company and supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.
  • Perform three-way matching of vendor invoices, purchase orders, and receipts, investigating and resolving price, quantity, receiving, and other discrepancies with Supply Chain, Operations, and vendors.
  • Manage AP approval workflows, the Acumatica Incoming Documents module, and shared AP inboxes to ensure vendor invoices, bills, and other AP requests are captured, routed, and addressed within established timelines.
  • Review and code non-PO vendor invoices and other expenses to the appropriate entity, general ledger account, warehouse, and other required dimensions while maintaining accurate supporting documentation.
  • Apply and allocate landed costs, including freight, processing fees, discounts, and taxes, to purchase order receipts using the appropriate allocation method.
  • Reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, vendor statements, received-not-invoiced purchase accruals, landed cost clearing accounts, and work-in-progress balances; research and resolve reconciling items.
  • Support month-end close by preparing accurate and timely AP accruals, aging reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s and banking information, and follow established controls.
  • Build responsive working relationships with vendors and internal partners, addressing invoice, payment, and account questions promptly and following issues through to resolution.
  • Support annual 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, audit requests, and other AP-related compliance activities by maintaining complete, organized, and audit-ready records.
  • Identify practical opportunities to optimize AP processes, controls, and efficiency while maintaining accuracy in a high-volume environment.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 4 - 6 years of hands-on, full-cycle accounts payable experience, ideally in a manufacturing, CPG, distribution, or other inventory-intensive environment.
  • Hands-on experience working in Acumatica or another large ERP environment, including purchase order, inventory, and accounts payable modules.
  • Demonstrated experience with three-way matching, landed cost allocations, and resolving invoice, purchase order, and receiving discrepancies.
  • Strong reconciliation skills, including AP subledger-to-GL, vendor statements, purchase accruals, and related clearing or work-in-progress accounts.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting and the accounts payable month-end close process.
  • Intermediate Excel skills, including PivotTables and formulas such as VLOOKUP and SUMIFS.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage a high volume of transactions with competing deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with vendors and cross-functional partners with little direction.

Bonus Points

  • Associate’s degree or higher in Accounting, Business, or a related field.
  • Direct experience with Acumatica, particularly within Purchase Order, Inventory, and Accounts Payable modules.
  • Experience in manufacturing, e-commerce, CPG, or a multi-entity environment with multiple warehouses or locations.
  • Experience supporting 1099 reporting, sales and use tax reviews, or financial audits.

Our Commitment to You

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) company-paid holidays each year & two (2) floating holidays
  • Paid parental leave after 6 months of service for eligible employees
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Referral bonuses up to $1,500 when you refer great people who join our team
  • 401(k) or Roth Plans with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • $300 Paleovalley Monthly product stipend for employees

Compliance & Employment Practices

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to .

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility to work in the U.S.

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology-assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team.

The ideal candidate combines strong digital marketing execution skills with the confidence to independently manage client relationships and communicate performance clearly.

  • Execute local SEO strategies across client accounts

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

The Cloudera IT team is looking for a talented, motivated, and passionate Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Engineering to join our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you’ll lead a multidisciplinary team of Senior Systems Engineers, Senior Platform Operations Engineers, and DevOps Engineers responsible for the availability, performance, security, scalability, and lifecycle management of a large on-premises private-cloud environment and its supporting services.


This leader owns the team’s operational and engineering outcomes, including 24x7 production support, major-incident leadership, service health, capacity and lifecycle planning, infrastructure automation, technical-debt reduction, and continual service improvement. The role establishes clear priorities and operating mechanisms that enable senior engineers to execute effectively while maintaining appropriate standards for change, risk, documentation, security, and reliability.


The Senior Manager also serves as the primary program coordinator for infrastructure initiatives that span Networking, Cloud Operations, Service Desk, Information Security, Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and Platform Engineering. The role manages interdependencies, risks, schedules, decisions, stakeholder communication, and delivery accountability across teams that may have different priorities and operating models.


As a Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Engineering you will:


  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior infrastructure, platform operations, and DevOps engineers.
  • Establish team priorities, ownership, performance expectations, career-development plans, and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Own the availability, performance, capacity, security, and lifecycle of the private-cloud environment and its supporting compute, storage, container, automation, monitoring, and recovery services.
  • Oversee 24x7 production operations, major-incident response, escalation, stakeholder communication, post-incident reviews, and corrective actions.
  • Lead cross-functional infrastructure programs involving Networking, Cloud Operations, Service Desk, Information Security, Software Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, and external vendors.
  • Develop integrated project plans, manage dependencies and risks, resolve resource conflicts, and communicate status and decisions to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Monitor ServiceNow incident, request, problem, and change queues; establish processes for assignment, prioritization, escalation, aging, and closure quality.
  • Build dashboards, review cadences, and continual-improvement plans that improve SLA compliance, backlog health, response times, and service quality.
  • Advance infrastructure-as-code, automation, configuration standards, peer review, testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
  • Direct capacity planning, platform upgrades, vulnerability remediation, disaster-recovery readiness, technical-debt reduction, and hardware and software lifecycle planning.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to define platform roadmaps, operational-readiness requirements, support models, and service-level objectives.
  • Use operational, delivery, capacity, and risk data to prioritize investments and improve service reliability.

What You'll Bring (Required Qualifications):


  • Significant experience leading infrastructure engineering, platform operations, cloud operations, DevOps, or site-reliability teams in a large production environment.
  • Demonstrated success managing and developing senior technical professionals, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and workforce planning.
  • Experience owning business-critical services, 24x7 support functions, on-call operations, and major-incident response.
  • Strong program-management skills with experience coordinating multiple interdependent initiatives across technical and business teams.
  • Experience implementing operational processes for incident, request, problem, change, service-level, and continual-improvement management.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform to manage queues, workflows, dashboards, SLAs, and operational reporting.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, Kubernetes, OpenStack or comparable private-cloud technologies, networking, storage, observability, infrastructure as code, and Terraform.
  • Ability to evaluate technical architecture, operational risk, capacity, implementation plans, and engineering tradeoffs without acting as the team’s primary hands-on engineer.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical issues, risk, and delivery status to engineers and executives.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience operating OpenStack and Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Familiarity with Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform, including hybrid- and multi-cloud operating models.
  • Experience with Terraform, configuration-management tools, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, policy as code, and automated infrastructure testing.
  • Experience defining service-level indicators, service-level objectives, operational-level agreements, and reliability metrics.
  • Experience with capacity forecasting, disaster-recovery testing, vulnerability management, infrastructure lifecycle planning, and vendor management.
  • Familiarity with ITIL service-management practices and certifications such as ITIL, PMP, or PgMP.
  • Relevant technical certifications in Kubernetes, OpenStack, Linux, Terraform, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

This role is not eligible for immigration support or relocation.

Role Summary
The Senior Analyst, Strategic Finance will support the IPA’s financial and strategic objectives by leveraging medical claims and financial data to deepen understanding of patient populations, utilization patterns, and network performance. This role will partner closely with clinical, network, operations, and leadership teams to deliver data-driven insights and recommendations that improve performance, support value-based care initiatives, and lower the total cost of care across the IPA.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze medical claims data to evaluate utilization patterns, cost drivers, quality performance, and population health trends across attributed member populations
  • Assess provider and network performance, including variation in utilization, cost, and outcomes, to support network strategy and provider engagement efforts
  • Support value-based care and risk-based arrangements by analyzing financial performance against benchmarks, targets, and capitation assumptions
  • Perform financial analysis, which includes ROI assessments, cost-benefit analysis, and variance analysis to enhance strategic decision-making
  • Develop financial models and reporting to support strategic initiatives, including network optimization, care management programs, and contract performance

  • 2–4 years of experience in healthcare analytics, financial analysis, consulting, or a related role, preferably in an IPA, health plan, MSO, or provider organization

  • Strong experience working with medical claims data and understanding drivers of utilization, cost, and quality in value-based care models
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel; Proficiency in SQL, Databricks, or similar data analytics platforms; experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) preferred
  • Solid understanding of risk-based contracting, capitation, and total cost of care concepts

Knowledge of integration with SAP Sales and Distribution module (for Billing and Revenue recognition) is a must Proficiency in creating queries or reports for AR related reporting Strong experience with IDoc processing and working knowledge of BAPI’s & BADI’s Experience with Project Systems configuration will be a plus Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Subject matter expert in SAP Financials including FI (Finance) and Serrala (Cash Application) Excellent verbal and written communications skills Strong self-starter and self-directed worker Excellent interpersonal, influencing and negotiation skills. jobs.description:
About Voyagu

Voyagu is a travel technology company building and scaling premium travel businesses. We combine experienced travel teams with technology and practical operational support to make the travel industry work better for both customers and the people serving them.

Our Travel Organization has around 100 people and is growing. We are looking for someone who can help that growth run smoothly behind the scenes.

The role

We need a hands-on People Operations Manager who brings order to the full employee journey — from joining the company to leaving it. You will make everyday administration reliable, help managers follow formal performance procedures, and make it easier to understand how new hires progress over time.

This is not a role focused on writing HR strategies or running culture programs. You will own practical problems, build better processes, and see the results of your work.

What you will do

Keep employee administration running smoothly. Coordinate contracts, payroll information, employee records, employment changes, onboarding paperwork and exits. Work with Finance and other teams to make sure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Keep performance procedures on track. HelpManagers complete formal warnings, performance improvement plans (PIPs) and exits correctly. Prepare and track documents, deadlines, checkpoints and approvals. Managers make performance decisions and have employee conversations; you make sure the supporting process works.

Track what happens to new hires. Connect information from Recruitment, Sales, Operations and HR so we can see how each hiring group progresses through onboarding, their first months of production and beyond. Help us understand retention, early departures and differences between offices.

Improve the system. Fix repetitive administrative problems, establish simple workflows and checklists, and automate tasks where practical. Make the company easier to run as the team grows.

Who you will work with

You will work closely with the CEO to provide a clear view of people-related trends and issues across the organization; with Heads of Sales Offices to keep onboarding, employee changes and performance procedures running smoothly; and with Team Leaders on documentation and required steps. You will also partner with Recruitment, Operations, Data and Finance.

Managers and Leaders remain responsible for their teams, coaching and commercial results. Your job is to help them operate effectively, not to manage their employees for them.

What we are looking for

  • Around 5+ years of hands-on HR Operations, People Operations or similar experience (relevant achievements matter more than years).
  • Experience in a growing organization with regular hiring, onboarding and employee departures.
  • Practical knowledge of contracts, payroll coordination, employee records and offboarding.
  • Direct experience supporting formal warnings, PIPs or comparable performance procedures.
  • Strong organization skills, attention to detail and the confidence to follow up with busy managers.
  • Comfort working with spreadsheets, HR systems and employee data.
  • Examples of processes you personally improved or automated.
  • Strong written and spoken English, sound judgment and discretion.

Experience in fast-growing technology, fintech, customer operations, BPO or contact centers is a plus. Experience supporting remote teams is also useful.

What makes you a great fit

You take ownership, follow through, and notice problems before they turn into emergencies. You are calm in sensitive situations, confident enough to challenge a manager when something is missing, and practical enough to choose a simple solution over unnecessary bureaucracy. You enjoy turning scattered information and manual work into clear, repeatable processes.

Why join Voyagu

You will have the opportunity to build and improve how a growing travel-tech business operates. Your work will directly reduce friction for employees and managers, improve the reliability of important procedures, and give leaders better visibility into how their teams are growing.

If you enjoy making complicated operations simple and reliable, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
ION is looking for a Director of Accounts to own end-to-end account management and partner success across HIP and Neon Canvas, including retention, expansion, and renewals, service standards, and partner support and onboarding, for a large portfolio of dental and orthodontic practices. If you've led an account function at scale, unified two brands under one operating model, and want a seat where you set the standard instead of following one, we want to talk to you.

This is not a day-to-day account management role.

The best fit has run an account management or partner success function at a similarly sized agency or recurring-revenue business, owning a book of business across 500+ accounts, and has personally run two brands or service models under one umbrella on a single operating standard. You won't carry a day-to-day book; your Team Leads, Practice Growth Advisors, and Account Managers own those relationships. Your job is to lead the leaders, set the strategy, own the numbers, and keep HIP and Neon Canvas partners staying and growing.

As Director of Accounts, you'll lead the account teams across both brands (Practice Growth Advisors at HIP, Account Managers at Neon Canvas) through a Senior and Team Lead ladder, run both under one consistent standard without blending their distinct service models, and own gross and net revenue retention, expansion and renewals, and the efficiency of the function. You'll also own innovation for the seat, making the account teams leaders in AI adoption for risk detection, call prep, and follow-up. You'll report to the COO and sit on the senior leadership team.

If you're a leader of leaders who thinks in playbooks, margin, and what's next, this role was built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own gross and net revenue retention across HIP and Neon Canvas, with net revenue retention as your number to move.
  • Own upsell, upgrade, and renewals across both books, including the growth path between the two brands and cross-sell of each brand's services into the other's book.
  • Run both account teams under one pod structure, servicing standards, and scorecards, without blending their distinct service models.
  • Diagnose churn at the portfolio level and fix the pattern behind it, instead of saving accounts one at a time.
  • Own the escalation path and internal response standards, and serve as the final escalation point before the COO or Founders.
  • Own the servicing standard end-to-end (monthly partner calls, logging, follow-up, and outreach to non-responsive partners), backed by playbooks, scorecards, and QA.
  • Lead Partner Support and Onboarding, and shape what it owns so tactical work moves off the account teams, and every new partner starts strong.
  • Own the hiring bar, the ladder (Account Manager, Senior, Team Lead), book-load standards, and variable comp tied to real benchmarks; make the promotion, development, and exit decisions that follow.
  • Partner with Finance on account-team efficiency and how retention connects to margin.
  • Lead AI adoption across the account teams, tools, workflows, and training, and set the standard for safe, high-quality use so speed never comes at the cost of client trust.
  • Run 1:1s with each Team Lead for coaching, scorecard review, and unblocking; personally work the handful of largest or highest-risk partners while the leads own the rest.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've run an account management or partner success function at a similar-size agency or recurring-revenue business, owning a book across 500-plus accounts, and can hit the ground running from day one.
  • You've personally led account teams across two brands or service models under one umbrella, and can speak to how you built one standard without flattening them into one model.
  • You're a leader of leaders, not just a leader of account managers; you know how to hire, level, coach, and hold Seniors and Team Leads accountable.
  • You think in retention rates, book loads, and scorecards, and you can spot where a portfolio is at risk before it shows up as churn.
  • You're commercially literate; expansion, renewals, payroll-to-billings, and margin aren't foreign concepts; they're how you already think about the function.
  • You're steady in the room with practice owners, leadership, and sales, and you can handle hard conversations or escalations with confidence.
  • You're genuinely AI-forward; you've put real AI workflows in your team's hands, not just followed the trend.
  • You hold your Team Leads to a high bar because you hold yourself to one.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

  • 3+ years as a Director of Accounts, Partner Success, or equivalent at an agency or recurring-revenue business of similar size and scope, managing a book across 500+ accounts.
  • Direct experience running account or success teams across two brands or service models under one umbrella on a single operating standard.
  • 6+ years in account management, client success, or partner success, including 3+ years leading people; dental, orthodontic, or healthcare experience is a plus.
  • 2+ years leading other managers (Seniors or Team Leads), not only individual account managers.
  • A portfolio-level retention track record (GRR and NRR) you can put numbers to, including an expansion, upsell, or renewal number you carried and hit.
  • Experience setting performance benchmarks and running variable compensation against them.
  • Proven change-management ability and experience standardizing two teams.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

COMPENSATION

This role includes base pay plus variable compensation.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental Insurance
  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO eligibility after 90 days of hire (10 vacation days the first year of service, unlimited PTO starting year two, flexible partial days, and sick/ personal days)
  • Remote position (You MUST be located in the US.)

SCHEDULE

  • 8 am- 5 pm CST
  • Monday to Friday

jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We're looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager for Network Infrastructure. This is not a "make slides, chase tickets, and ask engineers for status" job. It is a role for someone with an engineering skeleton: a person who has built, operated, broken and recovered things, and can earn trust in a room full of SREs, SWEs, network engineers, security and platform teams. We are at the early stage of our APAC expansion, so you will work with a high degree of independence, set up the project management practices for the region from scratch, and stay close to the technical details yourself.

The "T" matters. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every area, but you should be technical enough to understand real trade-offs: why rollback is not optional, why "just automate it" can create a bigger blast radius, why a provisioning flow must survive real-world constraints, why SLOs without ownership are decoration, and why network device CI/CD is very different from deploying a stateless service. You can read a design doc, challenge missing assumptions, notice unclear failure modes, ask sharp questions, and turn a vague but important problem into an executable plan.

The "P" is project delivery with a product mindset, even if the product is internal infrastructure. Your product may be a site bootstrap kit, secrets and robot-user management, an SLO framework, a firmware rollout process, a network observability platform, CI/CD for network devices, or automation that makes day-0 and day-N operations safe. The job is not done when the technical pieces exist. It is done when engineers trust the tool, the NOC actually uses the workflow, alerts are actionable, runbooks are real, and the new way becomes the default way. That means adoption, communication, documentation, feedback loops, and sometimes a bit of internal "marketing": the ability to convince smart technical people that the thing is worth using.

The "M" is management of execution, not people management. You will not be responsible for engineers' careers, performance reviews or promotions. You will be responsible for making important cross-team initiatives land: defining scope, aligning owners, exposing risks, driving decisions, tracking dependencies, creating clarity where things are unclear, and making sure we ship useful outcomes instead of collecting half-finished initiatives.

This is a high-leverage role in a early-stage and fast-scaling network infrastructure organisation. Many important systems are being built now: automation, observability, reliability standards, provisioning flows, operational safety, and cross-site consistency. You won't be maintaining a mature machine from the sidelines. You'll help shape how the machine works.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of cross-team network infrastructure initiatives in APAC, from a vague problem statement to an executable plan to adoption
  • Define scope and success criteria, align owners across SRE, SWE, network, security, platform and data center teams, and drive decisions to closure
  • Review designs and technical proposals, challenge missing assumptions, and surface failure modes, dependencies and risks early

  • Drive adoption: make sure tools and workflows become the default way of working, with real documentation, runbooks and feedback loops
  • Establish and run lightweight, effective project management practices for the region: planning, prioritization, reviews, and post-launch follow-up
  • Work with regional teams and external partners (vendors, carriers) on the rollout of new network capabilities
  • Turn operational pain and engineering input into a clear, prioritized backlog

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical project management, engineering management or a hands-on engineering role (SRE, SWE, network or infrastructure), with a track record of delivering complex cross-team infrastructure projects
  • A real engineering background: you have built and operated production systems and can earn the trust of deeply technical teams
  • Ability to read design docs and technical proposals, understand trade-offs, and ask sharp questions about reliability, rollback, blast radius and failure modes
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure fundamentals (Linux, networking, automation, CI/CD) at the level needed to hold your own in technical discussions
  • Proven ability to drive decisions and create clarity in ambiguous, fast-changing environments without formal authority
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documenting plans and decisions and influencing smart technical people
  • Ability to work independently in an early-stage environment and to build processes from scratch
  • Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) and comfort working across time zones

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with network infrastructure: network automation, observability, or network device lifecycle management
  • Experience with SLO/SLI frameworks, incident management, or production readiness processes
  • Experience with CI/CD or change management for network or other high-blast-radius infrastructure
  • Experience delivering projects with distributed teams across APAC time zones
  • Experience with secrets and access management, firmware rollout or fleet-wide operational initiatives
  • Hands-on engineering contributions (scripts, tooling, automation) alongside project work

Examples of initiatives you may own:

  • A user and secrets management system for network infrastructure, including robot-user lifecycle, safe key/password rotation, revocation, break-glass access, mixed agent/push-based device support, and integration with existing secrets backends
  • An SLO framework for network services and components, including SLIs, SLOs, dashboards, alerts, ownership, tiering, and a clear link between reliability targets and engineering investment
  • CI/CD for network devices, where configuration changes, validation, staged rollout, rollback, and blast-radius control become disciplined and repeatable instead of manual and risky
  • Fleet-wide operational initiatives such as firmware consistency, device lifecycle hygiene, observability coverage, monitoring quality, alert ownership, or production readiness for new network capabilities

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Fraud Specialist, Supplier Operations & Governance (P4).

About the job

We are actively recruiting for this role to fill an existing vacancy. This position will be responsible for working constructively with our customers and partners to resolve billing issues and fraudulent misuse of services.

We are seeking a sharp, highly data-oriented, and tenacious Fraud Specialist to join our team. Unlike a traditional billing or collections role focused on routine outreach or simple invoice review, this position is a hybrid of financial investigation, root cause analysis, and strategic dispute negotiation. In this role, you will look for billing discrepancies, investigate Artificially Inflated Traffic (AIT) or IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud), dig deep into messaging and call data, project manage high-value customer and vendor disputes, and build data-backed cases to resolve discrepancies. You will build dashboards to communicate key metrics and drive action. If you love solving complex data puzzles, negotiating with external parties, and finding win-win outcomes, this is the role for you.

You will be part of a company that is the category leader in Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS), an organization working with the largest customers and partners, and a team of operators and former consultants that have delivered exceptional impact. If you have an extreme owner / founder mindset and a desire to solve big challenges, you’ll find yourself at home.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Advise account managers, accounting, and management on best practices to handle billing disputes
  • Negotiate with customers and carriers with an understanding of resolution levers available as per contractual terms and industry norms
  • Identify, analyze, and handle fraudulent misuse (such as Artificially Inflated Traffic) and billing errors (such as rate differences) with both vendors and customers
  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer and vendor disputes from intake of disputes to initiating disputes, tracking progress, and ensuring timely, documented resolution
  • Uncover and resolve discrepancies, overcharges, and unpaid balances with carriers and customers due to quantities, rates, currency, and other root causes
  • Dig into call and messaging data to identify why bills don’t match or find evidence of fraud
  • Build dashboards that communicate key metrics related to the lifecycle of disputes
  • Read contracts and interpret what should be the invoice versus what it is
  • Act as the primary point of contact to negotiate dispute resolutions, settlements, and payment terms in accordance with company practices
  • Partner closely with data analytics, engineering, and accounting to reconcile accounts

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in telecom operations, fraud operations, customer success, vendor management, procurement, collections, or consulting.
  • Sharp written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience negotiating disputes constructively with customers or vendors.
  • Experience in collections, dispute resolution, or billing analysis.
  • Experience in project management.
  • Experience wrangling data with Excel / Google Sheets, Looker or SQL.

Desired:

  • Understanding of the A2P SMS ecosystem, international traffic routing, international revenue share fraud (IRSF), artificially inflated traffic (AIT) and the ecosystem profit chains.
  • Understanding of industry standards with respect to AIT and fraud handling such as frameworks from i3forum, GSMA, MEF or ITW Global Leaders’ Forum.
  • Understanding of Call Detail Records (CDRs) and ability to build strong dispute case files.
  • Experience working with workflow platforms like Airtable or building dashboards.
  • Experience in telecom, technology, or consulting industries.
  • Experience with advanced data analysis like Python or scripting
  • Experience with AI and automation tools to accelerate productivity.

Location

This role will be remote and based in Ontario, British Columbia or Alberta, Canada.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • 90,800.00 - CAD 113,500.00
  • Target Bonus Percentage 15%

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.
