We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Position: VP of Campaigns

Department: Advocacy, Strategic Programs

Reports to: Executive Chief of Staff

Supervises: Director of Organizing

FLSA Status: Exempt, Full-Time

Union Status: Not eligible for the bargaining unit

Location: Remote, near a major airport; See below for more

Salary: $146,000 - $163,000

About Us

Advocates for Trans Equality fights for the legal and political rights of transgender people in America. Leveraging decades of experience on the frontlines of power, we shift government and society towards a future where we are no less than equal. Founded in 2024, Advocates for Trans Equality was formed through an alliance by two national trans advocacy organizations and is of, for, and by the trans community. Advocates for Trans Equality (501c4) and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund (501c3) focuses its efforts on political and legal advocacy, public education, and community engagement. The Advocates for Trans Equality team catalyzes progress from the inside out and will settle for nothing less than equality for trans people in America. Advocates for Trans Equality and Advocates for Trans Equality Education Fund are incorporated in Washington, DC with offices in DC and New York and employ approximately 40 dedicated staff who share office space and work across the country.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Campaigns is responsible for developing, managing and executing state and federal ballot measure, public education, and advocacy campaigns in partnership with departments of Policy, Legal, Organizing, and Public Education.

The Vice President of Campaigns creates campaign engagement criteria, conducts campaign assessments, and makes recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments. They also coordinate A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns, monitor and keep the full team regularly appraised on developments, and serve as the lead on priority campaigns as needed.

Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop a thoughtful, strategic, coordinated campaign and ballot strategy on behalf of A4TE to address urgent, emerging ballot measures at the state level that have the potential to significantly impact transgender people in the 2026-2028 electoral cycles and beyond.
  • Work with A4TE leadership to execute A4TE’s ballot strategy in a manner to ensure such efforts are compliant with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and to protect the charitable statuses of A4TE and A4TEEF.
  • Serve as A4TE’s primary external contact and thought partner to LGBTQ+ movement partner organizations for coordination around advocacy strategy tactics influencing ballot issue work and electoral engagement, among other areas of advocacy.
  • Manage, cultivate, and inspire the leadership of the Organizing Director, who oversees A4TE’s organizing team. Support the transition of such organizing from predominantly mobilization techniques to deeper field organizing work in service of state needs, particularly around ballot issues. Support GOTV educational work as part of overall campaign strategy.
  • Support coordination of A4TE’s work on ballot measures impacting trans people, including how that work intersects with the work of other national partners. Serve as the primary A4TE representative working to support efforts in defeating anti-trans ballot measures in 2026 and beyond.
  • Oversee federal and state public education and advocacy campaigns, including creating and maintaining assessment criteria to determine priority campaigns and engagement in rapid response contexts, making recommendations about A4TE’s priorities and investments, developing and implementing successful strategies, advising and supporting organizational partners, and coordinating A4TE’s cross-team engagement in campaigns.
  • Keep A4TE team regularly apprised of developments on campaign-specific public education and advocacy efforts.
  • Work with consultants, lobbyists, organizational partners, and state and local leaders to help defeat discriminatory anti-trans ballot measures and advance pro-trans ballot measures. Determine and recommend prioritization of such campaigns and what role A4TE should serve in such campaigns, if any.
  • Manage, support, and ensure accountability of campaign consultants, including both existing teams and the cultivation of new consultant teams in states where work is not currently underway.
  • Contribute to fundraising efforts necessary to raise capital for campaign activities.
  • Work with the Organizing, Policy, Strategic Communications, and Public Education departments to drive public education and advocacy victories.
  • Travel to campaign sites as needed.
  • Work cross departmentally to ensure the effective delivery of latest messaging and research to legislative leaders, organizational partners, key constituencies, and allies.

Required Qualifications

A4TE Education Fund acknowledges that applicants from communities that have been historically marginalized are less likely to apply for positions unless they feel that they completely meet all qualifications listed in a job description. We understand that an ideal candidate might not completely meet the criteria listed above or be equally proficient in each area; we especially encourage applicants who are impacted by A4TE’s work to submit their application anyway.

  • Leadership Experience: A minimum of 6 years of experience in a leadership role. Demonstrated management experience, including the ability to coach team members using tested management techniques, emotional intelligence, and good judgement.
  • Ballot Experience: A strong working knowledge of and demonstrated success in advancing ballot campaigns. Deep understanding of how policy, legal, organizing, communications, fundraising, messaging, compliance, and other interests intersect within a given ballot campaign, and demonstrated ability to strategically coordinate these elements.
  • Compliance Experience: A working knowledge of 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), PAC, and ballot legal compliance. Demonstrated ability to pull in experts, partners and/or legal counsel when necessary to support organizational compliance efforts. Ability to exhibit good judgement for advancing complex and legally compliant strategies to successfully engage in ballot campaign work.
  • Political Experience: A strong working knowledge of the role politics plays within an overarching advocacy framework, including familiarity with campaign cycles, partisanship, and the role of politics in moving the Overton Window on a given issue.
  • Organizational Experience: Direct experience with diverse social justice, government, organizing, and/or movement building organizations. Demonstrated ability to bring partners with diverse missions together around a common goal.
  • Understanding of Transgender Justice: A deep and nuanced understanding of issues affecting transgender people as well as an understanding of how racism, classism, sexism, and other systems of inter-connected oppressions affect trans people. Strong belief in A4TE’s mission and the people who are driving the work forward. A strong commitment and desire to moving the Overton Window on trans issues over the next 5-10 years.
  • Communication Skills: Effective verbal and written skills to communicate complex policies and procedures to ensure staff have the information needed for their position responsibilities and overall organizational workflow; ability to listen to staff concerns and feedback to assist in working together for solutions that comply with organizational policies. Ability to understand organizational needs to communicate with those outside of the organization.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in all areas of MS Office 365 and collaborative tools, such as Slack, Asana, and Zoom. Experience with policy software, such as PolicyNote, BillTracker50, or similar product. Experience with organizing and campaign tools, such as NGP VAN, EveryAction, or similar products.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

  • Leadership Experience: 6-8 years’ experience in a management role, such as a Field Director, Campaign Director or Political Director
  • Campaign Experience: 8-10 years’ experience in traditional field organizing, preferably in ballot measures, advocacy campaigns, or political campaigns.
  • Geographic Location: Remote but located near a major airport. Based in the Midwest, South, Southwest, or Central United States, which are areas most impacted and forecasted to be impacted by anti-trans state policies and ballot campaigns. Ability and willingness to travel to states where field and campaign organizing support is necessary.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluency or proficiency in a language other than English, especially Spanish.
  • Technological Knowledge: Experience in using FileVine, FiscalNote, or other legal and policy database tools.

Traits of Successful Candidates

  • Trustworthy & Collaborative: Excellent relationship and trust building capabilities and a demonstrated track record building, leading, and managing teams; serving as a coach and mentor to staff across a range of areas. An earned reputation for being trustworthy, with excellent judgment and discretion. Kindness and strengths-based leadership: someone who sees value in every person and communicates respect and encouragement to people at all levels; a passionate investment in the well-being and success of staff. A willingness to accept input and feedback from colleagues at all levels of the organization.
  • Responsive Problem-Solving Skills: Agile project management skills, ability to develop and implement new strategies and procedures, and meet multiple competing deadlines.
  • Self-Direction: Initiative and ambition to ensure that all projects are moving forward. Ability to adapt as needed, self-manage, and prioritize between and manage multiple demands.
  • Optimism: A positive and productive attitude to problem-solving within the context of intense social justice work. Optimistic and resourceful, with strong self-awareness, cultural competence, emotional intelligence, and humility; grounded and flexible with a high degree of integrity and transparency.
  • Strength and Persistence: The ability to be exposed to transphobia and other kinds of discrimination or stress on a daily basis and keep fighting hard for transgender equality.

As a Customer Enablement Manager (CEM), you will build strong relationships with your portfolio of customers and ensure they onboard successfully, adopt consistently, operate confidently and realize meaningful outcomes from their investment.

You will work alongside Senior Customer Enablement Managers and the broader CX team in helping customers onboard successfully, adopt consistently, operate confidently and realize meaningful outcomes from their investment. This role is designed to flex across multiple customer engagements rather than owning a dedicated portfolio.

Your work will help drive customer satisfaction, system utilization, risk mitigation, and ultimately successful subscription renewals.

What are performance outcomes over the first 12 months you will work toward completing?

First 30–90 Days:

  • Become fully competent in Evolv’s products, workflows, and enablement methodology.
    Training includes in-person technical instruction at HQ, online self-study, structured learning paths, and peer shadowing.
  • Learn the CX operating model (onboarding, enablement, training, adoption, renewal readiness, customer health).
  • Build relationships with Sales, Program Management, Support, Technical Sales & Solutions, Channel Operations, and Marketing to understand customer history, deployment context, and value drivers.
  • Begin engaging with customers - supporting onboarding activities, training preparation, and early adoption.

3-6 Months:

  • Contribute to day-to-day customer onboarding, training and value-realization activities across the install base, ensuring progress towards key outcomes.
  • Deliver virtual and onsite training sessions covering system operation, best practices, and Evolv Academy learning paths.
  • Begin developing baseline success plans for your accounts that focus on adoption, learning milestones, and operational excellence.

6-12 Months:

  • Fully own your customer portfolio, including onboarding new customers, building proactive success plans, and driving adoption of learning resources such as Evolv Academy, MyEvolv Portal, and other customer platforms
  • Monitor customer health, usage signals, and feedback to identify risks early and mitigate them through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Lead regular performance reviews and business value conversations using customer dashboards (visitor scans, alerts, detections, engagement metrics).
  • Manage a smooth renewal readiness process by ensuring strong adoption, value realization, and risk reduction.

1+ year:

  • Be recognized as a strategic customer advocate with deep account relationships across accounts.
  • Maintain an internal network of cross-functional partners you can pull in to accelerate customer outcomes.
  • Consistently deliver measurable impact across your accounts—including improved system usage, reduced friction, higher training completion, and strong renewal rates.
  • Operate independently while driving scalable improvements to the broader customer enablement program.

The Work: What type of work will you be doing?

As a Customer Enablement Manager, your regular activities may be modified to suit the needs of your customer portfolio, however, you can expect a variety of the following:

Customer Onboarding & Training

  • Customer onboarding, and go-live activities with Program Management, TSS, and Support.
  • Deliver structured training sessions (onsite and virtual) tailored to each customer’s operational environment.
  • Ensure customers complete the right Evolv Academy learning paths and certifications.

Customer Adoption & Value Realization

  • Build and execute proactive success plans to drive consistent system usage, optimized detection performance, and operator confidence.
  • Continuously guide customers to evolve their workflows, staffing, and operating procedures to maximize value.
  • Promote adoption of MyEvolv, training content, and all customer enablement resources.
  • Conduct scheduled check-ins, performance reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

Customer Health & Risk Management

  • Work with Red Accounts team to identify at-risk accounts and help develop get-well plans to get them in good health
  • Coordinate with Support, Technical Sales & Solutions and other teams to ensure escalations are handled promptly
  • Maintain clean, accurate CRM documentation including contacts, milestones, health scores and renewal context.

Renewal Readiness & Growth Support

  • Proactively identify and engage the appropriate customer stakeholder’s day-to-day champions, operational owners, and economic buyers to ensure each clearly understands and is realizing the full value of their Evolv investment.
  • Lead the enablement workstream that ensures customers achieve the outcomes required for renewal, including validating success criteria with decision-makers, reinforcing business value with champions, and ensuring all stakeholders are informed, trained, and confident in their ability to operate and sustain their systems.
  • Minimize renewal friction by driving strong adoption, ensuring operators are well trained, and clearly demonstrating ongoing business value.

What is the leadership like for this role? What is the structure and culture of the team?

This role reports to the Senior Scaled Program Manager and sits on our Customer Experience team in the Revenue Organization.

The team is distributed across the United States and is entering an exciting phase of growth, with many new opportunities ahead. Most team members work remotely when they are not traveling to meet with customers. Our collective experience is exceptional spanning technical experts to seasoned business leaders with firsthand customer-facing expertise.

Location:

This is a remote position based in the Northeast, ideally near Boston, Providence, Hartford, New York City/Northern New Jersey, or Philadelphia. We are also open to exceptional candidates elsewhere in the Northeast with convenient access to transportation to support regional travel.

Travel:
Travel will vary based on customer engagement, trade shows, and your territory strategy, and may reach 25–30% of your time. Because some customer operations run outside normal business hours, flexibility for occasional nights, weekends, and holidays may be required.

We're helping a rapidly growing healthcare AI company find a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to lead the technical delivery of AI agent deployments for major healthcare organizations across the United States.

The company has a reported valuation of $1.6 billion and doubled its revenue last year. Its customers include some of the largest health systems, healthcare providers, health insurers, and pharmaceutical organizations in the country.

This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial, technically versatile engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with customer-facing leadership. You'll own complex enterprise engagements from initial discovery and solution design through implementation and post-launch support, working directly with executive stakeholders while helping shape the company's AI platform and product roadmap.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer with 5–15 years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy production-grade AI agent systems for sophisticated healthcare clients.

In this role, you'll operate at the intersection of software engineering, AI, healthcare technology, and enterprise consulting. You'll translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, integrate AI systems with existing healthcare infrastructure, and take ownership of delivery across the entire client engagement lifecycle.

You'll work independently, make critical architectural decisions, and collaborate with healthcare executives, technical teams, and internal product leaders. You'll also bring insights from customer deployments back into the core platform, helping develop reusable components and influence future product development.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end client engagements: Lead technical delivery from pre-sales demonstrations and requirements gathering through solution design, integration, implementation, and post-launch support.
  • Architect and build AI agent systems: Design and deploy production-ready AI applications that integrate with complex healthcare systems, including EHR/EMR platforms, claims systems, specialty pharmacy infrastructure, and CRMs.
  • Lead technical client sessions: Facilitate working sessions, present technical solutions, and communicate effectively with C-suite executives and other senior stakeholders at major healthcare organizations.
  • Make independent architectural decisions: Take ownership of system design, technology selection, integration strategy, and technical problem-solving, often operating as the primary engineer on an engagement.
  • Build production software: Develop reliable, scalable applications and integrations using modern programming languages, cloud infrastructure, and AI technologies.
  • Work with healthcare data: Build data pipelines and ingestion systems that process structured and unstructured data, support machine learning workflows, and meet applicable healthcare privacy and security requirements.
  • Influence product development: Translate lessons from client deployments into platform improvements, reusable components, and product capabilities that support future implementations.
  • Drive customer outcomes: Remain accountable for the technical quality, reliability, and business impact of multimillion-dollar enterprise engagements.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5–15 years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in building and delivering production software systems.
  • Experience owning full technical delivery for enterprise clients, including pre-sales support, requirements gathering, solution scoping, implementation, integration, and post-launch support.
  • Experience building and deploying customer-facing software systems end-to-end through production engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.
  • Healthcare or life sciences domain expertise, particularly in patient services, specialty pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, clinical operations, health insurance, or HIPAA-related compliance.
  • Ability to design end-to-end system architectures and produce clear, comprehensive architecture diagrams.
  • Strong client-facing communication and professional presence, with the ability to lead technical sessions and present solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives.
  • Fluency in modern programming languages and frameworks, including JavaScript, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, Next.js, and React.
  • Experience building data and machine learning pipelines, including ETL/ELT workflows, document ingestion, unstructured data processing, PySpark, or predictive modeling.
  • Experience deploying production applications and managing cloud infrastructure using AWS, GCP, or comparable platforms.
  • An entrepreneurial, ownership-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, make decisions under pressure, and take accountability for complex client engagements.
  • Existing authorization to work in the United States without requiring visa sponsorship or transfer.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience as a founding engineer, startup co-founder, startup CTO, or software engineer at a high-growth startup.
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-powered systems or AI agents, including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, guardrails, and observability.
  • Formal machine learning or internal data science experience on healthcare-related projects.
  • Experience integrating AI systems with EHR/EMR platforms, claims infrastructure, specialty pharmacy systems, healthcare CRMs, or other enterprise healthcare applications.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, and security requirements for production software.
  • Experience building scalable data infrastructure, ETL/ELT pipelines, and document-processing workflows for complex enterprise datasets.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSockets, vector stores, LLM orchestration, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini.
  • Experience presenting architecture decisions and technical recommendations to executive stakeholders at large enterprises.

Benefits

  • Base Salary: $170,000–$205,000 per year.
  • On-Target Earnings (OTE): $190,000–$240,000 per year.
  • Equity: Competitive equity opportunity.
  • Remote Work: Work remotely within the United States, with a preference for Eastern or Central time zones.
  • Quarterly Team Offsites: Opportunities to collaborate in person with the team in New York.
  • High-Impact Enterprise Work: Build AI solutions for some of the largest healthcare organizations in the country.
  • Technical Ownership: Lead complex deployments and make meaningful architectural decisions across enterprise AI implementations.
  • Product Influence: Directly influence the core AI platform and product roadmap through real-world client deployments.
  • Career Growth: Work at the intersection of healthcare, AI, enterprise software, and technical consulting within a rapidly growing company.

Prescryptive is the healthcare technology company enabling the direct access marketplace for prescription drugs. Our platform aligns incentives so affordability, choice, and patient access become the natural outcome of a functioning system. Learn more about us by following us on LinkedIn or visiting .


The Role

We're looking for a Director, Product (Pharmacy Claims Platform) who brings deep experience developing pharmacy claims adjudication technology, understands how it works in a real-world PBM environment, and wants to help advance sophisticated pharmacy transaction capabilities.


This is a hands-on product leadership role with meaningful ownership of core adjudication and transaction capabilities. You'll work closely with engineering and business teams to set product direction, solve complex technical and operational challenges, and deliver reliable, scalable technology that supports our pharmacy solutions. You'll need strong product judgment, a deep understanding of the claims lifecycle, and an appreciation for how product decisions affect members, pharmacies, clients, and financial outcomes.


We're looking for more than familiarity with claims processing. You'll need direct experience leading the development, enhancement, and delivery of adjudication platform capabilities, along with a strong understanding of the operational and financial implications of how claims are processed. Experience operating these systems is a plus.


You'll report to our Chief Product Officer and work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Clinical, Finance, and other teams.

  • Own the product direction. Lead the roadmap and priorities for core pharmacy adjudication and transaction capabilities, balancing business needs, operational requirements, and technical considerations.

  • Lead through complexity. Bring together technical and business teams, resolve competing requirements, make sound tradeoffs, and drive clear decisions and accountability.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

About the Role:

About the Role: Technical Research Analyst – Upstream Asset Valuation, Africa


The Team:

With the world’s most comprehensive primary data assets, S&P Global works closely with major energy companies globally. Our data and insights support risk management, business planning, investment decisions and a deeper understanding of global energy markets.


Within Energy, we enable organizations to create long-term, sustainable value through data, research and insights that provide a comprehensive view of global energy and commodity markets.

The Africa Upstream Asset Valuation team focuses on sourcing, researching, analysing and reporting production, cost, development and asset valuation information across the African upstream sector.


This role presents a great opportunity across research and analysis to join our dynamic team and contribute to the high-quality work we deliver. The successful candidate will contribute directly to the Upstream Asset Valuation team, while also supporting the broader research, content, analysis and insights produced by the Africa team.

Responsibilities and Impact:

  • The primary responsibility of the Upstream Asset Valuation Research Analyst is to maintain, grow and enhance African upstream content within the relevant platforms. This is a hybrid technical and analytical role, combining knowledge and understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry with strong research, modelling and analytical capabilities.
  • You will develop expertise across assigned African markets and assets and will be responsible for producing asset valuations, production forecasts, cost estimates and other insights based on your research and analysis.
  • You will have the opportunity to demonstrate and further develop your client engagement skills, both internally and externally, while contributing to a broad range of research topics, analytical deliverables and client discussions.
  • As the energy industry evolves, the team is also expanding its knowledge and analysis of technologies and development concepts related to emissions reduction, operational efficiency, decarbonization and the integration of lower-carbon and renewable energy solutions into oil and gas developments.
  • This position is critical in supporting customers who subscribe to the Upstream Valuation platform and wider Upstream Intelligence services, including international and national oil and gas companies, financial institutions, equipment and service providers, and other participants across the energy value chain.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct upstream asset evaluation and research across Africa, including reserves and resource assessment, production forecasting, field development planning, cost estimation and asset valuation.
  • Model the production, development and costs of oil and gas projects across the region, including conventional, unconventional and lower-carbon developments where relevant.
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team of geologists, economists, engineers and research analysts.
  • Assess and incorporate risk and uncertainty into asset analysis and develop appropriate scenarios.
  • Conduct independent research, integrating external findings with internal datasets and technical knowledge to develop consistent, robust and insightful asset analysis.
  • Apply an understanding of regional market dynamics, operational considerations and upstream development concepts when evaluating assets and projects.
  • Monitor industry developments, company activity, project progress and other factors affecting upstream investment and development across African markets.
  • Work with large and complex datasets, ensuring consistency, accuracy and quality while extracting meaningful insights to support research and analysis.
  • Engage with clients and industry stakeholders, communicating technical concepts, assumptions, methodologies and analytical workflows in a clear and structured manner.
  • Contribute to the broader research, content and analytical insights produced by the Africa team.
  • Leverage evolving analytical and digital tools, including generative AI where appropriate, to enhance research, analysis and workflow efficiency.

What We’re Looking For:

This position requires a university degree in Petroleum Engineering, Engineering, Geology, Economics or another relevant discipline. Relevant industry experience will also be considered.

A minimum of two years of relevant experience and a good understanding of the upstream oil and gas industry are preferred. Experience working with or analysing African oil and gas markets will be considered an advantage.


The successful candidate will be fluent in English and comfortable engaging directly with industry contacts and clients to build relationships, gather information and develop market insights.

Fluency in French will be considered a significant advantage, particularly given the role’s coverage of multiple African upstream markets. Additional languages relevant to the region will also be considered an advantage.


Hands-on operational or field experience within the oil and gas industry will be highly advantageous, particularly experience that provides a practical understanding of upstream operations, field development, production, drilling or project execution.


Experience working with large and complex datasets, as well as familiarity with generative AI and other emerging digital tools used to support research, analysis and workflow efficiency, will also be highly beneficial.


Basic Required Qualifications:

  • University degree in Petroleum Engineering, Engineering, Geology, Economics or a related discipline.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English.
  • Good understanding of the upstream oil and gas sector, including field development, production, cost estimation, midstream infrastructure and regulatory considerations.
  • Strong analytical and research capabilities.
  • Working knowledge of common spreadsheet, word-processing and presentation software.
  • Ability to work with large and complex datasets and translate information into clear analytical insights.
  • Self-motivated, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision, with strong attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable engaging with internal and external stakeholders and communicating technical concepts clearly.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Fluency in French is highly desirable and will be considered a significant advantage.
  • Hands-on field, operational or technical experience within the upstream oil and gas industry is highly advantageous.
  • Previous experience with an oil and gas operating or service company, or as an upstream researcher or analyst within a research or consulting organization.
  • Experience working with or analysing upstream assets and projects across Africa.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex datasets, including data analysis, validation, interpretation and quality assurance.
  • Experience using generative AI and other digital tools to support research, data analysis, content development and workflow efficiency will be considered a significant advantage.
  • Ability to critically evaluate field development plans and production performance, with a natural curiosity and willingness to challenge assumptions.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands across research, content delivery, stakeholder requests and commercial activities.
  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar data visualization and analytical tools would be advantageous.

About S&P Global Energy
At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:


The Medical Economist is a strategic and operational leader responsible for optimizing medical cost management, driving total cost of care (TCOC) strategy, and maximizing financial performance across Commercial lines of business.

This role bridges high-level financial strategy and end-to-end operational execution by evaluating complex provider contract reimbursement models, partnering with technical and claims engineering teams to ensure accurate system configuration and adjudication, monitoring total medical expense (TME) trends, and delivering actionable intelligence to executive leadership.

We place the highest value on proven real-world experience, problem-solving ability, and operational impact. While formal education and certifications are recognized, a strong track record of navigating complex Commercial healthcare economics, contract mechanics, and data-driven execution is what truly defines success in this role.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:


Strategic Contracting & Reimbursement Architecture

  • Reimbursement Strategy & Design: Partner with Network Development and Contracting teams to design, model, and evaluate complex provider reimbursement structures across Commercial networks (e.g., FFS, DRG/APC, Ambulatory Payment Classifications, bundled payments, sub-capitation, and value-based risk agreements).
  • Contract Evaluation & Financial Modeling: Conduct rigorous pre-contract modeling and scenario analysis for fee schedules, tiering, facility contracts, and alternative payment models (APMs) to quantify micro- and macro-financial impacts prior to execution.
  • Commercial Risk & Value-Based Care: Oversee financial mechanics for Commercial value-based contracts, shared savings/risk arrangements, quality bonus pools, and provider incentive programs.

Operations, Claims Configuration & Adjudication Alignment

  • Technical Translation & Configuration Guidance: Collaborate directly with Claims, Health Plan Operations, and Engineering/IT teams to translate complex contract terms, fee schedules, and payment logic into actionable technical specifications.
  • System Adjudication Assurance: Establish continuous testing, audit, and validation frameworks alongside Claims Operations and Payment Integrity to ensure claims adjudicate strictly according to contracted intent and configuration design.
  • Leakage & Payment Integrity Oversight: Identify systemic claim adjudication defects, configuration errors, and unexpected cost leakage; drive end-to-end root-cause analysis and system remediation.

Medical Cost Analytics, Trend Identification & Intelligence

  • Commercial TME & Unit Cost Monitoring: Drive regular decomposition and reporting of Total Medical Expense (TME), isolating price (unit cost), utilization (volume), mix shifts, and intensity across inpatient, outpatient, professional, and pharmacy categories.
  • Actionable Business Intelligence: Synthesize complex clinical, claims, authorization, and financial data into proactive business intelligence, pinpointing medical cost drivers and identifying actionable cost-optimization initiatives.
  • Benchmarking & Market Dynamics: Perform competitive market benchmarks (e.g., relative to Medicare rates or regional commercial benchmarks) to identify fee schedule gaps, contracting leverage, and efficiency opportunities.

Commercial Financial Mechanics & Forecasting

  • Commercial-Specific Mechanics: Analyze and model commercial-specific cost drivers, including high-cost claimant spikes, ACA risk adjustment (HHS-HCCs), stop-loss/reinsurance recoveries, benefit design changes, and out-of-network leakage.
  • Forecasting & IBNR Collaboration: Partner with Actuarial, Finance, and Underwriting teams to inform medical loss ratio (MLR) forecasting, IBNR reserve estimates, premium rate-setting, and employer group performance reporting.
  • Clinical & Care Management ROI: Collaborate with Clinical Operations and Medical Management to evaluate the financial return on investment (ROI) and medical cost reduction impact of disease management, utilization management, and population health initiatives.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Executive Presentation: Prepare and deliver high-impact executive summaries, monthly/quarterly financial trend packages, and strategic recommendations to market leadership, the CFO, and cross-functional steering committees.

Required skills and experience:


(Hands-on experience, execution ability, and proven performance take precedence over formal degrees or professional credentials).

  • Core Industry Experience: 8+ years of hands-on, progressive experience in healthcare economics, managed care finance, or healthcare data analytics, with at least 3–5 years focused specifically on Commercial lines of business (Individual/ACA, Group, ASO/Self-Funded).
  • Applied Reimbursement Expertise: Deep, practical knowledge of Commercial reimbursement methodologies (Commercial Fee-for-Service schedules, Medicare-relative pricing, DRGs, CPT/HCPCS, Revenue Codes, APCs, ASC fee schedules, stop-loss, and Commercial risk adjustment).
  • End-to-End Contract-to-Claims Execution: Demonstrated track record of evaluating provider contract language, modeling reimbursement shifts, and actively collaborating with IT/claims teams to guide configuration and ensure accurate claim adjudication.
  • Technical & Analytical Proficiency: Direct, hands-on ability to query, manipulate, and analyze large healthcare claims datasets using tools like SQL, Python, R, SAS, or modern cloud data warehouses.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and align priorities across Network, Claims, Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Actuarial teams.
  • Strategic Communication: Strong ability to synthesize complex claims and financial data into plain-language insights and present actionable recommendations directly to executive leaders.

Desired skills and experience:


(Degrees or certifications are optional; equivalent practical experience and demonstrated capability are fully recognized in lieu of credentials).

  • Value-Based Care Execution: Direct experience designing, evaluating, or managing Commercial ACO models, bundled payment structures, and shared risk/savings arrangements.
  • Regulatory Navigation: Practical understanding of Commercial regulatory environments, including state insurance mandates, ACA guidelines, ERISA, and the No Surprises Act (NSA).
  • Dual Payer/Provider Perspective: Experience working directly within health plan operations, health systems, or provider organizations navigating managed care contracts.
  • Education / Credentials (Optional): Actuarial credentials (ASA/FSA) or advanced degrees (Master’s/MBA) are considered a bonus, but are not required where robust, relevant job experience is demonstrated.



Salary Range: $175,000-$250,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

jobs.title: Regulatory Submissions-Start Up & Contract Specialist (dual role)
jobs.excerpt: Our European activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, home-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) to join our Clinical Operations team, in Estonia.
jobs.description:
Our European activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, home-based Regulatory Submissions Coordinator & Contract Specialist (Dual role) to join our Clinical Operations team, in Estonia.

In this dual role you will have the opportunity to work within Regulatory Submissions and contract negotiations, supporting our many projects. You will be a productive member of the team and will be mentored and supported as you develop your skills. Working directly with Regulatory Submissions Coordinators and Contract Specialists, you will gain valuable hands-on experience to enable you to develop a career in clinical research.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and file initial clinical trial applications to regulatory authorities and Ethics committees in Estonia;
  • Prepare and submit responses to queries and amendments to clinical trial applications;
  • Ensure submissions comply with applicable regulations and guidance documents;
  • Advise team members on changing regulations and compliance requirements;
  • Maintain the Clinical Trial Management System and ensure timely filing of documents;
  • Collection of essential documents and preparation essential documents packages for drug release;
  • Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing agreements, termination letters or other legal documents required for a clinical study;
  • Identify and assesses legal, financial, and operational risks and escalate to appropriate Contract Lead or Contract Manager;
  • Provide recommendations and alternative resolutions throughout negotiations using established escalation channels;
  • Coordinate with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual process and mutually agreed up timelines.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required (preferably in a Life Sciences field, Business or Law);
  • Experience preparing, reviewing, and submitting regulatory documentation to Ethics Committees and Regulatory Agencies; including formulating responses to queries;
  • Relevant working experience at a CRO, Pharmaceutical Company, or an investigative site;
  • Knowledge of local regulatory guidelines and legislation;
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills;
  • Use to work independently with a proactive approach;
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office;
  • Fluency in Estonian and English
  • Great attention to detail and excellent oral and written communication skills.

We kindly ask to submit applications in English.



Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

jobs.title: Senior Director, IT/Tech Procurement
jobs.excerpt: About this JobThis position will develop and execute Global Technology and IT Procurement strategies in close partnership with the Head of Procurement, CTO and CTO leadership team, Finance, Legal, Security and other key business stakeholders.
jobs.description:
About this Job

This position will develop and execute Global Technology and IT Procurement strategies in close partnership with the Head of Procurement, CTO and CTO leadership team, Finance, Legal, Security and other key business stakeholders.

The role will have responsibility for developing category and sub-category strategies across the Technology portfolio, which may include enterprise software and SaaS, cloud and infrastructure, IT professional services, telecommunications, hardware, data and analytics, and emerging technologies including AI.

This leader will manage complex global sourcing and negotiation initiatives, optimize the organization's technology spend and commercial models, and build strategic relationships with critical technology suppliers.

The position will go beyond traditional sourcing and contract negotiation by partnering with Technology leadership on demand management, license and consumption optimization, supplier consolidation, application rationalization, commercial model optimization and technology roadmap decisions.

The role will establish value creation targets, supplier performance measures and governance for strategic technology partners while proactively identifying opportunities to reduce cost, mitigate risk, improve contractual flexibility and enable innovation.

Responsibilities

Technology Category Strategy:

  • Develop and execute global category and sub-category strategies across the Technology and IT portfolio
  • Develop a holistic understanding of technology spend, demand, supplier landscape, contractual commitments and future technology requirements
  • Partner closely with the CTO organization and senior technology leaders to align sourcing strategies with the company's technology roadmap and business priorities
  • Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, application rationalization, license optimization, demand management and alternative technology solutions
  • Analyze technology market trends, supplier economics, commercial models and industry benchmarks to inform sourcing and negotiation strategies
  • Challenge existing specifications, consumption levels, licensing models and supplier relationships to improve overall value
  • Develop and present category strategies and business cases to senior executive stakeholders
  • Lead competitive sourcing processes, including RFIs, RFPs and complex global technology negotiations
  • Develop multi-year sourcing strategies for strategic and high-spend technology suppliers
  • Ensure commercial options, risks, trade-offs and recommendations are clearly communicated to executive stakeholders

Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation:

  • Develop comprehensive negotiation strategies for major technology agreements and renewals
  • Lead complex global negotiations involving software licensing, SaaS subscriptions, cloud consumption, professional services, infrastructure and other technology services
  • Evaluate supplier pricing models, discount structures, consumption commitments, renewal protections and commercial benchmarks
  • Negotiate contractual flexibility including volume adjustments, true-down rights, price protections, termination provisions and other mechanisms that align supplier commitments with business demand
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Security, Privacy and Technology teams to ensure appropriate commercial and contractual protections
  • Ensure adherence to corporate approval and signing authorities

Technology Supplier Management:

  • Establish strategic supplier management programs for critical technology partners
  • Conduct regular executive business reviews with key suppliers
  • Develop supplier scorecards and KPIs covering commercial performance, service delivery, innovation, risk and continuous improvement
  • Establish value creation and continuous improvement plans with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively develop alternative suppliers and competitive options to reduce dependency and strengthen commercial leverage
  • Partner with Technology leadership to assess emerging suppliers, technologies and commercial models

Spend, Demand & Value Management:

  • Develop a detailed understanding of Technology spend, contracts, consumption and demand drivers
  • Identify and deliver measurable savings, cost avoidance and other forms of commercial value
  • Partner with technology owners to optimize software licenses, cloud consumption, subscription quantities and contracted services
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate redundant technology, consolidate suppliers and improve purchasing leverage
  • Establish mechanisms for measuring realized versus negotiated value
  • Support budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning for major technology categories and strategic supplier commitments

Contract Lifecycle & Risk Management:

  • Ensure technology agreements comply with required corporate controls, including financial, security, privacy, sanctions, restricted-party and other compliance requirements
  • Monitor key contractual obligations, renewal dates, consumption commitments and commercial milestones
  • Ensure appropriate governance and adherence to global technology agreements
  • Identify and mitigate supplier concentration, financial, commercial, operational and contractual risks
  • Partner with stakeholders to proactively manage renewals and avoid unnecessary auto-renewals or unfavorable commercial commitments

Leadership & Stakeholder Management:

  • Serve as a trusted procurement advisor to the CTO organization and other senior business leaders
  • Build strong relationships across Technology, Finance, Legal, Security, Privacy and business functions
  • Effectively communicate complex commercial issues and recommendations to executive stakeholders
  • Lead cross-functional teams through strategic sourcing and supplier initiatives
  • Organize and deploy resources effectively across global projects and priorities
  • Coach and develop procurement team members and foster strong commercial and technology procurement capabilities
  • Promote a fact-based, collaborative and commercially challenging procurement culture
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Supply Chain, Finance or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience
  • 10+ years of progressive procurement experience, including significant experience in Technology/IT procurement within a complex global organization
  • Demonstrated experience managing and negotiating large, complex technology agreements
  • Strong knowledge of several major technology categories, ideally including enterprise software/SaaS, cloud infrastructure, IT services, data and analytics, hardware/networking and emerging technology/AI
  • Strong understanding of technology commercial and licensing models, including subscription, consumption-based, enterprise licensing and professional services models
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze technology spend, usage, licensing and supplier economics to identify optimization opportunities
  • Experience leading complex competitive sourcing initiatives and executive-level supplier negotiations
  • Strong financial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, evaluate total cost of ownership and translate commercial structures into financial impact
  • Strong understanding of sourcing processes, contract structures and key commercial and legal considerations associated with technology agreements
  • Proven ability to influence and challenge senior Technology and business stakeholders while maintaining strong collaborative relationships
  • Demonstrated change-management and stakeholder-management capabilities in a global matrixed organization
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills
  • Professional procurement qualification preferred
  • Fluent in English

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $151,800.00-$215,000.00. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include a flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support, and more.

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment
  • Volunteer time off
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

jobs.title: K-8 Science Education Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Tuva is the leading data literacy company in K-12 education.
jobs.description:
Tuva is the leading data literacy company in K-12 education. Tuva partners with schools, districts, curriculum publishers, and assessment organizations to bring our data literacy instructional program and our interactive, easy-to-use data, graphing, and statistical tools to teachers and students globally.

Tuva is moving the ball forward on the teaching, learning, and assessment of data literacy and building the next generation of data literate, global citizens of the world. To learn more or get started with Tuva, visit tuvalabs.com.

As a K-8 Science Education Specialist - NGSS, your responsibilities include but aren’t limited to:

  • Leading the design, development, and curation of science-related activities, lessons, datasets, and other instructional resources that support Next Generation Science Standards, taking into account learning strategies and best practices to address diverse abilities and backgrounds.
  • Working closely with content, production, and assessment specialists on our team to create high quality, meaningful, inquiry-based tasks, activities, lessons, and projects that are aligned with NGSS.
  • Creating or finding open-source teaching resources and adapt them for use by participating teachers, grades 2 through 8. Materials might include investigations, inquiry-based learning activities, videos, simulations, datasets, or other resources that help science educators successfully engage students with NGSS.
  • Engaging meaningfully with our community of science educators to successfully incorporate Tuva and NGSS-aligned materials into their instructional practice.
  • Initiating and fostering partnerships with academic institutions, research organizations, museums, and other science education and community groups to help educators teach and students learn foundational data literacy concepts and skills using Tuva.

About You:

  • Have a BS, MS, PhD, or Ed.M in Science Education or a graduate degree in a science field with equivalent experience in education training.
  • Have a strong background in Life Science, Physical Science, or Earth Science content.
  • Are familiar with the Next Generation Science Standards and research-based best teaching practices.
  • Have 3-5 years of successful classroom experience teaching science and/or mathematics at the elementary or middle school level.
  • Demonstrate ability to create cross-disciplinary curriculum or instructional activities that integrate concepts and skills from a variety of subject areas and topics.
  • Have a strong understanding and knowledge of foundational statistics and data analysis skills and concepts.
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with team members, customers, and partners across the Tuva ecosystem.
  • Are passionate about online learning and empowering educators to create powerful, memorable learning experiences for their students.
Salary: $60,000 – $80,000 / year

jobs.description:
Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security


At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.


Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.

Remote Location Illinois, Remote Location Indiana, Remote Location Kentucky, Remote Location Ohio

The Senior Technical Solutions Analyst- America’s IT will support the core back-office application strategy across the Americas technology ecosystem supporting Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, and broader business operations. This role serves as a key technical consultant for America’s IT’s business stakeholders and ERP sustaining and support teams, translating complex operational objectives and production support requirements into practical, repeatable solutions that align with stakeholder needs, enterprise standards, and long-term platform strategy. This individual will bring a consultative mindset, strong business partnership, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in support of the business’ priorities. This role will help create clearer direction for sustaining and support practices, improve incident-to-change discipline, evaluate the use of automation and embedded analytics, and support M&A and process harmonization related to evolving business needs.


Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.


What You Will Do:

  • Serve as a strategic technology partner to Americas back-office business unit stakeholders, translating business objectives and production support requirements into clear solution direction and actionable plans.
  • Own and help evolve the ERP sustaining and support strategy for capabilities across core modules (GL/AP/AR, Fixed Assets, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory, MRP/MPS, Shop Floor), integrations, and related middleware/patches.
  • Act as a business-facing technical consultant lead for incident, problem, and change management for back-office systems, translating stakeholder needs into prioritized, executable support and enhancement solutions with clear success criteria and SLAs.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and platform delivery to identify and resolve system inefficiencies, recurring incidents, and technical debt that impact business operations, while proactively recommending scalable, future-proof remediation and stabilization approaches.
  • Establish and support intake, prioritization, and governance processes for sustaining initiatives (break/fix, defects, small enhancements, compliance fixes), ensuring transparent visibility into business value, sequencing, resource tradeoffs, and platform alignment.
  • Evaluate technology solutions, automation, and AI capabilities and advise when to use embedded ERP features vs. external/custom tools, ensuring alignment with company AI policy, security, and business value.
  • Lead proofs of concept and pilot efforts to validate new sustaining tools or automation approaches (e.g., chatbots for common transactional queries, automated reconciliations), assess business value, and reduce risk prior to broader rollout.
  • Bring discipline to execution through stakeholder analysis, testing expectations, user acceptance planning, cutover/readiness planning, and adoption/change coordination for sustaining releases and patches.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across Platform Delivery, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Data, DevOps/Infrastructure, Procurement, and business process owners to reduce blind spots and delivery/downtime risk.
  • Support vendor evaluations, contract and renewal discussions, support escalations, and vendor alignment in partnership with procurement and enterprise architecture for ERP product and managed service providers.
  • Support M&A and carve-in/carve-out planning by assessing ERP impacts on processes, master data, integrations, and recommending phased, low-risk approaches aligned with business priorities.
  • Produce clear communications and executive-level reporting that connects technical tradeoffs, risks, recurring incident trends, and prioritization with business impact and recommended decisions.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • 5+ years of experience in ERP support, enterprise platforms, business solutions, product or program leadership, or related roles supporting core back-office systems and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience with major ERP platforms (Microsoft D365 F&O, Microsoft Dynamics AX2012, Oracle 11i, etc) and related integration technologies (middleware, APIs, EDI).
  • Strong understanding of business processes across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, and Warehouse operations and how they map to ERP configuration, master data, and integrations.
  • Proven ability to establish governance, prioritization, intake, and support practices (incident/problem/change) and bring structure to complex, fast-moving, or loosely governed workstreams.
  • Experience with production support tooling and frameworks (ServiceNow), monitoring, SLAs, on-call processes, RCA, and post-incident remediation tracking.
  • Knowledge of data concepts relevant to ERP (master data management, interfaces, data quality, reconciliation) and comfort working with SQL and data teams to investigate issues.
  • Familiarity with compliance and audit requirements (SOX, data security) and applying controls and documentation in an ERP environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders, translate technical complexity into business impact narratives, and operate effectively across matrixed teams without direct authority.
  • Strong systems thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to quickly understand new operational domains and apply technology thoughtfully to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Comfortable operating as a high-impact individual contributor initially, with the ability to mentor others and help scale the function over time.

Why Work for Us?

Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:

  • You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it”.
  • You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.

  • You want to work for an award-winning company that invests in its people. Allegion is proud to be a recipient of the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award for the second year in a row, recognizing our commitment to employee engagement, strengths-based development, and unlocking human potential.

What You’ll Get from Us:

We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives.   • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to confidently present to executive-level stakeholders.

  • Ability to guide and support others through collaboration, including assisting teammates and contributing to shared processes, to foster a high-quality, team-oriented environment that drives results.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-starter with strong organizational and time management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.
  • Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed, including availability for off-hours support as part of an on-call rotation.

Preferred:

At Eftsure, we’re focused on helping businesses operate with greater confidence, security and control. We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Operations Manager to help drive our most important product initiatives and bring our product strategy to life.

About the role

As Product Operations Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving cross-functional product programs, including company-critical launches and mergers and acquisitions (M&A) integration.

Working closely with Product, Engineering and senior leadership, you’ll bring structure, clarity and operational rigour to complex initiatives, ensuring they move seamlessly from strategy through execution, launch, adoption and measurable business outcomes.

You’ll help establish the processes, planning rhythms, reporting and decision-making frameworks that enable our teams to work effectively at scale. This is an opportunity to shape how product operations work across the business, building repeatable systems that improve alignment, accountability and execution.

What you’ll do

  • Drive strategic product initiatives: Lead end-to-end execution of key product programs, from initial alignment and planning through launch, rollout, adoption and post-launch follow-through.

  • Bring clarity to complex programs: Develop actionable plans that define scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decision points, success measures and escalation paths.

  • Own product planning: Establish and manage annual and monthly product planning cadences in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Enable effective decision-making: Establish and facilitate forums for strategy reviews, roadmap prioritisation, launch readiness, executive and board updates, and retrospectives.

  • Drive continuous improvement: Translate lessons from launches and planning cycles into improved processes, stronger ways of working and more effective execution.

  • Support cross-functional integration: Help coordinate complex initiatives across teams and business functions, including M&A integration and other company-critical programs.

What we’re looking for

You’re an organised, strategic thinker who thrives on bringing structure to complexity. You can move comfortably between big-picture planning and the operational details required to get things done. You build strong relationships across teams, communicate with clarity and know how to turn ambitious goals into measurable results.

You’ll bring:

  • Relevant experience: 4+ years in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations or a related role within a technology company.

  • Program leadership: A proven track record of leading complex, high-stakes, cross-functional product launches or multi-quarter programs from strategy through rollout and adoption.

  • Operational excellence: Demonstrated ability to build repeatable systems, scalable processes and effective ways of working, rather than simply operating within existing frameworks.

  • Global collaboration: Experience working effectively across geographies, time zones and distributed teams.

  • Direct experience with M&A, post-merger integration or major organisational restructuring.

Why join EFTsure?

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how our product organisation operates and scales. You’ll work closely with senior leaders, influence how critical initiatives are planned and delivered, and help build the operational foundations that support our continued growth.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, connecting strategy with execution and helping cross-functional teams deliver their best work, we’d love to hear from you.

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. As Director, TV, Video, Audio & Display (TVAD), you will lead a portfolio of clients as the senior, day‑to‑day owner of the relationship and growth agenda. You will align your team’s recommendations with client goals, set expectations, and build trust with senior stakeholders by proactively creating high‑value moments to meet, present, and influence decisions. You’ll partner with internal leaders to resolve escalations quickly, connect TVAD to Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media, and Creative, and translate platform, competitive, and Bliss Point TVAD insights into executive‑ready actions. You also own the financial health of your book: margin, utilization/capacity, and forecast accuracy, in partnership with the Client or Pod Leader and Finance. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.


Key responsibilities


Client‑Centric

  • Own senior‑stakeholder relationships and the client growth agenda; align full‑funnel TVAD plans (CTV/OTT, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display) to business goals; secure decisions on options and trade‑offs.
  • Lead onboarding, transitions, escalations, and expansion; support new business with clear narratives tied to measurable impact.

Product‑Led

  • Orchestrate optimization across partners/DSPs (goal strategies, pacing, frequency/overlap control, quality/brand‑safety/verification); pilot safely, measure, and scale.
  • Embed Bliss Point insights (Always‑On Incrementality, Brand/Creative/Customer Insights) into planning and allocation; close feedback loops with Product and Analytics to improve tools and models.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Install strong, simple measurement habits: growth‑first innovation with success thresholds and read cadence (geo/lift/holdout where feasible; otherwise sound A/B or time‑series); forecast expected impact and risk.
  • Help ensure data/ops health through close collaboration with the Media Investment team, and require forecast‑vs‑actual narratives in executive decisions.

The Tinuiti Way

  • Connect the dots across channels for clients: explain how TVAD complements Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media, CRM, TV/Audio, and Creative; propose integrated plans and a straightforward measurement approach to prove combined lift; codify reusable playbooks.

Owner Mindset

  • Own the business like it’s yours: make and stand behind decisions that maximize client outcomes (growth, margin, LTV) within agreed guardrails; surface trade‑offs with clear thresholds/tolerances; keep a simple decision log tied to Rocks/KPIs.
  • Financial stewardship with partners: forecast impact, track plan vs. actuals, and course‑correct quickly with Client Lead/Finance/Analytics; protect margin/utilization by prioritizing high‑value work and cutting busywork.
  • Love Growth: spot and de‑risk larger opportunities (e.g., higher‑quality CTV inventory, new audience/data partners, refreshed creative lengths) with small, safe pilots and clear thresholds—then scale and document the playbook.
  • Hate Waste: remove recurring waste at the root (e.g., unmanaged frequency, viewability/IVT issues, overlapping buys, tagging gaps); set simple standards that prevent backslide and shorten time‑to‑resolution.

People Leader

  • Build and lead a high‑performing team: clear Rocks/KPIs, weekly 1:1s, timely feedback, capability development, and a succession bench; hire and onboard well.
  • Install governance (standards, scorecards, QA cadence) that sustains quality and consistency across teams; coach managers to lead the system.

Ways of working and values

  • Greatness attracts Greatness: Set clear craft and leadership standards, coach managers and senior ICs, and keep learning (including responsible use of new tools/AI).
  • Clients grow, we grow: Tie decisions to business outcomes, connect TVAD with other channels in simple, integrated plans, and set expectations early with clear trade‑offs and timelines.
  • Culture of ownership: Own results (growth and margin), pilot and scale what works, eliminate recurring waste at the root, and follow through quickly on escalations and commitments.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in TV/video/audio/display with proven results at scale across multiple partners (CTV/OTT/Linear, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display); management experience required.
  • Technical: Hands‑on knowledge of DSP/ad platforms and ad‑server workflows; frequency/overlap management; audience/data usage; quality/verification (viewability, IVT, brand safety); comfort coordinating with publishers/PMPs.
  • Measurement: incrementality/lift, powered A/B or time‑series, forecasting; ability to connect media to revenue, CAC, LTV, incremental reach/attention; SQL familiarity a plus.
  • Cross‑channel literacy: connect TVAD to Search, Social, Commerce/Retail Media, CRM, and Creative in simple, executive‑ready narratives.
  • Financial acumen: margin/utilization management, capacity planning, reliable forecasting with Finance; staffing aligned to priorities.
  • Leadership presence: clear, concise storytelling; expectation setting; confident with senior clients and internal leaders.

KPIs

  • Client outcomes: growth in qualified reach/new households, revenue, and LTV; efficiency within guardrails (CPx/CAC/ROAS).
  • Innovation: steady flow of growth‑focused innovations adopted (audience/data, inventory quality, format/creative, frequency/quality), with decisions and learnings recorded.
  • Product/AI: responsible rollout/adoption of optimization features and Bliss Point‑guided allocations with proven, incremental impact.
  • Data/ops quality: high tag/event fidelity; strong attention/viewability; minimal IVT/brand‑safety flags; fast time‑to‑resolution and prevention of repeat issues.
  • Financials: margin/utilization on target; staffing aligned to priorities; forecast accuracy within tolerance.
  • People outcomes: engagement/retention, capability growth, succession readiness, strong manager practices.
  • Integrated impact: measurable lift from cross‑channel plans (Tinuiti Way).
