jobs.excerpt: Overview Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development.
jobs.description:
Overview

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.


Responsibilities

Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.

  • Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
  • Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
  • Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.

Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.

  • Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
  • Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
  • Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
  • Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.

Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.

  • Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
  • Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
  • Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.
  • Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.

  • Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.
  • Gather qualitative intel from direct observation of client environments and anecdotal evidence from routine interviews, e.g., pain points, nuances in their use cases, feedback on features, and opportunities for more training. Note: We often go off script for our largest clients in helping them resolve emergencies, so it will be a challenge to promote long-term health while dealing with the short-term “crisis of the week.”
  • Gather quantitative intel from analysis of client click paths and usage metrics to identify patterns of (mis)use, interpreting these insights in light of their stories.
  • Identify gaps and overlaps between clients’ existing processes and our intended use cases to advise their scope and sequence in adopting our solutions.

Out of Scope: Things we already have covered.

  • Our key value proposition is that we offer the same software to every client and regulatory authority to standardize data handling across industry and government. Note: Unlike some software boutiques, we do not create custom apps or novel interfaces client-by-client. Instead, we focus on educating and informing clients to better use the features they all already share, and we reject the majority of one-off change requests.
  • Because our sales and product lifecycles are constrained upstream of you, and because you will be busy with your core duties, expect to not be tasked with dealing with leads, preparing pricing tables and statements of work, handling contract renewals, gathering product requirements, making design mockups, coordinating engineering R&D, running usability focus groups, determining “best practices” for use of our software, authoring guides and documentation, and producing marketing content. Of course, if you master your duties and want to surprise us with more, be our guest!
  • Some of our clients are national regulatory agencies (FDA in the USA, PMDA in Japan, etc.), and we also offer an opensource product, but you will not interact with these teams. You will work with our commercial P21 Enterprise clients, predominantly Top Pharma, Biotechs, and CROs.

Qualifications

• Must
o Speak fluent Portuguese & have related industry experience

o Curious about our clients and products, cautious with our brand and industry goodwill, conscientious in follow-through
o Willing to learn and serve, flexible in adapting to rapid organizational change, receptive of constructive criticism
o Thick skin in being able to take heat from big clients when things go wrong outside of your control, unafraid to ask (and re-ask) team members to deliver on their promises
o High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for mess; able to create order out of chaos, attend to details, and push quality higher
o Service-obsessed, motivated to go above and beyond to assist clients, able to gain client trust as an advisor while also furthering our company goals
o Smooth and exact in communicating, writing, presenting, and facilitating; able to shift from calming “bedside manner” to exuberant sales-mode to calculating negotiator
o Relentlessly resourceful and discerning in solving problems independently vs. seeking help from others; brave yet humble in working across multi-disciplinary teams where each person is more of an expert than you in their

chosen field

o Candidates who live on the East Coast of the United States

• Plus
o Ability to work in a remote position requiring constant spoken and written communication; skill in exerting influence (even on company founders, owners, and partners) without leverage or managerial authority
o Education or qualifications relating to business, programming, data science, health sciences, medical writing, customer support, project management, or corporate communications
o Experience working for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) vendor, clinical laboratory, pharmaceutical company, or Contract Research Organization (CRO), specifically in functions supporting Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, or CDISC data submissions

ICF is seeking a talented Manager, Energy Markets Consulting to support our growing Energy, Development & Infrastructure (EDI) business.

As a Manager, you will lead project teams delivering market analysis, price forecasts, asset valuations, transaction support, and strategic advisory services to a diverse client base including independent power producers, developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, private equity firms, lenders, data center developers, and government agencies. You will be responsible for managing client relationships, overseeing complex analytical engagements, mentoring junior staff, and contributing to the continued growth of ICF’s energy business through business development, thought leadership, and innovation.

You will work closely with senior industry leaders and play a significant role in shaping investment and strategic decisions across the evolving energy landscape, including renewable energy, battery storage, conventional generation, transmission, electrification, and large-load growth from data centers and other emerging sectors.

Key Responsibilities


Project Leadership and Client Delivery

  • Lead multi-disciplinary consulting teams in the execution of power market studies, asset valuations, financing and M&A transaction support engagements, and strategic advisory projects.
  • Oversee development of long-term energy, capacity, ancillary service, and REC price forecasts across major U.S. power markets.

Client Management and Business Development

  • Lead proposal development efforts, including scope definition, pricing, and staffing strategies.

  • Represent ICF at industry conferences, client meetings, webinars, and other external forums.

Thought Leadership

  • Develop deep expertise in power market fundamentals, market design, policy developments, transmission planning, resource adequacy, and emerging technologies.
  • Publish white papers, market insights, presentations, and other thought leadership content.

Staff Leadership and Mentorship

  • Foster collaboration across market regions and technical disciplines.

Professional Skills

  • Strong project management and organizational abilities.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to executive and non-technical audiences.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


Jabil is seeking a collaborative and technically experienced Engineering Manager to join our Data Center Infrastructure Engineering team. This individual will lead and develop an engineering team supporting the design, development, release and lifecycle management of complex power, cooling and infrastructure products.


The Engineering Manager will establish clear priorities, strengthen engineering capabilities and create an environment in which engineers can work effectively across disciplines. This role will partner closely with other engineering teams, technical program management, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, robust, manufacturable and dependable products.

The position may support Design and Configuration, including CAD and PLM related functions, Electrical Engineering, or Controls Engineering. While the technical focus may vary by team, the role maintains a consistent responsibility for people leadership, engineering execution, technical oversight, resource planning and organizational development.

Location: This role allows remote work or can be based in Austin, TX with 25% travel per year domestically and international (rare)

What will you do?


  • Lead, coach, and develop a high performing engineering team supporting product development, NPI, production and sustaining activities.
  • Establish clear team priorities, performance expectations, development plans, and a culture of accountability, collaboration, technical rigor and continuous improvement.
  • Help plan and balance resources across multiple projects, programs and product platforms while monitoring workload, capacity, dependencies and capability needs.
  • Partner with technical program managers and engineering leaders to establish realistic schedules, milestones, resource plans and deliverables.
  • Provide technical guidance and design oversight while empowering engineers to maintain ownership of their work and decisions.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet functionality, quality, safety, manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, compliance and configuration requirements.

  • Work across Systems, Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Design and Configuration, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Product Management throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Drive consistent use and continuous improvement of engineering standards, tools, documentation, release processes, change control, baselining and traceability practices.
  • Support root cause analysis and resolution of design, production, and field issues, including implementation of corrective actions.

Education

Experience


  • 5+ years of engineering experience supporting complex products, equipment or integrated systems.
  • Experience leading controls engineering involving PLCs, embedded or industrial controls, BMS integration, instrumentation, automation, sequences of operation or system commissioning.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, supervising or managing engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product development, NPI, production and/or sustaining engineering environments.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, resources and technical deliverables simultaneously.
  • Experience collaborating across engineering, technical program management, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and other functional organizations.
  • Experience supporting engineering processes such as design reviews, product release, configuration management, change control, validation or technical issue resolution.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities


  • Ability to lead, motivate, coach, and develop engineers with varied technical backgrounds and experience levels.
  • Strong understanding of engineering execution, product development, product lifecycle, configuration management, and product release processes.
  • Ability to translate business and program objectives into executable priorities, resource plans, milestones and team deliverables.
  • Capable of assessing technical, schedule, and resource risks and driving appropriate mitigation and resolution plans.
  • Able to provide effective technical oversight while maintaining clear engineering ownership and accountability.
  • Strong cross functional leadership, influence, communication, presentation and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical and organizational information effectively to engineering teams, management, customers, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating within a global, geographically distributed organization supporting multiple products and lifecycle phases.
  • Ability to identify capability gaps and implement development, hiring, or resource strategies; travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading Controls engineering teams.
  • Experience with critical infrastructure, data center equipment, industrial systems, cooling products, power distribution equipment, automation or similarly complex products.
  • Familiarity with electrical design, requirements management, PLM and configuration controlled or customer configured products.
  • Familiarity with applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements, including IEC, UL, IEEE, ASHRAE, or related standards.

Experience building or scaling engineering teams; project management experience or certification is a plus. A suitable combination of education, experience and training may be considered

jobs.description:
At Fivestaff, our mission is to unlock the potential of talent by connecting them with meaningful work that drives real impact for businesses, communities, and the individuals themselves. We believe great work isn’t bound by borders, and that empowering people to contribute from where they are can transform lives and shape a better future for all.

We partner with global businesses to provide high-performing, full-time remote teams who are strategic, skilled, and ready to make a difference.

About the Role

Fivestaff is looking for a Digital Marketing Manager who will take full ownership of marketing activities that directly impact the bottom line of our client’s business in the holiday homes space.

This role is for someone who understands that marketing is not about vanity metrics, posting content, or running ads in isolation. The goal is simple and measurable: Impact supply and demand to help grow the business.

This is a high-impact role where you will be kickstarting the marketing function, taking full ownership of growth initiatives and driving measurable results across the business. You will work hands-on across paid ads, retargeting, social media, landing page optimization, marketing automation, and content. You are expected to strategize, execute, test, optimize, and think commercially at all times.

As the first hire in marketing, you will have the creative freedom to drive the company’s marketing efforts as per your expertise and research. This role is excellent for someone who is a self-starter, go-getter and can work independently without much oversight and is comfortable taking decisions when necessary.

Your Key Responsibilities

Performance Marketing & Acquisition

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across Google and Meta and potentially other platforms in future.
  • Manage property owner acquisition campaigns with messaging focused on yield, hands-off management, and revenue transparency
  • Manage guest acquisition campaigns targeting Dubai travelers and short-stay intent audiences
  • Own channel strategy, budgets, targeting, creative testing, and CAC goals
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creatives, hooks, formats, and audience to improve campaign performance
  • Launch new experiments to identify scalable growth angles and high-performing segments
  • Ensure guest and property owner audiences are never mixed

Retargeting, Funnels, & Conversion Optimization

  • Set up and manage pixel-based retargeting for property page visitors, search and booking abandoners
  • Run dynamic ads tied to specific units viewed and availability, pricing, and seasonal demand
  • Reduce funnel drop-offs and recover lost revenue through smart retargeting strategies
  • Optimize funnels to increase booking completion and conversion rates

Landing Pages & Direct Booking Growth

  • Optimize landing pages focused on Property Owners and Travelers to increase conversions.
  • Ensure pages are mobile-first, fast loading, and conversion focused
  • Improve booking CTAs, trust signals, reviews, and pricing clarity
  • Continuously test and improve conversion rate and booking completion

Organic Social Media

  • Manage organic social media accounts across Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn
  • Stitch up short-form content using existing property assets: property walkthroughs, guest experiences, and location highlights
  • Use tools like Canva and CapCut to produce static and video content
  • Coordinate influencer collaborations with clear deliverables and measurable impact
  • Focus on trust, demand generation, and faster decision

Email Marketing & Marketing Automation

  • Leverage existing guest data to drive repeat bookings and lifetime value
  • Set-up automation flows for post-stay follow-ups, rebooking nudges, seasonal offers, and referral incentives
  • Ensure booking journey is seamless, trackable, and low-friction
  • Use email as compounding ROI channel alongside paid media

Listing Optimization (Airbnb & )

  • Regularly optimize property listings on Airbnb and by improving content structure and language based on research and signals
  • A/B test cover images, titles, and descriptions
  • Optimize listings for click-through rate, conversion rate, and ranking signals
  • Track impact on occupancy, ADR, and booking velocity
  • Make data-driven improvements to increase platform-based revenue

What You’ll Need to Bring

  • 3-6 years of hands-on experience in digital and paid ads marketing
  • Proven experience executing and coordinating campaigns
  • Experience running campaigns for hospitality, travel, real estate, marketplaces, or e-commerce is a strong plus
  • Strong proficiency in Meta Ads, Google Ads, and (preferably) TikTok Ads
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization, funnels and retargeting, email marketing and automation
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze results and iterate quickly
  • Strong execution skills with a commercial, results-focused approach
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Reliable internet connection (25+ Mbps), a dependable laptop, and a focused workspace to get started.

You’ll Thrive Here If You

  • Care more about bookings and revenue than likes and impressions
  • Enjoy testing, optimizing, and owning outcomes
  • Can balance creativity with performance thinking
  • Take accountability for results end-to-end
  • Prefer hands-on execution over high-level planning
  • Love to work in start-ups with the make fast, break fast mindset.

This might not be a good fit for you if you

  • Cannot operate independently
  • Rely on day to day guidance and are not comfortable taking decisions
  • Don't move fast
  • Prefer an org chart that feels comfortable

What We Offer

  • A full-time, long-term remote role with global exposure
  • Excellent starting salary
  • Health coverage
  • Work with top tooling (you get to decide the tools)
  • Hardware, gear, whatever you need to be productive
  • Access to a nearby coworking space of your choice (just in case)
  • Supportive, respectful, and growth-focused team culture
  • Real impact and visibility beyond borders

Important Details

  • This is a full-time remote position based in Pakistan
  • Working hours align with UAE time zone (~10AM to 7PM Pakistan time)
  • You’ll be employed by Fivestaff and work closely with one of our client companies

This is a senior-level role requiring greater independence, case ownership, legal knowledge, and the ability to manage complex responsibilities with limited supervision.

Depending on experience and department needs, the Senior Staff Lawyer may perform responsibilities similar to those of a Senior Legal Assistant, Personal Injury Case Manager, or Paralegal, while providing direct support to attorneys and managing Personal Injury cases throughout different stages of the case lifecycle.

  • Coordinate medical referrals.
  • Maintain clean and organized client files.
  • Review case documentation for completeness and accuracy.

Demand & Pre-Litigation Support

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Brightside Health delivers life-saving virtual mental healthcare to everyone who needs it. We are powered by proprietary AI, purpose-built technology, a world-class clinician network, and a care model that rivals the best of in-person treatment. When combined with precision psychiatry and leading-edge therapeutic techniques, we’re able to improve outcomes for those with mild-to-severe clinical depression, anxiety, and other mood disorders. Our innovative approach has earned recognition from leading publications such as Healthline, Fortune, and Forbes, naming us 'Most Comprehensive,' and 'Best Online Therapy for Anxiety and Depression.'

We take an action-oriented, purposeful approach with everything we do and seek out team members who value collaboration and thoughtful prioritization. As a result, our organization is looking for the brightest and most innovative talent in the industry. We can promise you that, as a member of the Brightside team, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate alongside smart and driven people while growing your professional skills.

Brightside is looking for a versatile Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team and embed with our Network product and operations teams. The provider network is the backbone of our care model, and this role sits at the center of it. Your work will shape the clinician experience and, through it, the quality and accessibility of care our patients receive. You'll report to the Senior Director of Analytics and work most closely with the central Network product team.

Think of this as the analytical engine behind a healthy, balanced network. You'll help us anticipate where patient need is heading and make sure we have the right clinicians in the right places to meet it. That means understanding the full clinician lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through retention, and connecting it to the things that matter most to patients: quality of care, strong therapeutic relationships, and a smooth path to getting scheduled. Along the way, you'll work with Product and Engineering to test new ideas and measure what actually moves the needle.

You'll be a trusted thought partner to leaders across Network, Clinical, and Product, turning messy, multi-source data into clear direction on where to invest next. You'll also help shape how our team works, contributing to a modern data foundation where governed metrics and AI-assisted analysis make good decisions faster for everyone.

The best fit is someone who pairs deep technical craft with sound business judgment, who is energized by ambiguity, and who can explain a complex analysis in a way that gets people to act.

What you’ll do in this role:

  • Build and maintain the forecast model for network capacity vs. patient demand across all 50 state markets and multiple clinical care programs, and use it to guide where and when we invest in supply
  • Partner with Network Ops and Clinical Talent to deliver measurement and insights that support clinician recruitment and onboarding and strengthen retention
  • Develop frameworks to measure the impact of clinical quality, therapeutic alliance, and patient panel balance at both the clinician and market level
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to design and run experiments on patient scheduling experiences and clinician-facing product features
  • Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Network POD, explaining the drivers behind changes in performance metrics, tying them to OKRs, clinical, and financial outcomes, and presenting insights and experiment results to leadership
  • Join a Data team building AI-powered analytics infrastructure that governs metric reliability and unlocks deeper analysis, including developing and documenting the data models behind KPI reporting and agentic analytics
  • Solve ambiguous problems creatively with systematic, scalable solutions

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of analytics experience, with a Master's degree or equivalent practical experience
  • Expert-level SQL and data modeling in a cloud data warehouse (ex: BigQuery/GCP), with a track record of writing clean, performant, well-documented code
  • Hands-on experience developing and scaling a dbt project, including testing, documentation, and governed metric definitions
  • Strong forecasting and econometric modeling skills, ideally paired with operations research methods (capacity planning, supply-demand optimization, resource allocation)
  • Experience designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests and other experiments, including knowing when a clean experiment isn't possible and what to do instead
  • Proficiency with data visualization tools (ex: Tableau) to build dashboards and tell clear stories with data
  • Fluency with AI tools and MCPs, and a habit of using them to accelerate everything from data exploration to insight generation
  • Ability to turn complex analyses into clear business recommendations, with excellent written and verbal communication for audiences ranging from engineers to executives
  • A self-starter mindset: you're comfortable with ambiguity, set your own priorities, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment

Preferred:

  • Experience in the healthcare industry
  • Experience in an interdisciplinary/cross-functional field
  • Startup experience

  • Evaluate the appropriateness of requested levels of care and treatment plans.
  • Collaborate with physician reviewers on cases requiring medical necessity determinations or denials.
  • Research and obtain additional clinical information needed to support utilization management decisions.
  • Assess requests for out-of-network services when appropriate.

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation

  • Ensure utilization management activities meet NCQA, DOI, and other regulatory requirements.

  • Collaborate with physician reviewers to ensure appropriate oversight of complex utilization management decisions.
  • Support departmental compliance with regulatory timelines and quality standards.

jobs.description:
Senior consultant, health & welfare benefits (remote)

THE ORGANIZATION
Purchaser Business Group on Health (PBGH) is an action-oriented non-profit with a track record of improving health outcomes, experience and affordability for consumers and purchasers across the United States. PBGH advances quality, drives affordability and fosters equity in partnership with its members, who are some of the largest and most innovative private and public purchasers of health care, including The Boeing Company, Amazon, Intel, eBay, Walmart and CalPERS.

PBGH and its members are on the forefront of implementing innovations in the health care system through purchaser-led solutions. PBGH partners across stakeholders to continuously identify, create and put into practice new strategies to support the health and overall wellbeing of employees, their families and the public.

THE ROLE
The Senior Consultant, Health & Welfare Benefits supports PBGH’s mission to advance high-value, affordable, and equitable health care by delivering independent, purchaser-focused advisory services to employers and other health care purchasers. Serving as a strategic advisor—not a broker—this role provides objective analysis, market insight, and evidence-based guidance to support employer’s fiduciary decision-making across the health and welfare benefits lifecycle.

Working closely with PBGH senior leaders and subject-matter experts, the Senior Consultant is responsible for executing and managing day-to-day advisory engagements, producing rigorous, insight-driven analyses and recommendations, contributing to solution development, translating complex health data into actionable strategies for employers and helping shape purchaser-relevant insights that can scale across PBGH’s employer community.

This role requires strong technical expertise, analytical depth, comprehensive knowledge of employee benefits, well-established relationships with employers and the health markets, and polished client-ready communication skills, along with the ability to operate independently with minimal oversight, demonstrate agility in handling shifting priorities and dynamic environments, collaborate across internal and external stakeholders, and uphold PBGH’s independent advisory posture.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Client Engagement, Satisfaction, and Delivery
Under the guidance and oversight of senior leadership:
  • Independently manages multiple client engagements and owns defined workstreams from start to finish.
  • Develops client-ready analyses, insights, and deliverables across health and welfare strategies, including medical, pharmacy, wellbeing, and point solutions.
  • Develops and monitors engagement work plans, timelines, and milestones; proactively identifies risks, dependencies, or scope changes and escalates as appropriate to project and practice leadership to support on-time, high-quality delivery.
  • Collaborates with internal project teams, subcontractors, and external partners, coordinating closely with senior leaders to ensure effective execution of assigned projects.
  • Maintains organized project documentation, data files, and work products.
  • Prepares materials and presents findings to client teams with clarity and confidence, alongside and with review from senior leadership.
  • Partners with leadership to ensure recommendations are practical, data-driven, and aligned with client objectives and PBGH advisory principles.
  • Translates key findings into externally facing white papers, briefs, and presentations, with senior leadership input, to advance collective impact.

Financial Mastery, Data Analytics and Insights
With review and guidance from senior leadership and subject-matter experts:
  • Analyzes employer demographics, claims, utilization, cost, quality, and performance data, including self-funded medical and pharmacy claims.
  • Leads financial evaluations, including pricing, budgeting, forecasting, premium-equivalent rate setting, contribution modeling and working knowledge in IBNR and stop-loss.
  • Applies analytical tools, methodologies and comprehensive health and welfare benefits knowledge to assess plan performance, vendor effectiveness, cost drivers, and improvement opportunities, aligning findings with PBGH advisory principles.
  • Supports development and application of analytic solutions leveraging emerging datasets (e.g., Transparency in Coverage, Hospital Price Transparency).
  • Translates complex data into clear narratives, executive summaries, and actionable insights for employer audiences, incorporating feedback from senior leadership as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standardized tools, templates, and methodologies to support scalable consulting delivery.

Solutions Development and Strategic Impact
With input and review from senior leadership and subject matter experts:
  • Creates and documents methodologies, analyses, and insights to ensure rigor, consistency and alignment with PBGH advisory principles.
  • Stays current on market trends, regulatory developments, and innovations across the health benefits landscape, sharing relevant implications with leadership and colleagues.
  • Creates resources and tools that build knowledge base for continued intellectual capital development.
  • Shares learnings and best practices with colleagues to continuously improve service delivery.

Vendor Management
  • Has deep knowledge of the health care market ecosystem and well-established relationships with vendors, including carriers, TPAs, data platforms, data warehouses, and point solution vendors.
  • Manages the RFP/RFI process, including drafting questionnaires, interfacing vendors, evaluating proposals and responses, preparing and presenting results and recommendations to employers, and conducting vendor/finalist interviews, with input and oversight from senior leadership.
Compliance and Regulatory Oversight
  • Possesses fundamental knowledge of health and welfare program compliance and regulations, including but not limited to, ERISA, ACA, CAA, HIPAA, COBRA, Section 125, and MHPAEA.
  • Applies analytical rigor to conduct reviews of plan fiduciary and health plan compliance, contracts and agreements, identify potential risks and liabilities, and develop and implement strategic corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues.
  • Demonstrates track record of self-directed professional development and a commitment to staying current in a rapidly changing legal landscape and utilizing legal and industry research tools (e.g., Bloomberg Law, Federal Register, National Conference of State Legislatures) to independently resolve complex compliance inquiries.
  • Contributes to internal knowledge base or advisory service offerings regarding new regulatory trends.

Growth and Sales
  • Supports prospecting efforts and proposal development, including drafting scopes, workplans, timelines, and fee estimates.
  • Assists with responses to RFPs, RFIs, and grant-funded opportunities as needed.
  • Participates in client relationship development through excellent service delivery and responsiveness.
  • Identifies opportunities for follow-on work and flags potential expansion areas.
  • Supports technical learning opportunities for members.
  • Tracks activity with current and potential clients in Asana and Salesforce.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES & EXPERIENCE
  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • A minimum of 8+ years of experience in a consulting or similar environment advising large/jumbo employers on health and welfare benefits.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve Fortune 500 companies’ complex health and benefits issues.
  • Strong working knowledge of the health benefits ecosystem, including carriers, PBMs, point solutions, and consulting/brokerage models.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing employer medical and pharmacy claims data and translating results into client-ready insights.
  • Solid technical expertise across health and welfare topics, such as financial and actuarial concepts, plan design, vendor evaluation, compliance (e.g., ERISA, CAA), pharmacy and PBM strategies, mental health, wellbeing, and emerging solutions.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience developing polished PowerPoint presentations and executive summaries.
  • Mastery of Microsoft Office Suite
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive.
  • Ability to travel approximately 10–15%.
  • Life & Health Insurance License

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY
PBGH is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. PBGH strongly encourages applicants with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

COMPENSATION
PBGH offers a competitive annual base salary range of $138,000 - $168,000. The base pay offered will be determined by factors including but not limited to experience, skills, location, education, internal equity, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be made on a case-by-case basis.

In addition to base pay, this position is also eligible for year‐end bonus potential, a generous contributory retirement plan, comprehensive benefits and opportunities for professional growth. For more information and to apply, please visit .

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build software that helps the largest, AI-driven organizations build and operate advanced data science and AI solutions at scale. Our platform integrates a streamlined model development environment, MLOps capabilities, and novel features for collaboration, reuse, and reproducibility — all of which make data science teams more productive, reduce time to value, and ensure compliance. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Domino’s Identity and Access platform (IDSM) is the foundation for how customers in some of the world’s most regulated industries manage who can see and do what. We’re evolving it into a centralized, relationship-based authorization framework built on SpiceDB, and you’d be the technical anchor for its next phase.

  • A unified authorization model. Extend a centralized, fine-grained, relationship-based model across the platform, replacing feature-specific permission checks with consistent, reusable primitives.
  • Production-grade operations. Harden the authorization layer for the scale, reliability, and security that enterprise and public-sector customers expect.
  • A thoughtful migration path. Make the sequencing and design calls that let us retire legacy access checks without disrupting customers along the way.
  • Groups and organizations that mirror real customers. Rethink how we model groups and organizational hierarchies so large enterprises can represent their teams the way they actually work.
  • Cloud-native identity. Deepen integration with cloud workload identity, starting with AWS IRSA and extending to Azure and GCP equivalents.
  • Foundations other teams build on. Design core identity and access capabilities, with clean interfaces and flexible abstractions, that engineers across the company can adopt with confidence.

Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure. It integrates with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible in a single governed workflow so you deliver secure, compliant infrastructure at scale. Developer self-service, Golden Paths with guardrails, an OPA policy engine, and drift detection accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control. Spacelift Intelligence adds AI-powered provisioning and diagnostics across traditional and AI-driven workflows.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

About the role

Spacelift is looking for aProduct Manager to own our Kubernetes application-delivery product, a new product for teams that run Argo CD in production.

You will own the product from customer discovery through delivery, launch, and adoption. Working with Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support, you will identify important customer problems, decide where to invest, and turn validated opportunities into products customers use.

Most teams running Kubernetes have settled on Argo CD and do not want another CD engine. Their problems sit around it: promoting a release through environments without hand-written CI glue, knowing which version runs where, gating production on approvals and tests, and passing values from Terraform into application config. The product works with the Argo CD a customer already runs. We have an early design that captures the idea, not a spec, and parts of it will change. You will test the idea with customers, decide what the product should be and what ships first, and take it to market.

This role is for an experiencedproduct manager who has owned technical products and brings hands-on production experience with Kubernetes application delivery.You should also understand core infrastructure-as-code workflows, because connecting infrastructure to applications is part of the product.

What you'll do

  • Build and apply working knowledge of Spacelift, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, policy, cloud infrastructure, and our execution engine, including how the Kubernetes product connects with existing IaC workflows.

ICRW Asia operates at the intersection of research excellence and practical implementation - generating evidence that drives policy, designing interventions that create measurable change, and building partnerships that scale impact across communities, countries, and continents.

The Strategic Imperative

Educational gains for women are clear, yet without decisive action, gender parity will remain elusive for decades. The next Executive Director of ICRW Asia will drive the shift with bold strategic leadership , deepening our policy influence, expanding our voice, and leading ambitious, evidence-backed programs that affect millions.

This is more than a leadership role. It is an invitation to shape the trajectory of gender equity across one of the world’s most dynamic regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide overall leadership, strategic direction, and oversight to all ICRW Asia verticals - research and programmes, operations, finance, human resources, communications, and related management functions ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Lead and diversify fundraising activities as the chief fundraiser; develop and execute a strategy to expand the donor base across bilateral, philanthropic, multilateral, and private sector partners, securing long-term financial sustainability.

  • Recruit, lead, and develop a diverse, high-performing team; set and monitor transparent performance and development goals; foster a performance-oriented, inclusive, and equity-driven work culture.
  • Strengthen ICRW’s role as a thought leader in gender-based research and advocacy; expand programme implementation to engage new audiences; and cultivate high-value partnerships and coalitions to position ICRW as the “go-to” organization for gender research and policy influence.
  • Serve as chief spokesperson for ICRW Asia, representing the organization in high-profile regional and global fora; lead a consistent, impactful communications strategy across platforms and stakeholders.
  • Execute and sign all deeds, agreements, contracts, and official documents on behalf of ICRW Asia; maintain a transparent and productive relationship with the ICRW Asia Board to guide strategic direction and ensure adaptability in a changing environment.

Professional Experience and Qualifications Required

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Administration, or related field.
  • 15-20 years’ professional leadership experience in Asia or globally, in the non-profit, public, or private sectors preferably in public health, international development, or gender-related issues with a demonstrated commitment to gender equity and social justice.
  • Proven track record in fundraising and resource mobilization from diverse sources; strong ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships with donors, civil society, stakeholders, and the private sector.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary teams in dynamic environments; prior leadership of an organization, entity, or business unit of comparable scale and complexity preferred.
  • Expertise in leveraging or conducting research, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible messaging for varied audiences.
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with experience fostering a culture grounded in diversity, equity, social justice, ethics, transparency, and accountability.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to deliver measurable impact while ensuring financial health; skilled in budgeting, financial analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

Evidence & Impact

Explore all research and insights :

The Culture We Offer

At ICRW Asia, we strive to create an environment that reflects our commitment to gender equity and social inclusion. The team is multidisciplinary, comprising researchers, economists, anthropologists, and advocates who work together to generate evidence-based insights and actionable policy recommendations.

We value:

  • Academic rigor with contextual relevance
  • Collaborative inquiry and thought leadership
  • A commitment to inclusivity, diversity, and equitable workplace practices

As a regional hub within a globally respected organization, ICRW Asia combines:

  • The credibility and reach of a global institution
  • The adaptability and local responsiveness of a regional entity

Read more about our approach and values:

Why Exceptional Leaders Choose ICRW

These reflections are drawn from feedback shared by former policy advisors, multilateral agency partners, bilateral donors, funders, and internal staff on public platforms such as Glassdoor and LinkedIn:

  • ICRW stands at the intersection of rigorous research and strategic advocacy - a place where data drives action and change are shaped by evidence.
  • When global donors and governments need more than just frameworks - when they need grounded insights and policy-aligned strategies - ICRW becomes their go-to partner.
  • More than an institution, ICRW Asia is a space for mission-driven inquiry. Researchers are encouraged to question, challenge, and engage deeply with systems of power and justice.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. jobs.description:
Remote | Australia | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or demonstrated interest in family medicine.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or an interest in internal medicine.

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Physician Assistant or Physician Associate program, preferably in the clinical phase of training.

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking to earn supplemental income while applying your professional skills and expertise to meaningful projects.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Family Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Internal Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Nurse Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$20/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$28/hr

Physician Assistant

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$23/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$30/hr

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or study track required (see list above)

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets Under Consideration: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a medical knowledge or clinical reasoning assessment before selection.

Specific assignments, schedules, and workloads will be communicated as they become available.

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.
  • Clinical Reasoning and Evaluation: Ability to assess medical scenarios, interpret clinical information, and distinguish evidence-based reasoning from inaccurate or unsupported conclusions.
  • Research and Evidence Verification: Ability to research medical literature, interpret clinical guidelines, and validate findings using authoritative healthcare resources.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical case studies, laboratory results, or diagnostic documentation.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, differential diagnosis, and established clinical practice guidelines.
  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the executive responsible for protecting the organization's information, technology infrastructure, applications, data, and digital services from cyber threats and security risks.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CISO leads enterprise cybersecurity, information security governance, cyber risk management, security architecture, incident response, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, third-party security, and business continuity/cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise cybersecurity and information security strategy.

Establish information security policies, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.

Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management.

Protect sensitive customer, financial, investment, policyholder, employee, and corporate data.

Threat Detection & Response

Incident Response

Security Architecture

Vulnerability Management

Penetration Testing

Identity & Access Management

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

jobs.title: Senior Security & Compliance - Healthcare | Zenara Health
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive patient data, so security, access control, vendor risk, AI-tool risk, and evidence of how our controls operate are fundamental to earning customer trust.

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly and need a security and compliance program that is rigorous enough for healthcare and practical enough to work in a small, fast-moving company.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Security & Compliance Lead to build and own Zenara’s security and compliance program.

You will set risk priorities, define security and HIPAA-related controls, verify that they work, and lead our responses to customer security reviews. You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and our Platform Engineer, who owns day-to-day platform operations and implements and operates many of the technical controls.

You own the program’s direction and outcomes. The Platform Engineer owns the day-to-day operation of the platform. You will work together to turn security requirements into working practices, not just documents.

Here is the test: can you inspect a real technical environment, identify the risks that matter most, explain the trade-offs, and work with engineers to implement and verify effective controls?

We are not looking for someone who only produces compliance paperwork. We need a leader with healthcare security judgment, technical depth, and the willingness to remain involved until a control actually works.

Our Security and Compliance Vision

Security and compliance should be part of how Zenara operates every day—not a last-minute exercise when a customer sends a questionnaire.

You will build a program with clear control owners, practical policies, current evidence, tracked remediation, and tested response procedures. It should give engineering a safe path to move quickly while helping us protect patient data and answer customer questions with confidence.

Your remit includes:

  • HIPAA-related safeguards, policies, and evidence
  • Security risk assessment and remediation priorities
  • Technical control standards and verification
  • Patient-data flows and access controls
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews and audit preparation
  • Incident response and escalation procedures
  • Security practices for AI-assisted engineering

The goal is not to create the largest possible program. It is to establish the right controls, make ownership clear, and ensure those controls keep working as Zenara grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the security and compliance roadmap, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and follow-through.
  • Establish and maintain HIPAA-related policies, procedures, control requirements, and supporting evidence.
  • Review cloud infrastructure, access controls, secrets management, and other technical safeguards with the Platform Engineer.
  • Define what technical controls must achieve; partner with the Platform Engineer to implement and operate them; independently verify their effectiveness.
  • Review patient-data flows, vendors, AI tools, and LLM-related data risks.
  • Set requirements for how AI agents and tools access data, systems, and production environments.
  • Lead responses to customer security questionnaires and coordinate preparation for audits or other external reviews.
  • Establish incident response and escalation procedures, and help coordinate the response to significant security events.
  • Review the Platform Engineer’s security work regularly, mentor them, and identify gaps early.
  • Maintain a clear record of findings, decisions, exceptions, control owners, and remediation progress.

How You’ll Work With the Platform Engineer

These are closely connected roles, but they do not have identical ownership.

You will own: security and compliance strategy, risk decisions, control standards, HIPAA-related program requirements, verification, vendor and AI-tool risk reviews, and customer security responses.

The Platform Engineer will own: day-to-day infrastructure operations, deployments, monitoring, backups and restores, technical implementation of platform controls, and recurring operational checks.

For example, you may define the access-control standard and how its effectiveness will be verified. The Platform Engineer may implement it in Azure and operate the recurring checks. You will review the evidence, address exceptions, and remain accountable for whether the standard is adequate.

What AI-Native Security Means Here

Our engineering team uses AI agents to help build and operate software. That creates opportunities to improve speed and consistency, as well as risks that conventional security processes may miss.

You will help define:

  • Which tools and agents may access patient data, code, infrastructure, and production systems
  • What permissions and approval boundaries they need
  • How we assess AI vendors and data-processing risks
  • How agent activity and security findings are logged, reviewed, and escalated
  • Where automation can improve control monitoring and evidence collection

You do not need to be the person building every agent. You do need the judgment to govern their use and verify that automated checks are reliable. AI can assist with security work; it does not take accountability for security decisions.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior-level healthcare security and compliance experience, including substantial HIPAA expertise.
  • Verifiable examples of security or compliance programs, safeguards, or reviews you have led.
  • Hands-on technical security knowledge across cloud infrastructure, access control, secrets, and data protection.
  • Ability to assess a real technical environment—not only review policies.
  • Experience establishing or improving security practices in a small or growing organization.
  • Ability to translate risks and requirements into controls engineers can implement and operate.
  • Experience guiding engineers while independently assessing whether their controls work.
  • Clear written communication about risks, decisions, priorities, and practical next steps.
  • Judgment about what to address immediately, what to plan for, and when to escalate.

Relevant Areas

  • HIPAA and healthcare data security
  • Azure cloud and AKS / Kubernetes security
  • Access and secrets management
  • Patient-data flows and technical safeguards
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk
  • Customer security reviews
  • Control evidence and audit preparation
  • Incident response
  • Security roadmap prioritization

Nice to Have

  • SOC 2 or HITRUST experience
  • Azure security experience
  • Experience building a program at an early-stage startup
  • Experience assessing AI/LLM vendors and agent access to sensitive data

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review our current environment with the Platform Engineer, identify the highest-priority security and compliance gaps, clarify control ownership, and establish a practical remediation plan.

Within 90 days, core HIPAA-related policies and controls will have assigned owners and supporting evidence. Priority findings will be tracked to resolution, and the team will have a working cadence for reviewing risks, control effectiveness, and customer security requests.

Over time, Zenara will have a maintained security and compliance program: current evidence, tested incident procedures, tracked exceptions, clear ownership, and the ability to respond confidently to customer security reviews. Success means we can demonstrate how controls work in practice—not merely point to documents saying they exist.

Schedule

This is a full-time, remote role requiring regular live collaboration with our US-based founder and India-based engineering team. India-evening overlap is expected; the specific hours will be confirmed during hiring.

Significant security incidents may occasionally require coordination outside the usual collaboration window.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated expertise and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Significant ownership of the security and compliance foundations of an AI-native healthcare company

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Has real healthcare security and HIPAA experience.
  • Can combine policy knowledge with technical review.
  • Enjoys building a program and developing the people who operate its controls.
  • Prioritizes clearly instead of treating every finding as equally urgent.
  • Follows through from recommendation to implementation and verification.
  • Can balance startup speed with disciplined protection of patient data.

You may struggle if you prefer to advise from a distance, produce generic documentation without verifying implementation, or need a large established security team and budget to make progress.

If you want to own the security and compliance program for an AI-native health-tech company—and build foundations that work in practice—we would love to hear from you.

  • Experience supporting Cybersecurity Readiness Inspections, security assessments, control testing, or Security Test and Evaluation activities.
  • Experience with eMASS or comparable governance, risk, and compliance platforms.
  • Experience developing cybersecurity policies, security plans, standard operating procedures, interconnection agreements, risk assessments, and executive briefings.

Nice to have

Location & Availability
