jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior CSV/ CSA Specialist

Department: Information Technology

Location: Remote, East Coast Preferred

Hours Per Week: 40

Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday

SUMMARY

The Senior CSV/CSA Specialist leads risk-based validation and assurance activities for GxP-regulated computerized systems throughout their lifecycle. The role provides technical leadership in validation strategy, execution, quality review, audit and inspection readiness, while serving as a subject matter expert in CSV/CSA, SDLC, data integrity, electronic records/signatures, and regulatory requirements. The position also provides mentorship to junior CSV/CSA team members.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Validation and Assurance Strategy: Lead planning, execution, review, and approval of validation and assurance deliverables for new GxP systems, system upgrades, integrations, infrastructure changes, software changes, and system retirements, Determine appropriate validation or assurance rigor using risk-based principles aligned with GAMP 5, CSA, data integrity, e-record/e-signature, and applicable GxP expectations, Lead or review system risk assessments, validation strategy assessments, supplier/vendor assessments, impact assessments, and validation planning decisions, Ensure validation strategies are proportionate to system risk, intended use, business process impact, patient/subject safety, product quality, data integrity, and regulatory impact.
  • CSV/CSA Deliverables: Author, review, or approve validation lifecycle deliverables, including system risk assessments, validation plans or assurance plans, URS, functional/design/configuration specifications, IQ/OQ/PQ or functional testing protocols, regression testing, UAT evidence, traceability matrices, validation summary reports, periodic reviews, change impact assessments, data migration, archival, decommissioning, and retirement documentation, Ensure validation documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, reviewable, and inspection-ready, Provide quality and technical review of deliverables prepared by project teams, IT system owners, vendors, and less senior CSV/CSA resources.
  • IT Quality and Compliance Oversight: Provide IT Quality and Compliance oversight for computerized systems, SDLC activities, validation deliverables, change control deliverables, and system lifecycle processes, Support internal audits, external audits, client audits, regulatory inspections, audit responses, CAPAs, deviations, and remediation plans related to computerized systems, Identify compliance gaps, documentation weaknesses, lifecycle risks, and process improvement opportunities, Partner with Quality Assurance to resolve validation-related observations, audit findings, deviations, CAPAs, and inspection commitments.
  • System Lifecycle and Change Support: Support lifecycle activities including procurement, implementation, configuration, validation, operational use, change control, periodic review, incident/deviation support, migration, archival, and retirement, Ensure validated systems remain in a state of control through change assessment, regression testing, periodic review, access/security review, backup/restore review, data integrity review, and documentation maintenance, Provide senior-level review and guidance for GxP IT change controls, impact assessments, validation strategy decisions, test planning, evidence review, and release readiness.
  • Leadership, Mentoring, and Continuous Improvement: Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to CSV/CSA Specialists and cross-functional project teams, Support development and improvement of validation procedures, forms, templates, guidance documents, training materials, metrics, and operating rhythms, Promote consistent application of risk-based validation, CSA, supplier reliance, testing strategy, and lifecycle documentation practices, Facilitate cross-functional meetings and communications related to validation strategy, compliance expectations, audit readiness, and lifecycle deliverables, Perform other duties as assigned.

This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake any other duties that are reasonably required and are commensurate with the skills, experience and level of responsibility of the role.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or related field
  • OR Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience 5+ yrs CSV, CSA, IT quality, software validation, change control, SDLC, or GxP computerized systems experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong knowledge of computerized system validation, CSA, GAMP 5, SDLC, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, data integrity, and e-record/e-signature expectations.
  • Strong working knowledge of validation lifecycle deliverables and risk-based validation practices.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory expectations and apply them pragmatically to system risk, intended use, and business impact.
  • Strong technical writing, documentation review, inspection-readiness, analytical, prioritization, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Experience leading validation strategy and deliverable execution for laboratory, quality, clinical, enterprise, infrastructure, data, or integration systems.
  • Experience supporting audits, inspections, CAPAs, deviations, remediation activities, SDLC reviews, change controls, testing evidence, data integrity controls, and lifecycle records.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less senior validation or quality resources
  • Ability to lead complex validation activities across multiple systems, projects, stakeholders, and priorities.

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

This role leads the Specialty Pharmacy and Wholesaler Channel Management function within the US Market Access group (USMA), supporting Pfizer's U.S. Commercial business. This position is accountable for the strategy, contracting, and operational execution that ensures the access, distribution integrity, and appropriate handling of Pfizer's specialty and traditional products through the wholesaler and specialty pharmacy channels.

The Specialty Pharmacy & Wholesaler Channel team works closely with national and regional wholesalers, specialty distributors, and specialty pharmacies to ensure Pfizer's products move through the supply channel in a safe, secure, and compliant manner — with particular focus on the growing complexity of specialty product distribution, cold-chain/limited-distribution requirements, and evolving reimbursement and site-of-care dynamics that increasingly run through these two channels.

The position requires deep expertise in wholesaler and specialty pharmacy business models, distribution economics, and contracting, along with a strong understanding of how policy change (340B, site-of-care shifts, PBM/specialty pharmacy vertical integration, biosimilar and generic entry dynamics) affects channel strategy. The role requires strategic, analytical thinking with strong financial and business acumen, and experience negotiating complex channel contracts and services agreements.

This position partners closely with the USMA Strategy team, U.S. Commercial product teams, Trade & Distribution, Legal, Medical Affairs, Policy, Digital, and Finance. It represents Pfizer externally with large wholesaler and specialty pharmacy customers and internally with senior leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of channel management professionals responsible for wholesaler and specialty pharmacy account strategy, contracting, and performance management
  • Develop, negotiate, and execute wholesaler distribution agreements and specialty pharmacy network contracts that ensure appropriate, compliant, and efficient product flow
  • Partner with the USMA Strategy team to translate broader market access strategy into channel-specific execution plans for wholesalers and specialty pharmacies
  • Build and maintain productive, senior-level relationships with wholesaler and specialty pharmacy customers
  • Monitor and anticipate shifts in the specialty pharmacy and wholesaler landscape — including PBM-owned specialty pharmacy consolidation, alternative funding programs, and site-of-care migration — and adapt channel strategy accordingly
  • Ensure strong compliant governance and quality decision-making in all channels contracting and operations
  • Lead, develop, and hold managers accountable for an inclusive, engaged, and compliant team culture, including performance management and succession planning
  • Represent Pfizer in relevant industry and trade association initiatives related to distribution and specialty pharmacy channels

Basic Qualifications

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.


  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 15+ years of experience required with Bachelors; 13+ years of experience required with MBA/MS/MPH/master's degree; 10+ years of experience required with PhD or JD
  • Demonstrated experience in wholesaler and/or specialty pharmacy channel management, contracting, or trade relations within the healthcare/pharma sector
  • Track record of translating US healthcare policy and distribution trends into actionable channel strategy
  • Strong business/financial acumen, negotiation skills, and analytical capability
  • Proven experience as a leader, including coaching, developing talent, and driving inclusive team culture
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and lead through channel and policy change

  • Advanced degree in healthcare, business, or economics

Why Join STERRY?
We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your skills in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.description:
Job Title - Lead Specialist, Performance Marketing

This position is also known as: Senior Paid Search Manager; Lead SEM Specialist; Lead Performance Marketing Specialist; Paid Search Lead

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Lead Specialist, Performance Marketing to lead the day-to-day execution and optimization of paid search initiatives supporting the adoption of educational products and new student enrollment. This role will be responsible for operational excellence across search campaigns, driving performance improvements, managing internal team and agency execution, and delivering actionable insights that support enrollment and efficiency goals.

Reporting to the Principal, Performance Marketing, this position will serve as the primary owner of paid search campaign management and optimization, working closely with agency partners, Analytics, Enrollment, Finance, and Marketing stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines people leadership and deep hands-on search expertise with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for continuous testing and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Search Strategy & Execution

  • Serve as the day-to-day owner of Paid Search programs across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360, and other search platforms.
  • Execute and optimize campaigns designed to drive product adoption, student applications, and enrollments while meeting cost efficiency goals.
  • Translate strategic direction from the Principal, Performance Marketing into campaign plans, testing initiatives, and optimization recommendations.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and proactively identify opportunities to improve volume, conversion rates, and cost efficiency.
  • Manage keyword expansion, audience targeting, bidding strategies, ad copy testing, and campaign structure improvements.
  • Lead ongoing search query analysis and optimization efforts to maximize qualified traffic and enrollment outcomes.
  • Maintain deep expertise in evolving search trends, automation capabilities, AI-driven bidding, and platform best practices.

People, Agency & Vendor Management

  • Manage internal subject matter experts and paid media agency to deliver flawless campaign execution
  • Review agency recommendations and validate strategic and tactical decisions using performance data.
  • Hold agency partners accountable for campaign quality, reporting accuracy, and performance outcomes.
  • Coordinate the implementation of new platform features, beta opportunities, and testing initiatives.

Optimization, Testing & Innovation

  • Develop and manage a robust testing roadmap across campaigns, audiences, creative messaging, landing pages, bidding approaches, and automation strategies.
  • Conduct rigorous A/B testing and performance analysis to identify scalable opportunities for growth.
  • Utilize AI-enabled tools and platform capabilities to improve campaign efficiency and workflow effectiveness.
  • Partner with website and marketing stakeholders to support landing page optimization initiatives and improve conversion performance.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations to improve volume, efficiency, and return on investment.
  • Create recurring performance reports and dashboards highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Ensure campaign tracking, tagging, and measurement frameworks are functioning properly and producing accurate data.
  • Collaborate with Analytics teams to validate performance reporting and support attribution and measurement initiatives.
  • Assist with forecasting, spend pacing, and budget allocation recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Analytics, Finance, Enrollment, Marketing, and Digital COE teams to align campaign strategy with business objectives.
  • Communicate performance insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support enrollment planning discussions by providing performance projections, market insights, and search demand trends.
  • Contribute to broader performance marketing initiatives and support campaigns across additional digital channels as needed.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience managing Paid Search (SEM) campaigns.
  • Expert-level experience with Google Ads and SA360; Microsoft Ads experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated success managing large-scale search programs with measurable performance goals.
  • Strong understanding of conversion optimization, attribution, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and campaign measurement.
  • Experience managing agency relationships and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • People management, leadership, and development experience
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into action.
  • Experience with web analytics and tracking platforms, including Google Analytics and tag management solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and performance reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Preferred

  • Experience managing campaigns with varying goals across multiple geographies, markets, or business units.
  • Working knowledge of Paid Social, Programmatic, Online Video, or other performance media channels.
  • Experience supporting education, lead generation, healthcare, financial services, or other complex demand generation businesses.
  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) concepts and advanced measurement methodologies.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve campaign management, reporting, and optimization workflows.

Key Competencies

  • Paid Search Expertise
  • Data Analysis & Optimization
  • Performance Marketing
  • Agency Management
  • Campaign Execution
  • Testing & Experimentation
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Communication & Storytelling
  • Problem Solving
  • Attention to Detail
  • Project Management

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. This role uses customer experience methods, strategic communications, and stakeholder engagement to translate insights into actionable recommendations that improve products, services, and overall user experiences.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Why Patients Need You Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients.
jobs.description:
Why Patients Need You

Everything we do, every day, is in line with an unwavering commitment to the quality and the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our science and risk-based compliant quality culture is innovative and customer oriented. Whether you are involved in manufacturing, testing, or compliance, your contribution will directly impact patients.


What You Will Achieve

The Rare Disease (RD) Key Account Manager (KAM) will develop market insights and understand influencers on the market and Accounts/Customers in RD Therapeutic categories. This colleague is responsible for managing Accounts and developing key C-Suite/Administrative and RD therapeutic service line leader relationships.


The RD KAM is responsible for the development and implementation of Account Plans for the assigned Accounts and will identify, develop and pull through potential partnership opportunities between Pfizer and the Accounts/Customers. Work with other Pfizer stakeholders in the identification and development of appropriate RD KAM opportunities.


Responsible for working with state, regional or district business leaders and cross-functional Pfizer specialists to ensure appropriate level of support for an Account. Additional responsibilities include segmenting and prioritizing Accounts as well as identifying key Customers within the Accounts. Key Accounts can include, but are not limited to Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), Integrated Delivery Systems (IDSs), Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs), Medical Groups (MGs), Independent Physician Associations (IPAs), professional societies, HCP organizations, quality improvement organizations, and IDN specialty pharmacy (SPP) within the defined distribution network (DDN).

How You Will Achieve It

The Pfizer RD KAM role has three key focus areas: Customer Engagement, Account Management and Business and People Leadership.


Customer Engagement

  • Identify key Customers including the decision making and influencing network (within and those impacting on the Account and local health economy).
  • Maintain effective relationships with key Customer C-Suite and RD therapeutic service line leaders, administrative and decision-making roles within a prioritized Account
  • Develop effective relationships with key opinion leaders and stakeholders in local health economies.
  • Understand and seek to influence key local, regional and national healthcare issues and best practices aligned to market and key Accounts (political and advocacy organization engagements to be led by Political Affairs colleagues).
  • Manage co-execution of Project Plans (holding Customer and Pfizer accountable for plan execution).

Account Management

  • Manage a set of prioritized Accounts to achieve agreed business objectives.
  • Seek out opportunities for synergy and collaboration to achieve both Pfizer and Customer goals through active and transparent Customer/Account Planning.
  • Analyze and understand local environment, Account business, and aligned Pfizer priorities to create Account plans which identify mutually beneficial opportunities.
  • Leverage RD value propositions to create mutually beneficial business opportunities that result in action.
  • Identify, connect and communicate multiple insights from various stakeholders to develop a plan of action that is mutually beneficial to Pfizer and the customer.

Business & People Leadership

  • Partner with RD IAT to facilitate colleague understanding of local market/customer drivers.
  • Impact and influence development of KAM efforts locally, regionally or nationally by partnering with needed cross functional teams to compliantly shape efforts and deliver results.
  • Share and help scale proven practices across the region and nation.
  • Lead and support development of high functioning, x-functional team (sales, medical, marketing, HIT and IM KAM), consistent with account team model.
  • To be a local expert on healthcare reform, the evolving landscape and the organization of Accounts/Customers.
  • Lead the development of RD Account and strategic planning priorities.
  • Demonstrate a broad base of Rare Disease therapeutic category market knowledge and dynamics of healthcare which influences IDN behavior. Recognizes when and how to involve colleagues from other functional areas (IAT) to effectively build and execute strategic plans that address an issue or solve a problem.
  • Utilize organizational awareness skills and alignment of Pfizer's priorities to include appropriate Pfizer colleagues with an Account to optimize value provided to the Customer and to Pfizer.

Position Overview

Blue Acorn iCi is looking for an AEP Data Architect Consultant to serve as a senior, customer-facing advisor at the intersection of enterprise data architecture and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP). Client Advisory & Solution Strategy

  • Provide strategic guidance on Adobe Experience Platform adoption, enterprise data strategy, and solution architecture.

Data Architecture & Governance

  • Review and validate enterprise data architectures, XDM schema designs, identity resolution strategies, activation plans, and technical specifications.

Technical Leadership

  • Review technical design documents and architecture specifications to ensure alignment with Adobe best practices and enterprise standards.
  • Mentor Data Architects and cross-functional engineering teams by providing architectural oversight and technical leadership.

  • Act as the senior data architecture advisor across multiple client engagements, ensuring technical excellence throughout project delivery.

Delivery Excellence & Practice Development

  • Successfully manage multiple client engagements while balancing competing priorities and maintaining project governance.
  • Contribute reusable templates, playbooks, frameworks, and Center of Excellence initiatives that strengthen the Adobe consulting practice.
  • Develop client-facing documentation, presentations, architecture recommendations, and implementation guidance.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, workload estimates, and project tracking throughout engagements.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current on Adobe Experience Platform capabilities, Azure cloud technologies, and emerging enterprise data architecture trends.
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery methodologies and recommend innovative solutions that address evolving client needs.
  • Continuously expand technical expertise while contributing knowledge and best practices across the consulting organization.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise data architecture with expertise in ETL/ELT, large-scale data processing, and enterprise data strategy.
  • 5+ years of experience designing data models across relational, dimensional, columnar, and big data environments.
  • Experience working with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including XDM schema design and identity resolution strategies.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, NoSQL, enterprise data warehousing, and cloud-based data architecture.
  • Experience designing customer-centric datasets spanning CRM, marketing, call center, point-of-sale, and offline data sources.
  • Strong understanding of DataOps practices, enterprise data governance, GDPR/CCPA compliance, and data quality frameworks.
  • Experience reviewing technical architecture documents, solution designs, and data models while providing strategic recommendations.
  • Proven ability to mentor technical teams and provide architectural guidance across complex enterprise initiatives.
  • Strong business requirements gathering and structured analysis skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage engagement scope, govern project boundaries, and align client expectations to defined deliverables.
  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent client engagements in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Self-managed, proactive, customer-focused, and capable of delivering high-quality work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure cloud data platforms.
  • Experience with Databricks data architecture.
  • Familiarity with ML model management frameworks such as MLFlow.
  • Experience mentoring technical teams and leading enterprise advisory engagements.
  • Experience working within enterprise consulting or professional services organizations.

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 – $185,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors.

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

From large-scale digital transformation programs to platform implementations and ongoing optimization, we bring deep expertise and a collaborative mindset to every engagement.

Why Join Us?

Blue Acorn iCi is a place for curious thinkers, smart builders, and digital pioneers. We’re more than a consultancy—we’re a team of innovators helping the world’s top brands shape the future of digital.

Here, you won’t just contribute to a project—you’ll drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and grow your skills in a high-impact, high-growth environment. We believe great work starts with great people, and we’re committed to creating a culture where talent thrives, ideas spark change, and results speak for themselves.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.

About Ketch

Ketch is modern privacy management software that keeps customer data clean, permissioned, and AI-ready, so brands can power growth without regulatory or reputational risk.

The market came to us. GDPR and CCPA turned privacy from a legal afterthought into a funded, board-level requirement, and the wave of US state laws that followed means most enterprises are now managing a patchwork of overlapping obligations with tooling that was never built for it. AI sharpens the problem further: models are only as trustworthy as the permissions underneath them, and companies are finding that the data they have is not always data they are allowed to use.

That is the wedge. Ketch is a SaaS platform that sits underneath the customer data stack, capturing and enforcing permissions across every device, browser, system, and model a brand touches. It turns compliance spend into an asset by making previously unusable data available for advertising, analytics, and AI.

The results are measurable, and they are what you will sell on:

  • 80% improvement in operational efficiency through workflow automation
  • 23% lift in customer purchase intent when data collection practices are built around transparency, control, retention, and clear data sharing
  • 12x ROI against legacy tooling, with low-code maintenance and auditable records that stand up to a regulator

Customers back that up publicly. Ketch holds a 4.6 out of 5 satisfaction score on G2 across more than 140 verified reviews, and earned 22 badges across 41 reports in the Summer 2026 cycle, spanning consent management, DSAR, data privacy management, cookie tracking, and sensitive data discovery.

Ketch ranks #1 in Enterprise Usability, Results, and Relationship for consent management, and #1 in DSAR Momentum. Fewer than one in fifty products across G2's reports earn Leader recognition at all.

About the Organization
EnGen offers an at-scale, AI-powered approach to English instruction, designed to solve a systemic access issue: Adult English learners now represent 1 in 10 working-age adults in the U.S., yet the workforce system serves the needs of just 4% of these workers.
A Certified B Corporation, EnGen is filling the gap by partnering with employers, adult educators, workforce development organizations, and state governments to connect job seekers and incumbent workers with English skills, career pathways, and employment in high-demand industries. EnGen's workforce-aligned approach addresses employers' recruitment and retention challenges and advances learners' economic mobility.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to help build the technology that empowers adult English learners to achieve their career goals. You'll develop and enhance our AI-powered learning platform using TypeScript/React on the frontend and Python/FastAPI on the backend.
We expect our engineers to be fluent in AI-assisted development — using tools like Cursor and Claude Code to write, review, and ship code faster and at higher quality. You should be comfortable directing AI to generate code, critically evaluating what it produces, and knowing when to write it yourself.

Full-Stack Development

  • Deliver production software across our TypeScript/React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend — whether writing code directly or steering AI tools to generate it
  • Build responsive web applications for diverse learners across desktop and mobile
  • Design and implement scalable APIs to support our learning platform
  • Develop real-time features for interactive lessons, conversation practice, and learner-coach communication

AI/LLM Integration

  • Integrate Large Language Models for content classification, skill assessment, learner feedback, and personalization
  • Build information extraction systems to analyze learner responses
  • Implement AI-powered features for conversation practice and multilingual support

Development Excellence

  • Write clean, well-tested code — and apply the same rigor when reviewing AI-generated output
  • Actively use and refine AI-assisted development workflows to improve your own productivity
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and education specialists
  • Contribute to A/B testing frameworks and learning experience optimization

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack web development experience
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, React, Python, and FastAPI
  • Experience integrating with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) for classification, extraction, or personalization
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) — and genuine comfort using them as part of your daily workflow
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and API design
  • Strong passion for EnGen's mission to help immigrants and refugees remove English as a barrier to career advancement
  • Self-directed and able to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building edtech or language learning platforms
  • Knowledge of NLP and educational AI applications
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards
  • Experience with Railway, Cloudflare, or similar cloud infrastructure
  • Multilingual capabilities, particularly Spanish

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO and fully remote environment
  • Professional development budget
  • Mission-driven work with measurable real-world impact

jobs.description:
Ketch is redefining responsible data use for the AI era. Thousands of brands rely on our software to responsibly collect, control, and activate compliant, clean data across their enterprise ecosystem. The Ketch Data Permissioning Platform simplifies privacy and consent operations, increases revenue from advertising, data, and AI initiatives, and builds trust with customers and partners. Unlike legacy tools that stop at cookie banners, Ketch governs how data is actually used across a company’s entire stack, with no-code setup that gets customers live in weeks, not quarters.

As privacy regulations expand across the globe and AI transforms how companies use data, the demand for what Ketch has built has never been greater. Data privacy sits at the intersection of law, technology, and consumer trust, making it one of the most exciting and fastest-moving fields in software today.

Why Join Us?

At Ketch, we’re serious about our values of passion, growth, grit, collaboration, and integrity. We’re a 65-person, Series B company backed by top-tier investors, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers while shaping how the world handles data responsibly. We’re a rapidly growing, fast-paced, mission-based organization filled with a passionate, close-knit team all operating at the top of their game.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of premiums paid for US-based full-time employees

  • Unlimited PTO, with employees encouraged to take at least 15 days a year

  • 10 paid company holidays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Remote-friendly with flexible scheduling built around core collaboration hours

  • Commuter benefits for office-based employees

About The Role

You’ll work hand-in-hand with GTM leadership and the sales team and will partner regularly with Finance, Legal, and Marketing to help optimize the deal cycle. You’ll own Sales Operations end-to-end: the deal desk, pricing strategy and approvals, pipeline and forecast infrastructure, and the reporting and analysis that helps Sales leadership run the business. You will report directly to the VP of Revenue Operations/SMB Sales, and you two will partner closely on the broader revenue operations agenda.

At Ketch, operations sits at the intersection of systems, process, and data: you’ll design systems that minimize manual processes wherever reasonable – building for scale rather than an automation that gets torn out in six months. Those systems capture the data needed to analyze GTM processes, and those analyses drive the next round of process and systems improvements.

AI is changing what a lean operations team can accomplish. Rather than building out separate ops leads, system admins, and pods of analysts, we are looking for one exceptional operator who works with AI to cover that ground: streamlining systems improvements and building AI-powered tools that put data and analysis directly in the hands of Sales leaders.

This is a remote role within the United States.

Responsibilities

Deal Desk & Pricing:

  • Own the deal desk. Structure, review, and shepherd non-standard deals from quote through approval, and be the person Sales calls when a deal does not fit the standard shape. Keep the approval path fast and predictable, and make the standard shape the easy one to sell.

  • Own pricing strategy and operations: packaging, price books, discount guardrails, approval thresholds, and the quote-to-close mechanics that enforce them. Analyze realized discounting, win rates by price point, and deal shape to recommend pricing changes, and build the case for them with data.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal on contract terms, order forms, and revenue recognition inputs so the deal desk speeds deals up rather than slowing them down.

Pipeline, Forecast & Reporting:

  • Own pipeline hygiene, stage definitions, and the forecast cadence. Give Sales leadership a forecast they trust and can defend, and the reporting to see where it is drifting before quarter end.

  • Build the reporting and self-serve dashboards Sales leaders, managers, and reps use daily: pipeline coverage, conversion by stage and segment, velocity, quota attainment, activity-to-outcome linkage, and territory performance.

  • Run the analyses that change how Sales operates, not just report the numbers. Segment profitability, ROI on sales investments, ramp and productivity by cohort, win/loss patterns. Construct the business case, and tell the story.

Systems:

  • Design durable systems, not quick fixes. Do the math: quantify and prioritize business value before investing in automation. Ensure every system captures the data needed to analyze the process it runs. Make responsible, effective use of company assets.

  • Own the Sales side of the CRM and the surrounding stack (CPQ or quoting, forecasting, sales engagement, and conversation intelligence), including the workflow, data model, and integration work that keeps it clean.

  • Work with AI tools to accelerate systems design, administration, and integration work that historically required dedicated admins. Build AI-driven analytical tools and self-serve reporting that let Sales leaders answer their own questions. Continuously evaluate where AI can replace manual processes, and where it shouldn't.

Planning:

  • Support territory and quota planning, capacity modeling, comp plan mechanics, and headcount analysis alongside Sales and Finance leadership.

Experience

  • 7+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a comparable analytical GTM role at SaaS companies

  • 3+ years directly supporting a Sales organization, including hands-on deal desk or pricing ownership

  • Demonstrated track record of designing and implementing sales systems built to scale

  • Example systems include: Salesforce, HubSpot, CPQ and quoting tools, forecasting platforms, sales engagement and conversation intelligence tooling

  • Demonstrated experience running analyses that informed pricing, process, or systems changes

  • Fluency with the numbers that run a sales org: pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, ASP, discount realization, quota attainment

Qualifications and Characteristics

  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI to multiply your output in systems work, analytics, or tool-building; be prepared to show us what you've built

  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor: you are the Sales Ops team, augmented by AI, and you like it that way

  • Sound judgment under deal pressure: you can hold a pricing line and still be the person reps want in the room

  • Demonstrated ability to translate operational and systems work into measurable business value

  • History of success working as part of a virtual global team environment

  • Exceptional time management and people alignment skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

  • Able to legally work in the United States

  • English language fluency (spoken and written)

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Trial Success team ensures enterprise trials are executed with excellence. By enabling seamless trial execution, we help prospects realize the full value of our solution and prepare them for successful implementation.

As a Sr. Trial Success Manager (TSM), you will support trial execution, working alongside the Sales team to ensure that prospective customers experience the full value of our solutions during the trial. You will partner closely with internal sales, sales engineering, and other cross functional teams to create and drive progress on customized trial plans tailored to client needs. This is a high-profile role, critical to driving trial conversion, overall sales success, and long-term customer adoption, particularly in the Enterprise Sales segment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

Travel Requirements:

This role will require travel to Samsara and customer sites in the US and Canada up to 25% of the time. Expected travel includes 3-5 onsite trips per quarter of 1-2 nights each.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage the trial of Samsara technology for enterprise prospects, developing tailored trial plans customized to the prospect’s specific needs.
  • Lead value-based conversations to establish success criteria, define project scope and manage internal and external teams accountable for the end-to-end delivery of the trial.

  • Lead internal account team strategy sessions to unblock deals and drive alignment on next steps to progress the trial, coordinate leadership support asks, and more.
  • Coordinate with key cross functional teams to bring in the right resources at the right time based on strategic priorities of the trial.
  • Communicate updates on major milestones, keeping internal and external stakeholders informed of progress and trial outcomes.
  • Create tailored meeting content for key trial milestones and ad hoc engagements as needed.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale.

  • Bachelor’s degree required

Required Skills

  • Strong project management experience (PMP certification is a plus).
  • Expertise in change management, communication strategies, risk management, and coaching techniques.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and manage urgent requests. Experience managing stakeholders across cross functional teams, building processes and driving impact/results.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to convey complex ideas concisely.
  • Technical aptitude and experience with CRM and project management tools.
  • Adaptability and flexibility to navigate dynamic and fast-paced environments.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a focus on delivering results.
  • Strong quantitative, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Self-starter who enjoys owning projects and thrives in an unstructured, change-heavy environment.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Nice-to-have: Sales experience closing business with large Enterprise organizations
  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.
  • Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies.
  • Proven experience managing and leading proof-of-concept, proof-of-value, or trial processes in software or hardware.

Annual OTE Salary
$112,246—$169,785 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Company Overview
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.

The Role
We're hiring an Applied AI Operations Lead to join our GTM Operations team and drive successful deployment, adoption, and governance of AI agents across our customer base. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Applied AI engineering team and the healthcare organizations implementing Canvas's state-of-the-art AI capabilities to transform their clinical and operational workflows.
You'll be the hands-on expert who partners directly with customers to deploy and manage AI agents built with foundation model APIs and our server-side SDK, ensuring they deliver measurable value in real-world healthcare settings. This means working closely with clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, configure agents for optimal performance, and operate robust governance frameworks that build trust in AI-powered automation.
This role is ideal for someone who combines technical depth in LLM-based systems with exceptional customer-facing skills and a passion for healthcare transformation. You'll translate complex AI capabilities into compelling value stories, guide customers through change management, and create repeatable playbooks that accelerate AI adoption across the Canvas customer base. Your work will directly impact how thousands of care teams leverage AI to deliver better patient outcomes while reducing administrative burden.
You'll collaborate with our Applied AI engineering team to inform product development based on field insights, work with customer success to ensure smooth implementations, and partner with technical marketing to showcase the transformative impact of AI agents in Canvas. As AI becomes central to healthcare delivery, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, helping our customers realize the full potential of healthcare automation.
What You'll Do

Customer Deployment & Implementation

- Partner directly with healthcare organizations to deploy and configure AI agents for clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, communications, and workflow automation
- Conduct workflow assessments to identify high-impact automation opportunities and design agent implementations that deliver measurable ROI
- Configure and optimize agent performance using prompt engineering, context management, and tool selection based on specific customer requirements
- Create and maintain customer-specific evaluation frameworks that demonstrate agent effectiveness and build stakeholder confidence

Governance & Trust Building

- Maintain AI governance frameworks that ensure safe, reliable agent operations in production healthcare environments
- Design and implement monitoring systems for agent performance, including accuracy tracking, drift detection, and quality assurance protocols
- Partner with clinical and compliance teams to ensure deployed agents meet regulatory requirements and operational standards

Technical Excellence & Innovation

- Work hands-on with foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) and the Canvas SDK to troubleshoot and optimize agent behavior

Strategic Customer Partnership

- Serve as the trusted AI advisor for Canvas customers, helping them navigate the transformation to AI-powered healthcare operations
- Drive executive conversations about AI strategy, demonstrating how Canvas's platform capabilities enable competitive advantage
- Create compelling narratives around AI impact using customer success stories, performance metrics, and ROI analyses
- Partner with sales teams on strategic opportunities, providing technical expertise and vision for AI transformation
Qualifications

Required Experience & Background

- 5+ years in technical customer-facing roles (solutions engineering, technical consulting, customer success engineering)
- Demonstrated experience deploying and managing LLM-based applications in production environments
- Track record of driving successful enterprise technology implementations with measurable business outcomes
- Strong project management skills with ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously

AI & Technical Expertise

- Hands-on experience with products offered from foundation model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic,Google) and AI tools for low-code automation, with understanding of their capabilities and limitations
- Understanding of AI safety, alignment, and governance principles
- Experience with evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and performance monitoring for AI systems
- Learned experience with the edges and limitations of AI products, and understanding of the iterative process required to get high quality results

Healthcare & Domain Knowledge

- Healthcare technology experience required, with ability to give workflow advice and construct automations that meet the needs of healthcare users
- Understanding of clinical workflows, EMR systems, and healthcare operations a plus
- Familiarity with HIPAA, clinical documentation standards, and healthcare compliance considerations
- Ability to quickly develop domain expertise and speak credibly with clinical stakeholders

Skills & Capabilities

- Comfort with ambiguity and ability to define structure in undefined spaces
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with ability to create compelling technical content
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with data-driven approach to decision making
- Experience creating and delivering technical training to diverse audiences

Who You Are

  • You're energized by ambiguity and thrive in fast-paced environments where you can experiment, iterate, and scale what works
  • You have 5+ years of experience implementing workflow tools and automation solutions in enterprise settings, with 2+ years of hands-on experience with LLM-based systems
  • You're deeply familiar with foundation model capabilities and have practical experience with context engineering and adversarial testing
  • You excel at translating technical complexity into business value, comfortable presenting to both technical teams and C-suite executives
  • You bring a consultative approach to customer engagement, able to diagnose problems, design solutions, and drive change management
  • You have experience in healthcare technology or a strong willingness to rapidly develop domain expertise in clinical and operational workflows
  • You combine technical depth with exceptional communication skills, able to create documentation, deliver training, and influence stakeholders

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • You've successfully deployed AI agents with at least 3 Canvas customers, demonstrating measurable improvements in efficiency and user satisfaction
  • You've made significant contributions, based on your field insights, to the best practices playbook for AI agent deployment and monitoring
  • You've created compelling case studies and ROI analyses that accelerate sales cycles and customer adoption
Location

San Francisco preferred.

jobs.excerpt: Job Overview As a member of our Protection & Control Engineering Services Team, you will be responsible for creating substation drawing packages including one-line drawings, three-line drawings, DC schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, component layouts, electrical plans, and detailed assembly drawings that will be drafted using AutoCAD® and MicroStation.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

As a member of our Protection & Control Engineering Services Team, you will be responsible for creating substation drawing packages including one-line drawings, three-line drawings, DC schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, component layouts, electrical plans, and detailed assembly drawings that will be drafted using AutoCAD® and MicroStation. Our P&C Engineering Services teams also perform fault analysis and coordination studies, SCADA settings, along with developing settings for most station relays.

A Day In The Life

Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by:

Interpret customer specifications and provide a design which meets all requirements

Understand the theories and fundamentals of electrical circuits and related components

Check/yellow line protection and control wiring diagrams to schematic diagrams

Create control panel and field equipment wiring diagrams from schematic diagrams

Create project specific protection and control schematic diagrams from standard customer schematics

Create protection and control schematic diagrams from a 1-Line diagram

Update/revise existing customer substation legacy Brownfield schematic and wiring diagrams

Collaborate with designers and engineers on technical issues.

Perform all Project Management activities and lead small projects without supervision.

Recognize a need for, and champion process improvements

Customer visits (travel approximately 10% of the time)

What will help you thrive in this role?

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology; P.E. license or P.E. track preferred

Minimum one year of Transmission and Distribution Protection and Control related experience

Knowledge and understanding of the specifications, structure, programming and configuration of the following control devices is also beneficial:

  • Microprocessor Based Protection and Control Relays,RS-232/RS485/Fiber optic/Ethernet Communication,RTU Equipment, HMI, SCADA System

Advanced working knowledge of MS Office Suite

Strong attention to detail

Working knowledge of transmission and distribution protection and control schematic and wiring diagrams

Proven analytical & problem-solving skills

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Product Manager - 4 Day Week + Remote
jobs.excerpt: Do you know what product management is really about?
jobs.description:
Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.

At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.

The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for. That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.

We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.

This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

We are Shape.Construction!

We are digitising the largest and most fundamental industry in the world, the industry that literally builds the foundations of the civilisation we all depend on to spare us from a brutal hunter-gatherer life: CONSTRUCTION

It is one of the least digitised industries in the world but also the largest - 1 in 9 people globally work in the construction industry and it constitutes 11% of global GDP.

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it).

We got our start as a high-end construction project management consultancy. As a consultancy, we are focused on genuinely upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. We then take the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products that anyone can use to deliver their projects better.

We are building a full suite of products one module at a time - kind of like office 365 but for construction management - Check out Shape, our construction management tech

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit the very best both in capability and personality. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People that join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined.

This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 220 today (including consultancy) and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn't just some "job", it is a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. So our values reflect the 4 levels of relationships that each of us has:

  • Grow yourself - Your relationship with yourself
  • Care about people - Your relationship with others around you
  • Execute to greatness - Your relationship with your team
  • Build civilisation - Your relationship with humanity and the world

This goes much deeper but for the sake of brevity, we will keep the summary version!

We enshrined our values in our vision

We exist so that everyone in our team can thrive in a high-impact community that:

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

We believe that, by first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.

And enable the achievement of our vision through our dual missions:

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

The Role

Purpose of the role

As a Product Manager you'll own a core area of the Shape platform end to end, from the customer problem through to the outcome it produces on a live project.

You'll be accountable for a measurable business outcome for our customers, not for a feature list. Our platform spans two very different worlds, and both matter. On one side, the site: supervisors, field engineers and site managers working in conditions where an app has about five seconds to prove it's worth opening. On the other, the office: project directors, commercial directors and quantity surveyors who need to trust what they're looking at enough to make a call on it. Value only appears when those two sides connect, and that connection is what we build.

Depending on where you're strongest and what the business needs, you might own the field side, the commercial side, or the seam between them. In every case the standard is the same: real adoption by people who have no obligation to use us, and a concrete outcome for the project as a result.

You'll also be at the front of how AI shows up in our products. A meaningful part of our ambition depends on AI doing genuinely hard things well in a domain with very little tolerance for confident nonsense, the stakes for our users are commercial and often contractual. You'll be the person who decides where AI earns its place, and where it doesn't.

Team

You'll be part of our Product team, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design, and our consultancy delivery teams, who are on live projects every day and are the sharpest feedback loop any product team could ask for. You'll also work closely with growth and customer success to make sure what we build reaches the people who need it.

Your top five responsibilities

  1. Own the outcome: You will own a product area end to end, the problem, the strategy, the roadmap and the results. You'll define what success looks like in customer and commercial terms, and you'll be honest about whether we hit it.
  2. Get close to the problem, on both sides: You'll spend real time on live projects, in the site cabin and in the commercial meeting, with our consultancy teams, and in the data. You'll build a deeper understanding of how a construction project actually runs, and of the commercial machinery behind it, than most people in our industry have, and use it to make sharp calls about what to build and what to refuse.
  3. Ship AI that holds up in the real world: You'll take AI features from concept to production in a domain where being wrong has consequences. You'll design for human-in-the-loop where the stakes demand it, set the bar for evaluating output quality, and make sure we never ship something that sounds confident and is wrong.
  4. Drive the roadmap and the trade-offs: You'll sequence work into cycles, make the hard prioritisation calls, and communicate them clearly enough that everyone from an engineer to a founder understands why. You'll say no often and well.
  5. Grow yourself and others: We're big on learning and development. You'll raise the product craft around you, give and receive candid feedback, and help build a world-class product function as we scale.

Your Capabilities

You are a product person who is genuinely curious about how things work and impatient about whether they're actually helping anyone. You'd rather find out you were wrong in two weeks than be right in a year. You can hold a strong opinion and change it in front of evidence without ego.

Must-Have (The fundamentals)

  • Mastery: Proven experience managing enterprise SaaS products end to end, with a clear track record of driving business outcomes for customers - not just shipping features. You understand enterprise realities: long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, procurement, security, adoption inside organisations that don't change easily.
  • Mastery (AI): Real, hands-on proficiency with AI. You've shipped or seriously prototyped AI-powered features, you understand what LLMs are good and bad at, and you can reason about retrieval and grounding, evaluation, hallucination risk, cost and latency trade-offs, and where a human must stay in the loop. You use AI tools daily in your own work and it shows.
  • Range: You can design for a user in a hi-vis vest with one hand free and poor signal, and for a director who needs to defend a number in a room full of people who'd rather they couldn't. Products that serve both are harder than products that serve either, and you find that interesting rather than annoying.
  • Communication: A clear and compelling communicator. You can make a complex product argument simple, write a crisp strategy document, and hold your own with both a site-based engineer and a senior business leader. You build relationships through a humanistic, empathetic approach, because our customers aren't just users!
  • Leadership: You take ownership. You don't wait for permission, you don't hide behind process, and you're comfortable making a decision with incomplete information and being accountable for it.
  • Impact: You can read between the lines, spot the opportunity nobody asked for, and measure whether it worked. You're rigorous with data but you don't hide behind it.
  • Domain: Ideally some experience in construction, engineering, real estate, or an adjacent complex operational industry (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, field services). What matters most is that you can get deep into a hard, physical, unglamorous domain and love it.

Nice to Have (If you don't have it now you will after joining)

  • Mastery: Experience with mobile-first or field-facing products used in tough physical conditions, and/or with commercial workflows, contracts, change control, claims, cost management, or with products where the output carries legal or contractual weight. If you're not an expert in construction or digital project delivery yet, you will be! We'll give you the tools and knowledge to speak the industry's language.
  • Communication: Experience taking a product to market with sales and marketing, and telling its story publicly, talks, writing, or an extensive network in construction and/or tech.
  • Leadership: Early leadership or people management exposure, experience coaching or mentoring other PMs. We're growing fast, and we want our best product people to step up and take on bigger responsibilities. If you're ambitious, there's a clear path to more.
  • Impact: Experience scaling a product from early traction to a genuine platform, and the scars that come with it. Beyond hitting delivery targets, you'll play a key role in shaping how construction teams adopt technology, and that's a rare thing to be able to say about your work.

Shape isn't the place for you if any of the following is true:

  • You want an easy role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don't like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
  • You'd rather report on activity than be measured on an outcome

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • In-house coaching: Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being
  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self: Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact: We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • What do you think you bring to the team?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all letters will be read thoroughly.

After that, we will reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

After that, we will schedule a couple of technical and personal assessments to understand what your level of capability is based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join you are starting at the right level of responsibility based on your capability not just based on experience.
