jobs.title: Associate General Counsel, Corporate
jobs.excerpt: Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success.
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for an Associate General Counsel to own legal support for the Finance team and our capital markets and securitization program, reporting to the Deputy General Counsel.

The impact you'll make:

Behind every Mission Lane credit line is capital, and behind that capital is legal work that has to hold up: equity investments, ABS transactions and SEC filings. The Associate General Counsel in this role keeps that footing solid, so Capital Markets and Finance can keep unlocking the capital that moves more people further down their path to financial progress. You’ll do that by:

  • Serving as legal lead on ABS transactions, debt and structured debt deals, and M&A transactions
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documents, credit facilities and third-party contracts with partner banks, service providers, and technology vendors
  • Supporting IPO readiness projects, including building out processes to meet our current and future SEC reporting obligations
  • Managing outside counsel on Capital Markets and Finance matters so we get timely, high-quality advice on a cost effective basis
  • Tracking legal and market developments that could affect the business before they become a problem and flagging them early
  • Supporting corporate governance work as needed, including board and committee meeting prep and corporate resolutions

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You're experienced at drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex corporate financing agreements, whether at a law firm or in-house.
  • You have real, recent experience with SEC reporting and disclosure.
  • You are curious, interested in being challenged with new legal and business projects, and want to be part of a growing team and company.
  • You're humble and thoughtful, and you operate without needing much direction. You'd rather bring a proposed solution to a problem than a question and you spot the fundamental issue before anyone asks you to look for it.
  • You want to build something, not maintain it. If Mission Lane goes public, you'd help build our SEC reporting and corporate compliance programs and shape how they work.
  • You partner comfortably with our Capital Markets and Finance executives in a room where the legal question is real but isn't the only thing on the table and where your read on the situation carries weight.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar
  • 5+ years of relevant law firm experience or 7+ years of relevant in-house or combined legal experience, with strong, hands-on experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex corporate agreements
  • Demonstrated experience supporting SEC reporting obligations (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statements) and a strong working knowledge of current SEC rules and disclosure requirements
  • Exceptional analytical, writing and communication skills, including the ability to translate legal issues for non-lawyers
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and execute independently without needing day-to-day direction
  • A high standard of integrity, humility and sound judgment
  • Able to work remotely, with periodic required travel for team gatherings and business needs

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Background in structured finance beyond ABS: warehouse lending facilities, whole loan sales or forward flow arrangements
  • Familiarity with consumer financial products and the regulations that come with them
  • In-house experience at a late-stage private company, including exposure to investor relations or pre-IPO readiness work

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $178,000 - $225,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.

Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.

Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.

Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Mission Lane provides reasonable accommodations to applicants who need them for medical or religious reasons, as required by law. Applicants can initiate an accommodation request by contacting .

Mission Lane is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization and please, no third-party recruiters.

Application Integrity:

Our cardholders trust us with their financial well-being, and this trust starts with the integrity of the people on our team. We're looking for team members who share our dedication to transparency and truth. Please verify that the information in your application is accurate and complete.

Providing any information to Mission Lane that is not completely truthful at any point during the application or hiring process may result in removal from the hiring process, disqualification from future opportunities, withdrawal of an offer or other sanctions for candidates and, in addition for employees, disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.title: Talent Development Program Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Talent Development Program Specialist, you will play a key role in designing, building, and executing modern learning programs at Human Interest. You will act as both an instructional designer and an engaging facilitator, mixing strategy with storytelling to create resources, processes, and experiences that shape careers and drive our high-performance culture.

We are looking for someone who is tech-forward—who actively leverages modern AI tools to streamline content creation, elevate slide presentations, and scale enablement across the entire employee lifecycle.

What you get to do every day

Tech-Forward Instructional Design and Content Creation

  • Design and build contemporary, self-led e-learning modules, on-demand micro-learning assets, training guides, facilitator materials, and slide decks.
  • Actively leverage AI tools to write scripts, generate visual assets, draft assessments, and accelerate instructional design.
  • Document processes and update People Team resources in our intranet (Confluence).
  • Build structured project proposals and training deployment plans that clearly articulate learning objectives, target outcomes, and agile rollout strategies.
  • Uphold Human Interest’s brand consistently through communications and experiences.
  • Assess feedback and internal data to enhance, expand, change and/or adapt our offerings and ways of doing things.
  • Establish post-training feedback channels to gather participant insights, actively translating learner input into actionable updates to refine and elevate learning programs.

Facilitation and Learning Delivery

  • Facilitate energetic, interactive virtual and in-person training sessions and workshops across employee levels and different departments.
  • Conduct thorough learning needs assessments and gap analyses to align L&D initiatives with company objectives, directly translating identified gaps into actionable learning solutions.
  • Manage and execute talent programs, including ongoing employee growth and leadership development.

Stakeholder and People Team Support

  • Work cross-functionally to support the success of talent development programs.
  • Build effective relationships with other internal organizations to support employee development.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on employee development efforts that will aid in retaining top talent.
  • Provide administrative support for our Learning Management System (Docebo).
  • Manage and assist with People Team projects from inception to completion.

What you bring to the role

  • 3- 5 years of experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Instructional Design or related fields.
  • Experience creating eLearning content using tools such as Articulate Rise.
  • Strong facilitation and presentation skills in both in-person and virtual environments.
  • Working knowledge of LMS administration (experience with Docebo and Confluence is a major plus) and multimedia editing software (e.g., Canva).
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to optimize daily workflows, draft content, and build visual assets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Meticulous organization and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and cross-functional skills.
  • Able to function independently, as well as collaboratively with other team members.
  • Ability to leverage existing tools and materials creatively to build high-impact, scalable solutions within lean environments.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

Assistant General Counsel

What You’ll Do

Koalafi is looking for an Assistant General Counsel to lead and manage external legal matters and provide strategic legal counsel as we continue to grow and evolve our consumer-finance business. This role will have primary responsibility for managing consumer litigation and arbitration, regulatory examinations and investigations, enforcement matters, and escalated legal complaints.

You will manage matters from initial assessment through resolution, including internal fact development, discovery, motion and trial strategy, settlement, and coordination with regulators and outside counsel. You will work closely with partners across Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Finance, and Sales to assess exposure, develop effective strategies, and communicate legal risks, trends, and insights to key stakeholders and senior leadership.

Beyond managing disputes and regulatory matters, you will also serve as a strategic legal partner to leaders across the organization as Koalafi evaluates and launches new products, capabilities, and business initiatives. You will help identify and assess legal and regulatory risks, evaluate potential exposure and tradeoffs, and provide practical, risk-based guidance that enables the business to make informed decisions and move initiatives forward. This work will span both Koalafi's traditional lending and Lease-to-Own product segments and may involve novel or evolving legal issues where sound judgment is as important as clear precedent.

This role is ideal for an attorney who combines meaningful consumer-financial-services litigation and regulatory experience with strong business judgment, practical risk assessment, and an execution-oriented mindset. You will serve as a trusted advisor to the General Counsel & Chief Compliance Officer, senior leadership, and business partners while helping Koalafi manage legal risk, support strategic growth, and build scalable processes for managing external legal matters.

Litigation, Arbitration & Dispute Resolution

  • Lead Koalafi’s strategy and response across individual and class-action litigation, arbitration, threatened claims, demand letters, subpoenas, and other adversarial matters.
  • Manage matters throughout their full lifecycle, including initial assessment, internal fact investigation, discovery, motion practice, settlement strategy, trial preparation, and resolution.
  • Assess legal, financial, operational, customer, and reputational exposure and provide clear recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Direct and manage outside counsel, including matter strategy, staffing, budgets, performance, and work-product quality.
  • Maintain clear reporting on active matters, significant developments, potential exposure, and emerging trends.

Regulatory Examinations & Escalated Legal Complaints

  • SupportKoalafi’s response to regulatory examinations, investigations, inquiries, enforcement actions, and requests for information.
  • Manage regulatory matters from initial request through investigation, response, remediation, settlement, or other resolution.
  • Develop response strategies in partnership with the General Counsel & Chief Compliance Officer, Legal Operations team. outside counsel, and relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Serve as a legal point of contact for federal and state regulators and represent Koalafiwith credibility, responsiveness, and sound judgment.
  • Identify patterns across regulatory matters and escalated legal complaints and communicate relevant risks to the appropriate business owners.

Legal Strategy & Operational Effectiveness

  • Serve as a trusted legal advisor to the General Counsel & Chief Compliance Officer and senior leaders on strategic business initiatives, new products, and evolving operational priorities.
  • Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, and Sales to identify, assess, and address legal and regulatory risks associated with new and existing business initiatives.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Germany

Responsibilities

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
  • Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.
  • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
  • Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.
  • This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

  • Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.

    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
    • Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
    • Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.
    • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

jobs.description:
Du willst zu den Top-Verdienern in einer der am stärksten wachsenden Branchen Österreichs gehören? Dann werde Teil des führenden Anbieters für Photovoltaik und Energielösungen.

Über tausend Haushalte in Österreich vertrauen bereits auf unsere PV-Anlagen, unsere Marke ist österreichweit bekannt und wir wachsen seit Jahren stark. Genau deshalb suchen wir jetzt Verstärkung im Vertrieb (Setter und Closer):

Menschen, die motiviert sind, in einem wachsenden Unternehmen wirklich etwas aufzubauen und dabei überdurchschnittlich zu verdienen.

Aufgaben

Du übernimmst den gesamten Vertriebsprozess: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme mit vorqualifizierten Interessenten über die individuelle Beratung bis hin zum Abschluss. Du klärst die Situation des Kunden, erkennst seinen Bedarf und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserer Planungsabteilung ein passendes Angebot. Du präsentierst dieses Angebot und begleitest den Kunden bis zur Auftragsunterzeichnung.

Kaltakquise gibt es bei uns nicht. Alle Interessenten kennen die Marke bereits und kommen aktiv auf uns zu.

Qualifikation

  • Willensstärke, Motivation und Ehrgeiz
  • Klare und überzeugende Kommunikation am Telefon und im persönlichen Gespräch
  • Technisches Grundverständnis
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich auch über Quereinsteiger. Unser Onboarding bringt dich in kurzer Zeit auf den Stand, den du für kompetente Kundengespräche brauchst.

Benefits

  • Ungedeckeltes Provisionsmodell ohne Einkommensgrenze nach oben
  • Attraktives Fixum als solide Basis
  • Vollständig remote arbeitbar von überall aus, mit der Option, unser Büro in 1070 Wien zu nutzen
  • Selbstständige Zusammenarbeit auf Honorarbasis
  • Hochwertige Leads von Interessenten, die aktiv auf uns zukommen
  • Eine Planungsabteilung, die dir Angebote, Berechnungen und technische Unterlagen abnimmt
  • Klare Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen

Alter und Hintergrund spielen bei uns keine Rolle. Was zählt, ist deine Einstellung und dein Wille, Ergebnisse zu liefern. Wer das mitbringt, findet bei uns die Voraussetzungen, um wirklich erfolgreich zu sein.

Gemeinsam verändern wir Österreich!

jobs.title: Senior Customer Experience Manager (West)
jobs.excerpt: Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Location: Must be located in Western United States.

Minimum qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience as a CSM, AE, or other customer facing strategic role.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Ability to learn Wiz's offerings and pricing with agility.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proven track record of working with Fortune 100 customers with cloud-based technology.
  • Experience managing strategic customers, with an entrepreneurial mindset to problem solve and provide effective solutions for complex engagements.
  • Deep understanding of Security SaaS offerings and pricing models.

About the job

The vision of the Customer Experience team is to engage with strategic customers to deliver business value and help drive revenue growth. Customer Experience Managers (CEM) connect Wiz value to top customer initiatives, increase adoption, and outpace the competition. Your role will be to collaboratively steer the world's largest and most intricate high-tech, cloud-based enterprise software customers through their multi-year journey to the cloud with a primary focus on ensuring robust cloud security practices and extending the value of Wiz. This position requires a thought leader who can act as a trusted customer advisor, ensuring seamless collaboration across Wiz teams to deliver transformational outcomes with a paramount emphasis on cloud security.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of diverse projects and initiatives with a primary focus on cloud security, collaborating with core account groups (Sales, Support, Success), product/engineering teams, and customer teams.
  • Interface and influence key stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle, particularly emphasizing security best practices.
  • Establish a deep understanding of the customer’s business vision, culture, and processes with a keen focus on cloud security requirements.
  • Build and grow strong relationships across the org from the day-to-day technicians to the CISO level.
  • Evangelize Wiz value, influencing customers to adopt the right secure solutions at the right time.
  • Ensure the guidance from Wiz (documents, support, TAM, product team, etc) is understood and executed by the customer, while advocating internally at Wiz on behalf of customers to ensure their security needs are met.
  • Leverage your communication skills and extensive PM experience with large-scale transformations to guide customers post onboarding through their stages of Wiz adoption with a strong emphasis on implementing and maintaining robust cloud security practices.
  • Innovatively solve customer security challenges through the introduction of new ideas, tools, and mechanisms while overcoming any political blockers internal to the customer.
  • Collaborate with the Customer Account team to identify and pursue strategic cloud opportunities, specifically those related to cloud security enhancements by deepening product use or expanding to new business units.
  • Provide support through TCO analysis and business case assessments, ensuring alignment with customer security objectives.
  • Understand tool ecosystem and provide options for tool consolidation and deepen Wiz value.
  • Accelerate the customer’s cloud security adoption journey with a specific focus on defining key milestones, removing blockers, and implementing processes to ensure secure workload migrations.
  • Drive customer enablement by defining a comprehensive training strategy to upskill technical and non-technical roles across the customer's organization with a strong emphasis on cloud security awareness.
  • Implement effective governance structures to govern the partnership with the customer, placing a high priority on the security aspects of the partnership and the customer’s adoption of Wiz.

Compensation + Benefits

Compensation for this full-time position includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Learn more about benefits at Google.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below.

US Base Pay Range
$110,000—$151,000 USD

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where the position is based, without the need forvisa sponsorship.This role does not offervisasponsorship.

Wiz is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wiz will process your personal data in accordance with Wiz's Privacy Policy.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWho We AreBecause health is personal.  That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place.
jobs.description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

At Personify Health, we value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe in creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Why? Because diversity inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions. But more than this, diversity is our strength, and a catalyst in our ability to create a personalized experience for our clients and members. Because #healthispersonal.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do

The Marketing Events Specialist manages the planning, coordination, execution, and measurement of national events and conferences that advance Personify Health’s Wellbeing growth strategy. This role helps bring event plans to life by managing logistics, coordinating vendors and materials, supporting internal stakeholders, tracking key details, and ensuring events are executed consistently, professionally, and on schedule.

Reporting to the VP, Integrated Marketing, this position serves as a hands-on event operations partner for the Wellbeing business. The role is responsible for coordinating event promotion, timelines, registration and reporting workflows, vendor communications, budget tracking inputs, stakeholder updates, shipping and inventory needs, and on-site support for priority events. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple event workstreams in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Why This Role Is Important

Events are an important part of Personify Health’s market presence, buyer engagement, and commercial growth. This role helps ensure event participation is well organized, brand-consistent, and supported by strong preparation and follow-through. Success in this role contributes to smooth execution, stronger sales partnership, timely lead capture, accurate reporting, and a high-quality experience for prospects, clients, partners, and internal attendees.

Essential Responsibilities

Event Planning and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Support the national Wellbeing event and conference calendar by coordinating planning details, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder inputs aligned to approved event goals and priorities.
  • Partner with Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Sales, Product Marketing, Account Management, Consultant Broker Relations (CBR), Creative, Procurement, Finance, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, confirm deliverables, and keep event plans moving forward.
  • Assist with sponsorship, speaking opportunity, booth, promotional, and attendee engagement planning by collecting information, tracking decisions, and preparing materials for stakeholder review.

End-to-End Event Execution

  • Coordinate planning and execution for assigned national events and conferences; support regional events, partner events, and virtual experiences as needed.
  • Manage core event logistics, including timelines, vendor coordination, shipping, A/V needs, booth materials, speaker details, registration requirements, attendee communications, and on-site support.
  • Create and maintain event project plans, checklists, run-of-show documents, attendee lists, stakeholder updates, landing page inputs, and post-event recap materials.

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT GREYSTAR Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing.
jobs.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Greystar's D²AI organization (Data, Digital, and AI) is responsible for the platforms, processes, and practices that power analytics and AI across the company. Decision Intelligence is the team within D²AI that turns that capability into better business decisions. The name is the mandate: we exist to make the company's decisions faster, sharper, and better informed, not simply to produce reports.

Instead of a central intake queue, Decision Intelligence organizes into small, forward-deployed pods: analysts and engineers who sit alongside one another, each pod devoted to a critical area of the business such as Marketing, Property Operations, Resident, or FP&A. Pods become a standing part of that business rather than a rotating project resource, and the best of what they build graduates onto shared platforms so a win in one area becomes a capability for the whole company. Decision Intelligence reports through Technology, but a pod's priorities and success are defined by the business it serves, not by the technology organization.

This role leads the Property Operations pod. Property Operations is the core of what Greystar does, spanning the on-site teams, property performance, and operational execution behind the largest apartment portfolio in the world. It is the largest and highest-stakes pod in the model, and the work directly affects how thousands of communities and the teams running them operate every day.

About the Role:

Greystar is building the data foundation that will power the most AI-advanced operator in global multifamily real estate. As Director of Decision Intelligence for Property Operations, you lead the pod embedded in that business and you are accountable for whether it changes how Property Operations actually runs.

This is a builder's leadership role, not a caretaker's. You'll be accountable for the quality and impact of everything your pod ships, for hiring and developing the people who ship it, and for the standard the team holds itself to. You'll report to the leader of Decision Intelligence, who sets priorities and allocates resources across all pods, and you'll make the case for what Property Operations needs within that process.

The work comes from two directions. Property Operations brings you the problems it already knows it has, and you and your pod surface the ones it has not thought to raise. Between you, that defines what the pod takes on. How it gets solved is yours: the approach, the design, and the technology are your team's call, and the creative latitude that comes with that is one of the better parts of the job.

The role sits in a real tension and you should want that. Your pod is embedded deeply enough that Property Operations treats it as its own team, while you stay accountable through Decision Intelligence so the company gets enterprise leverage rather than a set of disconnected analytics groups. You'll operate as a peer to Property Operations leadership, and you'll represent the pod's work to senior leadership across Greystar.

You'll also set the technical and AI standard for your team. We are an AI-forward organization, and we expect the leader of this pod to be genuinely fluent, not merely supportive: credible in a design review, opinionated about where AI tooling changes what a small team can deliver, and able to tell the difference between work that is fast and work that is fast and sound.

JOB DESCRIPTION

What You'll Do

Lead the Property Operations Pod

  • Shape what the pod takes on alongside Property Operations leadership. The business brings problems it already knows it has, and you and your pod surface the opportunities it has not thought to ask for yet. Between you, that defines the work.
  • Own how the work gets done. The approach, the design, and the technology choices belong to you and your team, and we expect you to use that latitude rather than wait for direction.
  • Own delivery: sequencing, quality, and whether what ships actually gets used, within the priorities set across Decision Intelligence.
  • Go deep on Property Operations yourself. You cannot spot the opportunities the business has not raised without understanding how properties, on-site teams, and operational performance actually work.
  • Make sure the pod behaves like a standing part of the business rather than a project team, including keeping products alive and improving after launch rather than handing them off and moving on.
  • Identify and champion the products worth graduating onto shared platforms such as the Greystar Performance System (GPS), our platform for enterprise reporting, and Podium, our internally built platform for enabling and governing AI use. Partner with platform teams to get them there.
  • Default to doing it right; when speed is genuinely required, make the call to ship a usable solution with a documented path back to the governed, certified standard.
  • Contribute to how the broader pod model works by sharing patterns, tooling, and lessons from the largest pod with the rest of Decision Intelligence.

Build and Grow the Team

  • Hire, develop, and retain the analytics engineers on your pod, across the ladder from interns and associates through senior individual contributors.
  • Apply and help sharpen the career path and performance standard for the discipline, including what good looks like at each level on your team.
  • Grow the next generation of leaders on your pod, including senior engineers who can run workstreams and eventually lead pods of their own.
  • Set and hold a high technical bar through design reviews, hiring calibration, and direct engagement with the work rather than status reporting alone.
  • Build a team culture where people ship quickly, raise problems early, and are honest about what is and is not working.

Partner with Property Operations Leadership

  • Operate as a peer to Property Operations leaders, building a shared roadmap from both their stated priorities and the opportunities your pod surfaces, and pushing back credibly when the ask and the impact do not line up.
  • Represent the pod's work to senior leadership across Greystar, including progress, trade-offs, resourcing needs, and results.
  • Make the case for what Property Operations needs within the central prioritization process, and communicate honestly to your business partners when the answer is not yes.
  • Build the case for the model with evidence, using measurable operational savings and revenue opportunity rather than activity metrics.
  • Manage the expectation that the pod does not leave. Continuous iteration with the business is the commitment, and you own making that sustainable rather than overextended.

Set the AI and Technical Standard

  • Set the standard for how your pod uses AI, including AI coding assistants as core tooling, and make sure speed never comes at the cost of work the team cannot explain or defend.
  • Stay current on where AI tooling is changing what a small embedded team can deliver, and adjust how your pod works accordingly.
  • Partner with data engineering and platform teams on the data foundation your pod depends on, and escalate effectively when it is not meeting the bar.
  • Own data quality and trust as a leadership responsibility. When the data underneath a decision is wrong, you are accountable for driving it to root cause across organizational lines.
  • Ensure the team follows data governance practices including access controls, PII handling, and appropriate use of data in AI systems.

What You'll Bring

Leadership Experience

  • 8+ years in analytics, analytics engineering, data science, or a closely related discipline, including 3+ years leading teams.
  • Experience building and running a high-performing analytics team, including hiring, developing, and retaining strong technical talent in a competitive market.
  • A track record of analytics work that changed business decisions and produced measurable outcomes, not just delivered reports and dashboards.
  • Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders as a peer, including navigating competing priorities across business units.
  • Comfort operating in a model where your team is embedded in the business but accountable through a central organization, including advocating for your business partners without breaking enterprise alignment.

Analytics and Technical Depth

  • Hands-on background in SQL, Python, and data modeling deep enough to be credible in a design review and to set a real technical bar.
  • Experience with a modern lakehouse or warehouse platform, ideally Databricks, and a working understanding of what it takes to run one well.
  • Fluency with business intelligence tooling such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik, and a point of view on when a dashboard is the wrong answer.
  • Understanding of experiment design, measurement, and the difference between correlation and causation, sufficient to hold the team to it.
  • Enough breadth to know what your team should build, what it should adopt, and what it should hand to a platform team.

AI Fluency

  • Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI tooling, including AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. This role sets the standard, so it cannot be secondhand.
  • A clear point of view on how AI changes the scope of what a small analytics team can deliver, and where it does not.
  • Understanding of how LLMs and AI agents consume data, including what makes a data product reliable when an AI tool is the consumer.
  • Judgment on AI governance: data provenance, appropriate scoping, and responsible use, including when to slow down.

How You Operate

    • Builder's bias to action: you push the team toward working products in front of real users rather than long-dated plans, and you model it yourself.
    • High standard, clearly held: you are specific about what good looks like, and "it runs" is not the bar. Reliability and quality are.
    • Direct and honest: you raise problems early, deliver hard feedback well, and tell leadership what is actually happening rather than what is comfortable.
    • You learn the business: you go deep on the domain, including real estate, property management, investment, and financial data, and you expect your team to do the same.
    • Scope-disciplined: you protect the team from sprawl, say no with a reason, and keep the pod focused on work that matters.
    • You build people: you measure yourself partly by who on your team gets promoted and who grows into leading others.

jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The ChallengeWe connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes.
jobs.description:
The Challenge

We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.

A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.

Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

This is a remote opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own call quality holistically: hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

  • Manage zones, codes, and origins: own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

  • Update routing continuously: change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

  • Work cross-functionally by design: partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

  • Move routing toward automation: work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

  • NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

  • Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

  • Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are

  • Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

  • Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

  • A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

  • Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

  • Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter screening

  2. Hiring manager screening with COO

  3. Technical interview

  4. Case study

What you get

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

jobs.description:
Senior Director, Client Experience

About the Role

Market My Market is looking for a Senior Director, Client Experience to own the Client Experience department. Today that department serves more than 320 clients and is made up of two Directors, Client Experience, roughly 11 Client Experience Managers, and 7 Client Success Assistants. This is the leader our two Directors report to, and the person the whole department looks to for direction, standards, and accountability.

This is a leadership seat first. It is built for someone who has already run a client-facing organization inside a fast-growing digital marketing agency, who knows what it takes to keep clients for years, and who can set the tone for how an entire department communicates, inspects its own work, and gets ahead of problems before clients feel them.

You will also keep your feet wet by managing a small portfolio of approximately five accounts of your own, so you are living the same client conversations, reports, and results your team is accountable for. You will own retention, the client messaging standard, and the department's operating rhythm. You will look at the KPIs every week, ask the questions no one else is asking, and teach your directors and their teams to do the same. When something is off, you will propose the fix, not just flag the issue. The Senior Director, Client Experience reports to the CEO and sits on the leadership team.

What You Will Own

Department Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable Client Experience Managers a team of roughly 11 Client Experience Managers and 7 Client Success Assistants serving 320+ clients. This role will have a handful of direct reports, and will also monitor the success of Client Experience Managers and Client Success Assistants that report to other Directors of Client Experience
  • Set clear expectations and scoreboards for every seat in the department, then inspect against them consistently. Praise in public, correct in private, and never let a miss go unaddressed.
  • Own the department's operating cadence: weekly KPI reviews, portfolio health reviews, one-on-ones, and quarterly rocks that ladder up to company goals.
  • Build the bench. Identify and develop the next generation of CX leaders and make sure every director and manager has a growth plan.
  • Represent Client Experience on the leadership team and partner with the SEO, Content, Paid, Creative, and Business Development leaders so clients experience one company, not five departments.

Client Retention & Portfolio Health

  • Own client retention and lifetime value across every account the department manages. Retention is the number this role is measured on first.
  • Build and run an early-warning system for at-risk clients: know which accounts are drifting before they tell us, and make sure there is a documented save plan and an owner on every one.
  • Personally get involved in the accounts that matter most and the escalations that could cost us a client, then turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook for the team.
  • Drive renewals, upsell, and cross-sell as a natural outcome of well-run accounts, working closely with Business Development.
  • Set the standard for onboarding, the first 90 days, and QBRs so every client understands what we are doing, why, and what it is producing.
  • Manage approximately five client accounts of your own to the same standard you hold the team to, and use that hands-on experience to keep your coaching, playbooks, and expectations grounded in reality.

Messaging & Value Communication

  • Own the messaging standard for the entire department: how we talk about results, how we explain what happened in a month, how we deliver hard news, and how we frame the next recommendation.
  • Build the frameworks, templates, and talk tracks that turn rankings, traffic, calls, and leads into a clear ROI story a practice or business owner cares about.
  • Review client-facing communication, reports, and meeting recaps regularly and coach to the standard. If a client is confused about the value they are getting, that is on us.
  • Make sure every CXM can explain the full MMM offering, including SEO, paid ads, content, web, and Google Business Profile, and position it in a way that fits each client's goals.

KPIs, Inspection & Proactive Operations

  • Define the department's KPIs, including retention, NPS, response time, meeting cadence, upsell, and portfolio health, and report on them to the CEO and leadership team every week.
  • Look at the numbers before anyone asks. Spot the trend, dig into the cause, and show up with a point of view and a recommendation.
  • Teach the team to be proactive, not reactive. Build the habits and checklists that mean clients hear from us with the answer, not the other way around.
  • Audit the work: sit in on client calls, read the reports, review the Asana boards, listen to CallRail calls, and use what you find to raise the bar.
  • Get the most out of the tools we have already invested in, including Zoom Revenue Accelerator, HubSpot, Claude, Replit, and our internal apps, then push them further. Use call intelligence to coach, CRM data to spot risk, and AI to take manual work off the team's plate.
  • Champion automation and AI inside the department so the team spends its time on strategy and relationships instead of manual work, and hold the team to actually adopting what we build.

Solutions & Opportunities

jobs.description:
À titre de Testeur de Plateforme, vous contribuerez à assurer la qualité de la plateforme centrale qui soutient les solutions d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad : les services, les API, les intégrations et l’infrastructure sur lesquels les professionnels de la santé s’appuient chaque jour. En vous appuyant sur une solide expertise en assurance qualité, vous prendrez en charge la stratégie de tests pour les composantes de plateforme, élargirez la couverture automatisée des couches d’intégration et des systèmes back-end, et collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes d’Ingénierie, DevOps et Produit. Ensemble, vous veillerez à ce que chaque livraison soit stable, évolutive et prête à être utilisée dans des environnements cliniques.

Principales responsabilités

  • Stratégie de tests de plateforme : Assumer la responsabilité de la planification et de l’exécution des tests pour les composantes et services de plateforme assignés. Définir la couverture de tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de régression et non fonctionnels afin de réduire les risques liés aux mises en production.

  • Automatisation et intégration CI/CD : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des suites de tests automatisés pour les API, les services et les systèmes back-end. Intégrer ces tests aux pipelines CI/CD afin de raccourcir les délais de rétroaction et d’accroître la confiance envers les déploiements.

  • Tests d’intégration et non fonctionnels : Valider le comportement de la plateforme à travers les interfaces et les environnements de déploiement. Cela comprend notamment l’interopérabilité (par exemple DICOM et HL7), la performance, l’évolutivité ainsi que les scénarios de mise à niveau et de migration.

  • Analyse et résolution des problèmes : Enquêter sur des problèmes complexes impliquant plusieurs composantes en utilisant les journaux, les données et les outils de diagnostic afin d’identifier les causes profondes. Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie pour assurer une résolution rapide et prévenir la récurrence des problèmes.

  • Pratiques de qualité et mentorat : Contribuer à l’établissement des normes de tests de plateforme et des indicateurs de qualité. Accompagner les analystes en assurance qualité dans l’adoption des meilleures pratiques, des outils et des approches propres aux tests de plateforme.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • +5 ans d’expérience en tests logiciels ou en assurance qualité, incluant l’évaluation de systèmes intégrés, de plateformes ou d’architectures composées de multiples services, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la maintenance de cadres d’automatisation de tests pour les API et les intégrations.
  • Bonne connaissance du SQL, des outils de gestion des tests (par exemple : qTest, Zephyr) et des pipelines CI/CD.
  • Expérience de tests dans des environnements conteneurisés ou infonuagiques (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Capacité démontrée à définir et diriger une stratégie de tests pour des livraisons complexes avec un minimum de supervision.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience avec les outils de tests de performance et de charge pour des systèmes distribués.
  • Connaissance des technologies de l’information en santé ou de l’imagerie médicale (par exemple : PACS, RIS, DICOM).
  • Certification ISTQB ou certification équivalente.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Implementation (Launch)
jobs.excerpt: The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care.
jobs.description:
The Program Manager (Launch)is responsible for leading the program workstreams that guide partner practices through Aledade's onboarding journey to achieve sustained success in value-based care. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role structures, executes, and monitors assigned launch initiatives, establishing clear milestones and task structures aligned with overall program objectives to maintain project timelines. By leveraging data-driven governance and program discipline, the Program Manager ensures full transparency into launch progress and identifies potential roadblocks early. Core responsibilities include designing workstream operational frameworks, defining and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs), proactively mitigating risks, and driving strategic alignment across Sales, Field, Implementation, and Product teams. The Program Manager facilitates cross-functional execution and directly oversees key launch deliverables to meet organizational goals. Combining strong organizational leadership with deep healthcare technology expertise, the ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments to advance Aledade's mission in value-based care.

Primary Duties

    1. Launch Program Management: Plan and manage assigned launch workstreams from definition through close-out, including scope, milestones, dependencies, and owners. Build the program plan and task structure for each workstream, sequencing work by business priority, available resources, and dependencies. Maintain the workstream backlog and status in the team's tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Cloud Coach, Salesforce) so progress is visible without manual chasing. Identify and escalate risks and roadblocks early, with a proposed mitigation or options for the Sr. Director.

    2. Goal Measurement & Analytics: Define and monitor KPIs that show whether launch goals are being met, including follow-through and milestone completion rates. Analyze program and practice-level data (e.g., Tableau, Salesforce reporting) to surface opportunities, risks, and trends, and turn them into actionable recommendations. Prepare clear, decision-ready status updates and reporting for Implementation leadership and cross-functional partners. Account for data-capture limitations and changes over time when reading trends, so decisions are not driven by reporting artifacts.

    3. Stakeholder Management: Align Product, Implementation, Field, Sales, and Support on shared launch priorities and clear handoffs. Navigate competing priorities across internal teams and practice stakeholders while keeping launch objectives in focus. Articulate the business case and rationale ("why") behind launch initiatives to leadership, internal teams, and practice-facing audiences. Apply working knowledge of value-based care and ACO models to connect launch work to Aledade's broader business goals.

    4. AI-Enabled Operations & Process Support: Leverage automation and AI solutions to streamline reporting, minimize manual status tracking, and reduce operational overhead, sharing best practices across the team. Create and maintain standardized workstream templates, playbooks, and repeatable workflows to drive consistent program execution. Define operational guidelines and quality gates for AI-assisted workflows to ensure data accuracy, prevent tracking errors, and uphold long-term maintainability. Develop reusable prompt templates and workflow accelerators to empower the team and unlock capacity for high-impact program management. Proactively identify and propose process enhancements that drive operational efficiency.

    5. Coaching & Thought Partnership: Support Implementation team members on program-level challenges and help them connect their work to launch goals. Translate complex operational and program concepts into clear, accessible guidance. Contribute to cross-team initiatives, including interviewing and onboarding, as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or relevant field. Significant relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of educational requirements.

    • 6+ years of relevant experience in healthcare (program management, project management, or a related field.).

    • Demonstrated track record of managing multi-stakeholder programs or initiatives with competing priorities and tight timelines.

    • Working knowledge of ambulatory EHR environments and how they affect clinical workflows and data exchange.

    • Proficiency with program and project tracking tools (e.g., Monday.com, Jira, Salesforce, Tableau, or equivalent).

    • Willingness and ability to travel 10–25% to partner practices, cross-functional meetings, and Aledade headquarters as needed.

Preferred KSA’s

    • PMP or equivalent program/project management certification.

    • Change management certification or formal training (e.g., Prosci ADKAR).

    • Agile/Scrum methodology and sprint-based delivery.

    • AI-assisted program management tools, automated reporting, or API-based system integration.

    • ACO or value-based care program experience, with understanding of Promoting Interoperability and quality measure reporting.

    • Track record of influencing teams without direct authority.

      • Enterprise Program

    • Enterprise Project Lifecycle: Deep understanding of the end-to-end implementation process for high-value enterprise accounts, specifically within a SaaS or professional services environment, ideally population health or value-based care tools.

    • Organizational Dynamics: Knowledge of how to navigate complex corporate structures, identifying key decision-makers, influencers, and blockers within large-scale healthcare or legal practices (or similar professional verticals).

    • Conflict Resolution Methodologies: Understanding of various strategies to manage competing priorities and resolve friction between internal product/engineering teams and external client expectations.

    • Strategic Communication: Ability to articulate complex project statuses, technical requirements, and value propositions to diverse audiences, ranging from C-suite executives to end-user administrative staff.

    • Negotiation & Influence: Skilled at gaining buy-in for project timelines and process changes, ensuring that both the client and the internal delivery teams remain aligned on the scope of work.

    • Expectation Management: Expert at setting realistic milestones and proactively communicating potential risks or delays to maintain trust and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.

    • Adaptability: Ability to pivot communication styles and project strategies quickly based on the specific culture, needs, and feedback of different enterprise stakeholders.

    • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to lead cross-functional internal teams (Product, Sales, Support) to ensure a unified front is presented to the client, ensuring all stakeholder needs are met without compromising internal resources.

    • EHR Ecosystem Standards: Familiarity with the technical and operational requirements for deploying third-party insights within EHR environments (ideally EpicCare Ambulatory), including an understanding of how these integrations impact clinical workflows and provider experience.

Physical Requirements

    • Occasional travel may be required (approximately 10-25%).

    • Environment: Extensive use of computers and keyboards; sitting for prolonged periods.

jobs.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
jobs.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

The next stage of CoLab's growth depends on bringing exceptional people into the business, quickly and thoughtfully. We're looking for a Senior Recruiter who can make that happen.

You'll own full-cycle recruiting across our GTM and R&D teams, with a heavier focus on GTM roles spanning Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering. One week you might be closing an Enterprise Account Executive while building a pipeline for a specialized technical role the next.

This isn't a role where you wait for hiring managers to tell you what to do. You'll be their talent partner: shaping hiring strategies, challenging assumptions, bringing market insights, and keeping searches moving. You'll balance multiple priorities without losing track of the details, and you'll know when to move quickly, when to push back, and when to hold the bar.

Our Ideal Candidate

You're an experienced recruiter who combines urgency with exceptional organization. You can manage several searches at different stages, keep candidates engaged, and ensure hiring managers always know where things stand, without needing to be asked.

You're comfortable advising senior stakeholders, not just taking their requests. If a hiring process is moving too slowly or expectations don't match the talent market, you speak up and propose a better approach.

You care about candidate experience, communicate with honesty and respect, and take pride in finding people who will thrive at CoLab.

If you prefer a predictable workload, need constant direction, or rely primarily on inbound applicants, this probably isn't the right role.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across GTM and R&D, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance.
  • Build strong, diverse talent pipelines through proactive sourcing and thoughtful candidate engagement.
  • Partner with hiring managers to define successful profiles, calibrate expectations, and develop effective hiring strategies.
  • Manage multiple searches simultaneously with exceptional organization, clear priorities, and consistent follow-through.
  • Drive hiring velocity by identifying bottlenecks, improving processes, and keeping candidates and stakeholders moving.
  • Run structured assessments that maintain CoLab's high talent bar and deliver a positive candidate experience.
  • Use recruiting data and market insights to advise hiring managers and improve hiring outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Extensive full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant experience hiring GTM talent in B2B SaaS.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions; comfort navigating technical roles is important.
  • Strong direct sourcing skills and a track record of engaging passive candidates.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and experience managing competing hiring priorities.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships, influence hiring decisions, and provide constructive pushback.
  • Excellent communication skills, sound judgment, and a bias toward action.

Extra Details

  • Compensation: Full-time, permanent position with competitive compensation and stock options.
  • Benefits: In Canada, extended health benefits, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP matching. In the USA, health and dental insurance covered at 100% for employees, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO.
  • Location: Remote opportunities across Canada and the USA, with a main office in St. John's, NL.
  • Travel: Periodic travel for team and recruiting events.
