Job Description – Revit Templates & Families Creator

Position:Revit Templates & Families Creator / BIM Content Specialist
Employment Type:Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract
Work Arrangement:Remote / Hybrid
Department:BIM / Digital Engineering / Design Technology
Reports To:BIM Manager / Digital Engineering Manager

Role Overview

We are seeking an experiencedRevit Templates & Families Creatorto develop, standardise and maintain high-quality Autodesk Revit templates, parametric families and BIM content.

The role will focus on creating a consistent and scalable Revit environment that enables architectural, structural and MEP teams to work efficiently while maintaining agreed BIM standards. The successful candidate will have strong hands-on experience withRevit family creation, parameter management, templates, schedules, view standards and BIM content libraries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, configure and maintain company-standardRevit project templates (.RTE)for architectural, structural and/or MEP projects.
  • Develop high-qualityRevit families (.RFA), including loadable, system, hosted, face-based and nested families as required.
  • Create intelligentparametric familiesusing dimensions, constraints, formulas, visibility parameters and configurable types.
  • Develop and manageshared, project, family and global parameters, ensuring consistent naming and data structures.
  • Build standard Revit views, view templates, filters, schedules, sheets, title blocks, legends, annotations and documentation standards.
  • Create reusable BIM content for elements such as doors, windows, furniture, equipment, fixtures, fittings, casework, building components and MEP equipment.
  • Optimise family geometry and data to maintain appropriateLevels of Development (LOD)and Levels of Information Need while avoiding unnecessarily heavy models.
  • Configure templates covering project units, object styles, line styles, materials, fill patterns, browser organisation, worksets and other project standards.
  • Develop schedules and data structures to support quantities, specifications, asset information and BIM deliverables.
  • Establish and maintain a structuredRevit family/content library, including naming conventions, classifications, version control and approval processes.
  • Review existing Revit families and templates, identify quality or performance issues and rebuild/optimise content where necessary.
  • Test families for flexing, parameter behaviour, hosting, visibility, scheduling, tagging and project performance before release.
  • Ensure templates and families support organisationalBIM standards, ISO 19650 principles and project/client requirements, where applicable.
  • Work closely with BIM Managers, architects, engineers, designers and project teams to understand content requirements and translate them into reusable BIM components.
  • Produce user guides, family creation standards and documentation to help project teams use BIM content consistently.
  • Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for Revit templates and families.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate and improve BIM content creation and management.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience withAutodesk Revit.
  • Demonstrated experience creatingRevit templates and parametric families from scratch.
  • Advanced understanding of:
    • Family Editor
    • Reference planes and constraints
    • Instance and type parameters
    • Shared parameters
    • Nested and shared families
    • Formulas and conditional parameters
    • Visibility controls
    • Materials and subcategories
    • Type catalogues
    • Tags and annotations
    • Schedules and quantities
    • View templates and filters
    • Project Browser organisation
  • Understanding of BIM modelling and documentation standards.
  • Ability to createlightweight, efficient and scalable Revit contentrather than unnecessarily complex families.
  • Experience managing BIM libraries and maintaining consistent naming and parameter standards.
  • Ability to interpret architectural/engineering drawings, manufacturer specifications and product information and convert them into accurate BIM content.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality assurance.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple BIM-content requests.

Highly Desirable

Experience withDynamo for Revit, Autodesk Construction Cloud/BIM 360, Navisworks, AutoCAD, BIM interoperability and IFC workflows would be advantageous.

Experience developing BIM content forAustralian AEC projectsand familiarity with Australian building/documentation practices would also be highly regarded.

Knowledge ofRevit API, Python, C# or other BIM automation technologieswould be beneficial but is not mandatory.

Key Deliverables

The successful candidate will be expected to develop and maintain:

Standard Revit Templates → Revit Family Library → Shared Parameter Library → View Templates → Schedules → Title Blocks → Annotation Families → Material Library → BIM Content Standards → QA/QC Procedures → User Documentation

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is more than a Revit modeller. The ideal candidate is aBIM content specialist who understands how to build reusable, intelligent and maintainable Revit contentthat can be deployed consistently across multiple projects and project teams.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate a portfolio ofRevit families and templates they have personally created, and explain their approach to parameters, family performance, standardisation and quality control.

Portfolio requirement:Shortlisted candidates may be requested to demonstrate or provide examples of Revit templates, parametric families or BIM libraries they have developed.

jobs.title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts.
jobs.description:
At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it’s medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity

The Role

We're looking for a Sr. Growth Marketing Manager to own and scale the programs that turn target accounts into qualified pipeline. This role owns demand generation end-to-end — email nurtures, paid media (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads), content syndication, webinars, and organic social presence — while contributing to overall messaging strategy and brand direction.

This is a high-ownership, execution-focused role for someone who's equally comfortable optimizing a paid search account, building a nurture sequence, and keeping our social channels sharp day to day. You’ll set demand gen campaign strategy and ensure it stays aligned with FourKites’ broader narrative by partnering across Marketing, Product, and Sales.

What You'll Do

Demand Generation Strategy & Campaigns

  • Lead the growth and pipeline strategy: design and execute an integrated plan across paid, content, social, and lifecycle programs, with the roadmap and budget to hit awareness, conversion, and pipeline targets.
  • Build and manage always-on and campaign-specific nurture programs including drip sequences, segmentation, and A/B testing, in coordination with sales development.
  • Own end-to-end execution for webinars tied to active demand gen campaigns (platform administration, promotion, registration, and follow-up).
  • Draft first-pass content supporting demand gen campaigns — landing pages, campaign emails, ad copy, and gated assets — for review and refinement.

Programs & Partnerships

  • Own content syndication, third-party promotions, and paid placements end-to-end — from vendor selection and contracting through asset delivery, lead handoff with marketing ops and SDRs, and performance tracking.
  • Build and maintain campaign planning templates and calendars that keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on timing, assets, and channels.

Paid Media & Search

  • Own strategy, execution, and ongoing optimization of Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, including keyword strategy, bid management, audience targeting, and budget allocation across funnel stages.
  • Own quarterly keyword planning — competitive gap analysis, tiered keyword strategy, and forecasting to inform budget conversations.
  • Maintain and refresh our ICP and target persona/title lists each half or after major launches, feeding both paid and account-based targeting.

Social Media

  • Own day-to-day management of FourKites' social channels with agency support on execution: copywriting on 2-3 posts weekly, final QA on all posts and graphics, community moderation, and photo/asset sourcing.
  • Serve as the go-to resource for internal teams looking to get social content published, ensuring everything meets brand and voice standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with the Director, Corporate Marketing on campaign strategy for nurture and webinar programs.
  • Partner with content, PR, and product marketing to align demand gen campaigns with major company moments (product launches, positioning shifts, analyst events).
  • Partner with marketing operations on analytics and reporting infrastructure — pipeline sourced/influenced, cost per opportunity, and channel-level ROI — so performance data is reliable and accessible across campaigns.
  • Own continuous improvement across all campaigns: regularly test, measure, and iterate on targeting, messaging, and spend allocation based on performance data, rather than treating campaigns as set-and-forget.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience in enterprise SaaS. Experience in supply chain, logistics, or transportation technology and AI agents is a plus.
  • Hands-on email marketing experience, including building nurture sequences, managing segmentation, and reporting on engagement and conversion.
  • Direct, hands-on experience managing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns, from strategy through execution and optimization is preferred.
  • Experience owning a webinar program (platform administration, promotion, and reporting) is a plus.
  • Comfort managing organic social channels day to day, including community moderation and content QA.
  • Strong project management instincts — comfortable building and maintaining the templates, processes, and calendars that keep a marketing team organized.
  • A collaborative style; you'll work closely across Sales, Marketing, and Product and need to bring people along rather than execute in a silo.
  • Comfort working with data to track performance — you don't need to build dashboards yourself, but you should be fluent enough in the numbers to know what to test next.
  • Strong writing skills — clear, human copy for campaigns and social, even if long-form content isn't your primary focus.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days: you'll have taken ownership of the paid media, social media, and webinar programs, be fluent in current campaign performance and ICP targeting, and have a working rhythm established with the Director, Corporate Marketing on nurture and webinar strategy.

By month six: you'll be running demand gen campaigns independently end-to-end, have a content syndication program live and generating qualified leads, have improved reporting visibility into pipeline sourced by channel, and have tightened up campaign planning processes for the broader marketing team.

We know that job postings can be intimidating, and research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. We encourage you to apply if you think you may be a fit and give us both a chance to find out!

Compensation

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $115,000 - $140,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to experience, qualifications, skills, and business needs. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for bonus and incentive compensation as well as participation in FourKites' employee stock option program.

Benefits

FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.

Benefits include:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision benefits starting on first day of employment

  • 401k Retirement savings with employer match

  • Bonus and incentive compensation as well as employee stock option program

  • Employer paid life insurance and short term disability insurance

  • Generous PTO, global recharge days, and volunteer days

  • Paid parental leave for all parents

  • Family planning and inclusive wellbeing resources

  • Technology reimbursement

  • Commuter benefits for in-office employees (Chicago)

  • Annual Wellness Stipend

  • Ongoing learning & development opportunities

About FourKites

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. Position: Conveyancing Paralegal

About the Role:

We are seeking an adaptable, highly reliable Conveyancing Paralegal to join our UK based client as a dedicated, full-time remote team member based in South Africa or the Philippines.

Our UK based client is an established East London law firm handling approximately 100 residential conveyancing matters per month. To relieve pressure across the department, free up existing UK fee earners, and ensure seamless service, the firm is creating a flexible, "floating" offshore conveyancing resource.

In this role, you will act as an essential operational engine—supporting multiple fee earners, taking complete ownership of routine and post-completion work across the department, and stepping in to cover active caseloads during periods of high volume or annual leave under UK supervision. Whether assisting with initial searches, reviewing documents, or managing post-completion requirements, you will take work away from the team without creating additional management burden.

Key Responsibilities

Core Conveyancing Support & Departmental Workflow

  • Floating Fee-Earner Support: Move seamlessly across multiple fee earners' files, providing operational support where demand is highest across sales, purchases, re-mortgages, and transfers of equity.
  • Searches & File Setup: Order, track, and perform initial reviews of property search packages (local authority, environmental, drainage) and ensure onboarding compliance documents (KYC/AML, TA forms) are logged.
  • Legal Drafting: Prepare standard contracts, transfers of title (TR1), property questionnaires, and mortgage documentation under UK fee-earner guidance.

Department-Wide Post-Completion Ownership

  • End-to-End Post-Completion: Take complete ownership of post-completion duties across the entire firm, including preparing completion statements, drafting and submitting SDLT returns, and submitting Land Registry applications (AP1).
  • Requisition Management: Monitor and respond to Land Registry requisitions promptly, ensuring clear title registration without delays.

Caseload Coverage & Continuity

  • Active File Progressions: Substantially progress active conveyancing files under supervision, keeping matters moving when fee earners are away on leave or experiencing workload spikes.
  • Multi-Party Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and articulately with UK colleagues, estate agents, lenders, redemption departments, and opposing conveyancers.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • England & Wales Conveyancing Experience (Essential): Direct, practical experience handling residential conveyancing specifically under English and Welsh law. (General SA/PH legal qualifications without UK conveyancing experience will not be considered).
  • Full Process Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the complete UK conveyancing lifecycle—from file opening, search ordering, and contract drafting to exchange, completion, and post-completion.
  • Post-Completion Competence: Proven track record of independently handling AP1 Land Registry submissions, SDLT filings, and resolving requisitions.
  • Case Management Tech: Confident operating legal Case Management Systems (CMS) and keeping digital audit trails up to date.
  • Ego-Free & Adaptable Attitude: Zero hesitation towards administrative tasks; comfortable serving as a floating resource supporting multiple team members.
  • Professional Communication: Clear, articulate spoken and written English, suited for professional collaboration with UK legal teams and third parties.

What Success Looks Like

The firm's UK fee earners have significantly more time to focus on complex legal matters and firm growth; post-completion tasks are executed flawlessly on time; caseloads progress uninterrupted during staff absences; and the department operates smoothly without creating added management oversight for the Managing Directors.

About the Position The Student Support Advisor plays a vital role in supporting students throughout their educational journey, embodying our TEACH values and fostering a culture of CARE that aligns with our mission, vision, and purpose. Their role involves providing proactive, prompt, and accurate advising on financial, academic, and service-related matters, to ensure students receive the necessary support to reach graduation. This includes advocating for students at every stage of their academic journey by establishing personalized relationships, monitoring their financial and academic progress, and promoting their success through holistic advising. In addition, the Student Support Advisor serves as an advocate for students and connects them with resources and support services, addressing their concerns, and working collaboratively with faculty and staff to ensure they have the tools and support they need to succeed. In a dynamic and rapidly changing environment, Student Support Advisors operate within a state-of-the-art call center architecture, where their day is meticulously planned out. Their objective is to offer one-call resolution while inspiring students to take ownership of their educational goals. Through various communication channels, such as incoming and outgoing calls, chats and personalized emails and SMS, they cater to the individual student needs and preferences. This role of a Student Support Advisor is a critical ingredient of student success, and proactive, accurate and timely support from them can have a substantial impact on the lives of their students. jobs.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy:

Job Description:

Business Resilience Manager (Solventum)


3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue. We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.


The Impact You’ll Make in this Role


The Business Resilience Manager will lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Solventum’s enterprise Business Resilience program. The role will establish the governance, methodologies, standards, tools, and assurance activities necessary to strengthen organizational preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience across Solventum’s global operations.

Working within Global Security and in close partnership with business units and functions, the Manager will coordinate Business Resilience with Crisis Management, Technology Resilience, Cybersecurity Incident Response, Manufacturing and Operational Technology resilience, Supply Chain, Enterprise Risk Management, and other related disciplines. The role will help ensure that business-defined recovery requirements, technology recovery capabilities, operational dependencies, and crisis decision-making processes are aligned.

The Manager will lead enterprise Business Impact Analysis and continuity-planning cycles, establish minimum program and plan requirements, maintain an integrated view of critical business services and dependencies, oversee exercising and corrective-action management. The role will also support the delivery of Internal Audit and management remediation commitments related to business resilience.

This is a hands-on program management role requiring the ability to translate strategy and audit requirements into practical methodologies, accountable workstreams, measurable outcomes, and sustainable business practices.


Program Governance

Lead the operationalization of Solventum’s Business Resilience governance framework.

Develop and maintain the BCM operating model, program charter, policies, procedures, methodologies, standards, and annual program plan.

Identify and implement opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence and automation to strengthen business resilience capabilities, including risk identification, scenario analysis, business impact analysis, crisis preparedness and response.

Serve as principal program lead for the BCM system and associated program data.

Coordinate alignment across Business Continuity, Crisis Management, Technology Resilience, Cybersecurity Incident Response, Manufacturing and Operational Technology resilience, Supply Chain resilience, Enterprise Risk Management, and other related programs.

Translate Internal Audit, regulatory, and management findings into structured remediation plans with defined owners, milestones, dependencies, evidence requirements, and target outcomes.

Monitor remediation progress, challenge delays or gaps, escalate material risks, and prepare regular status updates for program and executive governance bodies.

Design and facilitate discussion-based and operational exercises that test governance, plans, recovery strategies, communication methods, dependencies, and decision-making.

Establish an exception-management process for business areas unable to meet BCM standards or documented recovery requirements.

Maintain defensible evidence supporting program implementation, control operation, management oversight, and remediation closure.

Establish a consistent after-action process, including observations, root causes, accountable corrective actions, target dates, validation evidence, and closure approval.

Analyze exercise and incident results to identify recurring or enterprise-wide weaknesses.

Develop executive dashboards covering BIA coverage, plan quality, exercising, recovery capability gaps, overdue actions, exceptions, and remediation performance.

Prepare regular program reports that identify trends, systemic risks, decisions required, and areas requiring leadership intervention.

Create guidance, templates, toolkits, and communications that help business teams meet BCM requirements consistently.

Champion responsible adoption of AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to improve resilience insights, accelerate decision-making, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the business resilience program.

Represent the BCM program in governance forums, audits, assessments, major projects, and relevant risk discussions.

Business Impact Analysis and Continuity Risk

Own and continuously improve the enterprise BIA and continuity-risk assessment methodology.

Lead the enterprise BIA cycle and ensure appropriate coverage of critical business services, processes, products, locations, and supporting operations.

Establish consistent criteria for assessing operational, customer, patient, financial, regulatory, legal, reputational, and strategic impacts.

Guide business leaders and process owners in establishing recovery time objectives, recovery point objectives, impact tolerances, minimum resource requirements, and recovery priorities.

Maintain an enterprise inventory of dependencies, including people, technology, data, facilities, suppliers, operational technology, equipment, utilities, logistics, and interdependent processes.

Analyze BIA results to identify concentrations of risk, single points of failure, conflicting recovery requirements, and systemic dependencies.

Facilitate alignment between business-defined recovery requirements and Technology Resilience application tiering, IT contingency planning, recovery strategies, and testing priorities.

Escalate material gaps between required recovery outcomes and demonstrated recovery capabilities.


Crisis Management and Incident Support

Support with maintaining & improving Solventum’s Crisis Management Framework, including escalation criteria, team structures, roles, decision rights, communication protocols, activation procedures, and supporting playbooks.

Ensure the Crisis Management Framework remains integrated with the wider Business Resilience program and aligned with business continuity and technology recovery arrangements.

Provide specialist advice during crisis activations and significant disruptions.

Support or coordinate situation reporting, action tracking, decision logging, stakeholder briefings, response documentation, and transition-to-recovery activities.

Support with post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are translated into sustainable corrective actions.


Your Skills and Expertise


To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher AND 10 years of experience in business resilience, disaster recovery, crisis management, risk management, or a related field in a private, public, government or military environment

OR

  • High school diploma/GED and 14 years of experience in business resilience, disaster recovery, crisis management, risk management, or a related field in a private, public, government or military environment

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • Professional certification in business continuity and/or emergency management, such as CBCI, CBCP, MBCI (previous or current)
  • Experience with ISO 22301

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Familiarity with other relevant standards, regulations, and frameworks, including ISO 22317 / ISO 22361 / NIST SP 800-34 / NFPA 1600
  • Experience in conducting business impact analyses and developing business continuity plans
  • Previous manufacturing experience is preferred
  • Working knowledge of risk assessment techniques, BIA methodology, and recovery strategy development
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to turn data and interviews into clear findings and recommendations
  • Excellent planning, organizational, and project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams to target dates
  • Proficiency with business continuity software platforms (ServiceNow BCM) and emergency notification systems (e.g., Horizon, Everbridge)
  • Knowledge of IT infrastructure, application recovery, and data protection principles sufficient to partner effectively with IT disaster recovery teams.
  • Familiarity with relevant standards, regulations, and frameworks, including:
  • ISO 22301 / ISO 22317 / ISO 22361
  • NIST SP 800-34
  • NFPA 1600
  • ASIS Business Continuity and Crisis Management Standards

Work location: Remote-United States

Travel: May include up to 25% (domestic / international)

Relocation Assistance: Not authorized


Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).


Supporting Your Well-being 


Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

You’ll set direction hands-on, in Figma, in prototypes, in critique, and through influence: building the conviction and relationships needed for R&D and cross-functional teams to adopt the patterns you define, not just execute your roadmap. This is a principal-level role for someone who has tackled genuinely complex, multi-stakeholder design problems and thrives on driving transformation.

The right ingredients (Requirements)

  • Onboarding flow expertise: You've shipped end-to-end onboarding or product adoption experiences, setup flows, guided workflows, feature tours, or progressive disclosure patterns. You understand how to sequence information, create aha moments, and reduce friction for new users.
  • Hands-on systems thinking: Design cohesive experiences across multiple surfaces and interaction modes. You see how one flow connects to another and design for the seams, especially transitions between self-service setup and human-in-the-loop support.
  • AI-guided experience design: You've designed with AI as a core part of the experience, whether that's guided workflows, intelligent suggestions, or contextual assistance. You understand how to make AI feel like a helpful partner, not a replacement or afterthought.
  • UI/UX rigor: Strong visual design skills demonstrated through a real portfolio. You can prototype interactions, spec components, and push Figma work that sets a high bar. Your work is both functional and thoughtfully crafted.
  • Organizational influence at principal level: You build conviction within product, engineering, and cross-functional leadership teams. You define new patterns and drive adoption of them beyond your immediate team.
  • Pragmatic product thinking: You understand the business context behind onboarding, activation rates, time-to-value, feature discovery, customer success outcomes. You design with outcomes in mind.
  • Research-driven approach: You design with data by conducting user research, usability testing, and pulling insights from onboarding metrics and customer feedback. You know when to prototype before committing to direction.
  • Familiarity with AI design tooling: You're comfortable working with Claude, V0, Replit, and similar tools.

What we'll ask to see

Case studies showing:

  • How you navigated complexity across multiple surfaces or interaction modes (web + mobile, or setup + guided workflows + human handoff)

About you

You bring the same tenets that drive Toast's Design practice:

  • Founder's mentality: You own outcomes, not just outputs. You care deeply about whether your designs actually work for support agents and restaurant operators.
  • You lift others up: You make the designers around you better through example, feedback, and generosity with your process.
  • You drive action through influence: You build trusted relationships across product, engineering, and customer service teams. You can shift a room's perspective without authority.
  • You build strong perspectives: You make decisions quickly and collaboratively, informed by both data and intuition. You know when to push back.
  • You raise the bar: You're constantly learning—new interaction patterns, new AI capabilities, new tooling. You bring that learning into your work and share it with your team.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. jobs.description:
Manager, Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)

Team: Commercial Analytics

Employment type: Full-time

Role Summary

We are seeking a Manager of Multi-Touch Attribution to lead client engagements that measure how HCP and patient touchpoints, including field detailing, digital, paid media, email, congress, and medical education, contribute to prescription outcomes. You will own end-to-end attribution projects for pharma and biotech clients, from data integration and methodology design through stakeholder recommendations and budget reallocation guidance. You will also lead and develop a small team of consultants and analysts, and serve as a trusted advisor to brand, commercial operations, and marketing leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead client MTA engagements from scoping through delivery, setting timelines, budgets, and success criteria with client stakeholders.

  • Design attribution frameworks that combine rules-based, probabilistic, and algorithmic approaches (e.g., Markov chain, Shapley value, logistic or Bayesian models), and document their assumptions and limitations.

  • Should have understanding of MMx and Omnichannel analytics.

  • Integrate and reconcile multi-source data, including Rx and claims data, CRM and call activity, digital and email engagement logs, media delivery data, and sample or market access data, while maintaining patient and HCP privacy standards.

  • Triangulate MTA results with marketing mix modeling (MMM), geo-based or holdout incrementality tests, and other measurement methods to build a defensible, consistent view of channel performance.

  • Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for executive audiences, including channel ROI, sequencing insights, and reallocation scenarios.

  • Oversee code quality, model validation, and reproducibility across the team's analytical work.

  • Manage, coach, and develop consultants and analysts, including workload planning, performance feedback, and career development.

  • Contribute to firm thought leadership, proposal development, and the continued evolution of the firm's attribution methodology and accelerators.

  • Ensure all work complies with applicable regulations and internal standards, including the PhRMA Code, OPDP guidance, HIPAA, and regional privacy laws such as GDPR and CCPA.

Required Qualifications

  • 6 or more years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, or data science, with at least 3 years in pharma, healthcare, or life sciences.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering multi-touch attribution or equivalent customer-journey analytics.

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R, with experience working in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.

  • Solid understanding of statistical modeling, causal inference, and experimental design, including the strengths and limitations of attribution compared to MMM and incrementality testing.

  • Working knowledge of pharma commercial data sources (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, Veeva CRM) and pharma promotional channel structure.

  • Proven ability to present to senior client stakeholders and influence decisions without direct authority.

  • Experience leading or mentoring a team of at least 3 people in a client-service environment.

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business discipline (statistics, economics, engineering, math, marketing analytics, or similar). An advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with commercial measurement platforms or vendor MTA tools.

  • Familiarity with patient-journey analytics, omnichannel orchestration, or next-best-action frameworks.

  • Background in consulting, agency, or analytics vendor environments.

  • Publications, conference presentations, or internal thought-leadership contributions on attribution or measurement.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical rigor: Challenges assumptions, tests robustness, and communicates uncertainty honestly.

  • Client judgment: Balances methodological purity with the practical decisions clients need to make.

  • Leadership: Builds team capability, sets clear expectations, and creates an environment where people do their best work.

  • Business acumen: Understands how pharma brands, launches, and market access dynamics shape measurement priorities.

  • Communication: Tells a clear story from complex results and adapts the message for technical and executive audiences.

It's Time to Join Stryker!

Are you passionate about designing intuitive, high-quality software experiences that make a meaningful impact? Join Stryker's Mako Robotics team and help shape the user interfaces that support robotic-assisted orthopedic surgery.


As a Staff level User Interface and Experience Designer, you'll play a key role in developing the software experiences used in Mako's hip replacement applications. You'll combine strong visual and interaction design expertise with hands-on technical execution, translating complex workflows into intuitive interfaces and detailed, production-ready design specifications.


This is an opportunity to contribute to both current and next-generation Mako technologies. You'll help deliver critical UI designs for existing applications while collaborating across engineering, product development, and design teams to influence the future of robotic-assisted surgery.


You'll join a collaborative, geographically distributed team that values creativity, attention to detail, technical excellence, and the ability to take ownership of your work.


What You Will Do

User Interface Design & Development

  • Design and develop intuitive, visually consistent software interfaces for Mako robotic-assisted surgery applications, with an initial focus on Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA).
  • Create high-fidelity interface designs, screen layouts, interactive prototypes, and reusable UI components using Figma and established design systems.
  • Translate complex clinical workflows, product requirements, and user needs into clear, functional, and accessible software experiences.
  • Apply visual and interaction design principles, including typography, color, layout, navigation, messaging, component states, and user feedback.
  • Develop detailed, production-ready UI specifications that accurately communicate design intent to software development teams.
  • Create and manage design assets, component libraries, naming conventions, documentation, and version-controlled design deliverables.

User Experience & Product Development

  • Contribute to the development of next-generation Mako applications through workflow analysis, concept exploration, prototyping, and iterative design.
  • Collaborate with UX researchers, product owners, and cross-functional teams to incorporate user feedback, clinical insights, and usability considerations into design solutions.
  • Support design reviews, usability evaluations, and voice-of-customer activities to refine interfaces and improve the overall user experience.
  • Balance user needs, technical feasibility, design consistency, and product requirements throughout the development process.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Design Ownership

  • Partner closely with software engineers, scrum teams, product owners, systems engineers, and other designers to support successful implementation of UI designs.
  • Collaborate with design teams across Mako's hip, knee, and shoulder applications to maintain consistency within shared software platforms and design systems.
  • Independently manage assigned design activities, proactively resolve challenges, and drive deliverables from concept through implementation.
  • Communicate design decisions, technical specifications, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes, documentation standards, tools, and team practices.
  • Support applicable medical device design controls, usability, and quality requirements throughout product development.

What You Will Need


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in User Interface Design, User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Industrial Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience is required.
  • 4 or more years of professional experience in UI/UX design, software product design, interaction design, or a closely related field is required.
  • Proficiency with Figma, including experience working with shared design systems, component libraries, and high-fidelity interface designs is required.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Illustrator and Photoshop is required.

Preferred Qualifications (You do not need to all of these)

  • Experience designing software interfaces, creating interactive prototypes, and applying established visual and interaction design principles.
  • A portfolio or representative work samples demonstrating relevant user interface design capabilities.
  • Experience developing detailed UI specifications, design documentation, component definitions, and production-ready assets for software development teams.
  • Strong visual design, graphic design, and illustration skills, including creating instructional graphics, icons, and informational illustrations.
  • Experience with complex software applications, technical systems, or products requiring highly detailed and consistent user interfaces.
  • Experience with 3D modeling or rendering tools such as KeyShot, SolidWorks, or similar applications.
  • Experience designing software for medical devices, surgical systems, robotics, or other regulated or safety-critical industries.
  • Familiarity with usability engineering, accessibility principles, human factors, and user-centered design methodologies.
  • Experience collaborating with software development teams in Agile or Scrum environments.
  • Understanding of software development practices and how UI designs are translated into functional applications.
  • Experience collaborating across distributed teams and working independently within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Kunden-, Umsatz- und Ergebnisverantwortung

  • dem Newell-Portfolio.

  • Transparente und sorgfältige Volumen- und Umsatzschätzung inkl. regelmäßiger Kommentierung.

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, title companies, attorneys and capital partners to fund deals quickly and reliably.

As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep closings accurate, controlled and on schedule.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Closing & Funding Specialist to own the closing process, from opening title and obtaining insurance through funding and post-closing handoff.

You will coordinate title companies, attorneys, borrowers and internal teams, review loan documents and settlement statements, and manage funding packages with capital partners under strict wire verification controls.

This role requires direct hard money closing experience, a clear understanding of urgent funding timelines and exceptionally responsive service.

What You'll Do

Title, Escrow & Insurance

  • Open and manage title and escrow.
  • Review title, liens, vesting and insurance.
  • Coordinate attorneys, title companies, borrowers and internal teams to resolve closing issues.

Loan Documents & Settlement Review

  • Coordinate loan document preparation.
  • Review loan documents and HUD/settlement statements against approved terms, fees, payoffs, reserves and disbursements.
  • Obtain required approvals before closing.

Closing Conditions

  • Collect and clear all remaining closing and funding documents.
  • Work with the processor and originator on underwriting conditions and escalate material exceptions.

Funding

  • Submit funding packages to warehouse lenders and capital partners and resolve their conditions.
  • Obtain clear-to-fund approval and coordinate final funding under company authorization and wire verification controls.

Post-Closing

  • Confirm funding and organize the final loan file in the company's loan portal.
  • Flag trailing documents or post-closing deficiencies to the processor and originator for correction.
  • Track the handoff of each loan to servicing.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Direct hard money closing and funding experience.
  • Solid knowledge of title, escrow, insurance, loan documents and HUD/settlement statements.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Loans close and fund on schedule.
  • Settlement statements and loan documents match approved terms.
  • Funding packages are cleared by capital partners with minimal back and forth.
  • Wire verification and funding controls are followed every time.
  • Final files are complete, and trailing items are flagged and resolved quickly.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,500 to $2,200 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own every closing from title through funding.
  • Professional Growth: Approval authority grows as you prove your competence.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct hard money closing experience is required.
  • Approval authority for documents, settlement statements and clear-to-fund is expanded only after you demonstrate competence and receive delegation.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionProduct & Delivery Lead — UI/UX, Mid-Level | Zenara HealthLocation: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
jobs.description:
Description

Product & Delivery Lead — UI/UX, Mid-Level | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building modern software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include Assess and Zenflow, which support clinical workflows, assessments, care management, and operational delivery ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, use AI heavily, and expect each person to own meaningful outcomes rather than wait for process to be handed down.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product & Delivery Lead who can turn rough ideas into designed, buildable, and shippable product work.

This is not a pure project management role.

This is not a pure UI design role.

This is a hands-on product role for someone who can do both: design the experience and drive the delivery.

Today, product ideas, customer requests, UI/UX decisions, backlog ownership, and sprint tracking sit too heavily with the founder and Head of Engineering. Without this role, the roadmap drifts, requirements remain unclear, and engineering builds from incomplete direction ..

You will work closely with the founder on product vision and roadmap, with the Head of Engineering on delivery, and with commercial and clinical stakeholders to turn feedback into clear priorities ..

Here is the test: can you take a vague customer or founder request, understand the workflow, design the interface, write the acceptance criteria, prioritize the work, and keep the sprint moving until the feature ships?

Our Product Operating Vision

We are building an AI-native software company, but strong product judgment still matters.

AI can help research, summarize feedback, draft requirements, generate options, and speed up prototyping. But the product owner must still decide what matters, what should be built, what trade-offs are acceptable, and what “done” means.

You will help create the product operating rhythm at Zenara, including:

  • Clear product discovery
  • Fast UI/UX exploration
  • Practical prototypes
  • Requirements with examples and edge cases
  • Acceptance criteria engineering can actually build against
  • Backlog hygiene
  • Sprint planning and review
  • Customer feedback loops
  • Delivery visibility across the team

The goal is to help engineering move faster because the product work is clear, designed, and prioritized.

What You’ll Do

  • Turn product ideas into sketches, workflows, clickable prototypes, and final UI/UX.
  • Own and maintain the product roadmap with the founder and commercial team . .
  • Write requirements with user flows, examples, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Own the active backlog and sprint rhythm in Linear . .
  • Keep tickets clear, prioritized, and ready for engineering.
  • Chase decisions, clarify trade-offs, and prevent delivery from getting stuck.
  • Collect customer and commercial feedback and turn it into prioritized product work.
  • Review finished work against acceptance criteria before release.
  • Use AI tools for research, drafting, prototyping, synthesis, and delivery tracking.
  • Help define reusable UI patterns and product conventions across Assess and Zenflow.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong UI/UX ability, with real examples of product flows, prototypes, or shipped interfaces.
  • Product management judgment: prioritization, roadmap ownership, trade-offs, and clear decision-making.
  • Experience running sprints or delivery for a software team.
  • Ability to write clear acceptance criteria with examples and edge cases.
  • Comfort working with engineers and translating between customer needs and technical execution.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar systems for research, drafting, prototyping, or planning .
  • High ownership, curiosity, and willingness to learn fast.
  • Strong communication and follow-through.

Tools and Domain

  • Linear
  • Figma or similar design/prototyping tools
  • ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools
  • Clinical software for behavioral-health clinics
  • Assess and Zenflow product workflows

What “AI-Native Product” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use AI to speed up product research and synthesis.
  • Convert rough conversations into structured requirements.
  • Generate and compare product options quickly.
  • Draft acceptance criteria and edge cases, then refine them with human judgment.
  • Use AI to support delivery tracking without losing accountability.
  • Move faster without producing vague, generic, or unvalidated product work.

AI should make your product work sharper, not lazier.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, health-tech, or clinical-workflow experience.
  • Ability to read basic code or technical documentation.
  • Experience with Figma or similar prototyping tools.
  • Startup experience.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will own the active backlog and sprint review, clarify the next few features with prototypes and acceptance criteria, and set up a simple customer-feedback loop ..

Within your first 90 days, the roadmap will be owned and reviewed regularly with the founder, every new feature will begin from your prototype and acceptance criteria, and sprints will run without the Head of Engineering needing to track them ..

Over time, success means owning product delivery across Assess and Zenflow, improving on-time delivery and user acceptance, and establishing reusable design patterns for the team.

Schedule

This role requires meaningful overlap with the US-based founder and the India-based engineering team. India evening availability is expected. Final collaboration hours can be confirmed during the hiring process.

Outside live collaboration, we care about output, clarity, responsiveness, and delivery ownership.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Significant ownership of product direction in an early-stage company

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de bases de données (InteleShare)
jobs.excerpt: Aperçu du poste La ou le gestionnaire de bases de données dirige l’équipe responsable de l’architecture de bases de données des solutions d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad.
jobs.description:
Aperçu du poste

La ou le gestionnaire de bases de données dirige l’équipe responsable de l’architecture de bases de données des solutions d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad. La personne titulaire du poste définit la stratégie et les normes de bases de données de nos plateformes PACS, RIS et d’imagerie d’entreprise, qui doivent demeurer évolutives, sécurisées et hautement disponibles. Elle met sur pied et fait progresser une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie et en architecture de bases de données, qu’elle recrute, accompagne et mobilise autour d’objectifs clairs. Avec la direction du génie logiciel, de DevOps, de l’infrastructure et des produits, elle harmonise cette stratégie avec les feuilles de route des produits. Elle fait valoir les enjeux de bases de données dans les décisions touchant la fiabilité des systèmes et les soins aux patients.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger, recruter et faire progresser une équipe de spécialistes en ingénierie et en architecture de bases de données. Fixer des objectifs clairs de rendement et de perfectionnement, et tenir des rencontres de suivi régulières. Bâtir une équipe capable de répondre aux besoins actuels et futurs d’Intelerad en matière de bases de données.
  • Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie et des normes d’architecture de bases de données des plateformes d’imagerie médicale d’Intelerad. Veiller à ce que les conceptions soient évolutives, sécurisées et fiables dans les modèles de déploiement sur place, infonuagiques et hybrides.
  • Favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle et la fiabilité de tous les systèmes de bases de données en production. Établir des références de performance, superviser la planification de la capacité et veiller à la mise en place de pratiques robustes de sauvegarde, de reprise après sinistre et de continuité des activités.
  • Établir et faire respecter les protocoles de sécurité et les cadres de conformité des bases de données, notamment la HIPAA et les normes d’interopérabilité en santé, comme DICOM, HL7 et FHIR. Protéger ainsi l’intégrité et la confidentialité des données dans tous les systèmes.
  • Collaborer avec la direction du génie logiciel, de DevOps, de l’infrastructure et des produits pour harmoniser la stratégie de bases de données avec les feuilles de route des produits. Évaluer et choisir des technologies de bases de données, et diriger d’importants projets de migration, de mise à niveau et de modernisation.

Compétences et expérience

  • Au moins 7 ans d’expérience en architecture, en conception et en administration de bases de données
  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en gestion directe ou en direction de spécialistes en ingénierie ou en architecture de bases de données
  • Solide expertise tant des bases de données relationnelles (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) que des bases de données NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) dans des environnements à grande échelle et à haute disponibilité.
  • Expérience reconnue de l’établissement de protocoles de sécurité et de cadres de conformité pour les bases de données, notamment pour la protection des données de santé et la conformité à la HIPAA.
  • Expérience des plateformes et des services de bases de données infonuagiques d’AWS, d’Azure ou de GCP, notamment des stratégies de migration de bases de données et des architectures hybrides.
  • Capacité démontrée à recruter, à accompagner et à développer des talents techniques. Aptitude à communiquer clairement la stratégie de bases de données et les compromis qu’elle suppose aux parties prenantes, qu’elles aient ou non un profil technique.

Atouts et exigences particulières

  • Expérience de l’architecture de systèmes d’imagerie médicale (PACS, RIS, VNA ou plateformes d’imagerie d’entreprise) et des normes de données en santé comme DICOM, HL7 et FHIR.
  • Expérience des outils d’infrastructure en tant que code, comme Terraform ou CloudFormation, et des pipelines CI/CD pour le déploiement de bases de données.
  • Certification professionnelle comme AWS Certified Database – Specialty, Microsoft Certified : Azure Database Administrator Associate ou Oracle Certified Professional.
  • Expérience de la direction d’équipes réparties et privilégiant le travail à distance, dans plusieurs fuseaux horaires, au sein d’environnements de développement agile.
  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en systèmes d’information, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine équivalent
  • Déplacements occasionnels (jusqu’à 10 % du temps) pour des rencontres d’équipe hors site et des séances de planification interfonctionnelles.

La présente description de poste ne constitue pas une liste exhaustive des responsabilités ou des exigences du poste. Intelerad se réserve le droit de la modifier en tout temps.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $108,750 to $145,000 CAD. Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Intelerad est une entreprise qui offre une rémunération globale. Le salaire dépend du poste proposé. Des bonus et d'autres formes de rémunération peuvent être accordés dans le cadre d'un programme de rémunération globale, en plus d'une gamme complète d'avantages sociaux médicaux, financiers, de retraite, de congés payés et/ou autres.

Tous les candidats répondant aux qualifications minimales devront effectuer une évaluation en ligne de 30 minutes dans le cadre de leur candidature.

Tous vos renseignements seront gardés confidentiels conformément aux lignes directrices de l'EEO.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

Chez Intelerad, nous croyons que le chemin vers les réponses en matière de soins de santé doit être clair, que vous attendiez un diagnostic ou que vous essayiez d'en accélérer un. Nos solutions d’imagerie médicale rationalisent le flux d’informations, simplifient les processus complexes, maximisent l’efficacité et mettent en lumière l’inconnu. Nous permettons aux médecins d'apporter aux patients les réponses dont ils ont besoin plus rapidement et d'améliorer les résultats pour tous. Grâce à une imagerie plus accessible, on sort les patients de l’obscurité.

Basée à Raleigh, en Caroline du Nord, et à Montréal, Intelerad compte près de 800 employés dans des bureaux répartis dans quatre pays. L'entreprise offre à près de 2 000 organisations de soins de santé à travers le monde la rapidité, l'évolutivité et la simplicité nécessaires pour augmenter les performances de l'entreprise tout en, surtout, en améliorant les résultats des patients. Les solutions d'entreprise modernes d'Intelerad ont été récompensées par le prix « Best in KLAS », se classant à la première place dans la catégorie « PACS Europe (UK/Irlande) » du rapport « Best in KLAS : Global Software (Non-US) » de 2026.

jobs.description:
AI2CYBER develops cybersecurity products and delivers security services across cyber threat intelligence, application security and AI-enabled security operations.

We are looking for a GRC & AI Governance Consultant to support client engagements and our own products and services. Your work will cover risk assessments, policies, control reviews and audit preparation, alongside the governance of AI systems and their use.

You will take responsibility for assigned assessments and deliverables, work directly with technical and business teams, and help control owners address findings through to closure.

Requirements

  • Develop and maintain ISO/IEC 27001 policies and processes, including risk assessments, risk treatment plans and Statements of Applicability.
  • Assess control design and operating effectiveness, evaluate audit evidence and verify the completion of corrective actions.
  • Maintain risk registers, document exceptions and residual risks, and prepare recommendations for accountable risk owners.
  • Support GDPR, NIS2 and EU AI Act gap assessments, mapping applicable requirements to controls and evidence in collaboration with technical, privacy and legal specialists.
  • Contribute to AI governance frameworks and ISO/IEC 42001 implementation, including AI inventories, risk and impact assessments, ownership, acceptable-use policies and approval processes.
  • Work with engineering teams to define AI controls covering data quality and protection, access and agent permissions, human oversight, transparency, logging and change management.
  • Review AI evaluation and security-test evidence against agreed acceptance criteria before deployment and after material changes. Coordinate periodic reassessments and track actions arising from control gaps and incidents.
  • Assess cloud and AI providers, including security assurances, data retention, use of customer data for model training and management of material service changes.
  • Present significant risks, control weaknesses and overdue actions to management, with clear recommendations and priorities.

What we are looking for

  • At least three years of experience in GRC, information security consulting, IT audit or a related discipline.
  • Practical experience applying ISO/IEC 27001, including risk assessments and control reviews.
  • Experience evaluating evidence, documenting findings and following corrective actions through to completion.
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and familiarity with NIS2.
  • An understanding of common AI and generative AI use cases, with the ability to identify relevant risks and discuss appropriate controls.
  • The ability to manage your deliverables, work constructively with technical and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly in English and Greek.

Additional experience we would value

  • Participation in AI governance, AI risk assessment or AI supplier evaluation projects.
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Experience with SaaS products, cloud environments or organisations in regulated sectors.
  • Relevant certifications, such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, CISM or AIGP.

You will work with the teams building and operating the systems you assess, giving you the opportunity to see your recommendations implemented and evaluate their effectiveness. The combination of product work and client engagements offers practical experience across different technologies and risk environments.

Benefits

  • Highly competitive salary reviewed upwards on a regular basis.
  • Participation in state-of-the-art project and tech challenges and participation in large-scale projects.
  • Personal and professional development, amongst industry experts and talented people.
  • Continuous learning, having access to board resources.
  • Equipment support so you have all the tools to do effectively and efficiently your work.
  • No dress code as we want you to be as comfortable as possible.

AI2CYBER is a cybersecurity company building advanced AI-driven solutions for vulnerability discovery, secure software development, offensive security automation, and cyber risk reduction.

We operate at the intersection of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, software engineering, and automation. Our mission is to help organizations identify, understand, prioritize, and remediate security weaknesses faster and more effectively.

This is a full-time position with competitive salary and benefits. If you are looking for an exciting opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Quality Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: House Rx is on a mission to make specialty medications more affordable and accessible for patients suffering from chronic illnesses like cancer and autoimmune disorders.
jobs.description:
House Rx is on a mission to make specialty medications more affordable and accessible for patients suffering from chronic illnesses like cancer and autoimmune disorders. We provide clinics with specialized technology and support from pharmacists and care coordinators to dispense medication directly to their patients, known as medically integrated dispensing (MID).

This role sits at the intersection of quality expertise and operational leadership. It is an opportunity for an experienced House Rx team member to step into leadership, set the standard for quality across our specialty pharmacy services, and directly contribute to the company’s mission of making specialty medications affordable and accessible for patients—keep reading to learn more about the role, our team, and why this is the right next step in your career! This position is open to internal candidates. Applicants must be based in the United States.

About the role

We are seeking a Quality Supervisor to lead our team of Quality Specialists and own the quality assurance function across House Rx’s specialty pharmacy operations. This is not a traditional people manager role—we are looking for a working supervisor who is a recognized subject matter expert in pharmacy operations quality, from order processing and claims to prior authorizations, dispensing, and patient communication. You will set the standard for the team by doing the work alongside them, while also building the audit programs, systems, and talent needed to scale a high-performing quality function.

This role reports to the Sr. Director, Centralized Services and is a remote position, with occasional travel to House Rx hubs or customer sites as needed.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Assurance Leadership & Program Ownership:

    • Audit Program Ownership: Own the end-to-end quality audit program for order processing, claims, prior authorizations, dispensing, and patient/caregiver phone calls, ensuring audit coverage, sampling, and scoring standards are consistent, compliant, and aligned with House Rx standards of excellence.
    • Working Supervisor: Maintain a working audit caseload alongside the team to model best practices, demonstrate audit excellence, and stay close to platform workflows, SOPs, and clinic-specific requirements.
    • QA Documentation & Tools: Develop, document, and continuously improve QA scorecards, audit tools, SOPs, and calibration procedures to ensure consistency across the team and scalability as House Rx grows.
    • Escalation & Remediation: Serve as the escalation point for quality concerns, leading root cause analysis, real-time remediation, and corrective action plans in partnership with the responsible teams.
    • Standards Alignment: Stay current on workflow changes, payer requirements, and clinic-specific expectations, and proactively translate them into updated audit criteria and quality standards.

Team Leadership & Development:

    • Lead and Coach: Lead, coach, and develop a team of Quality Specialists, fostering a culture of accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement.
    • Performance Management: Conduct regular 1:1s and structured performance reviews to identify development opportunities, address performance gaps, and retain top talent.
    • Workload Management: Manage scheduling, PTO coverage, audit assignments, and workload distribution to ensure consistent audit coverage and team wellbeing.
    • Calibration: Lead regular calibration sessions to ensure audit scoring is consistent, objective, and aligned across all Quality Specialists.
    • Training Partnership: Collaborate with the training team to design and deliver quality-focused coaching, onboarding, and ongoing education informed by audit findings and error trends.
    • Team Culture: Champion team morale and a collaborative, patient-first culture.

Performance Reporting & Cross-Functional Partnership:

    • Metrics and Reporting: Track and report on key quality metrics, including audit scores, error rates, trends by team, clinic, and process, remediation completion, and patient and clinic experience indicators.
    • Trend Analysis: Identify patterns in errors and inefficiencies to proactively address root causes and drive measurable improvement.
    • Process Improvement: Partner with operations, training, clinical operations, care coordinators, pharmacists, and leadership to design and implement process improvements and remove barriers to quality.
    • Clinic Launch Readiness: Support clinic launches by ensuring quality audit coverage and standards are established and operational before go-live.
    • Customer and Leadership Support: Provide quality data and subject matter expertise to client-facing teams during implementation, QBRs, and operational reviews as needed, and deliver regular updates to executive leadership on quality performance, risks, and opportunities.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in pharmacy operations, including claims processing, prior authorizations, and/or dispensing, with 2+ years in a quality assurance, auditing, or compliance capacity. Specialty pharmacy experience required; medically integrated dispensing experience preferred.
  • Leadership: 2+ years of supervisory, lead, or mentoring experience, or a demonstrated record of informally leading, coaching, and developing peers. You earn credibility through expertise, not just title.
  • Quality & Audit Expertise: Strong understanding of specialty pharmacy workflows, SOPs, and the importance of accuracy at every step, with a keen eye for identifying errors, inconsistencies, and inefficiencies and solving them.
  • Analytical Abilities: Proficient in analyzing data, synthesizing insights, and driving improvement through data-driven decision-making. Proficiency in reporting tools, spreadsheets, and data visualization preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Clear, confident communicator able to deliver constructive feedback, align internal stakeholders, and adapt communication style to diverse audiences.
  • Technology: Comfortable navigating pharmacy management and EMR systems and learning new technology quickly.
  • Startup Mindset: Thrive in a fast-paced, startup-style environment and are energized by building and improving quality processes from the ground up.

Expected Starting Salary: $85K

This is an anticipated starting salary. The actual base salary/wage will depend on several factors, including experience, knowledge, and skills. Actual compensation packages may include other elements equity, paid time off and benefits.
