Senior Category Manager – Direct Materials

Tarkett North America | Corporate Sourcing

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE.

Basic Function

The Senior Category Manager – Direct Materials is a key leadership role within Tarkett North America’s Corporate Procurement organization. This position is responsible for developing and executing commercially competitive category management and sourcing strategies across Tarkett’s North American operations, and owns Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for a portfolio of the company’s most critical direct material categories. Categories managed include PVC resin, Plasticizers, Fillers, Recycled PVC, PVB, Dispersions, and Adhesives, with potential expansion into Additives and other Chemicals based on business need and demonstrated capability.

This individual will set the strategic direction for supplier relationships across the managed portfolio, holding suppliers accountable for cost performance, quality, supply assurance, service levels, and ongoing continuous improvement. Working through cross-functional teams (CFT), the Senior Category Manager partners closely with plant leadership, R&D, Quality, Operations, Planning, Finance, and senior executives to enhance value delivery through data-driven strategies, strong governance, disciplined negotiation, and creative problem-solving.

The role leads each category through the full TCO sourcing process — from planning and strategy development through sourcing, contracting, supplier qualification, and ongoing performance management — delivering high-impact initiatives that improve operational efficiency, drive structural cost savings, and support Tarkett’s strategic and sustainability objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute multi-year category strategies for PVC, plasticizers, fillers, recycled PVC, PVB, dispersions, and adhesives that optimize cost, quality, supply assurance, risk, and sustainability performance.

  • Lead the full category lifecycle using Strategic Sourcing process — from business case development and market analysis through strategy execution, contracting, and ongoing supplier management.

  • Drive Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) by applying market intelligence, cost modeling, should-cost analysis, and competitive benchmarking.

  • Build and maintain feedstock-to-material cost models (e.g., ethylene/EDC/VCM linkages for PVC; oil and oleochemical linkages for plasticizers) to validate supplier pricing and support fact-based negotiation.

  • Negotiate complex supply agreements — pricing, commercial terms, volume commitments, capacity guarantees, and continuity provisions — that secure long-term value and mitigate supply risk.

  • Lead Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) for strategic suppliers, including joint business plans, innovation pipelines, and continuous improvement programs.

  • Manage the day-to-day relationship and overall performance of managed suppliers, holding them accountable to SLAs, KPIs, and cost targets.

  • Develop and manage category KPIs (cost, quality, service, delivery, safety, productivity) and supplier scorecards to ensure measurable value delivery.

  • Analyze market and cost-driver dynamics — capacity, feedstock, logistics, trade policy, and regulatory shifts — to anticipate changes in raw material economics and develop mitigation strategies.

  • Reduce single-source exposure through dual sourcing, qualified alternates, and regional supply options; maintain category risk assessments and business continuity plans.

  • Lead cross-functional stakeholder teams (Operations, R&D, Quality, Finance, Planning, Sustainability) to align sourcing strategies with business goals and secure organizational buy-in.

  • Partner with R&D and Quality on material qualification, specification changes, formulation alternatives, and new product introduction (NPI) sourcing support.

  • Advance Tarkett’s circularity and sustainability objectives through recycled PVC and post-industrial/post-consumer content sourcing, supplier carbon and EPD data collection, and lower-impact material alternatives.

  • Partner with Supply Chain and Planning on inventory strategy, working capital, minimum order quantities, lead times, and safety stock levels for managed categories.

  • Measure and report category performance, establishing baseline benchmarks and tracking savings, price variance versus index, lead time, service level, and delivery improvements.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and communicator to executive stakeholders, translating complex business cases and market dynamics into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Maintain contract, pricing, and supplier data integrity in enterprise systems, and ensure adherence to procurement policy, internal controls, and delegation of authority.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field (MBA preferred).

  • Minimum 6–10 years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or procurement — or in Production, R&D, or Engineering with significant commercial exposure — preferably including direct materials.

  • Strong understanding of TCO principles, strategic sourcing methodology, cost modeling, and contract negotiation.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.

  • Strong communicator and collaborator with executive presence; able to build trust with senior stakeholders across the organization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

  • Strong analytical capability, including Excel-based cost modeling; proficient with ERP and e-sourcing systems (e.g., SAP, Ariba, or equivalent).

  • Demonstrated ability to problem-solve and develop creative, practical solutions to complex operational challenges.

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote capacity with a high degree of self-direction.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% to support supplier and company site operations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct sourcing experience with PVC resin, plasticizers, fillers, PVB, dispersions, adhesives, additives, or specialty chemicals.

  • Experience sourcing recycled or post-consumer material streams and supporting circular-economy initiatives.

  • Experience in a multi-plant manufacturing environment; flooring, building products, or plastics processing industry knowledge strongly preferred.

  • Expertise in category management from strategy development through execution (“cradle-to-grave”).

  • Experience with index-based and formula pricing, commodity risk management, and hedging concepts.

  • Knowledge of supply markets, cost drivers, and technology trends affecting direct materials.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to develop fact-based business cases and influence senior stakeholders.

  • Advanced project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.

  • Skilled in the creation, negotiation, and administration of supplier contracts.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement training.

  • Professional certification such as CPSM, CPSD, CIPS, or C.P.M.

What We Offer

  • A commitment that Safety is #1

  • Competitive benefits, pay, and retirement plan options!

  • Career growth, stability, and flexible work arrangements.

Responsible Manufacturing – Protecting Our Planet for the Future

  • We utilize renewable energy and a closed loop recycled water process.

  • We are committed to reducing greenhouse emissions and water consumption.

  • We are the only flooring company recognized by the Asthma and Allergy foundation.

Who we are:

With a history of more than 140 years, Tarkett is a worldwide leader in innovative and sustainable flooring and sport surface solutions, generating turnover of €3.3 billion in 2025. The Group has close to 12,000 employees, 25 R&D centers, 8 recycling centers and 33 production sites. Tarkett creates and manufactures solutions for hospitals, schools, housing, hotels, offices, stores and sports fields, serving customers in over 100 countries. To build “The Way to Better Floors,” the Group is committed to circular economy and sustainability, in line with its Tarkett Human‐Conscious Design® approach.

Tarkett is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in backgrounds and in experiences and promote an inclusive workplace where all employees can perform at their best.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Senior CSV/ CSA Specialist Department: Information Technology Location: Remote, East Coast Preferred Hours Per Week: 40 Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday SUMMARY The Senior CSV/CSA Specialist leads risk-based validation and assurance activities for GxP-regulated computerized systems throughout their lifecycle.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior CSV/ CSA Specialist

Department: Information Technology

Location: Remote, East Coast Preferred

Hours Per Week: 40

Schedule: Days, Monday – Friday

SUMMARY

The Senior CSV/CSA Specialist leads risk-based validation and assurance activities for GxP-regulated computerized systems throughout their lifecycle. The role provides technical leadership in validation strategy, execution, quality review, audit and inspection readiness, while serving as a subject matter expert in CSV/CSA, SDLC, data integrity, electronic records/signatures, and regulatory requirements. The position also provides mentorship to junior CSV/CSA team members.

RESPONSIBILTIES

  • Validation and Assurance Strategy: Lead planning, execution, review, and approval of validation and assurance deliverables for new GxP systems, system upgrades, integrations, infrastructure changes, software changes, and system retirements, Determine appropriate validation or assurance rigor using risk-based principles aligned with GAMP 5, CSA, data integrity, e-record/e-signature, and applicable GxP expectations, Lead or review system risk assessments, validation strategy assessments, supplier/vendor assessments, impact assessments, and validation planning decisions, Ensure validation strategies are proportionate to system risk, intended use, business process impact, patient/subject safety, product quality, data integrity, and regulatory impact.
  • CSV/CSA Deliverables: Author, review, or approve validation lifecycle deliverables, including system risk assessments, validation plans or assurance plans, URS, functional/design/configuration specifications, IQ/OQ/PQ or functional testing protocols, regression testing, UAT evidence, traceability matrices, validation summary reports, periodic reviews, change impact assessments, data migration, archival, decommissioning, and retirement documentation, Ensure validation documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, reviewable, and inspection-ready, Provide quality and technical review of deliverables prepared by project teams, IT system owners, vendors, and less senior CSV/CSA resources.
  • IT Quality and Compliance Oversight: Provide IT Quality and Compliance oversight for computerized systems, SDLC activities, validation deliverables, change control deliverables, and system lifecycle processes, Support internal audits, external audits, client audits, regulatory inspections, audit responses, CAPAs, deviations, and remediation plans related to computerized systems, Identify compliance gaps, documentation weaknesses, lifecycle risks, and process improvement opportunities, Partner with Quality Assurance to resolve validation-related observations, audit findings, deviations, CAPAs, and inspection commitments.
  • System Lifecycle and Change Support: Support lifecycle activities including procurement, implementation, configuration, validation, operational use, change control, periodic review, incident/deviation support, migration, archival, and retirement, Ensure validated systems remain in a state of control through change assessment, regression testing, periodic review, access/security review, backup/restore review, data integrity review, and documentation maintenance, Provide senior-level review and guidance for GxP IT change controls, impact assessments, validation strategy decisions, test planning, evidence review, and release readiness.
  • Leadership, Mentoring, and Continuous Improvement: Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to CSV/CSA Specialists and cross-functional project teams, Support development and improvement of validation procedures, forms, templates, guidance documents, training materials, metrics, and operating rhythms, Promote consistent application of risk-based validation, CSA, supplier reliance, testing strategy, and lifecycle documentation practices, Facilitate cross-functional meetings and communications related to validation strategy, compliance expectations, audit readiness, and lifecycle deliverables, Perform other duties as assigned.

This job description is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake any other duties that are reasonably required and are commensurate with the skills, experience and level of responsibility of the role.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, Quality, or related field
  • OR Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience 5+ yrs CSV, CSA, IT quality, software validation, change control, SDLC, or GxP computerized systems experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong knowledge of computerized system validation, CSA, GAMP 5, SDLC, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, data integrity, and e-record/e-signature expectations.
  • Strong working knowledge of validation lifecycle deliverables and risk-based validation practices.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory expectations and apply them pragmatically to system risk, intended use, and business impact.
  • Strong technical writing, documentation review, inspection-readiness, analytical, prioritization, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Experience leading validation strategy and deliverable execution for laboratory, quality, clinical, enterprise, infrastructure, data, or integration systems.
  • Experience supporting audits, inspections, CAPAs, deviations, remediation activities, SDLC reviews, change controls, testing evidence, data integrity controls, and lifecycle records.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less senior validation or quality resources
  • Ability to lead complex validation activities across multiple systems, projects, stakeholders, and priorities.

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Sedentary - Sedentary roles are primarily office-based and require prolonged sitting (67–100% of the workday) with minimal physical effort and lifting limited to under 10 lbs. Fine motor skills are necessary for computer work, writing, and telephone use, supported by clear visual and auditory ability. Cognitive and emotional demands are high due to extended concentration, frequent interruptions, independent decision-making, and information processing. Although physical exposure is low, administrative areas within healthcare environments may occasionally involve contact with infectious agents. Some roles may require flexible hours, TB screening, or a valid driver’s license.

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Senior Salesforce Administrator to play a critical role in enabling our sales and service organizations through effective, well-designed use of the Salesforce platform.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Salesforce Administrator to play a critical role in enabling our sales and service organizations through effective, well-designed use of the Salesforce platform. This role goes well beyond ticket fulfillment: it focuses on how Salesforce is actually used to support customer-facing operations, and it takes ownership of the platform's day-to-day health, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, adoption, and data quality.

The Senior Administrator partners with business stakeholders, Business Process Analyst, and Sales Force Architect to ensure standards set by the Salesforce Architect, are leveraged appropriately, consistently, and in alignment with platform best practices. This role is ideal for an administrator who understands both the technical mechanics of Salesforce and the real-world workflows of sales and service teams, and who is motivated by improving outcomes through the platform. This is a senior, proactive role, a partner to the business, not a reactive support desk.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Enablement & Business Support

  • Partner with sales and service teams to understand day-to-day workflows and how Salesforce is used to support customer engagement.

  • Identify opportunities to improve platform usability, efficiency, and adoption based on observed usage patterns and user feedback.

  • Translate business requirements into well-designed Salesforce configurations that enhance productivity without unnecessary customization.

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for Salesforce-related questions, guidance, and continuous improvement ideas.

Salesforce Administration & Configuration

  • Administer and configure Salesforce features including:

    • Objects, fields, record types, page layouts, and validation rules

    • Flows and other declarative automation

    • Reports and dashboards to support operational visibility

  • Maintain and enforce data quality standards, including data validation, cleanup, and lifecycle management.

  • Support user access management, including profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchy.

Collaboration with Architecture & Governance

  • Work with Salesforce Architect on any refactoring and simplifying existing configuration to reduce complexity and technical debt, in line with architectural established standards and architectural direction.

  • Participate in reviews of proposed changes to ensure scalability, maintainability, and adherence to best practices.

  • Help reinforce governance guardrails and prevent the introduction of technical debt.

Support Operations & Adoption

•Partner with Salesforce Delivery Lead to support ticket queue, including but not limited to:

◦Ticket triage, root cause documentation, and resolve requests against agreed response expectations

•As-Needed: Onboard new users, deliver training, and support change-management initiatives

•Provide occasional training and upskilling across the organization as needed, building user competence and self-sufficiency on the platform

Testing, Deployment & Documentation

  • Support end-of-the-end testing of new features and enhancements prior to deployment

  • Assist with sandbox management and deployment coordination

  • Create and maintain clear documentation for configurations, processes, and user guidance

Continuous Improvement & Adoption

  • Monitor platform usage and adoption trends to proactively recommend improvements.

  • Help onboard new users and support change management initiatives.

  • Contribute to ongoing refinement of Salesforce processes as business needs evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • 6–10+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience.

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration and declarative automation (Flows).

  • Experience supporting sales and/or service organizations in a production Salesforce environment.

  • Solid understanding of Salesforce data model, security model, and reporting capabilities.

  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into effective platform solutions.

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications such as:

    • Salesforce Certified Administrator

    • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator

  • Experience working alongside Salesforce architects or development teams.

  • Exposure to integrations, APIs, or external system coordination.

  • Exposure to Data Cloud

·Experience administering managed packages / AppExchange apps and coordinating with integrated external systems.

  • Experience supporting organizations with complex or evolving Salesforce usage

  • Ticket management systems Fresh Service, Service Now

  • Agile Methodologies / Jira

What Success Looks Like

  • Salesforce is easier for sales and service teams to use and better aligned to their workflows.

  • Platform changes are implemented consistently and with minimal rework.

  • Data quality and reporting reliability improve over time.

  • Business teams view Salesforce as an enabler rather than a bottleneck.

  • The administrator operates as a proactive partner, not just a reactive support role.

At Advocate Health, we're committed to helping people live well by delivering exceptional care with compassion, innovation, and expertise. We're seeking an experienced Recruiter to join our team and help attract exceptional talent while building strong partnerships with hiring leaders across the organization.

As a valued member of our Talent Acquisition team, you'll play an important role in creating thoughtful recruitment strategies, engaging top talent, and delivering an exceptional hiring experience from initial outreach through offer acceptance.


About This Opportunity

This opportunity is ideal for a recruiter who enjoys building relationships, solving hiring challenges, and finding creative ways to connect great talent with meaningful career opportunities. You'll partner closely with hiring managers and HR partners to understand business needs, develop effective recruitment strategies, and move candidates through the hiring process efficiently.

You'll also have the opportunity to leverage recruiting data, market trends, social media, and innovative sourcing approaches to continuously strengthen how we attract and engage talent.

Advocate Health is the third-largest nonprofit, integrated health system in the United States, created from the combination of Advocate Aurora Health and Atrium Health. Providing care under the names Advocate Health Care in Illinois; Atrium Health in the Carolinas, Georgia and Alabama; and Aurora Health Care in Wisconsin, Advocate Health is a national leader in clinical innovation, health outcomes, consumer experience and value-based care. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Advocate Health services nearly 6 million patients and is engaged in hundreds of clinical trials and research studies, with Wake Forest University School of Medicine serving as the academic core of the enterprise. It is nationally recognized for its expertise in cardiology, neurosciences, oncology, pediatrics and rehabilitation, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. Advocate Health employs 155,000 teammates across 69 hospitals and over 1,000 care locations, and offers one of the nation’s largest graduate medical education programs with over 2,000 residents and fellows across more than 200 programs. Committed to providing equitable care for all, Advocate Health provides more than $6 billion in annual community benefits.

jobs.excerpt: About Seamless Seamless is building the future of AI-powered sales and revenue technology.
jobs.description:
About Seamless

Seamless is building the future of AI-powered sales and revenue technology.

Our platform combines real-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, and automation to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, and create pipeline more efficiently.

Seamless brings data and execution together through an integrated platform spanning sales intelligence, prospecting, buyer signals, data enrichment, AI-powered engagement, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and automated workflows. Our technology helps sales and go-to-market teams turn accurate data and actionable insights into more connections, meetings, pipeline, and revenue.

We operate at the intersection of AI, data, automation, and revenue technology, solving complex problems around data quality, accuracy, scale, intelligent workflows, and how businesses identify and engage prospective customers.

As AI continues to transform how companies go to market, Seamless is investing in our platform, data capabilities, AI products, and people to help define the next generation of sales technology.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Seamless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Visa sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

Why Seamless

Seamless is building the future of AI-powered sales and revenue technology.

Our platform brings together real-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, enrichment, automation, buyer signals, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and workflow capabilities to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, create pipeline, and convert more opportunities into revenue.

As a Sales Development Representative (Growth) at Seamless, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build your career in technology sales. Develop cold-calling, account research,
  • discovery, and consultative selling skills in a SaaS environment.
  • Own opportunities for account expansion. Identify new contacts, teams, and
  • business units within organizations that already use Seamless.

  • qualified demos and expansion pipeline.

  • communicate its value to new buyers across customer organizations.
  • Strengthen your outbound sales skills. Practice high-volume prospecting, objection
  • handling, follow-up, and account mapping.
  • Learn through coaching. Use feedback and sales training to improve your outreach
  • quality, productivity, and results.
  • Build a foundation for growth. Gain experience in a measurable, performance-driven sales development role.

At Seamless, ownership, accountability, continuous learning, collaboration, and results

matter. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your sales capabilities while helping more

teams realize value from Seamless.

The Opportunity

Seamless is hiring a Sales Development Representative, Growth to help expand relationships within our existing customer accounts by reaching new contacts, departments, and business units that have not yet used the platform.

This is a high-volume, phone-first outbound role. Although you will prospect into current customer organizations, the individuals you contact may have no prior relationship with Seamless. You’ll bring a hunter mentality to account expansion, using cold calling and other outreach channels to start conversations and uncover new opportunities.

You’ll research accounts, map decision-makers and adjacent teams, communicate Seamless’s value, and convert qualified interest into demos that support license, credit, and team expansion.

Success requires disciplined execution, including 500+ daily dials through a power dialer, as well as effective time management for research, follow-ups, and other assigned work. You’ll be accountable for activity, qualified meetings, and pipeline outcomes.

What You’ll Own

  • Prospect Within Existing Accounts: Identify net-new buyers, teams, and business units inside current Seamless customer organizations.
  • Execute High-Volume Cold Calling: Make 500+ daily dials through a power dialer and use approved outreach channels to engage contacts who may be unfamiliar with Seamless. Generate Expansion Opportunities: Turn conversations into qualified demos and pipeline for additional licenses, credits, and team adoption.
  • Map Customer Organizations: Research account structures to identify decisionmakers, influencers, and adjacent departments.
  • Communicate Product Value: Become a confident Seamless product user who can explain relevant platform capabilities and business outcomes.
  • Conduct Discovery: Ask targeted questions, listen actively, uncover needs, and assess fit for account expansion.
  • Navigate Objections: Respond professionally to resistance and keep conversations moving toward productive next steps.
  • Research Buyers and Industries: Learn buyer personas, lines of business, and account priorities to improve targeting and messaging.
  • Manage Your Daily Priorities: Balance power-dialer activity with research, followup, and assigned non-dialer responsibilities.
  • Own Performance Outcomes: Work toward or exceed daily activity targets and monthly qualified meeting and pipeline goals.
  • Improve Through Coaching: Apply feedback, adapt messaging, and strengthen outreach effectiveness over time.
  • Maintain Accurate Activity Records: Document outreach, account insights, and next steps in approved systems to support effective follow-through.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

Success means consistently reaching new buyers within existing customer organizations, converting those conversations into qualified demos, and building a reliable pipeline of expansion opportunities while meeting the role’s high-volume outreach expectations.

During your first 90 days, you will:

  • Complete product, systems, sales-process, and outreach training.
  • Understand Seamless’ value proposition and the expansion opportunities across existing customer accounts.
  • Learn to identify new departments, decision-makers, and potential buyers within customer organizations.
  • Establish a disciplined power-dialer routine and work toward the 500+ daily dial expectation.
  • Demonstrate discovery, objection-handling, and product communication skills.
  • Begin independently generating qualified demos and tracking progress against assigned activity and pipeline goals.
  • Balance daily outreach with research, follow-ups, and other assigned priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of SDR or BDR experience with a history of exceeding sales quotas.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience with cold calling, objection handling, and outbound prospect engagement.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to build rapport with new contacts.
  • Empathy, active listening, and the ability to uncover customer needs.
  • Resilience, persistence, and a strong work ethic in a high-activity sales role.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to manage competing outreach and non-dialer priorities.
  • Adaptability, coachability, and willingness to improve through feedback.

Benefits

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Job Description: SUMMARY The Digital Solutions Specialist is a field-based customer implementation and training professional responsible for accelerating the adoption and effective utilization of Ormco's digital orthodontic products and workflows.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

SUMMARY

The Digital Solutions Specialist is a field-based customer implementation and training professional responsible for accelerating the adoption and effective utilization of Ormco's digital orthodontic products and workflows. The position partners with Doctors, practice teams, Ormco Field Representatives, Clinical Education, Clinical Success, Customer Support, and other internal stakeholders to move customers from commercial commitment through successful implementation and repeatable utilization.

Following the commercial handoff, the Digital Solutions Specialist assesses practice readiness, develops an implementation plan, delivers product and workflow training, supports initial case submissions and product use, and helps resolve early adoption barriers. The role serves as a trusted product and workflow resource throughout the implementation period and ensures customers are equipped to confidently integrate Ormco solutions into their practices.

The position does not own the commercial sale or primary account relationship. Its primary accountability is to convert committed customers into activated, confident, and consistently utilizing practices.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Customer Readiness and Implementation Planning

  • Partner with the commercial team to receive qualified customer handoffs after the customer's commitment to implement an Ormco product or solution.
  • Conduct structured practice-readiness assessments to understand current workflows, technology, staffing, training needs, and potential barriers to implementation.
  • Develop a customer-specific implementation plan with defined milestones, responsibilities, training requirements, target dates, and success measures.
  • Establish clear expectations with doctors and practice teams regarding the implementation process and required participation.
  • Maintain visibility into assigned implementations, upcoming milestones, open risks, and implementation backlog.

Product and Workflow Training

  • Deliver in-depth, field-based training, education, onboarding, and implementation support for Ormco's digital orthodontic portfolio.
  • Train orthodontists, general practitioners, clinical team members, treatment coordinators, and other practice personnel on relevant products, systems, and workflows.
  • Translate complex product and technical information into clear, practical, and repeatable practice workflows.
  • Adapt training delivery to the customer's experience level, operating environment, and implementation needs while maintaining consistent program standards.
  • Provide virtual follow-up training and reinforcement when appropriate.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of standardized implementation guides, training resources, checklists, and customer-facing tools.

Activation and Initial Case Support

  • Guide customers through initial product setup, workflow preparation, and readiness for first use.
  • Support initial case submissions, approvals, and early product utilization, as appropriate to the product and established role boundaries.
  • Monitor customer progress against implementation milestones and proactively address delays or barriers.
  • Provide hands-on coaching during the early implementation period to strengthen customer confidence and reinforce effective use.
  • Confirm that defined activation and implementation criteria have been met before transitioning the customer to ongoing support.
  • Coordinate a clear and documented handoff to Clinical Success, Customer Support, or the appropriate long-term owner.

Workflow Support and Issue Resolution

  • Serve as a regional subject-matter resource for Ormco's digital orthodontic products and associated practice workflows.
  • Identify workflow gaps, adoption barriers, and training needs that could delay or prevent effective product utilization.
  • Provide timely first-line product and workflow guidance within the established scope of the role.
  • Coordinate escalation of technical, clinical, quality, or customer-service issues to the appropriate internal function.
  • Track open customer issues and facilitate follow-through until ownership and next steps are clear.
  • Review and report customer complaints through established company and quality-reporting processes.

Field and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Ormco Field Representatives to align implementation activity with the customer's broader account plan while preserving the Field Representative's commercial ownership of the account.
  • Maintain regular communication with Sales regarding implementation status, customer risks, milestone progress, and activation outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Education to ensure field training is clinically accurate, consistent, appropriately approved, and aligned with established curriculum.
  • Partner with Clinical Success to support a smooth transition from initial activation to sustained utilization.
  • Work with Customer Support and Technical Support to resolve product, system, and workflow issues requiring specialized assistance.
  • Provide training and implementation guidance to internal Ormco teams to build broader understanding of product workflows and customer adoption needs.

Customer and Field Insights

  • Gather structured customer feedback regarding product experience, implementation challenges, training effectiveness, and workflow needs.
  • Communicate relevant field insights, product feedback, enhancement opportunities, and emerging trends to Marketing, Product Management, Clinical Education, and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify common implementation barriers and recommend improvements to onboarding processes, training materials, workflow guidance, and internal handoffs.
  • Remain current on Ormco products, digital orthodontic workflows, industry developments, and relevant customer practices.

Documentation and Territory Management

  • Document implementation plans, customer activities, milestones, risks, outcomes, and handoffs in the designated CRM or implementation-management system.
  • Maintain an organized field schedule and manage customer activity across an assigned geography.
  • Prepare periodic implementation, activity, expense, and status reports as required.
  • Manage travel and assigned resources in accordance with company policies and budget expectations.
  • Comply with company policies related to customer interactions, product training, quality reporting, data privacy, travel, and expense management.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Performance measures focus on activation and implementation outcomes rather than direct sales quotas. Measures may include:

jobs.description:
Communications Manager

Center for WorkLife Law

Classification:Class Code 1717 / Exempt / Full-Time / Benefited / 1-Year Contract / Fully Remote

Anticipated hiring range: $80,000-$90,000, commensurate with qualifications, location and experience

ABOUT WORKLIFE LAW

WorkLife Law is a national advocacy and research organization that advances gender and racial equity by strengthening legal rights for pregnant people and family caregivers. Our work seeks to ensure all people have the freedom to build and maintain economic security through employment and educational opportunities, without having to sacrifice their health or their loved ones’ care. As a center of the University of California College of the Law, San Francisco, WorkLife Law provides direct assistance to workers and students in need and addresses structural inequality by changing public policy at the state and national levels.

Current areas of focus include fighting for reproductive justice; preventing discrimination against family caregivers; promoting legal rights for pregnant and lactating workers; operating the nation’s only legal resource center for pregnant and parenting students; and ensuring equitable access to leave.

THE ROLE

The Communications Manager will play a central role in the development and execution of WorkLife Law’s communications strategy, advancing our mission, amplifying our impact, and improving awareness of WorkLife Law and our services. This position will lead content development for our social media, email newsletter, website, press engagement, annual report, and public education materials and will take a hands-on role crafting compelling narratives and designs, incorporating stories to highlight our programs and impact.

The Communications Manager will also work closely with WorkLife Law Co-Directors to develop and implement communications initiatives that support organizational, advocacy, and fundraising priorities, including drafting and editing content for donor communications and grant applications. This team member will regularly work in partnership with WorkLife Law’s Co-Directors to evaluate existing strategies, develop new approaches, identify opportunities to expand our reach, and strengthen the effectiveness of WorkLife Law’s communications.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Typical duties and responsibilities consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

Communications Strategy

  • Deeply understand WorkLife Law’s mission, programs, and goals to develop effective communications strategies and messaging for varied audiences
  • Collaborate with Co-Directors to develop and execute WorkLife Law’s communications strategy and related initiatives and perform the day-to-day tasks to implement it
  • Work with program staff to synthesize achievements and capture WorkLife Law’s impact
  • Develop compelling narratives and talking points to support WorkLife Law’s advocacy and fundraising goals
  • Track our performance across platforms, report results, and use data and audience insights to refine communications strategies and expand our reach
  • Identify opportunities to test new communications approaches, channels, and formats and recommend improvements based on results

Website

  • Draft and adapt content (copy, imagery, videos) for WorkLife Law’s websites (; ; )
  • Manage website updates in WordPress, ensuring accuracy and usability
  • Understand and apply effective SEO, AEO and SMO to maximize our reach
  • Analyze and report on website performance and web traffic to inform ongoing strategy

Social Media

  • Manage our presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Bluesky (and other platforms, as appropriate)
  • Create and manage a comprehensive content calendar in tune with political and cultural happenings
  • Produce high-quality content (copy, graphics, short-form videos)
  • Grow WorkLife Law’s audience through effective communications strategies and initiatives

Email

  • Manage WorkLife Law’s monthly email newsletter program: setting the messaging calendar, drafting copy, and creating engaging designs
  • Set up email messages in MailChimp and manage quality assurance process
  • Implement effective list growth strategies and ensure data hygiene
  • Analyze and report on email performance to inform ongoing strategy

Graphic Design and Basic Video Editing

  • Create engaging visual assets for our websites, reports, and social media channels
  • Liaise with external consultants to produce more complex designs as needed

Press Engagement

  • Provide strategic input on messaging and communications priorities for press outreach.
  • Edit and co-author blogs, press releases, and other related items
  • Maintain and grow media lists

Fundraising Support

  • Gather metrics from WorkLife Law programmatic staff and manage database of reportable achievements to be used in grant applications and reports
  • Support the preparation of grant reports and other funder communications by drafting high-impact messages tailored to funder audiences
  • Produce content that keeps donors apprised of WorkLife Law activities
  • Work with Co-Directors and program staff to develop communications that support fundraising and organizational priorities

REQUIREMENTS

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least four years of communications experience; professional experience with non-profit social justice organizations strongly preferred
  • Familiarity, which may include lived expertise, with the challenges facing family caregivers, pregnant people, people of color and/or women in the workplace and education

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Commitment to gender, racial, and class equity, disability and reproductive justice
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with an understanding of what works best in different channels (e.g. social, email, website, press releases, reports)
  • The ability to quickly understand the complex legal and social concepts of WorkLife Law’s work and to thoughtfully translate them for lay audiences in accessible, persuasive, and inspiring ways
  • Acute attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize time to meet deadlines for multiple projects, including the nimbleness to shift between long-term and time-sensitive tasks
  • An eye for design and ability to create compelling visuals
  • Ability to effectively use WordPress or similar web design program; Canva, Adobe Creative, or other design tools to generate social media and basic publication design; social media platforms; Microsoft Office Suite; and ability to pick up other software and applications quickly
  • Comfort analyzing performance data and metrics to shape communications strategy
  • Ability to collaborate well with others, including articulating your ideas clearly, whether verbally or in writing
  • Strong desire to work in a group that prioritizes open communication, work-life balance, personal health, and positive relationships
  • Fluency in Spanish strongly preferred

The skills listed above are comprehensive, and we understand that there are great candidates who possess only a subset of those skills, or who have other important skills. If you match some of these skills, please do not hesitate to apply.

BENEFITS

Health and Welfare Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts for transportation-related, healthcare, and dependent care expenses
  • Employee Assistance Program

For Your Financial Future

  • Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, and Legal Insurance
  • University of California Retirement Plan (a defined benefit plan)
  • Deferred Compensation Plans/Pre-tax Retirement Savings Programs

For Your Work/Life Balance

  • Fifteen paid holidays per year
  • Three weeks' vacation, three personal days, and 12 paid sick days per year
  • Flexible work hours

THE HIRING PROCESS

Interested candidates should submit the following materials with their application:

  • Resume
  • Cover letter explaining your interest in WorkLife Law and this position
  • Three creative content samples (at least one should be writing-heavy like a blog post or email blast, at least one should be visual like a social media post or graphic)

We aim to be transparent and efficient in our hiring process. All applications are reviewed by members of WorkLife Law’s team. Application review will begin the week of November 2, 2026. This hiring process will include two video interviews and a skills assessment. In each interview, you will be asked to provide examples of these skills and experiences or how you would draw on your experiences to handle a scenario commonly found at WorkLife Law.

WorkLife Law is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from members of underrepresented communities and are eager to provide disability accommodations, when needed.

Please note: This position has been designated as “sensitive” and requires a pre-employment background check.

Federal law requires employers to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact Human Resources if you require reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Applicants who meet the position requirements will be competitively evaluated to identify the individuals whose breadth and depth of experience and education most closely relate to the stated requirements and the needs of the College. Not all applicants will be contacted for an interview.

The skills listed above are comprehensive, and we understand there are great candidates who possess only a subset of those skills, or who have other important skills. If you match some of these skills, please do not hesitate to apply.

jobs.excerpt: AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home.
jobs.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


AnewHealth is seeking a mid-level Software Engineer to develop and maintain software on our existing Electronic Health Record (EHR) platform using Ruby. This role will make changes to the platform across both front-end and back-end layers, balancing defect resolution with new feature development in an agile environment. The ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, is comfortable working within a mature, mission-critical codebase, and brings prior exposure to development in a healthcare setting.


Responsibilities

  • Platform Development — Design, develop, and maintain features on the existing EHR platform using Ruby (Ruby on Rails), working across both front-end and back-end layers of the application.
  • Build and modify user-facing views and interactions on the front end, and implement business logic, services, and data access on the back end.
  • Defect Resolution — Triage, debug, and resolve defects in the production EHR application, performing root-cause analysis and delivering durable fixes.
  • New Feature Development — Design and build new features and enhancements within the existing platform architecture, from requirements through implementation and testing.
  • Data & SQL — Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries against the platform's relational database(s), including work involving clinical and patient-related data structures.
  • Agile Delivery — Participate in sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Commit to and deliver against sprint timelines, collaborating closely with product owners, QA, and other engineers on the team.
  • Quality & Compliance — Write and maintain automated tests, participate in code reviews, and follow secure coding practices appropriate for a system handling protected health information (PHI).
  • AI-Enabled Development — Use AI tools to accelerate technical documentation, generate and refactor code, build supporting resources (test data, scripts, diagrams), and assist with code execution and validation, while ensuring appropriate review of AI-assisted output.

Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience using Ruby, preferably Ruby on Rails.
  • Demonstrated full-stack experience, including front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Rails view/UI technologies) and back-end development (Rails, ActiveRecord, service/business logic layers).
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, query optimization, and working with relational database schemas (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL).
  • Experience resolving defects in a live, production application and performing root-cause analysis.
  • Experience developing new features within an existing, mature codebase.
  • Exposure to software development in a healthcare environment, ideally involving an EHR or other clinical system.
  • Working experience in an agile/scrum environment, including familiarity with tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (e.g., RSpec, Capybara) and Git-based version control.
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) for documentation acceleration, resource development, and code execution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across a cross-functional team.

Requirements

  • Direct experience working on or supporting an EHR platform (proprietary or commercial, e.g., Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, or similar).
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and PHI handling requirements.
  • Exposure to pharmacy or other clinical workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern front-end frameworks or Rails tooling (e.g., Turbo, Stimulus, React).

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. Medical, dental and vision coverage are effective 1st of the month following date of hire.

AnewHealth provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status, or other legally protected classification in the state in which a person is seeking employment. Applicants are encouraged to confidentially self-identify when applying. Local applicants are encouraged to apply. We maintain a drug-free work environment. Applicants must be eligible to work in this country.

jobs.excerpt: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.
jobs.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Manager, Global Vigilance provides leadership and oversight for post-market surveillance activities supporting the safety, performance, quality, and regulatory compliance of the company’s medical devices. The role has primary responsibility for the Field Action Specialist group and global field action/FSCA execution, while also supporting broader PMS activities including vigilance and adverse event reporting, complaint analysis, trending, signal detection, regulatory reporting, and process improvement.

A Manager of Global Vigilance at Tandem also:


  • Manages assigned Global Post-Market Surveillance personnel, with primary responsibility for the Field Action Specialist group; establishes priorities, allocates work and resources, coaches and develops employees, and ensures appropriate training and coverage.
  • Provides oversight for assigned PMS processes, including field actions and, as assigned, vigilance reporting, complaint analysis, trending, signal detection, post-market data review, and related regulatory reporting.
  • Collaborates across Complaint Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical or Clinical Affairs, Product Safety, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Legal, and other functions to support consistent evaluation and communication of post-market information.
  • Develops, reviews, or presents PMS metrics, significant product issues, vigilance performance, field action status, and process performance to management and applicable governance bodies.
  • Provides oversight or subject-matter support for global vigilance and adverse event reporting and helps ensure potentially reportable events are evaluated, documented, escalated, and submitted in accordance with applicable requirements and procedures.
  • Supports preparation, review, or approval of vigilance reports, follow-up or supplemental reports, trend reports, and regulatory authority responses, as applicable to the role.
  • Reviews or oversees analysis of complaint, vigilance, service, field action, and other post-market data to identify potential trends, signals, or changes in known product issues and supports appropriate investigation and escalation.
  • Leads and oversees global field actions, including recalls, corrections and removals, Field Safety Corrective Actions, Field Safety Notices, product corrections, safety alerts, and other jurisdiction-specific market actions, as applicable.
  • Leads cross-functional field action teams from initiation through documented closure, applying structured project management to define scope, deliverables, owners, dependencies, timelines, risks, escalation pathways, and closure criteria.
  • Maintains awareness of applicable global PMS requirements and supports procedures, training, metrics, process improvement, audits, inspections, resource planning, and management reporting.
  • Supports the short-term planning for the department including headcount, budgeting, training, and systems requirements.
  • Participates in the selection, development, performance appraisal, merit recommendation, and promotion of staff.
  • Ensures department staff is properly trained, per designated training plan, before assuming job responsibilities.
  • Develops and manages schedules and performance requirements of staff.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.

WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, life sciences, nursing, pharmacy, regulatory affairs, quality assurance, business, project management, or a related discipline or combination of equivalent education and applicable work experience.
  • Eight years of progressively responsible experience in regulated life sciences, including five years in post-market surveillance or a closely related function such as complaint management, vigilance, field actions, product safety, regulatory affairs, quality assurance, or risk management.
  • Two years of formal people-management, supervisory, or equivalent team-leadership experience.
  • Experience with electronic quality management, complaint handling, regulatory reporting, or comparable PMS systems and proficiency with standard business applications.
  • Experience with connected, software-driven, drug-delivery, durable medical equipment, or other complex medical devices, preferred.
  • Broad working knowledge of medical device post-market surveillance, including field actions, complaint handling and analysis, vigilance and adverse event reporting, trending, signal detection, risk management, and quality system principles.
  • Direct experience with medical device field actions, recalls, corrections and removals, Field Safety Corrective Actions, international vigilance reporting, complaint trending, or signal detection, preferred.Demonstrated people-management skills, including prioritization, delegation, coaching, performance management, and employee development.·
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional projects and supporting regulatory inspections, audits, or regulatory authority interactions.
  • Demonstrated project management capability and ability to lead complex, cross-functional, time-sensitive activities from initiation through closure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate evolving information, identify trends or data gaps, and develop evidence-based recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including regulatory, technical, customer-facing, and executive-level communications.
  • Ability to influence and drive accountable execution across functions and regions without relying solely on direct reporting authority.Formal project management training or certification (e.g., PMP) and/or a quality or regulatory certification, preferred.Skilled at effectively communicating department or area issues and results within and across functional areas and conducting presentations of technical information concerning specific projects or timelines.
  • Skilled at effectively leading a cooperative team effort and organizing resources to achieve team goals.
  • Able to make and prioritize process and resource decisions based on overall team needs.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $110,000 - $130,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.


Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Content Marketing Manager – Industrial B2B

Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Content Marketing Manager who specializes in marketing to complex, engineering-driven industrial sectors and thrives at the intersection of technical depth and compelling storytelling. This individual will create content that earns the trust of executive audiences and translates complex technical concepts into narratives that drive awareness, pipeline, and product adoption.

Content

jobs.title: Wedding Flower Video Creator (Part-Time, Contract)
jobs.excerpt: Most creator gigs pay you the same whether your video gets 200 views or 2 million.
jobs.description:
Most creator gigs pay you the same whether your video gets 200 views or 2 million. This one pays you more when you win.

You get $25 an hour to make wedding flowers on camera. On top of that, every video earns you $2 for each 1,000 views past its first 10,000. No cap. A video that hits 250,000 views pays you an extra $480. One that hits a million pays an extra $1,980.

What you’d be filming

Every bouquet we ship started as a bag of plain wood shavings and a date that cannot move.

Sola Wood Flowers makes wedding flowers out of sola wood. Every petal is cut, shaped, dyed and assembled by hand. They look real, they never wilt, and brides can dye them any color they want. Brides all over the US use them to build their own bouquets, or have us build them.

Our Instagram and TikTok are a blank canvas... and you decide what goes on it.

Your week

  • Make 5-10 short videos a week for Instagram and TikTok, then Facebook, YouTube Shorts and Pinterest.
  • Be on camera doing the fun part: building bouquets, dyeing flowers, matching a bride’s colors, answering the questions brides actually ask.
  • Film at home, on your own schedule. We ship you the flowers, dye and tools.
  • Pitch your own hooks and formats. Spot a trend on Monday... ride it that week. No committee.
  • Write the caption, pick the audio, hand it off ready to post.
  • Check what worked and tell us why, with numbers.
  • About 20 hours a week, plus one call a week with our marketing team.

Why creators like this setup

  • Your upside isn’t capped. A breakout video pays you like a breakout video.
  • Your ideas actually ship. No approval maze, no five rounds of notes.
  • Supplies are free. Flowers, dye and tools show up at your door.
  • Flops are fine. We judge videos on views, watch time, saves and shares, and we expect some to miss. The only way to get in trouble here is not posting.

You’re a fit if

  • You already make short-form video, for yourself or for brands, and you can link it.
  • You’re relaxed talking to a camera.
  • You’re good with your hands. Bouquets, wreaths, home decor, any craft counts. Never worked with sola wood? Fine. We’ll teach you.
  • You shoot and edit start to finish on your own. A phone and a window are enough.
  • You live in the US and have a corner at home to film and store supplies.

What you’re probably wondering

Do I need a big following? No. We care what your videos do, not how many people follow you.

Do I need fancy gear? No. A phone, good light and an editing app.

Do I have to be on camera? Yes, every week. If that’s a dealbreaker, skip this one.

Can I just edit? No. You shoot it, you’re in it, you edit it.

Is this full-time? No. It’s a 1099 contract, about 20 hours a week, no benefits.

How hiring works

  • Apply with links to your videos. They matter more than your resume.
  • A 20-minute video call.
  • A paid test: we mail you a kit and you make two Reels. You get paid for the test whether we hire you or not.
Salary: $25 / hour

As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one.

This role is technical and service-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

User Support & Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible.

  • Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve.

  • Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day.

  • Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status.

  • Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root-cause findings, and user impact.

Monitoring, Escalation & Reporting

  • Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team.

  • Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity.

  • Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends.

  • Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements.

User Enablement & Release Support

  • Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates.

  • Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads.

  • Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback.

  • Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise-level web applications, including complex, workflow-driven or role-based systems.

  • Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting.

  • Experience consistently meeting defined service-level agreements for response and resolution times.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user-reported issues.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers.

  • Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations.

  • Experience writing user-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A+ certification.

  • Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks.

  • Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user-facing content.

How We Support Our Team:

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
