jobs.title: CRM Senior Business Systems Analyst
jobs.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Business Systems Analyst is the design authority for Salesforce-based solutions across Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations. This role bridges business intent and technical execution; translating business strategy, stakeholder needs, and product roadmaps into robust, scalable solution designs that the engineering team builds and delivers.

You will work upstream of delivery; partnering with Product Owners to shape roadmaps, evaluating platform capabilities, and producing solution designs that account for Salesforce core, ServiceMax, Conga CPQ, Conga CLM, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, and enterprise integrations. You will earn influence through the quality of your designs and the trust you build with stakeholders and engineering teams alike.

This role operates within an Agile Scrum delivery model. Product Owners in Commercial and Services define business priorities and roadmaps. Software Engineers, Test Automation Engineers (TAEs), and Technical Architects execute delivery. The Business Systems Analyst connects these activities ensuring what gets built is the right solution, designed for scale, and aligned to Illumina’s technology strategy.

Your designs increasingly serve a second audience: the AI agents the engineering team uses to build. In an AI-augmented, spec-driven delivery model, a precise, testable, well-decomposed solution design is the specification that grounds reliable AI implementation, so the clarity of your designs, acceptance criteria, and data contracts now creates even more leverage. You also design the AI solutions themselves (Agentforce, Data Cloud) for evaluability, safe failure, and responsible, compliant use.

Responsibilities

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Own end-to-end solution design for Salesforce initiatives; from discovery through design approval. Produce technical design documents, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decision records.
  • Evaluate and recommend solution approaches across the Salesforce ecosystem: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, ServiceMax, Conga CPQ, Conga CLM, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, and Experience Cloud.
  • Design cross-system solutions that account for integrations with middleware (SnapLogic), ERP (SAP), and other enterprise systems. Define data flows, API contracts, event-driven patterns, and error handling strategies.
  • Conduct fit-gap analysis for new requirements; assessing when to leverage declarative capabilities, custom development, AppExchange products, or third-party solutions.
  • Design solutions with security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability built in. Account for Salesforce governor limits, large data volumes, and multi-tenant architecture constraints.
  • Design Agentforce agent architectures; topic decomposition, action orchestration, guardrails, escalation flows, and Trust Layer configuration. Ensure AI solutions meet responsible AI standards.
  • Define data architecture for Data Cloud (Data 360) implementations; data model design, ingestion patterns, identity resolution strategy, and activation design.
  • Present solution options to stakeholders with clear tradeoff analysis; enabling confident, informed decisions.

Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Product Owners, business stakeholders, and engineering leadership. Translate business strategy into technology direction.
  • Partner with Product Owners to shape roadmaps; providing technical feasibility assessments, effort estimation guidance, and solution sequencing recommendations.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to create prototypes, proofs of concept, and visual solution illustrations as a means of validating requirements and building shared understanding.
  • Evaluate the Salesforce platform roadmap (new releases, features, deprecations) and proactively advise stakeholders on opportunities and risks.
  • Communicate solution designs to both technical and non-technical audiences; tailoring depth, format, and language to the audience.
  • Build and maintain a solution architecture repository; reference architectures, design patterns, and decision logs that serve as institutional knowledge.

Delivery Enablement

  • Work 1-2 sprints ahead of development; ensuring solution designs are ready, validated, and decomposed into implementable user stories before they enter the sprint backlog.
  • Define success and acceptance criteria for user stories in collaboration with Product Owners. Provide guidance on story readiness and technical completeness.
  • Support backlog grooming and refinement; clarifying technical approach, identifying dependencies, and helping the team estimate with confidence.
  • Participate in sprint planning to ensure the team understands the solution design and can raise questions or concerns early.
  • Review completed work against the solution design; validating that implementations align with architectural intent. Provide design-level feedback during code and configuration reviews.
  • Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers to ensure solution designs are testable and that acceptance criteria are clear enough to drive test strategy.
  • Support release planning by identifying solution-level risks, cross-feature dependencies, and integration validation requirements.

Designing for the AI-Augmented SDLC

  • Produce solution designs precise and testable enough to act as the specification an AI-augmented team, and its agents, build from: clear acceptance criteria, decomposed scope, explicit data contracts, and the context the team can ground AI in.
  • Design AI solutions (Agentforce agents, Data Cloud) for evaluability and safe failure: guardrails, escalation, human-in-the-loop, and responsible-AI, model, and data-residency tradeoffs.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate design exploration, option analysis, and documentation (ADRs, diagrams) while owning the decisions and their rationale.
  • Account for governance of AI tooling and AI-generated assets in your designs: data boundaries for external AI tools, IP/authorship, and shadow-AI prevention for regulated data.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Salesforce solution design, architecture, or senior technical delivery roles.
  • Demonstrated experience designing solutions across multiple Salesforce clouds and third-party add-ons (ServiceMax, Conga CPQ/CLM, or similar).
  • Experience designing cross-system integrations involving middleware (SnapLogic or similar), ERP (SAP), and enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum delivery models, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Proven ability to produce technical design artifacts;solution architecture diagrams, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decision records.
  • Experience with regulated environments (HIPAA, FDA, SOX) is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical

  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce platform;data model, security model, automation framework (Flows, Apex triggers), governor limits, and order of execution.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns; REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, named credentials, and middleware orchestration.
  • Working knowledge of Agentforce; agent design, topic/action architecture, Prompt Builder, Agent Script, Atlas Reasoning Engine, and the Einstein Trust Layer.
  • Working knowledge of Data Cloud (Data 360);data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activations.
  • Functional understanding of ServiceMax (field service), Conga CPQ (quoting/pricing), and Conga CLM (contract lifecycle management).
  • Ability to design solutions considering non-functional requirements; performance, scalability, security, compliance, and maintainability.
  • Proficiency with solution architecture tools; diagramming (Lucidchart), documentation (Confluence), and design collaboration.
  • Working knowledge of designing for the AI-augmented SDLC: designs and specifications as the source of truth for human and agent delivery, designing AI solutions for evaluability and responsible use, and governance of AI tooling for regulated data.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Foundation & Platform - Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Development & Specialization - Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud (Data 360) Consultant.

Leadership & Communication

  • Design authority presence; ability to make and defend design decisions with confidence, while remaining open to input and challenge.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences through visual diagrams, narratives, and demonstrations.
  • Strong facilitation skills; ability to lead design workshops, stakeholder alignment sessions, and tradeoff discussions to consensus.
  • Strategic thinking; ability to connect solution design decisions to business outcomes and long-term platform health.
  • Proactive and self-directed; works ahead of the team, anticipates design needs, and raises risks early.
  • Relationship builder; earns trust with both business stakeholders and engineering teams through consistent follow-through, transparency, and quality of work.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent related work experience.

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Inbound Marketer – Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Inbound Marketer to build scalable inbound marketing systems that generate qualified pipeline through content, SEO, and conversion optimization.

This is far more than a traditional SEO role.

You’ll create high-quality content, improve search visibility, develop lead magnets, optimize conversion paths, and distribute content across the right channels to drive awareness, demand, and measurable business growth.

You’ll work closely with leadership and marketing teams to build inbound engines that turn content into qualified leads—not just traffic.

If you understand how search, content, buyer psychology, and conversion work together, and enjoy creating marketing assets that generate real business results, this role is a strong fit.

  • Analyze:

What Success Looks Like

  • Higher organic search visibility and rankings.

  • High-performing, valuable content assets.

  • Strong understanding of:

Tech Stack

  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

  • SEMrush

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Write and optimize blogs, landing pages, and website content.

  • Review SEO and content performance data.
  • Optimize existing content based on rankings and analytics.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams on inbound campaigns.

In short: You’ll build inbound marketing systems that turn valuable content, search visibility, and conversion optimization into qualified pipeline and measurable business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Qualified inbound leads generated.
  • Improved keyword rankings and search visibility.
  • Landing page and lead magnet conversion rates.
  • Engagement and performance of inbound content.
  • Pipeline contribution from inbound marketing.
  • Consistent execution of high-quality inbound campaigns.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Opportunity to build scalable content and demand generation systems.
  • Work across:
    • SEO
    • Content Marketing
    • AI Search Optimization
    • Lead Generation
    • Conversion Optimization
  • Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior Inbound Marketer
    • Content Marketing Manager
    • SEO Manager
    • Demand Generation Manager
    • Growth Marketing Lead

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Inbound Marketing Assessment
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your experience with inbound marketing, SEO, content creation, lead generation, and conversion optimization. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight campaigns you’ve worked on, how you’ve improved organic growth, and how you’ve used AI tools to enhance content creation, research, and marketing workflows. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the practical assessment and client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about building inbound marketing systems, creating high-impact content, and turning search traffic into qualified pipeline, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive measurable business growth through modern inbound marketing.

JOB DESCRIPTION – STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL

Title: Country Sales Manager – Data Centers – China / 中国区销售经理 – 数据中心

Location: Remote or Home-based within China

Business Line: Sales / Data Centers / Fire Protection / Fire Detection / Fire Suppression

Reports To:General Manager, China / Regional Sales Director

External Clients: Data Centre Developers, EPC Contractors, Consultants, Design Institutes, General Contractors, MEP Contractors, Fire Protection Contractors, System Integrators and End Users

Job Purpose

The Country Sales Manager – Data Centers is responsible for developing and executing the company's growth strategy within the rapidly expanding Chinese data center market. The successful candidate will drive sales of the complete portfolio of fire protection solutions, including nitrogen (N) fire suppression systems, pre-action sprinkler systems, fire detection systems, releasing control panels, pressure switches, waterflow switches and other special hazard fire protection technologies.

This is a strategic business development role focused on identifying, influencing and securing major hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data center projects across China. The successful candidate will engage with consultants, design institutes, EPC contractors, developers, MEP consultants, fire protection contractors and end users throughout the entire project lifecycle—from concept design and specification through to installation and commissioning.

Working closely with regional leadership, technical support, engineering and marketing teams, the Country Sales Manager will build presence within the data center sector by developing strong customer relationships, increasing specification activity and securing long-term project opportunities.

The successful candidate will possess an excellent understanding of China's data center ecosystem, including the key market participants responsible for designing, constructing and operating mission-critical facilities.

A highly competitive remuneration package, including a performance-related bonus and comprehensive benefits, will be offered. Base salary will be commensurate with experience, technical expertise and industry network.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a national sales strategy for the Data Centre market across China.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities with hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data center operators.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with consultants, EPC contractors, design institutes, MEP consultants, fire engineers and general contractors involved in data center construction.
  • Promote the portfolio of fire protection products, including:
  • Nitrogen (N) fire suppression systems
  • Pre-action sprinkler systems
  • Dry pipe sprinkler systems
  • Fire detection systems
  • Releasing control systems
  • Pressure switches
  • Waterflow switches
  • Other special hazard fire protection solutions
  • Drive product specification with consulting engineers and project designers during the early stages of major projects.
  • Influence technical specifications to maximize inclusion of products within tender documents.
  • Develop strategic relationships with major developers, consultants and EPC organizations responsible for China's largest data center developments.
  • Manage major project opportunities from initial identification through quotation, negotiation, contract award and project completion.
  • Support distributors and channel partners involved in the data center market.
  • Deliver technical and commercial presentations to consultants, contractors and end users.
  • Work closely with technical and engineering teams to develop application-specific fire protection solutions.
  • Maintain accurate project pipelines, forecasts and customer activity using Salesforce CRM.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, emerging technologies and customer requirements within the mission-critical infrastructure sector.
  • Represent at industry conferences, exhibitions and technical seminars relating to data centers and mission-critical facilities.
  • Achieve agreed annual sales, profitability and strategic growth objectives.

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of the Chinese data center industry and its key stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated understanding of data center design, construction and mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Established network among:
  • Data center developers
  • EPC contractors
  • General contractors
  • MEP contractors
  • Consulting engineers
  • Fire engineering consultants
  • Design institutes
  • Data center operators

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects, working closely with borrowers, brokers, title companies, attorneys and capital partners to fund deals quickly and reliably.

As its loan volume grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep closings accurate, controlled and on schedule.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Closing & Funding Specialist to own the closing process, from opening title and obtaining insurance through funding and post-closing handoff.

You will coordinate title companies, attorneys, borrowers and internal teams, review loan documents and settlement statements, and manage funding packages with capital partners under strict wire verification controls.

This role requires direct hard money closing experience, a clear understanding of urgent funding timelines and exceptionally responsive service.

What You'll Do

Title, Escrow & Insurance

  • Open and manage title and escrow.
  • Review title, liens, vesting and insurance.
  • Coordinate attorneys, title companies, borrowers and internal teams to resolve closing issues.

Loan Documents & Settlement Review

  • Coordinate loan document preparation.
  • Review loan documents and HUD/settlement statements against approved terms, fees, payoffs, reserves and disbursements.
  • Obtain required approvals before closing.

Closing Conditions

  • Collect and clear all remaining closing and funding documents.
  • Work with the processor and originator on underwriting conditions and escalate material exceptions.

Funding

  • Submit funding packages to warehouse lenders and capital partners and resolve their conditions.
  • Obtain clear-to-fund approval and coordinate final funding under company authorization and wire verification controls.

Post-Closing

  • Confirm funding and organize the final loan file in the company's loan portal.
  • Flag trailing documents or post-closing deficiencies to the processor and originator for correction.
  • Track the handoff of each loan to servicing.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Direct hard money closing and funding experience.
  • Solid knowledge of title, escrow, insurance, loan documents and HUD/settlement statements.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Loans close and fund on schedule.
  • Settlement statements and loan documents match approved terms.
  • Funding packages are cleared by capital partners with minimal back and forth.
  • Wire verification and funding controls are followed every time.
  • Final files are complete, and trailing items are flagged and resolved quickly.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,500 to $2,200 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own every closing from title through funding.
  • Professional Growth: Approval authority grows as you prove your competence.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct hard money closing experience is required.
  • Approval authority for documents, settlement statements and clear-to-fund is expanded only after you demonstrate competence and receive delegation.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Job Description

The Sr CRA must have a minimum 3-5 years' experience as a monitor and can work independently and monitor all stages of a study, in different phases, and should have special therapeutic expertise (oncology). The Sr CRA can take on-board LST tasks and support the LST in coordination or document preparation as and when required but their main task is still independent and advanced monitoring. Ability to travel internationally as required. Valid driving license.

Short role description

The Clinical Research Associate (SrCRA) has local responsibility for the delivery of the studies at allocated sites and is an active participant in the local study team(s). The SrCRA works in close collaboration with other CRAs and the Local Study Team/ Local Study Associate Director (LSAD) to ensure that study commitments are achieved in a timely and efficient manner. The SrCRA acts as the main contact with the study site and has the responsibility for monitoring the study conduct to ensure proper delivery of the study.

The SrCRA is responsible for the preparation, initiation, monitoring and closure of assigned sites in clinical studies, in compliance with AZ Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP, and relevant local regulations and that the sites deliver according to their respective commitment in the individual studies.

A SrCRA with longer tenure and experience may take on additional responsibilities that include additional tasks associated with LSAD.

CRAs might have different internal titles based on the experience level (CRA, Senior CRA). The experience level depends on the years of experience, performance record, level of independence in the role, ability to take on additional tasks or tutor more junior colleagues. The Director, Country Head may assign this internal title after confirmation with Senior Director, Cluster Head or Executive Director, Regional Head.

Typical Accountabilities

  • Contributes to the selection of potential investigators.
  • In some countries, as required, SrCRAs are accountable for study start-up and regulatory maintenance. Tasks may include Site Qualification Visits, collection, preparation, review and tracking of documents for the application process; submission of proper application/documents to EC/IRB and to Regulatory Authorities for start-up and for the duration of the study.
  • Trains, supports and advises Investigators and site staff in study related matters, including Risk Based Quality Management (RbQM) principles.
  • Confirms that site staff have completed and documented the required trainings appropriately, including ICH-GCP training, prior to and for the duration of the study. Ensures the sites are inspection ready at all times.
  • Actively participates in Local Study Team (LST) meetings.
  • Contributes to National Investigators meetings, as applicable.
  • Initiates, monitors and closes study sites in compliance with AZ Procedural Documents. Shares information on patient recruitment and study site progress (site quality/performance) within the LST.
  • Drives performance at the sites. Proactively identifies and ensures timely resolution to study-related issues and escalates them as appropriate.
  • Updates CTMS and other systems with data from study sites as per required timelines.
  • Manages study supplies (ISF, etc), drug supplies and drug accountability at study site. Prepares study drug for destruction, if applicable.
  • Performs monitoring visits (remote and onsite), as well as remote data checks, in accordance with the timelines specified in the study specific Monitoring Plan. If required, determines and discusses with LSAD the correct timing and type of visits.
  • Performs Source Data Review (SDR), Case Report Form (CRF) review and Source Data Verification (SDV), in accordance with the Monitoring Plan.
  • Performs regular Site Quality Risk Assessments and adapts monitoring intensity accordingly during the study.
  • Ensures data query resolution in a timely manner.
  • Works with data management to ensure robust quality of the collected study data.
  • Ensures accurate and timely reporting of Serious Adverse Events and their follow ups.
  • Prepares and finalises monitoring visit reports in CTMS and provides timely feed-back to the Principal Investigator, including follow-up letter, within required timelines and in line with AZ SOP.
  • Follows up on outstanding actions with study sites to ensure resolution in a timely manner.
  • Follows quality issue processes by escalating systematic or serious quality issues, data privacy breaches, CSP or ICH-GCP compliance issues to Local Management and/or COM as required.
  • Assists site in maintaining inspection ready ISF.
  • Prepares for and collaborates with the activities associated with audits and regulatory inspections in liaison with LSAD and CQAD.
  • Ensures timely collection/uploading of essential documents into the eTMF in accordance with ICH-GCP, AZ SOPs and local requirements. Supports/participates in regular QC checks performed by LSAD or delegate.
  • Ensures that all study documents under their responsibility (i.e., site documents, relevant communications, etc) are available and ready for final archiving and completion of local part of the eTMF.
  • Provides feedback on any research related information including sites/investigators/competing studies that might be useful for the local market.
  • Ensures compliance with AstraZeneca’s Code of Ethics, company policies and procedures relating to people, finance, technology, security and SHE (Safety, Health and Environment).
  • Ensures compliance with local, national and regional legislation, as applicable.
  • Collaborates with local MSLs as directed by LSAD or line manager.

jobs.title: Director of Safety
jobs.excerpt: Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults.
jobs.description:
Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor’s growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world’s leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

About the Role

We're hiring a Director of Safety to build and scale safety strategy for our distributed in-home care workforce. In this role, you will own reducing injury rates and severity, reducing workers' compensation spend, and driving a safe environment for clients and Care Professionals (CPs). You'll mine large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to surface the risk indicators that actually predict incidents and injuries, then design systemic solutions—built on technology, not just process—that hold up as we grow into new markets and service lines. You'll own the full workers' compensation lifecycle, building durable programs that manage costs more effectively. You will also partner with Product and Engineering to build tools and automation that make safety a scalable advantage rather than a manual, reactive function.

The right candidate has built and scaled safety, trust & safety, or risk programs inside a technology-enabled, high-growth, distributed workforce, using data and product thinking to solve problems at scale. You're equally comfortable diving into the details of a single incident investigation and stepping back to design company-wide systems. You think outside the box rather than defaulting to "industry best practice"—you can identify the handful of activities that actually move injury and cost outcomes, build the case for whichever investment they require, and influence outcomes across distributed teams who don't report to you. You can also translate messy, imperfect data into a clear, credible story for leadership.

This role is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S. You'll manage your team remotely, so strong written communication and remote coaching skills are essential.

As a Director of Safety at Honor, you will:

Safety Program Leadership

  • Own the safety operating model and architecture, balancing quick fixes with the larger structural changes the business needs as it scales.
  • Build systemic solutions that address common in-home care hazards: environmental safety, mobility issues, infection control, client behavior, and more.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to build tools, automation, and product features that reduce risk, and make the case for the investment they require.
  • Develop programs to build a culture of safety among Care Professionals and HQ employees.

Workers' Compensation & Incident Management

  • Own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend, with end-to-end accountability for strategy and case management.
  • Use data to find the levers that reduce claim cost and cycle time, and build durable programs and tooling that manage costs more effectively when injuries do occur, keeping claims on track at scale.
  • Own vendor management and evaluate alternative models.
  • Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis, and turn findings into corrective action plans that prevent recurrence.
  • Maintain accurate incident records and reporting for leadership.
  • Forecast reserves, build forward-looking budgets, and communicate financial impact to leadership. • Ensure compliance with OSHA and state-specific home care regulations.

Data & Culture

  • Own the metrics that make safety and claims performance visible and enable early intervention.
  • Communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership, presenting findings and recommendations—including business cases for new investment—in terms executives can act on.
  • Influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams—franchise operators, field leaders, Product, and Engineering—who don't report to you directly.

Leadership Principles We'll Assess in This Role

  • Balance Incremental and Radical Change: You know when to close the gap with a quick fix and when the data says to rethink the safety or claims model entirely. You push for durable, technology-enabled programs and you're willing to think outside the box and embrace unconventional approaches when a conventional fix won't hold.
  • Think Systemically: You consider how a safety intervention ripples across markets, franchise operators, Care Pros, and clients before you act, and you build systemic solutions that leverage technology rather than one-off fixes. You identify the handful of activities that actually move injury rates and workers' compensation spend, rather than defaulting to "industry best practice."
  • Fly High & Dive Deep: You work with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to find the risk indicators hiding in the noise, and you know when to dive into the details of a single claim or incident versus stepping back to run the function at scale. You audit when the data and what you're hearing from the field don't match.
  • Drive Impact: You own the outcome of reducing workers' compensation spend and building a safer environment for clients and Care Professionals—measured by injury rate and severity reduction, not activity. You communicate complex and imperfect data clearly to leadership and influence outcomes across distributed, cross-functional teams who don't report to you.

We're Looking for You to Bring

  • 8+ years in safety, risk, trust & safety, or operations leadership, with a track record of scaling programs inside a fast-growing, technology-enabled, distributed workforce (delivery, rideshare, e-commerce fulfillment, on-demand services, logistics).
  • Strong data skills (SQL, analytics, dashboarding) and a track record of working with large, ambiguous, and imperfect datasets to identify risk indicators, find root causes, and prioritize investment.
  • Experience using technology and automation—not just process and headcount—to scale safety or operational outcomes.
  • Experience owning workers' compensation end-to-end: claims, return-to-work plans, and provider relationships (or comparable risk/insurance claims experience).
  • A track record of building the business case for investment, communicating complex and imperfect data clearly, and winning buy-in from senior leadership.
  • Experience building and managing a remote team, including hiring, developing, and retaining talent as a function scales.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence outcomes across distributed teams—from frontline staff to executives.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA and related regulatory frameworks, or the ability to ramp quickly from an adjacent regulated environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience at a technology-enabled, high-growth company (DoorDash, Amazon, Chewy, Instacart, Uber, Lyft, or similar) in safety, trust & safety, risk, or operations.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to ship tools or product features that reduce risk at scale.
  • Familiarity with modern safety/case management software, data platforms, and BI tools.
  • Experience scaling a team through a period of significant growth, including building a leadership pipeline.

Our range reflects the hiring range for this position. We use national average to determine pay as we are a remote first company. Individual pay is based on a number of factors including qualifications, skills, experience, education, and training.

Base pay is just a part of our total rewards program. Honor offers equity and 401K with up to a 4% match. We provide medical, dental and vision coverage including zero cost plans for employees. Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance are fully employer paid with a voluntary additional Life Insurance option. We offer a generous time off program, mental health benefits, wellness program, and discount program.

Hiring Salary Range
$172,800—$192,000 USD

At Honor, we put people first. Our leadership culture is guided by Leadership Principles that prioritize integrity, compassion, and excellence. We offer a unique opportunity to lead with purpose and make a meaningful impact no matter your role.

Honor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or belief.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior IT Technical Training Lead to direct technical workforce assessment, training planning, curriculum alignment, and proficiency improvement for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior IT Technical Training Lead to direct technical workforce assessment, training planning, curriculum alignment, and proficiency improvement for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role leads development and maintenance of the Skills & Proficiency Matrix, role-based learning paths, training schedules, and measurable workforce-development objectives.

The IT Technical Training Lead will align training with enterprise modernization, system releases, migrations, operational priorities, and future-state technology requirements. The successful candidate will coordinate closely with Government stakeholders, technical leaders, subject matter experts, external training providers, and program leadership to ensure that USMEPCOM IT personnel are prepared to operate and support enterprise systems alongside contractor personnel.

Training may be delivered virtually, in classrooms, side by side, through pair programming, or through other practical formats appropriate to the technical subject and learner population.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The IT Technical Training Lead will:

  • Lead technical workforce assessments to identify current capabilities, proficiency levels, role requirements, and emerging skill gaps.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive Skills & Proficiency Matrix for Government IT roles and technical domains.
  • Establish role-based competency models, proficiency definitions, learning objectives, and measurable qualification criteria.
  • Design and maintain learning paths aligned with workforce roles, technologies, mission priorities, and modernization roadmaps.
  • Develop integrated training schedules that account for system releases, upgrades, migrations, operational requirements, and workforce availability.
  • Translate enterprise IT changes into practical learning objectives, training plans, exercises, and measurable proficiency outcomes.
  • Coordinate training priorities, schedules, delivery methods, facilities, access, and participation with Government stakeholders.
  • Align technical training with current and future USMEPCOM enterprise systems, platforms, tools, services, and operational responsibilities.
  • Develop, tailor, review, and update technical course content for program-specific requirements.
  • Deliver selected technical courses, workshops, demonstrations, labs, coaching sessions, and knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Coordinate subject matter expert coaching, mentoring, side-by-side instruction, pair programming, and hands-on technical learning.
  • Identify and coordinate appropriate industry training, certification preparation, vendor courses, and external instructors.
  • Coordinate Fast Lane activation, enrollment, access, scheduling, utilization, and completion tracking.
  • Evaluate available training providers and recommend solutions based on technical relevance, quality, cost, schedule, and mission value.
  • Ensure that training opportunities support current and future operations across the USMEPCOM enterprise portfolio.
  • Confirm that training content and delivery approaches comply with applicable Department of Defense standards and program requirements.
  • Develop course outlines, instructor guides, learner materials, exercises, labs, assessments, job aids, reference materials, and evaluation instruments.
  • Coordinate virtual, classroom, side-by-side, pair-programming, and blended-learning delivery.
  • Establish methods for measuring participation, completion, knowledge acquisition, skill application, proficiency improvement, and operational impact.
  • Analyze assessment results, learner feedback, completion data, and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain training records, schedules, attendance, completion status, certification information, proficiency results, and supporting evidence.
  • Develop training dashboards, status reports, gap analyses, and executive briefings for program leadership and Government stakeholders.
  • Provide training information for Monthly Status Reports, Program Management Reviews, transition planning, and workforce-readiness discussions.
  • Coordinate training activities with technical teams responsible for infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, software, data, ITSM, and enterprise services.
  • Support transition-in and transition-out activities through structured knowledge transfer and workforce-readiness planning.
  • Maintain a technical training catalog, annual training plan, prioritized backlog, and training-demand forecast.
  • Capture lessons learned and continually improve curricula, delivery methods, assessments, and learning paths.
  • Protect sensitive Government, program, personnel, training, and technical information.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Instructional Design, Adult Education, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Current ITIL certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current Microsoft Certified Trainer certification.
  • Experience leading enterprise technical training, workforce development, instructional design, or technical enablement programs.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government IT programs.

jobs.description:
Senior Sales Enablement Manager

Job Overview

The Senior Sales Enablement Manager will play a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering scalable enablement programs that strengthen seller capability and support Convera's global go-to-market priorities. Working across Convera's full seller curriculum, this role will design and deliver enablement that builds capability across sales processes, skills, tools, product and solution knowledge, and other priority areas. The role will help sellers confidently apply what they learn through practical, engaging, seller-friendly content and learning experiences.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on enablement professional who can translate complex business and seller needs, including process, customer, market, product, solution, and tool-related inputs, into high-quality enablement, facilitate live sessions with confidence, and flex across priority initiatives as team and business needs evolve. This role is for someone comfortable moving from strategy to execution: shaping the plan, building the materials, facilitating sessions, and improving the experience based on field feedback.

Responsibilities

  • Shape and lead scalable sales enablement programs across the full seller curriculum, including sales processes, skills, tools, product and solution knowledge, and priority role-specific needs.
  • Assess business priorities, seller needs, existing programs, content, and workflows; identify gaps; and develop practical plans that balance immediate requirements with scalable, long-term solutions.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts and cross-functional teams to translate complex business, process, customer, market, product, and competitive information into clear, practical, and engaging seller-ready learning and resources.
  • Design and deliver learning experiences for global audiences through live and virtual facilitation, self-paced content, seller practice, and in-the-flow-of-work support, adapting delivery for specific roles, teams, regions, and business priorities.
  • Design and strengthen the architecture for onboarding, ramp, certification, continuous learning, and role-specific enablement by defining learning outcomes, applied practice, readiness milestones, and reinforcement approaches.
  • Advise and partner with sales leaders and managers to define what sellers must know, say, show, and do; build alignment around priorities; and enable managers to reinforce application through coaching and inspection.
  • Drive execution governance across multiple workstreams, including program goals, scope, stakeholder alignment, project plans, dependencies, risks, communications, delivery, and follow-through.
  • Use Highspot, Gong, AI tools, and other enablement technologies to scale access, practice, reinforcement, insight, and adoption.
  • Define success measures and evaluate program impact across engagement, proficiency, adoption, behavior change, seller confidence, manager reinforcement, and business outcomes; communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years (approx.) of related experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales training, product marketing, or an equivalent field, ideally supporting complex B2B sales organizations.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex enablement programs end to end, from discovery and strategy through design, development, deployment, measurement, insight generation, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience developing seller capability across multiple enablement areas and supporting effective application in the field.
  • Strong instructional design and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into practical, engaging learning and resources for sellers.
  • Hands-on experience with sales enablement, conversation intelligence, learning, or content management platforms is required; experience with Gong and Highspot is strongly preferred.
  • Practical fluency with generative AI and the judgment to use it efficiently, responsibly, and with appropriate human review.
  • Excellent facilitation, consulting, project leadership, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functional partners, and challenge constructively.
  • Experience supporting global or geographically distributed sales organizations and balancing global consistency with relevant local application.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is helpful, but not required:

  • Previous experience in an SDR, BDR, Account Executive, Sales Manager, or other customer-facing sales role.
  • Experience in payments, fintech, financial services, foreign exchange, or another complex B2B environment.
  • Experience designing manager-led coaching, reinforcement, competency, and certification approaches.

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories.

 

Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. 

 

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.  

Pay Transparency Statement

Convera is committed to pay transparency and equity in accordance with applicable U.S. state and local laws. For this position, the expected base salary range is $95,000 - $136,000 per year, depending on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, which may include:

  • Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Paid time off, holidays, and parental leave
  • Wellness programs and mental health resources

Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process and may vary based on individual circumstances and business needs.

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you’re ready to unleash your potential.

Sales Leadership

ROLE SUMMARY

The Sales Team Leader leads and develops an assigned sales team and is accountable for team performance, sales execution, client growth, pipeline management, and accurate forecasting. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a proactive approach, and a strong desire to succeed in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and hold assigned sales representatives accountable for individual and team sales goals.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, performance standards, and ways of working.
  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, team meetings, pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and coaching sessions.
  • Provide timely feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps through documented coaching and corrective action when needed.
  • Create development plans and identify training, mentoring, and growth opportunities for team members.
  • Monitor workload, account coverage, and team capacity, and recommend resource or structural changes as appropriate.
  • Support recruitment, selection, onboarding, and training of new team members.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, sales practices, approval requirements, and professional standards.
  • Communicate business and process changes clearly and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

Sales Strategy and Performance

  • Partner with the EVP, Global Sales to execute sales strategies across assigned markets, products, and client segments.
  • Translate commercial priorities into team objectives, account plans, activity expectations, and measurable actions.
  • Own team pipeline quality, forecasting accuracy, opportunity stages, close dates, and next steps.
  • Analyze sales results, conversion trends, client feedback, and activity data to identify risks, opportunities, and coaching needs.
  • Provide clear performance updates and recommendations to sales leadership and help remove barriers to revenue growth.
  • Improve sales processes, reporting, tools, and operating rhythms to increase team effectiveness.
  • Support team members with complex opportunities, client strategy, negotiations, and escalations as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Marketing, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Product, and other teams to support lead generation, solution development, contracting, and client handoffs.
  • Coordinate with sales leadership to clarify ownership, avoid duplication, and support cross-sell and enterprise opportunities.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven sales leadership experience with a strong understanding of complex sales cycles and client relationships.
  • Minimum of five years of people-management or formal sales-leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in coaching, performance management, pipeline management, forecasting, and sales execution.
  • Strong leadership, communication, presentation, commercial judgment, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM, sales reporting, and analytics tools.
  • Ability to lead and develop a sales team in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Measures of Success

  • Team achievement against revenue, pipeline, activity, retention, and growth goals.
  • Forecast accuracy, pipeline quality, CRM discipline, and consistent sales execution.
  • Improvement in team capability, accountability, and performance.
  • Strong client outcomes and effective cross-functional partnerships.

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

We’re hiring a Senior Media Buyer to lead Meta buying for RYZE. Meta is our largest acquisition channel and one of the larger DTC accounts on the platform — we are adding a dedicated testing budget on top of an account that is already scaling quickly. We need a senior operator who has run spend at this level before and can come in ready to own it.


This is a cross-functional role. The biggest levers in our account sit outside the ad manager: the creative we test and the landing pages we send traffic to. You’ll work every day with our in-house Performance Creative and CRO teams to decide what gets tested, read the results, and scale what works.


Responsibilities will include:


Meta Account Strategy & Daily Management

  • Own campaign structure, budgets, bidding, and pacing across a high-spend account, including scaling structures and pre-launch ramp-up ahead of key moments.
  • Grow spend on top of the existing baseline while holding first-time CAC and new-customer guardrails. Know when to push, when to hold, and how to tell the difference between noise and a real trend.

Testing at Scale

  • Run a high-velocity testing program for creative and landing pages with a dedicated testing budget.
  • Design clean tests, call them on clear rules, and move winners into scale.
  • Partner with CRO on landing pages, listicles, advertorials, quiz funnels, and new page formats — including pages built for specific audiences, age groups, and stages of awareness.

Creative Direction from the Buying Seat

  • Turn account data into clear briefs and feedback for the Performance Creative team: which angles, hooks, and formats to make more of, which to retire, and why.
  • Own the feedback loop between buying performance and creative output — not just passing data, but driving decisions.

Measurement & Attribution

  • Run the account on our attribution stack (Northbeam), reconcile it with platform reporting, and use incrementality testing to confirm that growth is real.
  • Build repeatable buying processes and apply automation and the Meta API to reporting, rules, and launch workflows.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Set the standard for the account — how it’s structured, how tests are run, and how decisions are made.
  • Mentor and develop the buyers who work in the account.
  • Help shape how RYZE staffs paid media as we expand to more channels.

Professional Qualifications

  • 10+ years in paid social, with most of that time spent hands-on in Meta.
  • Experience managing $100K+ per day (or $36.5M+ per year) in Meta spend for a DTC or subscription brand.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta campaign structure, bidding, budget scaling, and creative testing at volume.
  • Fluency with third-party attribution tools such as Northbeam, and experience designing and reading incrementality tests.
  • A track record of working closely with creative and CRO teams, with a clear understanding of how landing pages and funnels drive account performance.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or setting direction for other media buyers.
  • Strong judgment with data, and the ability to explain decisions plainly to leadership and partner teams.

Core Competencies

  • Meta account mastery — Owns campaign structure, bidding, scaling logic, and pacing at high spend. Knows the platform deeply enough to know when it’s working and when it’s lying.
  • Scaling judgment — Understands when to push spend and when to hold. Distinguishes signal from noise without over-indexing on either.
  • Testing architecture — Designs clean, callable tests with clear rules. Moves winners to scale without letting good tests die from indecision.
  • Creative partnership — Translates account data into clear creative briefs. Drives the feedback loop between buying performance and creative output.
  • Attribution & measurement — Runs multi-touch and incrementality frameworks. Reconciles platform reporting with third-party tools to confirm growth is real.
  • CRO fluency — Understands how landing pages, funnels, and page formats affect account performance. Briefs CRO with the same precision as creative.
  • Process & automation — Builds repeatable systems. Applies Meta API and automation to reduce manual work and increase consistency.
  • Senior leadership — Sets the standard others operate to. Develops buyers, shapes team structure, and communicates decisions clearly to leadership.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

  • Competitive hourly or monthly contract compensation 💰
  • Fully remote, flexible work environment 🌍
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact performance creative for a fast-growing brand 🚀
  • Access to RYZE creative assets, tools, templates, and performance insights 🎨

Netomi is the leading agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience. Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!

About the Role:

The Principal Account Manager, Strategic Accounts is a senior, quota-carrying individual contributor responsible for renewals and expansion within Netomi’s existing Strategic and Enterprise (Fortune 100) accounts. This role requires persistence and commercial judgment—someone who can navigate large, siloed organizations, secure buy-in across multiple executives and departments, and lead renewal and expansion sales cycles. You will own the post-sale commercial cycle from qualification through pricing, negotiation, contracting, and signature, partnering with the CSM who owns ongoing account strategy and customer success. This is an opportunity to help shape the future of Enterprise GenAI.

You'll be working with cutting-edge technology, a collaborative team, and real-world challenges that matter.

Core Strategic Pillars:

  • Commercial Ownership: Full commercial accountability for retention, renewals, and expansion for top-tier enterprise accounts, including a quota for renewals and expansion across assigned existing accounts.

Responsibilities:

  • Commercial Account Planning: Drive deep account penetration by developing, championing, and executing a multi-year commercial growth plan for renewals and expansion, aligned with the CSM-owned account strategy and customer success roadmap.

  • Commercial Acumen / Renewals: Ownership over the financial health, expansion, and long-term commercial structure of the account, including renewal and expansion forecasting provided to Operations.

  • Commercial Deal Leadership: The hands-on responsibility for structuring, driving, and governing complex renewal and expansion pursuits.

  • Executive Alignment: Translate complex AI capabilities and performance data into clear, compelling narratives to support investment decisions, commercial proposals, renewals, and expansion negotiations, using CS-validated value evidence.

  • Expansion & Growth: Qualify and convert identified growth opportunities into signed expansion agreements, including new use cases, departments, and lines of business.

  • Voice of the Customer: Advocate for the customer's commercial requirements and investment priorities, partnering with the CSM, who owns the broader customer success strategy and voice-of-customer feedback.

  • Executive Advocacy & Communication: Serve as the executive-facing commercial leader for the account. Contribute commercial sections to CSM-owned Quarterly and Executive Business Reviews, if/when it makes sense.

  • Strategic Commercial Leadership: Own and craft the commercial account growth plan and pursuit strategy, including purchasing milestones, investment decisions, and commercial success criteria. Engage the CSM and accountable delivery teams on dependencies affecting the sale.

  • Commercial Strategy & Renewals: Take full accountability for the account's commercial health, qualifying and closing expansion opportunities (upselling/cross-selling), structuring agreements, and leading the entire renewal process. Execute the 12-month renewal process, and keep CS informed.

  • Internal and External Executive: Serve as the escalation point for commercial roadblocks. Utilize superior negotiation, persistence, and problem-solving skills to overcome purchasing, contractual, or budget-based obstacles. Partner with the CSM on customer success risks and with Delivery on execution dependencies.

  • Translating Strategy into Action: Translate complex AI capabilities and performance data into clear, concise, business-value-focused insights to support investment decisions, commercial proposals, renewals, and expansion negotiations, using CS-validated value evidence.

  • Risk & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify budget, competitive, purchasing, and contractual risks within the customer's organization. Utilize superior negotiation, persistence, and problem-solving skills to protect retention and growth, escalating commercial decisions to Deal Desk and leadership as needed.

  • Contract Development & Execution: Prepare commercial proposals and draft order forms using approved templates when available; coordinate Legal review, Deal Desk/Finance approvals, pricing, negotiation, procurement, and signature. Complete the commercial handoff of contracted scope, objectives, and commitments.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of demonstrated experience in a highly strategic, client-facing, Individual Contributor role (e.g., Principal/Senior Solutions Consultant, Strategic Account Director, Enterprise Program Manager, Strategic Advisor, Strategic Account Manager) in enterprise B2B SaaS or consulting, with demonstrated responsibility for enterprise renewals, expansion sales, and commercial negotiations.

  • Proven track record of managing and influencing complex enterprise commercial pursuits without direct authority over cross-functional teams, partnering with dedicated CSMs and technical leads.

  • Expert-level ability to conceptualize, structure, and deliver executive-grade presentations (decks) that lead with the recommendation, are data-driven, and clearly articulate business impact and risk mitigation.

  • Proven success in driving commercial outcomes including leading large enterprise contract renewals, upsells, and defining long-term client financial roadmaps.

  • Proven track record of navigating Fortune 500-level organizations (e.g., Financial Services, Airlines, etc.) to achieve results, specifically managing highly fragmented, siloed environments with multiple executive sponsors and competing priorities.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to discuss integrations, solution capabilities, and their business implications.

  • Ability to travel up to 10-20% to client sites for commercial workshops, executive engagement, and negotiations.

jobs.description:
Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour, based on relevant experience and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your years of experience navigating government regulations, evaluating complex cases, or interpreting public-sector policies could help make artificial intelligence more accurate, reliable, and effective?

At Volga Partners, we're bringing experienced government professionals into the next generation of AI development.

We're seeking Government Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who can apply their professional knowledge, analytical judgment, and industry experience to evaluate and improve advanced AI models.

This isn't a traditional government position, and you won't be processing applications or managing government caseloads. Instead, you'll use your expertise to assess how well AI systems interpret information, apply regulations, reason through complex scenarios, and produce accurate, defensible conclusions.

Your expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.

The Opportunity

As a Government SME, you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized government functions.

You'll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established regulations, policies, and professional standards.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex public-sector challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. Government Policy, Public Records & Regulatory Compliance

  • Interpreting federal, state, or local government regulations and policies
  • Freedom of Information Act (FOIA), public records, and disclosure requirements
  • Privacy compliance, sensitive information protection, and regulatory auditing
  • Evaluating complex compliance scenarios and identifying regulatory risks

2. Government Programs, Eligibility & Administrative Decision-Making

  • Interpreting government program requirements and eligibility regulations
  • Evaluating complex cases, supporting documentation, and administrative determinations
  • Identifying inconsistencies, compliance issues, or unsupported decisions
  • Applying professional judgment to regulatory and program-specific scenarios

3. Government Procurement, Contracts & Vendor Evaluation

  • Federal, state, or local government procurement processes
  • Request for Proposal (RFP) analysis and evaluation
  • Contracting standards, vendor selection, and procurement compliance
  • Developing or applying evaluation criteria, scoring methodologies, and defensible recommendations

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses: Review complex government-related scenarios for accuracy, completeness, reasoning, and regulatory alignment.
  • Apply expert judgment: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are appropriate, defensible, and supported by relevant policies or regulations.
  • Identify errors and gaps: Recognize inaccurate interpretations, flawed assumptions, missing information, and potential compliance concerns.
  • Validate against authoritative sources: Use applicable statutes, regulations, agency guidance, and professional standards to verify findings.
  • Develop evaluation benchmarks: Help establish high-quality reference responses, assessment criteria, and examples of sound professional reasoning.
  • Provide actionable feedback: Clearly explain your evaluations and recommend improvements to AI-generated content.
  • Collaborate on quality: Apply project-specific evaluation guidelines and participate in quality reviews to support consistency and accuracy.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Put your professional expertise to work in a new way.

Rather than performing traditional government administrative functions, you'll apply the knowledge you've developed throughout your career to emerging AI technology.

Contribute to meaningful AI development.

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI reasoning and improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated information.

Work remotely with project-based flexibility.

Participate in specialized assignments from anywhere in the United States, with opportunities for future engagements based on project availability and performance.

No AI background required.

We value professionals who understand their field and can recognize when an AI-generated answer is right, wrong, incomplete, or misleading.

Project Details

  • Engagement: Independent contractor, project-based
  • Location: Remote, United States only
  • Compensation: $35–$40 USD/hour
  • Schedule: Variable, based on project assignments and deadlines; weekday or weekend availability may be needed
  • Duration: Initial short-term pilot, with potential future project opportunities
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates must successfully complete a skills-based assessment evaluating domain expertise, analytical reasoning, and ability to follow project guidelines

Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed. Compensation is subject to completion of assigned work in accordance with project instructions and quality standards.

Ready to Apply Your Expertise to the Future of AI?

If you've built your career understanding government systems, interpreting regulations, evaluating complex information, or making informed professional assessments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise. Help us build better AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming Government SME opportunities with Volga Partners.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced professionals who bring more than familiarity with government processes. You should be comfortable analyzing complex information, exercising independent judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in government operations, public administration, regulatory compliance, government procurement, or a closely related field
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in at least one of the government specializations outlined above
  • Experience interpreting, evaluating, auditing, or applying government policies, regulations, or professional standards
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to identify inaccuracies, inconsistencies, and unsupported conclusions
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly and concisely
  • Ability to conduct independent research and validate information using authoritative sources
  • Comfort using digital platforms, online research tools, and structured evaluation guidelines
  • Current U.S. residency and ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment

Especially Valuable Experience

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Government Policy or Program Analyst
  • Senior Regulatory or Compliance Analyst
  • Government Auditor or Quality Assurance Specialist
  • Public Records or Privacy Compliance Officer
  • Government Procurement or Contracting Specialist
  • RFP Evaluation or Source Selection Specialist
  • Government Program Manager or Senior Eligibility Analyst
  • Public Sector Consultant or Regulatory Advisor

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead.
jobs.description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

The Opportunity:

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. AI: Architect and develop a multi-agent AI framework where autonomous agents coordinate to solve domain-specific technical queries.
  2. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  3. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  4. Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  5. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You Will Do:

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack:

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: React, Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.
