jobs.description:
The Cyber Security Engineer will provide security engineering, compliance, and risk management support for cloud-based systems aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and DoD IL4–6 requirements. The role will advise partners and customers navigating government security requirements while supporting authorization, audit readiness, and continuous monitoring activities. A key focus will be improving compliance efficiency through GRC platforms, APIs, scripts, cloud-native services, and automation for evidence collection, control validation, documentation, reporting, and remediation tracking. This position is remote supporting a Herndon, VA based team.

Essential Skills

  • Provide cybersecurity engineering and compliance support for FedRAMP and DoD-authorized cloud environments, including IL4–6.
    • Advise partners and customers on federal and DoD security requirements, authorization strategies, control implementation, and audit readiness.
    • Develop, review, and maintain authorization documentation, including SSPs, SAPs, SARs, POA&Ms, FedRAMP appendices, policies, and supporting evidence.
    • Support system authorization and reauthorization activities across FedRAMP/RMF, including gap assessments, control validation, evidence development, and remediation planning.
    • Leverage GRC platforms, APIs, scripts, and automation to streamline compliance workflows, evidence collection, documentation updates, control testing, and reporting.
    • Develop repeatable and auditable processes that reduce manual compliance effort and improve the accuracy and consistency of authorization artifacts.
    • Collaborate with cloud engineering and DevOps teams to design, implement, and validate security controls across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
    • Review system changes and significant change requests to assess security impact, identify documentation updates, and maintain authorization boundaries.
    • Coordinate with system owners, engineers, 3PAOs, Authorizing Officials, and government stakeholders to address findings and support authorization outcomes.
    • Support continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, POA&M updates, remediation tracking, and recurring compliance deliverables.
    • Evaluate security tooling and data sources to identify opportunities for automated control validation and compliance reporting.
    • Track evolving federal cybersecurity requirements and translate them into practical technical and operational actions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills with a focus on secure and compliant outcomes.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to advise partners, customers, engineers, and government stakeholders.
    • Ability to translate federal security requirements into practical technical controls and operational processes.
    • U.S. citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret or higher security clearance.
    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • Five or more years of cybersecurity experience, including at least three years supporting federal cloud security engineering, information assurance, RMF, or ISSO functions.
    • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, FedRAMP Moderate and High, DoD IL4–6 overlays, RMF, and related federal compliance frameworks.
    • Experience developing and maintaining SSPs, POA&Ms, SARs, policies, control evidence, and other authorization artifacts.
    • Experience supporting authorization planning, gap assessments, audit readiness, control implementation, and remediation activities.
    • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud environments, including IAM, encryption, logging, configuration management, and security monitoring.
    • Experience using GRC platforms, APIs, scripting, or automation to improve compliance and security workflows.
    • Familiarity with tools such as eMASS, Paramify, Nessus/Tenable, Splunk, Prisma Cloud, or comparable solutions.
  • CISSP, CGRC/CAP, CISM, Security+, or similar cybersecurity certificate

.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting FedRAMP, DoD, DISA, or federal agency ATO activities.
    • Experience developing automation with Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, infrastructure-as-code, or cloud-native services.
    • Experience integrating vulnerability, configuration, and cloud-security data into GRC (Paramify) and POA&M workflows.
    • Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines, automated security testing, policy-as-code, and continuous control validation.
    • Knowledge of FISMA, the Privacy Act, and agency-specific security requirements.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Our Product CTO organization includes a team of Technical Strategy leaders that bring outstanding ideas, the ability to execute, and teamwork to a strategic, high future impact organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to define and drive the company's technical vision, product strategy, and platform narrative for our Next-Gen SIEM and Log Management products.


This role requires deep technical knowledge in AI, SIEM/SOAR, log management, and data analysis and a functional understanding of actual real-world deployments, extended use-cases, and customer motivations. The ideal candidate doesn't just advise on strategy: they define what we build, why, and in what order, and they articulate how NGSIEM anchors CrowdStrike's platform consolidation story. This role reports to the Product CTO.

What You'll Do:
Product Strategy & Creation

  • Define and own the NGSIEM product strategy, including capability roadmap, competitive positioning, and technical differentiation. Translate market signals, customer pain, and threat landscape shifts into concrete product bets with clear success criteria.
  • Drive product definition for new NGSIEM capabilities across data ingestion, detection logic, investigation workflows, and response automation. Partner with PM and Engineering to write strategy briefs that become epics, not shelf-ware.
  • Own the data strategy for NGSIEM: which sources to prioritize for native connectors, how to handle petabyte-scale ingestion economics, and where federated search vs. centralized storage creates the right customer trade-off.
  • Define the AI integration roadmap for NGSIEM: where Charlotte AI accelerates analyst workflows (triage, case analysis, CQL generation, threat hunting), and where AI-native detection and automated response create step-function improvements over rule-based approaches.
  • Work with Product Management and Engineering to make key decisions on short/medium term roadmap as well as long term multi-year strategy.
  • Help develop frameworks for aggregating multiple sources of information to streamline and expedite data-driven decision making.

Platform Narrative & Cross-Pillar Integration

  • Anchor NGSIEM within the Falcon platform consolidation narrative. Define how NGSIEM collapses the traditional SIEM + SOAR + log management + threat intel stack into a single platform experience, and articulate that story for analysts, CISOs, and the market.
  • Drive cross-pillar integration strategy. Define how NGSIEM consumes and enriches data from Endpoint, Cloud Security, Identity Protection, and Exposure Management to deliver correlated detections that no standalone SIEM can match. Own the "better together" story with technical specificity.
  • Shape the platform data flywheel narrative. Articulate how every Falcon module feeding data into NGSIEM makes detections better, and how NGSIEM insights flow back to improve prevention, posture, and response across the platform.
  • Partner with NGSIEM, Fusion SOAR, Charlotte AI, and Falcon Foundry teams to define the automation and extensibility layer that sits on top of NGSIEM, ensuring the product strategy accounts for the full detect-investigate-respond lifecycle within the platform.
  • Contribute to CrowdStrike's platform thought leadership. Represent the NGSIEM perspective in analyst briefings, customer advisory boards, and competitive positioning. Help tell the story of why a platform-native SIEM beats a bolt-on SIEM.

Market Intelligence & Stakeholder Engagement

  • With your extensive cybersecurity background and your ability to think and operate at a strategic level, you will drive CrowdStrike's technical vision and strategy for Next-Gen SIEM.
  • Engage in the development of CrowdStrike's long-range strategic vision, and facilitate the entry of new security technology concepts to market to position CrowdStrike as the thought leader for Cybersecurity.
  • Engage with field sales, strategic accounts, customer success, and other stakeholders to research product ideas, pain points, obstacles, and market opportunities.
  • Use stakeholder feedback to inform necessary improvements and adjustments to the product.
  • Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the cybersecurity industry, competitors, and related developments, to ensure we continue to be innovative thought leaders.
  • Provide support to the wider CTO organization including the Falcon Fund, Privacy & Cyber Policy, Data Science and Detection Architecture teams, as well as the broader CrowdStrike organization as needed.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the cybersecurity or log management market with heavy emphasis on security visibility and insights.
  • Minimum of 5 years relevant work experience (ideal candidates will have experience in at least TWO of the following): sales engineer/pre-sales, competitive intelligence, solution architect, sales operations, product management, technical marketing, professional services, research & development, and technical support.
  • Experience defining and shipping product capabilities (not just advising on them); demonstrated ability to turn strategy into shipped features.
  • Understanding of platform economics: how data network effects, module attach rates, and consolidation pricing drive platform value.
  • Familiarity with detection engineering pipelines, correlation rule frameworks, or content-as-code approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with products (either designing, evaluating/testing, or in production).
  • Superior communication skills including experience presenting to senior & executive level management.
  • Excellent people and project management skills to manage projects and interact/build rapport with staff, colleagues, cross-functional teams and third parties.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Direct experience with customers (as a customer, or in a customer support or field role).
  • Real world experience with AI, SIEM, SOAR or Log Management tools to do threat hunting, vulnerability detection, risk analysis or compliance validation.
  • Experience articulating platform consolidation narratives to analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) or in competitive displacement scenarios.
  • Hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Query Language (CQL), LogScale, or comparable query-time analytics at scale.
  • Background in building or evaluating AI/ML-driven security automation (auto-triage, anomaly detection, LLM-assisted investigation).

jobs.description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

We believe technology will play a critical role in enabling the next generation of cash delivery operations: from identifying recipients without needing to knock on doors to a modern payments infrastructure that gets dollars in recipients’ hands faster and more scalable. We are seeking a Technical Program Associate responsible for implementing and managing the technology used across our programs - including systems for recipient data collection, verification, payments, and monitoring.

In this role, you will own all technology-related aspects of new project launches: working with our operations team to define and implement program requirements, project managing the implementation across multiple stakeholders, and analyzing, structuring, and acting on program data. You are a systems thinker who is comfortable assessing tradeoffs and deriving and communicating data-driven insights. You enjoy learning about technology in a variety of business contexts. You naturally take ownership, can navigate unfamiliar settings, and enjoy both building and managing ops. You can excel at both 10,000 feet as well as in the weeds of complex problems.

Reports to: Senior Technical Program Manager

Level: Open to Associate or Manager, depending on the candidate. We would rather find the right person than fill a predetermined level. A candidate with deeper experience, stronger technical skills, and the judgment to run their own projects and think critically and propositionally on project designs will be brought in at the higher end, with correspondingly more independence.

Location: At this stage of GiveDirectly’s growth and scale, we’re prioritizing hiring in the countries below, where we can employ you through a GD entity or an established employer of record: Cameroon, Canada, Colombia, DRC, Germany, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, Uganda, United Kingdom, and United States. This list reflects where our employment infrastructure is established today, and may evolve as we grow. If you’re based elsewhere and not open to relocation, we may not be able to consider your application for this role right now, but we’d encourage you to check back. Please also note that regardless of location, we expect 3 hours of daily overlap with the East Africa timezone.

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end-to-end technical delivery for program launches - leading scoping, requirements gathering, system configuration and implementation, QA and testing, troubleshooting, and closeout

We are looking for Customer Service Representatives to support inbound customer service, help desk, and back-office processing representatives for commercial and public sector support positions. In this role, you will handle inbound inquiries, troubleshoot basic technical issues, assist callers with products, process-related inquiries, and professionally represent some of the most recognizable brands in the world.

We offer many advancement opportunities including Supervisor, Trainer, Talent Acquisition, and Operations Management.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues

COMPENSATION DETAILS

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. About DuploCloud

DuploCloud is an AI-native DevOps automation platform that delivers the AI DevOps Engineer, an always-on teammate that builds, secures, and manages cloud infrastructure. Instead of relying on scripts and fragmented tooling, DuploCloud uses agentic AI to execute real operational tasks across provisioning, compliance, Kubernetes, observability, and cost optimization.

Built on a unified automation layer with security and compliance embedded by design, DuploCloud abstracts complex Infrastructure as Code into a streamlined, self-service experience. Engineering teams move faster, reduce operational overhead, and scale without adding DevOps headcount.

Backed by Mayfield, WestBridge Capital and StepStone Group,, DuploCloud sits at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and security, helping modern teams deploy and operate with speed, safety, and confidence. It is a place where builders can work on meaningful AI infrastructure challenges, move quickly, and have real impact as the company scales.

About the role:

DuploCloud is growing, and we’re looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to help accelerate our growth by bringing our AI-native DevOps automation platform to enterprise customers. In this role, you’ll own the full sales cycle, identifying and engaging organizations looking to simplify cloud infrastructure management, automate DevOps workflows, and streamline security and compliance. You’ll work with engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, and security leaders to understand their infrastructure challenges and demonstrate how DuploCloud helps teams provision cloud infrastructure faster, reduce operational complexity, and build security and compliance into their workflows. As a member of our growing sales team, you’ll play a key role in building our enterprise sales motion, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving revenue growth.

You will be a strong fit for this role if you have experience …

  • Owning the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle for B2B SaaS or cloud technology solutions, from prospecting and discovery through technical validation, negotiation, and close.
  • Proactively identifying enterprise accounts, developing targeted outbound strategies, and building a pipeline of organizations that can benefit from cloud automation, DevOps modernization, and infrastructure management solutions.
  • Engaging technical and executive stakeholders to uncover challenges related to cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, security, compliance, and DevOps efficiency.
  • Translating complex technical challenges into clear business value, demonstrating how DuploCloud can help customers accelerate infrastructure provisioning, reduce manual engineering effort, and improve security and compliance.
  • Navigating complex enterprise buying processes, building consensus across engineering, security, infrastructure, and executive teams, and driving opportunities forward.
  • Consistently meeting and exceeding revenue targets while maintaining a strong pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management.
  • Partnering with Business Development Representatives and Solution Architects to develop opportunities, lead technical evaluations, and demonstrate DuploCloud’s value to prospective customers.
  • Building relationships with AWS and other cloud ecosystem partners to develop co-selling opportunities and expand DuploCloud’s enterprise reach.

Qualifications:

  • Proven success in B2B SaaS sales, selling enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cybersecurity solutions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, with familiarity in DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or cloud security.
  • Experience with AWS partner sales motions, cloud marketplaces, or co-selling opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to source new business, build strategic account pipelines, and close complex deals involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience selling technical solutions to engineering leaders, DevOps teams, platform engineering, infrastructure, and/or security organizations.
  • Ability to connect technical capabilities to business outcomes, including operational efficiency, faster deployments, infrastructure scalability, and security and compliance automation.
  • Experience thriving in an early-stage, fast-moving startup environment where you can take ownership, adapt quickly, and help build repeatable sales processes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Consultative selling approach with the ability to understand customer infrastructure challenges and position DuploCloud as a strategic solution.
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and excited to help scale DuploCloud’s enterprise sales organization.

Compensation Philosophy:

At DuploCloud we recognize the value you bring, and our commitment to your success is reflected in a competitive compensation package tailored to your experience, location, and skills. To further align your incentives with the value you deliver, we're excited to introduce a commission-based compensation structure. In addition to our competitive compensation, we offer a comprehensive array of benefits designed to elevate your overall work experience.

The Lead Logistics Manager will manage logistics and project-delivery activities for a complex, mission-critical federal program. This role integrates material shipping, secure transportation, supply chain, inventory, schedule, cost, risk, and stakeholder-management functions to ensure program assets are delivered safely, securely, on time, and in compliance with contractual requirements.

The position also establishes long-term working relationships with Long Haul Transport Carriers, White Glove service providers, suppliers, contractors, government representatives, warehouse, and site personnel.

  • Lead logistics projects from planning through delivery, acceptance, and closeout.
  • Develop and manage project scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, budgets, risks, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate project activities across logistics, engineering, procurement, finance, security, transportation providers, contractors, and customer teams.
  • Manage detailed material-shipping activities, including transportation planning, secure handling, shipment tracking, delivery coordination, receipt, and documentation.
  • Support and maintain the program’s secure-shipping standard operating procedures.
  • Build and sustain strategic relationships with Long Haul Transport carriers and White Glove service providers.
  • Coordinate carrier capacity, equipment, specialized handling, site access, delivery, placement, unpacking, and related White Glove requirements.
  • Process and track purchase requests, goods receipts, invoices, proofs of delivery, chain-of-custody records, Bill of Lading, and other logistics documentation.

About Teamified

Teamified works with top enterprises and digital native businesses in Australia helping them build their remote teams in India, Philippines and Sri Lanka. About Our Client

Our client is an Australian FinTech company that provides a platform for business credit cards and spend management. In essence,they offer a modern alternative to traditional corporate cards, designed to simplify spending for businesses, save time and money on financial administration, and give businesses greater control and visibility over their expenses. Their key services include providing Mastercard-powered credit cards to businesses, which can be issued to employees, and a spend management platform that allows businesses to track spending in real-time, capture receipts, categorize expenses, and automate reconciliation with accounting software. Our client also enables employees to use a mobile app to upload receipts and add notes, streamlining the expense reporting process. Notably, our client does not charge any foreign transaction fee mark-ups and integrates with popular accounting software like Xero and SAP Concur. Additionally, our client provides controls and oversight features, allowing businesses to set spending limits, and lock or freeze cards. Our client’s users can also earn Velocity Points on eligible spending.

About the Role

This is a hands-on senior role in a small team. You'll ship production code in your first week, then help shape how we build cleaner architecture, real test coverage, safer deployments and AI-assisted engineering workflows. You'll work closely with our Head of Engineering and Product, and be based in Melbourne Australia.

We believe working closely with stakeholders and customers is key to engineering & product success so our client’s engineering team works closely alongside the commercial and product teams, to build a ground breaking technology platform.

  • Work on the payments core: card issuing and lifecycle, spend controls, transaction handling and webhooks from our 3rd party partners.

  • Strong relational data modelling and PostgreSQL skills.
  • A testing mindset: you write test suites as a matter of course and know how to bring testing patterns and the right level of coverage to an existing codebase.
  • Experience shipping on cloud infrastructure with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Sound security instincts, including authentication and authorisation with an identity provider such as Auth0 or Okta.
  • Ownership: you drive work from design doc to production and stay accountable for it once live.

Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

About the Role:

Credible is looking for a data-driven, results-oriented Data Analyst to join the Business Intelligence and Analytics team. This role will be integral in providing insights that inform company decisions across several business functions including user acquisition, brand marketing, product development, finance, and operations. This is a great opportunity for you to join a growth stage company and contribute to the success of our products and the continual improvement of our user and customer experiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with teams across the organization (user acquisition, product development, etc) to understand their analytics needs and produce dashboards and analytics solutions that allow them to execute more effectively
  • Monitor performance trends and provide regular insights to stakeholders, flagging data discrepancies and business risks before they impact results
  • Become the subject matter expert on our profit drivers, unit economics, and campaign/funnel performance
  • Proactively identify data gaps and inconsistencies, working cross-functionally to enhance data quality and analytical depth
  • Work with business leaders to define key metrics and build reporting to monitor performance along those metrics
  • Conduct in-depth investigative data analyses that lead to actionable insights, owning the entire process from ideation to execution to presentation of findings to stakeholders
  • Help structure A/B tests, establish goals and define instrumentation and logging requirements for tests and features
  • Become an expert on all aspects of Credible’s data and analytics infrastructure

Education and Experience:

  • BA/BS in a quantitative field
  • 3+ years of work experience as a data analyst, data engineer, or in a highly analytical role
  • Experience writing SQL queries and optimizing data models
  • Experience leveraging visualization/reporting tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience using Excel for analysis
  • Experience with A/B and multivariate testing, which includes providing input into structuring experiments appropriately
  • Strong grasp of statistics and experience conducting rigorous data analyses
  • Experience using the command line and git repositories
  • Experience with a scripting language (preferably Python) for data processing and analysis a plus
  • Experience developing models and visualizations in Looker a plus
  • Experience at an e-commerce or fintech company a plus

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

jobs.excerpt: Rabbit helps enterprises cut their GCP spend — and the difference between a customer who saves millions and one who churns is the engineer standing next to them during adoption.
jobs.description:
Rabbit helps enterprises cut their GCP spend — and the difference between a customer who saves millions and one who churns is the engineer standing next to them during adoption. We’re hiring a Customer Engineer to be that person for our customers across the US and the broader Americas.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing engineering role. Your focus is making customers successful: gluing Rabbit into each customer’s GCP environment, getting them onboarded and integrated, and keeping them unblocked so the product delivers real savings on their workloads. You’ll work closely with the core engineering team, but your center of gravity is the customer, not the roadmap.

Initial domain: BigQuery cost optimization — slot management, reservation models, job-level optimization, query analysis at petabyte scale. As Rabbit’s optimization scope expands across GCP, so will yours.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Own technical adoption for a portfolio of enterprise customers — onboarding, configuration, and integrating Rabbit into their GCP setup until they hit first measurable savings
  • Be the go-to technical contact when something breaks — investigate, debug, and fix issues across data anomalies, pipelines, and BigQuery cost questions
  • Advise customers on GCP cost strategy — BigQuery reservation models, slot management, billing mechanics — and how Rabbit fits in
  • Run technical Q&A, troubleshooting sessions, and hands-on workshops with customer teams
  • Relay field signal back to Product and Engineering — you’ll have more customer context than anyone, and the core team builds on what you surface
  • When the product genuinely can’t cover a customer need, build a custom solution to bridge the gap — but the goal is always to fold that need back into the platform, not to maintain bespoke one-offs

How We Work — AI-First, Agentic by Default

Rabbit is an AI-first company. Agentic development practices are mandatory, not optional — Claude Code, Cursor, and agent-driven workflows are how we move. You’ll use them to integrate, debug, and unblock customers in hours, not days.

You Should Have

Must-have:

  • 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing role — Customer/Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, TAM, or similar — with real hands-on engineering, not just advisory
  • Deep BigQuery expertise — slots, reservations, pricing models, INFORMATION_SCHEMA, query optimization. Hard requirement; we’ll test for it.
  • Strong SQL, and comfort in backend code (any language) — enough to integrate, script, and debug in a customer’s environment
  • Hands-on GCP experience — you’ve worked with production workloads on Google Cloud
  • Customer-facing instinct — you can run a technical conversation with an enterprise team without an Account Executive holding your hand
  • Fluent with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) on real production work — not just demos
  • Autonomy — small team, no middle management, you own customer outcomes

Strong plus:

  • GCP cost management, FinOps, or cloud billing optimization background
  • Familiarity with BigQuery reservation models, slot pricing, and workload management
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform on GCP)

Why This Role

  • Direct customer impact. You see your work land in dollars saved on real workloads, customer by customer.
  • Hard problems, hands-on. BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-world anomalies, messy integrations — not generic SaaS onboarding.
  • Short path to the product. What you surface from the field shapes what the core team builds next.
  • Own the relationship. Small team, real ownership over whether your customers succeed.

Why Join Rabbit

  • Ownership from day one: Design your own pipelines, choose your own tools, architect your own solutions. We trust senior engineers and managers to make senior decisions
  • Work with cutting-edge at scale: BigQuery optimization at petabyte scale, real-time anomaly detection, cost prediction algorithms — these are hard, unsolved problems.
  • Learn and grow fast: Work alongside data architects and senior engineers who will challenge you. Shipping to Fortune 500 companies will level you up faster than any course ever could
  • Not for everyone. Perfect for you if: You're driven by impact, not comfort. You'd rather tackle hard problems with smart people than easy problems alone. You want your work to matter.

In Return We Offer

  • the opportunity to maintain a healthy work-life balance with financial initiatives to support physical and mental health and green commuting, including support for remote work, commuting, and eyeglasses (depending on the location)
  • continuous training and learning opportunities with yearly allocated learning hours from working time, including language learning (English and German)
  • social activities for everyone (team building events, company breakfasts, Christmas, Halloween, and alumni parties, sport events, professional meetups, darts tournaments)

...last but not least, a great community and an international environment. :)

About Aliz

Aliz was founded by a group of driven software engineers with one vision in mind: Build a human-centered company to solve exciting business challenges with cutting-edge technologies all around the globe.

We are a proud Google Cloud Partner with specializations in Generative AI, Infrastructure, Data Analytics, Cloud Migration, and Machine Learning - we deliver solutions, off the shelf, or custom-built on GCP using an agile, holistic approach. Our team includes engineers, industry experts, and digital professionals who ensure our clients are ready to face the challenges of the ever-changing digital world.

Life has been pretty exciting at Aliz recently (here's proof). Since winning Google Cloud’s Breakthrough Partner of the Year in APAC, we’ve continued to grow our team and expertise and were more recently recognized with the Partner of the Year Award in the Alps and the Google Cloud Generative AI Specialization. We have over 100 people working from our offices in Europe or Asia, and we're still counting!

You couldn’t pick a better time to join this world-class team of GCP experts.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.


The Opportunity: Senior Finance Lead, Credit Card

Tilt's Strategic Finance (StratFin) team is hiring a Senior Finance Lead dedicated to the Credit Card business unit. You'll be the embedded finance lead for Credit Card, owning the P&L, driving forecasting and unit economics, and acting as the primary financial thought partner to Credit Card product, credit/risk, and marketing leadership. This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to BU and executive leadership, and regular input into board-level reporting. Given the seniority of the role, you'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy and to shape strategic direction for the business, not just execute against it.


How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Own the Credit Card P&L: Drive the monthly forecast-vs-actual process, variance analysis, and financial reporting for the Credit Card business, including inputs to company-wide board and executive materials.

  • Be the embedded finance partner: Serve as the primary point of contact between Finance and Credit Card leadership — attending BU staff meetings, flagging financial risk/opportunity in real time, and translating operating decisions into financial impact.

  • Own unit economics: Build and maintain the Credit Card unit economics model (CAC, LTV, contribution margin, portfolio yield, delinquency and loss curves) and use it to evaluate new product, pricing, and credit line initiatives.

  • Drive planning cycles: Lead the Credit Card-specific inputs to annual planning and quarterly re-forecasts, ensuring assumptions are grounded and resourcing tradeoffs are made explicit.

  • Build the business case: Partner with Credit, Product, and Marketing to size and evaluate new initiatives — pricing changes, acquisition channel shifts, portfolio strategy — with rigorous, data-backed analysis.

  • Partner with Credit/Data Science on portfolio performance: Translate model and portfolio performance (delinquency, roll rates, approval/pricing strategy) into financial terms for leadership.

  • Shape strategic priorities: Independently identify risks and opportunities in the Credit Card business and proactively bring recommendations to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Drive AI-enabled finance workflows: Identify and implement opportunities to use AI tools (e.g., Claude, internal automation via Aleph/Databricks) to accelerate reporting, variance analysis, and ad hoc modeling — reducing manual cycle time and freeing capacity for higher-value strategic work. Set an example for the broader StratFin team on responsible, effective AI-assisted analysis.

  • Improve the reporting infrastructure: Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting so Credit Card metrics are visible, self-serve, and decision-ready for stakeholders.


Why You’re a Great Fit

  • 6+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, bizops, management consulting, or investment banking; lending, credit card, or consumer finance experience strongly preferred

  • Demonstrated track record of owning a P&L or business unit's financial narrative at a senior level, including direct engagement with BU and executive leadership

  • Strong unit economics and financial modeling skills, ideally with exposure to credit/lending economics (loss rates, yield, CAC/LTV)

  • Comfortable with SQL; experience with Databricks and/or Aleph a plus

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to drive real efficiency gains in financial analysis or reporting — not just casual use, but a demonstrated habit of building and scaling

  • Proven ability to build trust and influence with non-finance BU leaders (product, credit/risk, marketing), including pushing back on flawed assumptions and supplying alternatives

  • A get-it-done mindset — resourceful, hands-on, comfortable in the weeds despite seniority

  • Strong strategic thinking and ability to structure ambiguous problems independently, with minimal oversight

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior/executive and board-level audiences

  • Advanced degree (MBA or related) preferred; experience working across international markets or with global/multi-currency businesses is a plus

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Spécialiste des solutions anti-usureProvince de Québec | Télétravail | Bureau à Vaudreuil-Dorion, | Allocation automobile | Commissions non plafonnées Êtes-vous un professionnel du développement des affaires qui aime repérer de nouvelles occasions, entrer en contact avec les décideurs et transformer des prospects en clients à long terme?
jobs.description:
Spécialiste des solutions anti-usure

Province de Québec | Télétravail | Bureau à Vaudreuil-Dorion, | Allocation automobile | Commissions non plafonnées

Êtes-vous un professionnel du développement des affaires qui aime repérer de nouvelles occasions, entrer en contact avec les décideurs et transformer des prospects en clients à long terme? Savez-vous comment établir de nouveaux contacts dans des marchés concurrentiels, gagner la confiance des clients et transformer une première conversation en une relation d’affaires rentable?

Si le développement de nouvelles affaires et la création de relations clients vous motivent, cette occasion pourrait être votre prochain défi professionnel.

Chez Castolin Eutectic, vous aurez l’occasion de développer votre territoire partout au Québec, d’établir des relations avec des clients industriels et de faire croître les affaires en vous appuyant sur l’expertise d’un chef de file mondial reconnu dans son domaine.

Forte de plus de 120 ans d’expérience dans les consommables de soudage, la protection contre l’usure, les technologies de projection thermique et les solutions d’entretien industriel, Castolin Eutectic aide les industries lourdes à réduire les temps d’arrêt, à prolonger la durée de vie des équipements et à améliorer leur productivité.

L’occasion

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) spécialiste des solutions anti-usure ayant une vision stratégique pour développer et faire croître nos services de protection contre l’usure partout au Québec, principalement dans les secteurs des mines, de la production d’énergie, des pâtes et papiers, du ciment et de l’acier.

La personne idéale possède une bonne compréhension des problématiques liées à l’usure dans un ou plusieurs de ces secteurs. Que vous soyez un professionnel de la vente expérimenté ou que vous proveniez du domaine de l’entretien industriel, de la fiabilité, de l’ingénierie, de la mécanique industrielle ou de la gestion d’usine et souhaitiez relever un nouveau défi, cette occasion vous permettra de mettre votre expertise technique au service du développement des affaires.

Aperçu du poste

En tant que membre clé de l’unité d’affaires des services de protection contre l’usure de Castolin Eutectic, le ou la spécialiste sera responsable de développer et d’élargir les comptes stratégiques en proposant aux clients et aux fabricants d’équipement d’origine (FEO) des produits, des services et des solutions techniques adaptés à leurs besoins.

Ce poste combine expertise technique, vente-conseil et développement proactif des affaires afin de repérer de nouvelles occasions, d’acquérir de nouveaux clients et d’accroître les revenus partout au Québec.

Vos responsabilités

  • Développement du marché : Stimuler la croissance de nos services de protection contre l’usure, notamment les plaques d’usure CDP, Castotube, LaserClad et les produits et solutions complémentaires, en ciblant des comptes stratégiques partout au Québec.

  • Développement des affaires : Repérer, qualifier et poursuivre de nouvelles occasions d’affaires tout en développant les relations avec les clients existants.

  • Relations avec la clientèle : Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les utilisateurs finaux, les FEO et les principaux décideurs des services d’entretien, d’ingénierie, de fiabilité et des achats.

  • Solutions techniques : Comprendre les problèmes d’usure des clients et collaborer avec les spécialistes internes afin de recommander les produits et services appropriés.

  • Gestion des occasions d’affaires : Maintenir un portefeuille actif d’occasions dans le système CRM, assurer le suivi des possibilités et faire progresser les initiatives de développement des affaires.

  • Soutien technique et commercial : Aider les clients en répondant à leurs questions techniques, en les conseillant sur le choix des produits et leurs applications, et en préparant des propositions et des soumissions.

  • Collaboration interrégionale : Collaborer avec les équipes des autres régions afin de partager les meilleures pratiques et d’améliorer continuellement les approches techniques et commerciales.

  • Résultats des ventes : Atteindre les objectifs de volume des ventes, de revenus et de marge bénéficiaire brute pour les services de protection contre l’usure.

  • Représentation de l’entreprise : Représenter Castolin Eutectic lors de salons professionnels, de conférences sectorielles, d’événements clients et de séances de formation technique.

  • Administration : Tenir à jour les dossiers dans le CRM, soumettre les rapports de dépenses chaque semaine, communiquer les enjeux importants et contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs organisationnels.

Votre profil

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience pertinente en solutions anti-usure, entretien industriel, fiabilité, exploitation d’usine ou vente technique dans un ou plusieurs des secteurs suivants : mines, production d’énergie, pâtes et papiers, ciment ou acier.

  • Bonne compréhension des mécanismes d’usure, de la protection des surfaces et des solutions de gestion de l’usure.

  • Capacité à communiquer avec assurance avec les professionnels de l’entretien, de l’ingénierie, de la fiabilité et des achats.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication-conseil, en développement de relations et en développement des affaires.

  • Bonnes aptitudes mécaniques et capacité à lire et à interpréter des dessins techniques de base.

  • Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office.

  • Autonomie, esprit d’initiative et orientation vers les résultats, avec la capacité de gérer efficacement un territoire.

  • Atout : Connaissances de base en soudage, en entretien industriel et en technologies de réparation.

  • Compétences linguistiques : Excellente maîtrise du français et connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais afin de communiquer avec les clients et les collègues partout au Québec et au sein de l’organisation.

Ce qui distingue cette occasion

La liberté de bâtir. La technologie pour réussir. Le potentiel de gagner davantage.

  • Salaire de base concurrentiel

  • Commissions non plafonnées : Votre potentiel de rémunération augmente à mesure que vous développez votre territoire et obtenez de

  • Possibilités de primes au rendement.

  • Allocation automobile pour couvrir les déplacements sur le territoire québécois.

  • Flexibilité du télétravail : Organisez votre horaire et gérez votre territoire en toute autonomie, tout en étant responsable de vos résultats.

  • Soutien technique solide : Collaborez avec des spécialistes expérimentés des services et des produits pour élaborer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients.

  • Programme complet d’avantages sociaux : Couverture médicale et dentaire, compte de dépenses de santé (CDS), assurance vie, assurance invalidité de courte et de longue durée, programme d’aide aux employés (PAE) et services de télémédecine.

  • Régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER) collectif avec cotisations de l’employeur.

  • Formation technique continue et possibilités de développement professionnel.

Prêt(e) à relever un nouveau défi?

Si vous avez le dynamisme nécessaire pour trouver de nouveaux clients, l’assurance pour établir des relations à partir de zéro et l’ambition de développer un territoire offrant un important potentiel de rémunération, nous aimerions vous rencontrer.

Mettez votre talent en prospection à profit. Nous vous fournirons la technologie, l’expertise et le soutien nécessaires pour réussir.

Postulez dès aujourd’hui et découvrez les possibilités de développement professionnel qui vous attendent chez Castolin Eutectic.

Les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Province of Quebec | Home-Based | Office in Vaudreuil-Dorion | Vehicle Allowance | Uncapped Commission

Are you a business developer who enjoys identifying untapped opportunities, connecting with decision-makers, and turning prospects into long-term customers? Do you know how to open doors in competitive markets, build credibility, and turn initial conversations into profitable business relationships?

If winning new business and developing customer relationships motivate you, this could be your next career move.

At Castolin Eutectic, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your territory across Quebec, build relationships with industrial customers, and grow a business backed by a recognized global technology leader.

With more than 120 years of experience in welding consumables, wear protection, thermal spray technologies, and engineered maintenance solutions, we help heavy industries reduce downtime, extend equipment life, and improve productivity.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a strategically minded Wear Solutions Specialist to develop and grow our wear services business across Quebec, focusing on key industries including mining, power generation, pulp and paper, cement, and steel.

Our ideal candidate has a strong understanding of wear-related challenges in one or more of these industries. Whether you are an experienced sales professional or have a background in maintenance, reliability, engineering, millwrighting, or plant operations and are ready for a new challenge, this is an opportunity to combine your technical expertise with business development.

Position Overview

As a key member of Castolin Eutectic’s Wear Services Business Unit, the Wear Solutions Specialist will develop and expand strategic accounts by providing customers and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) with tailored wear-resistant products, services, and engineered solutions.

This role combines technical knowledge, consultative selling, and proactive business development to identify opportunities, acquire new customers, and increase revenue throughout Quebec.

What You’ll Do

  • Market Development: Drive growth in wear services, including CDP wearplate, Castotube, LaserClad, and complementary products and solutions, by targeting strategic accounts across Quebec.

  • Business Development: Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.

  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with end users, OEMs, and key decision-makers in maintenance, engineering, reliability, and purchasing.

  • Technical Solutions: Understand customers’ wear-related challenges and collaborate with internal specialists to recommend appropriate products and services.

  • Opportunity Management: Maintain an active sales pipeline in the CRM, track opportunities, and follow up consistently to advance business development initiatives.

  • Technical and Commercial Support: Assist customers with technical inquiries, product selection, applications, proposals, and quotations.

  • Cross-Regional Collaboration: Work with colleagues across regions to share best practices and strengthen technical and commercial approaches.

  • Sales Performance: Achieve sales volume, revenue, and gross profit margin objectives for the Wear Services business.

  • Industry Representation: Represent Castolin Eutectic at trade shows, industry conferences, customer events, and technical training sessions.

  • Administration: Maintain accurate CRM records, submit weekly expense reports, communicate important business issues, and contribute to the achievement of organizational objectives.

What You’ll Bring

  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in wear solutions, industrial maintenance, reliability, plant operations, or technical sales within one or more of the following industries: mining, power generation, pulp and paper, cement, or steel.

  • A solid understanding of wear mechanisms, surface protection, and wear management solutions.

  • The ability to engage confidently with maintenance, engineering, reliability, and purchasing professionals.

  • Strong consultative communication, relationship-building, and business development skills.

  • Mechanical aptitude and the ability to interpret basic technical drawings.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • A self-motivated, results-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently and manage a territory effectively.

  • An asset: Basic knowledge of welding, industrial maintenance, and repair technologies.

  • Language skills: Fluency in French and a working knowledge of English to communicate with customers and colleagues across Quebec and the wider organization.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

The freedom to build. The technology to deliver. The opportunity to earn.

  • Competitive base salary

  • Uncapped commission: Your earning potential grows as you develop your territory and win new business.

  • Performance bonus opportunities.

  • Vehicle allowance to support travel throughout Quebec.

  • Home-based flexibility: Manage your schedule and territory while taking ownership of your results.

  • Strong technical support: Work alongside experienced service and product specialists to develop solutions for your customers.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical and dental coverage, Health Spending Account (HSA), life insurance, short- and long-term disability, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and telemedicine.

  • Company RRSP with employer contributions.

  • Ongoing technical training and career development.

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

If you have the drive to find new customers, the confidence to build relationships from scratch, and the ambition to grow a territory with significant earning potential, we’d like to meet you.

Bring your prospecting talent. We’ll bring the technology, expertise, and support to help you succeed.

Apply today and explore the opportunity to grow your career with Castolin Eutectic.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

jobs.description:
Join us to shape the future of work: your next adventure awaits!

We’re looking for a Principal IT Engineer to own and evolve the technology experience of our global workforce.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership across identity, endpoint management, workplace applications, IT automation, security controls, and service operations.

You will work in a global, product-led, high-paced technology company, partnering closely with Security, Engineering, People, Finance, Legal, and business teams to ensure employees can work securely, efficiently, and with minimal friction across multiple countries and time zones.

Responsibilities

    Corporate IT & Workplace Technology

  • Own the architecture and continuous improvement of our corporate IT environment.

  • Manage and optimize identity, SSO, authentication, device management, and access controls.

  • Own technologies including Google Workspace, Okta, Workspace ONE, Slack, and other critical workplace SaaS platforms.

  • Define endpoint standards across Windows, macOS, and mobile devices.

  • Drive device trust, conditional access, compliance, and secure access to corporate applications.

  • Evaluate and implement new workplace technologies and SaaS solutions.

    • IT Operations & Global Helpdesk

  • Drive the technical excellence and continuous improvement of global IT service delivery and helpdesk operations, partnering with IT management to improve scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Ensure business continuity and support coverage for critical IT services and incidents.

  • Define service standards, SLAs, escalation processes, monitoring, and operational metrics.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex identity, endpoint, networking, SaaS, and workplace technology issues.

  • Create technical standards, guidelines, documentation, and operating procedures for more junior IT team members.

  • Mentor and provide technical direction to IT engineers and support teams, raising the overall technical quality of the function.

    • Automation & Integrations

  • Automate onboarding, offboarding, role changes, provisioning, and access-management workflows.

  • Build integrations between HR, identity, device-management, SaaS, and internal systems.

  • Eliminate repetitive processes through scripting, APIs, workflow automation, and AI

  • Improve employee self-service and reduce dependency on manual IT operations.

    • Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Partner with Security to implement identity, endpoint, access-control, and device-security policies.

  • Support compliance requirements including ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR.

  • Improve SaaS governance, licence management, application discovery, and access reviews.

  • Ensure IT architecture follows appropriate security, privacy, reliability, and audit standards.

You have

  • 8–10+ years of experience in corporate IT, workplace technology, identity, endpoint management, or related roles within global technology companies.

  • Experience working in a global, product-led, fast-growing and fast-paced technology environment. Deep experience with Google Workspace and Workspace ONE, or comparable enterprise platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, MFA, identity lifecycle management, and device trust.

  • Strong Windows and macOS endpoint-management experience.

  • Experience supporting global organisations and IT operations across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Experience automating workflows using APIs, scripting, and integration platforms.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS administration, networking, security, and modern Zero Trust principles.

  • Ability to independently design solutions and lead technically complex initiatives from architecture through production.

  • Ability to define technical standards and provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level IT professionals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate clearly with employees, technical teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a bias toward automation and scalable solutions.

About us

Job&Talent is a world-leading, AI-powered workforce management platform for frontline industries. We help companies boost productivity and efficiency at scale, while giving workers the tools they need to thrive. Our mission is simple: to empower the people who make the world go round.
Built on deep industry expertise, cutting-edge technology, and smart AI agents, our end-to-end platform covers the entire workforce lifecycle — from recruitment and planning to time and attendance, performance, cost management, and communication.
It delivers measurable improvements in the areas that matter most: fulfilment, attendance, retention, and workforce quality. Our platform strength is rooted in unique experience: placing millions of workers over the years and serving thousands of blue-chip clients across delivery, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, retail, and hospitality.
Headquartered in Madrid, the company operates in 10 countries across Europe, the US, and Latin America and is backed by leading investors including Atomico, Goldman Sachs, Kinnevik, BlackRock, and SoftBank.

Join our community and make an impact

Innovation, high standards, and analytical thinking are in our DNA. Everyone has a voice here, and that voice matters. It’s how we stay sharp, move fast, and make decisions that keep us ahead of the curve.
You’ll take full ownership of your work, collaborate across borders, and grow by doing. Around here, you’ll hear a lot about 10x experiences, human-centered design, and the power of AI. But what truly sets us apart is our people: Our diverse team brings unique perspectives, deep commitment and real-world experience to the table.
We champion empathy, honesty, and inclusion. Because when people can be their authentic selves, incredible things happen—for our workers, our clients, and for each other.
And we reward that impact—with competitive pay, meaningful benefits, and the opportunity to shape what work looks like for millions around the globe.
If you're ready to make a real impact at scale, you're in the right place.

Proud to champion equality

At Job&Talent we value diversity and we're an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified people regardless of national origin, race, disability, religious beliefs or sexual orientation. Come join us. We look forward to your application.
