jobs.description:
Technical Implementation Manager

Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) is one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers. The company, which is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia has company-owned leisure and corporate travel business in 23 countries, spanning Australia, New Zealand, the Americas, Europe, the United Kingdom, South Africa, the United Arab Emirates and Asia. FCTG also operates a global corporate travel management network, which extends to more than 90 countries through company-owned businesses and independent licensees. The company opened its first leisure travel shop in Sydney, Australia in 1982 and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange in 1995. Our purpose is to “open up the world for those who want to see”. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something really amazing – travel!

To learn more about Flight Centre Travel Group please click HERE

About The Opportunity

Technology continues to transform the corporate travel industry, and this role is at the forefront of that evolution. As a Technical Implementation Manager, you'll lead the technical delivery of online booking solutions that power exceptional client experiences across FCM. Working closely with internal teams, partners, and customers, you'll oversee implementations from kickoff through launch while driving process improvements, automation, and innovation. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically skilled, customer-focused professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and making a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical implementation of online booking tools (OBTs), including customer profile configuration, policy setup, system configuration, testing, launch, and post go-live support
  • Apply knowledge of Web Services and XML to troubleshoot data integrations, system configurations, and technical issues
  • Maintain and continuously improve implementation templates and project management workflows within Wrike
  • Manage multiple onboarding projects while meeting or exceeding implementation timelines
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities for client onboarding projects
  • Lead regional technical projects by gathering requirements, engaging stakeholders, and driving successful outcomes
  • Stay current with enhancements and releases across FCM Booking and partner online booking platforms
  • Assess implementation impacts of new technology developments and proactively plan solutions
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiencies to improve implementation speed and quality
  • Deliver exceptional customer experiences that support client satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnerships
  • Provide Level 3 technical support through internal ticketing systems for Client Portal, FCM Booking, and third-party OBT issues
  • Manage support tickets and consistently achieve SLA and KPI targets
  • Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years' experience implementing Concur, including technical configuration and client-facing responsibilities
  • Or minimum 3 years' experience implementing Deem, including technical configuration and client-facing responsibilities

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Summary

Job Title: Head of U.S. Federal Growth

Level: Leadership; 5+ years of relevant experience

Clearance: Previously held or current Secret or higher U.S. government security clearance

Work Location Type: Remote, United States; Bay Area or Washington, DC

Work Type: Full-time, benefits

Travel: Up to 25%

Agency name: US Navy

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Head of U.S. Federal Growth. This role will lead business development, capture management, government affairs, and strategic partnerships across the U.S. federal government, turning early customer interest into funded federal programs. The focus spans defense and civilian agencies, including maritime operations, environmental intelligence, weather and ocean data, and national security missions.

Our client is an ocean technology company that designs, builds, and deploys marine sensors and combines oceanographic and underwater acoustic sensing with data and software. Its capabilities help commercial customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions, while helping government and defense stakeholders understand ocean conditions, maritime activity, and remote environments. The company has more than a decade of Navy research partnerships and is expanding its established capabilities into funded federal programs.

What will you do

You will lead the cross-cutting activities that help our client identify, shape, capture, and win strategic opportunities across the U.S. federal government. Your portfolio will span defense and civilian agencies, with particular emphasis on maritime operations, environmental intelligence, weather and ocean data, and national security missions. You will own business development, capture management, government affairs, and strategic partnerships, creating viable pathways from early customer interest to funded federal programs. The role reports to the Global Head of Government and Defense.

Responsibilities

Develop and execute capture strategies for the highest-priority U.S. federal opportunities, from early qualification and shaping through acquisition strategy, teaming, proposal development, award, and transition to contract execution. Connect near-term sales opportunities with longer-term programs, contract vehicles, appropriations, and agency acquisition strategies.

Provide leadership with concise, decision-ready assessments of pipeline health, capture progress, partner activity, government-affairs priorities, risks, resource needs, and recommended actions.

Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events, partner discussions, exercises, demonstrations, and other federal-market engagements.

Lead U.S. federal government-affairs execution in coordination with external advisors; directly manage consultants and lobbyists.

Partner with the government programs team on capture materials, white papers, responses to requests for information, statements of work, ROMs, proposals, presentations, and other customer-facing submissions.

Build and manage relationships and teaming strategies with prime contractors and other partners that expand access, capabilities, and competitiveness.

Collaborate across sales, product, engineering, legal, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership to ensure priority pursuits are compelling to the customer and executable.

Requirements

5+ years of experience in U.S. federal business development, capture management, government affairs, strategic partnerships, federal acquisition, or a related field, including demonstrated experience advancing and winning complex U.S. federal opportunities involving multiple stakeholders, long sales cycles, and non-obvious funding or contracting pathways.

Strong understanding of the federal acquisition lifecycle, including opportunity shaping, capture planning, proposal development, source selection, contracting mechanisms, and post-award transition.

Ability to connect operational users, program managers, contracting officials, funders, policymakers, and industry partners around a coherent path to award.

Working knowledge of the federal budget, authorization, and appropriations processes and how they relate to agency programs and business-development priorities.

Strong project-management skills, with the ability to establish milestones, assign owners, surface risks, and maintain momentum across several complex pursuits.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn technical capabilities and customer needs into compelling, audience-appropriate narratives.

Willingness to work directly on capture materials, partner strategies, presentations, proposals, and follow-up actions, not simply advise others.

Willingness to travel up to 25% to meet customers, policymakers, partners, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Active Secret or TS/SCI security clearance.

Direct experience supporting maritime, ocean, weather, environmental, autonomy, sensing, data, or decision-support programs; experience at a fast-paced defense or federal technology company; and/or experience with the U.S. Navy, Air Force, Army, SOCOM, NOAA, or other U.S. agencies with relevant missions.

Experience capturing both defense and civilian-agency opportunities.

Experience selling or preparing proposals for hardware-enabled solutions, data-as-a-service offerings, software, or integrated technical capabilities to the federal government.

Work Authorization and Clearance

U.S. citizenship required.

Previously held or current Secret or higher U.S. government security clearance required.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Competitive base pay plus equity and commission.

Medical, dental and vision coverage.

Continued learning and development stipend.

One-time home office stipend for remote team members.

Relocation bonus for team members moving to the Bay Area.

Flexible PTO, in addition to 10 company-wide office closure days; the last week of December off for everyone.

12 weeks of parental leave, plus 4 additional weeks for birthing parents.

Military leave and job protection for reservists and guard members under USERRA.

Annual company onsite week and team events throughout the year.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About WonderlyWonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue.
jobs.description:
About Wonderly

Wonderly is a closed-loop, end-to-end system that self-improves on our customers’ revenue. We serve the home service industry ($1.3T), and can consistently double a new customer’s revenue within 90 days. We make all of our AI and software completely free - and only get paid when our customers make real money. We’re here helping real small businesses make a life, pay for their children’s college tuition, and live the American dream.

Pre-AI SaaS sold tools. AI companies claim they sell outcomes - task done, call answered, lead booked, ticket resolved - but calls or leads aren’t the outcomes that ultimately matter. Revenue is what ultimately matters, and today, none of the AI companies actually promise revenue. Wonderly changes that.

Our 70-person team (mostly in PDE) spent over a year building in stealth; our thesis is that - if you actually want to control the end result (revenue) of a business and deploy AI fast/cheaply, you can’t just build the sexy part (agents), you must also build the unsexy parts and own everything end to end: the system of record layer and the application layer. We built from scratch every software a home service business needs - replacing ServiceTitan, Squarespace, Ringcentral, Jobber, Square, Hubspot, and a dozen others applications. And we built every agent necessary - AI marketing, AI receptionist, AI voice, AI sales outreach, AI sales coaching, AI follow-ups, AI 3D design, AI finance, AI quoting, AI collections, and more - all embedded inside our own system with native data access. As a result, we can deploy dozens of production-ready Agents to our customers in under 24 hours with no FDEs, no integrations, and no data cleaning work.

We are the most outcome driven business model in the business because we’ve proven our system and AI Agents actually work in driving the end result - revenue. We are not trying to sell our customers a dream - each of our 10+ core AI Agents help improve our customers’ revenue by 5-20%.

Wonderly already has PMF and has gone from 0 → 1 (we are happy to share more over a call), with very clear moat and deep industry knowledge that took a team of 70 hardcore A-players 18 months to build (we are at least 2 years ahead of anyone else in the space). We believe Wonderly has the potential to be a $100B - $1T outcome. The market is massive: home service businesses across North America (a $1.3T market). We’ve raised over $50M from top-tier investors, have $20M a year in free cashflow from another product line (Motion), and all that money gets pumped into Wonderly.

About the Hiring Manager

Hey, I’m Bishop, Head of Operations at Wonderly.

I’m extreme, direct, and care a lot about getting to the truth. I started in FP&A, realized I wanted to be in the middle of building something instead of analyzing it from the outside, and ended up here.

I give a lot of feedback and it’s direct. It won’t be softened and it isn’t personal. I’d expect you to push back on me. I change my mind when the argument is good.

The Role

This is a closing job. Not coaching, not account management, not a desk. You’ll be in homeowners’ kitchens every day, running appointments and signing contracts. If you’ve never closed a homeowner in person, this isn’t the role.

We generate leads for home improvement contractors and only make money when those leads turn into closed jobs. Right now, some of our contractors close well and some barely close at all, on the same kind of leads. We want to see what happens when a real closer runs those appointments.

You’ll be based in the same city as one or two of our contractor customers and run their in-home appointments yourself.

Day to day:

  • Show up to the appointments our team books for them

  • Walk the job, build the quote, and close in the home

  • Follow up on everything that doesn’t sign the first night

  • Hand off clean to the contractor’s crew so the job gets built the way you sold it

  • Log every appointment: outcome, ticket, objections, why it was won or lost

We’ll track the contractor’s close rate, deal size, and onsite volume before you start and after. Your number is the number.

What Makes This Role Different

Most in-home sales jobs give you leads and a quota for one company, and that’s the ceiling.

Here, you get our leads, our booking team, and our software behind you. And if this works, you’re the first one in. The plan is more contractors, more cities, and more closers, and the people who prove it first are the ones who lead it.

Backgrounds That Tend to Work

People from these backgrounds tend to thrive:

  • Top closers in remodeling: kitchen, bath, design-build

  • In-home sales for roofing, HVAC, plumbing, windows, siding, or other exteriors

  • One-call-close environments where you had a number and hit it

  • Anyone with a track record of closing homeowners in person

Backgrounds we care less about:

  • B2B or SaaS sales with no homeowner experience

  • Inside sales or appointment setting only

  • Sales managers who haven’t run their own appointments in years

What matters more than the resume:

  • You can take control of an appointment in the first five minutes without being pushy

  • You can tell when someone’s actually buying versus just shopping around

  • You can give a price without losing the room

  • You follow up until it’s a yes or a clear no

  • You can explain honestly why a deal was won or lost

Expectations

  • You’re already based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the cities where our contractors are.

  • 60–70 hour weeks. Evenings and weekends, when homeowners are available

  • Driving to appointments every day

  • Performance is transparent. You’ll see your numbers daily and so will everyone else.

  • The process changes fast. What we tell you Monday might be rewritten by Thursday because the numbers told us to.

Compensation

Base + OTE + Equity: $100,000 - $350,000

In-person in one of our customer cities in the US or Canada.

We do not discriminate based on gender identity, race, ancestry, disability, religion, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We welcome and encourage all qualified candidates to apply for our job openings.

jobs.description:
About MedReview

MedReview is a leading provider of payment integrity solutions that help national and regional health plans promote population health, ensure payment accuracy, reduce administrative waste, improve provider relationships, and optimize financial performance. For more than four decades, MedReview has partnered with health plans, third-party administrators, and other healthcare organizations to deliver technology-enabled solutions that identify savings opportunities, drive operational efficiency, and improve healthcare outcomes.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Data Mining Senior Auditor to join our Payment Integrity team. This role is responsible for identifying healthcare cost-savings opportunities through advanced data mining strategies, claims analysis, audit development, and payment integrity initiatives. The Data Mining Senior Auditor will leverage extensive healthcare claims expertise to uncover overpayments, develop innovative audit concepts, enhance existing savings strategies, and support operational and financial objectives for health plan clients.

This position requires strong analytical skills, deep knowledge of healthcare claims processing and reimbursement methodologies, and the ability to transform complex data into actionable insights that drive measurable client savings.

Key Responsibilities

Data Mining and Audit Strategy

  • Develop, implement, and maintain data mining strategies that identify claims overpayments and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Create and deploy payment integrity edits, algorithms, and auditing methodologies to flag suspect claims and drive recoveries.
  • Perform detailed claims analyses to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for enhanced savings initiatives.
  • Assist in the development of new audit concepts and payment integrity programs.
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance existing savings strategies to improve client outcomes.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Produce detailed data mining reports and analyses for Payment Integrity operations.
  • Extract and interpret critical information from large healthcare claims datasets to support business and operational decisions.
  • Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
  • Utilize data analytics tools to identify meaningful business insights and opportunities.
  • Perform ad hoc analyses to quantify, prioritize, and validate savings opportunities.

Operational Excellence and Quality

  • Develop and maintain quality control processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Build sustainable audit processes that ensure overpayment findings are accurate, defensible, and repeatable.
  • Optimize technology solutions and workflows to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and support issue resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize processes and improve operational reporting capabilities.
  • Support ongoing process improvement initiatives across the Payment Integrity function.

Collaboration and Leadership

  • Collaborate with Payment Integrity, Clinical, Operations, and Analytics teams to support organizational objectives.
  • Assess and triage referrals from health plans, Clinical Affordability teams, healthcare economics departments, and other stakeholders.
  • Communicate operational challenges, findings, and recommendations to leadership.
  • Partner with Data Mining leadership to communicate operational needs and strategic opportunities to executive leadership.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives that improve audit performance and maximize client savings.

Qualifications

  • Minimum high school diploma or GED required.
  • Seven (7) or more years of healthcare claims investigation, payment integrity, or data mining experience.
  • Five (5) or more years of leadership experience within healthcare auditing, payment integrity, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in healthcare claims processing, reimbursement methodologies, and payment integrity concepts.
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience developing performance measures and quality assurance methodologies.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to client satisfaction.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to quickly learn and utilize SQL Server, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.
  • Knowledge of coding edits, reimbursement methodologies, and medical claims payment systems.
  • Understanding of medical terminology, procedures, diagnoses, treatment practices, and claims adjudication processes.
  • Experience applying coding guidelines, billing regulations, and federal and state healthcare policies.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer reimbursement requirements.
  • Experience working with healthcare payer systems such as Facets, QNXT, or similar claims platforms.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field.
  • CPC, CCS, CPMA, RHIA, RHIT, or other relevant coding, billing, or auditing certification.
  • Experience with SQL, data warehousing, Power BI, and advanced healthcare analytics tools.
  • Experience developing healthcare payment integrity concepts resulting in measurable client savings.
  • Experience working with health plans, third-party administrators, or payment integrity organizations.

Remote Work Requirements

  • High-speed internet connection (100 Mbps recommended).
  • Dedicated workspace with minimal interruptions and the ability to protect PHI and HIPAA-sensitive information.
  • Ability to work at a computer and utilize a keyboard for extended periods.

$85,000 - $90,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

Job Title: Chef de projet adjoint - Appareils connectés / Connected Devices Associate

French

Présentation du département :


Le secteur des appareils connectés est l'un des plus dynamiques et passionnants de l'industrie de la recherche clinique. L'identification, la stratégie et la gestion de divers dispositifs et de leurs modalités d'acquisition de données, afin d'atteindre les objectifs de nos clients, représentent un défi constant et stimulant. Cette unité commerciale à forte visibilité est étroitement liée aux autres équipes de réalisation d'essais cliniques au sein d'IQVIA. Nous collaborons étroitement avec nos partenaires technologiques et nos partenaires commanditaires pour accélérer la commercialisation des traitements à l'échelle mondiale. Nous sommes à la recherche de personnes motivées et responsables, désireuses d'avoir un impact sur l'entreprise et de contribuer à la solution. Chez IQVIA, nous accordons de la valeur aux personnes qui privilégient l'apprentissage continu et le développement de carrière.


Description du poste :

Le chef de projet adjoint(e) gérera des projets d'appareils connectés de petite à moyenne envergure, qu'ils soient autonomes ou intégrés, et ce, pour toutes les phases des études cliniques. Il/Elle veillera à ce que tous les travaux soient effectués à la satisfaction du commanditaire, dans les délais impartis, en respectant le budget et conformément aux politiques et procédures en vigueur.


Formation et expérience requises :

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, gestion d'entreprise ou discipline liée à la santé
  • 3 ans et plus d’expérience en gestion de projet dans le secteur de la recherche clinique/CRO, incluant la planification, les échéanciers, les livrables, les budgets, la gestion des risques/problèmes, la rédaction de manuels, la gestion documentaire, etc.
  • Ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience
  • L'expérience des essais décentralisés ou des dispositifs médicaux est un atout.

Résumé des responsabilités :

  • Sous supervision, planifier, initier, exécuter, contrôler et clôturer les projets conformément au cahier des charges convenu avec le client.
  • Superviser et coordonner le travail des équipes de projet pluridisciplinaires.
  • Suivre l’avancement des projets, identifier et évaluer les risques et solliciter les recommandations de la hiérarchie concernant les mesures correctives à prendre.
  • Élaborer et superviser la maintenance des bases de données internes et des plans de projet.
  • Veiller à ce que les services opérationnels soient pleinement informés des exigences du projet.
  • Animer une réunion de bilan de fin de projet afin de s'assurer que toutes les activités ont été menées à bien.
  • Garder la direction de Connected Devices pleinement informée de tout problème de projet susceptible d'affecter la qualité, le budget et le respect des délais de livraison, afin d'assurer la satisfaction du client.
  • Former et encadrer les jeunes employés en soutien aux projets.
  • Fournir aux gestionnaires hiérarchiques des renseignements sur le rendement des membres de leur équipe de projet par rapport aux tâches à accomplir.
  • Préparer et présenter les renseignements relatifs au projet lors des réunions internes et externes.
  • S'assurer que des directives claires et pertinentes, propres au projet, sont documentées et diffusées à tous les membres de l'équipe, et que ces derniers sont bien formés à leur utilisation.
  • Vérifier le contrat du projet afin de s'assurer que tout travail hors périmètre est géré rapidement et efficacement.

Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes requises :

  • Excellentes compétences en leadership
  • Bonne capacité à prioriser, planifier et organiser
  • Bonnes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de communication
  • Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes
  • Excellent sens du service à la clientèle
  • Maîtrise de Microsoft Office
  • Capacité d'établir et de maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les clients

Connected Devices is one of the most dynamic and interesting areas within the Clinical Research industry. We work closely with technology partners and our sponsor partners to help speed therapies to market in a global network. We seek highly motivated and accountable people looking for opportunities to impact the business and be part of the solution. At IQVIA, we look at individuals with a focus on continuous learning and career development.

The Associate Project Manager will manage small to medium size Connected Devices projects that are stand-alone or full-service in scope, across all phases of clinical studies. Ensure all project work is completed to the sponsor's satisfaction, on time and within budget and in accordance with policies and procedures.

jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewThe Database Architect designs, implements, and optimizes the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Database Architect designs, implements, and optimizes the database architecture that powers Intelerad's medical imaging solutions. This strategic technical leader will be responsible for creating scalable, secure, and high-performance database systems that support our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging platforms serving healthcare providers and imaging centers globally. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in database design, data modeling, and performance optimization within large-scale, mission-critical environments where system reliability directly impacts patient care. This role requires balancing technical excellence with business needs, collaborating across engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to ensure our data architecture supports both current operations and future growth in the healthcare IT sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise-wide database architectures for Intelerad's medical imaging platforms, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability to support healthcare providers' diagnostic workflows and patient care delivery across multiple deployment models including on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive data models, schemas, and database documentation that align with healthcare interoperability standards including DICOM, HL7, and FHIR, while optimizing storage strategies for large-scale medical imaging data and ensuring efficient retrieval for clinical workflows.
  • Establish and enforce database development standards, security protocols, and compliance frameworks to meet healthcare regulations including HIPAA, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and availability across all database systems while implementing robust backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies.
  • Lead database performance optimization initiatives through query tuning, indexing strategies, and capacity planning, proactively monitoring system health and implementing solutions that maintain sub-second response times critical for real-time diagnostic imaging access in clinical settings.
  • Collaborate with software engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to integrate database systems with application architecture, evaluate and recommend database technologies and platforms, and provide technical leadership on database migrations, upgrades, and modernization initiatives that support product innovation and operational excellence.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in database architecture, design, and administration with demonstrated expertise in both relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra), including hands-on experience with large-scale, high-availability database environments.
  • Proven expertise in data modeling, database design patterns, normalization techniques, and creating logical and physical data models that support complex business requirements and high-volume transactional systems.
  • Strong proficiency in database performance optimization, including query tuning, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and capacity planning for systems processing millions of transactions and managing petabyte-scale data storage.
  • Extensive experience with cloud database platforms and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including experience with database migration strategies, hybrid architectures, and cloud-native database solutions.
  • Deep understanding of database security best practices, encryption methodologies, access control mechanisms, and regulatory compliance requirements, with specific experience in healthcare data protection and HIPAA compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor development teams, and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering
  • Experience with medical imaging systems architecture including PACS, RIS, VNA, or enterprise imaging platforms, and understanding of healthcare data standards such as DICOM, HL7, and FHIR.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed database systems, data replication strategies, sharding, and multi-region database architectures that support global healthcare operations.
  • Proficiency with ETL processes, data integration tools, and experience designing data pipelines that support business intelligence, analytics, and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation for database provisioning and management.
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines for database deployments, including experience with automated database testing, schema version control, and migration automation.
  • Professional certifications such as AWS Certified Database Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Certified Professional, or TOGAF certification.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first organizational structure.

jobs.title: Logistics Managers: Parcel Shipping Contracts And Carrier Allocation
jobs.excerpt: What We're ResearchingWe're running a paid study on the strategies organizations use to negotiate parcel shipping agreements.
jobs.description:
What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the strategies organizations use to negotiate parcel shipping agreements. Carrier allocation and contract terms have a massive impact on supply chain efficiency, and we want to understand the decision-making process behind these choices. Your insights will help us map the current landscape of logistics partnerships.

How It Works

You will join a remote video interview to walk us through your approach to managing shipping logistics. We will ask you to detail how your organization negotiates contracts and allocates package volume among various carriers. You will discuss the primary factors that influence your carrier selection, including pricing, reliability, and service level agreements.   • Translate complex financial concepts into clear, approachable experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, visual design and overall quality.

  • Collaborate closely with our team of designers, combining their longer-range product thinking with your hands-on craft to shape what we build.

  • Design and run experiments with your product and data partners, from hypothesis through analysis, and use what you learn to shape what comes next.

  • Iterate on critical user experiences based on metrics, research and customer feedback, treating launch as the start of the work, not the end.

  • Partner with product and engineering to scope smartly, make thoughtful tradeoffs and bring people along on your decisions.

  • Build with and contribute to our design system, and use AI tools to transform the way we deliver user impact

Why You're a Great Fit

  • Significant experience designing and shipping complex digital products, ideally in fintech, financial services, commerce or another multi-stakeholder environment.

  • A portfolio showing strong UX thinking and polished visual and UI execution, including examples of iteration and the results your work drove.

  • Strong interaction design fundamentals, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to keep quality high while moving with momentum.

  • Hands-on experience designing for A/B tests and experiments, and knowing how to structure variants to get clear, useful results.

  • A strong grasp of product metrics like conversion, activation, engagement and retention, and a data-informed approach that blends quantitative and qualitative signals.

  • You thrive in close collaboration, bring a strong point of view, and like building on others' ideas as much as sharing your own.

  • Clear communication, and hands-on use of AI tools in your day-to-day work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing consumer financial products, including lending, banking, budgeting, payments, and more

  • Experience contributing to or evolving a design system.

  • Experience with analytics and experimentation tools like Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Optimizely.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Get to know our customers, products and design system, build relationships with your partners, and ship your first work.

First 90 days: Own design across a set of key initiatives, shipping on a regular rhythm and running your first experiments. Trusted member to EPD partners in the problem space.

Over time: You're known for quality, momentum and measurable impact, and you play a key part in how the EPD team delivers on its biggest priorities.

Why Join Us

  • Own meaningful product experiences used by millions of people.

  • Ship often, test your ideas with real customers, and see the impact in the metrics.

  • Work closely with tenured, talented designers on a team that values strong craft, constructive debate and thoughtful collaboration.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $152,150 - $179,000

jobs.excerpt: Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos.
jobs.description:
Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! 🖤

Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui. 😎

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP).Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma culturamassa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo doGreat Place to Work™e em 2025 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a darmatch! 🥰

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

📌Dentro do time de Produto, sua missão será:

Fazer parte da Tribo de Clientes e Valor, criando experiências digitais que simplificam os desafios complexos da rotina de quem advoga. Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em design de produtos com inteligência artificial e no uso de IA para potencializar o próprio processo de design. Ferramentas como o Claude Design já fazem parte da nossa rotina.

Você vai conectar pensamento estratégico de produto e excelência em UX/UI para transformar necessidades reais em soluções intuitivas, conectadas aos objetivos do negócio. Sua atuação será de ponta a ponta, do discovery à validação, explorando oportunidades, prototipando e testando soluções.

A IA será uma aliada nesse processo, ajudando a ampliar possibilidades, experimentar abordagens e acelerar o desenvolvimento de soluções com mais agilidade e qualidade.

👉Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga:O modelo de trabalho é 100% remoto!

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Conduzir o design de ponta a ponta, do discovery ao handoff, com liderança técnica nas decisões do dia a dia. Projetar fluxos e interfaces centrados em quem advoga para ampliar a percepção de valor, reduzir fricções e gerar oportunidades de conversão e receita.
  • Prototipar com velocidade, em baixa e alta fidelidade, conduzindo ciclos rápidos de hipótese, teste, aprendizado e interação, com foco em impacto mensurável.
  • Usar IA no processo de design, especialmente o Claude Design, para explorar alternativas, gerar variações de layout e copy, apoiar a análise de benchmarks e organizar aprendizados de experimentos.
  • Projetar experiências com IA integradas ao Astrea, nas quais a tecnologia apoia e a pessoa usuária mantém autonomia e controle.
  • Aplicar princípios de psicologia comportamental de forma ética e transparente, como prova social, ancoragem, aversão à perda e redução de incerteza, para apoiar decisões e melhorar o desempenho do funil.
  • Definir e acompanhar, junto do squad, métricas de sucesso como ativação e conversão, garantindo a instrumentação e a leitura dos resultados.
  • Conduzir testes de usabilidade e validações quantitativas e qualitativas, transformando insights em decisões de design.
  • Colaborar diariamente com Produto, Engenharia, Dados e Marketing, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em experiências claras, viáveis e testáveis, com handoffs robustos.
  • Documentar decisões, variações testadas e aprendizados, contribuindo para o repositório de conhecimento, a evolução do Design System e a troca de conhecimento na célula de design.

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Graduação em Design ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida como Product Designer, com atuação em produtos digitais complexos.
  • Domínio prático de ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao design, com experiência obrigatória em Claude Design.
  • Repertório consistente em UX/UI, arquitetura de informação, interação e prototipação.
  • Vivência com pesquisa e validação junto a pessoas usuárias.
  • Pensamento estratégico de produto, com capacidade de conectar experiência, negócio e métricas.
  • Comunicação clara para apresentar ideias, defender decisões e colaborar com diferentes áreas.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas do dia a dia (Jira, Notion, Lovable, Replit)

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em design de produtos ou funcionalidades com IA, como experiências conversacionais, assistentes e fluxos de cocriação.
  • Experiência com produtos B2B ou SaaS.
  • Conhecimento do mercado jurídico ou de rotinas de profissionais autônomos.

Informações adicionais

E dá uma olhada no que oferecemos às pessoas áureas:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição:R$ 1.300 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Home Office:R$ 135,00 mensais, sem desconto em folha.
  • Plano de Saúde: Bradesco nacional.
  • Plano Odontológico:SulAmérica.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Licenças parentais estendidas: fazemos parte do Programa Empresa Cidadã e oferecemos licenças que apoiam diferentes formatos de família — incluindo adoção, casais homoafetivos e famílias monoparentais.
  • Auxílio Creche:Para filhos(as) até 5 anos de idade.
  • Gympass/Wellhub: plataforma de bem-estar, com foco em atividades físicas e saúde integral. Dá acesso a milhares de academias, estúdios, aulas ao vivo e apps de bem-estar, com apenas uma única mensalidade;
  • Conexa Saúde: plataforma de saúde digital, com diversas especialidades. Com ela, as pessoas áureas têm acesso a 2 consultas psicológicas e 2 consultas nutricionais gratuitas por mês.
  • Guapeco: plano de saúde pet com adesão simples, cobertura nacional e reembolsos de até 100%.
  • Parceria com escola de idiomas:parceria com descontos para os idiomas de inglês e espanhol com a OpenEnglish, Fluentia e Instituto Cervantes, em modalidades online e presenciais.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): se o time bate a meta anual, todo mundo (real!) ganha participação nos lucros!
  • Semana Relax: Não trabalhamos nos dias úteis entre as datas de natal e ano novo, para descansar e aproveitar o final de ano da forma que cada um preferir.
  • Auxílio Posto de Trabalho: além de emprestarmos o notebook, para local de trabalho em sua casa confortável, disponibilizamos um auxílio de R$ 2.400,00.
  • Folga de Aniversários:No mês de seu aniversário você tem um dia inteirinho de day off para descansar e curtir.
  • Trabalhar em um Great Place to Work©: Somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar na América Latina e no Brasil.
  • E muito mais!Com uma cultura de feedback, guildas de desenvolvimento, PDI no onboarding, Aurum Talks, reuniões frequentes com toda a Aurum, transparência em OKR, ações comemorativas, avaliação de desempenho, programas de desenvolvimento entre outros processos que ajudam a desenvolver cada vez mais as pessoas áureas.

E aí, curtiu!? Então vem com a gente :)

Job Title

Senior Project Manager, India Lead - Airport Solutions

Title: Senior Project Manager, India Lead - Airport Solutions

Location: Mumbai / Delhi / Bangalore

Summary of the Role

At Amadeus, we believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, customer-facing airport transformation and implementation programs across the Indian Subcontinent.

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of multiple projects and workstreams, ensuring successful execution from planning through deployment and transition. You will collaborate with customers, business leaders, and cross-functional teams to deliver results while maintaining strong governance, financial control, and stakeholder engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Responsibility for all projects in the India Subcontinent
  • Lead large-scale airport technology, transformation, and delivery programs from initiation to closure.
  • Manage multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, and timelines.
  • Manage, Mentor and guide project team members while fostering collaboration and accountability.
  • Partner with customer stakeholders, including senior leadership and CxO-level executives.
  • Drive program planning, governance, reporting, and execution activities.
  • Monitor project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Manage project financials, including budgets, forecasting, cost control, invoicing, and change management.
  • Lead customer reviews, steering committee meetings, and program status discussions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
  • Establish project milestones, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
  • Support knowledge transfer and operational transition activities at project completion.
  • Ensure adherence to project management methodologies, standards, and governance processes.

What Your Day Might Look Like

  • Reviewing project progress and delivery milestones.
  • Engaging with customers and internal stakeholders to discuss project status and priorities.
  • Managing and Mentoring your India based Project Managers
  • Facilitating risk and issue review sessions to keep projects on track.
  • Working with delivery, product, engineering, and operational teams to remove roadblocks.
  • Presenting updates to customer leadership and steering committees.
  • Managing budgets, forecasts, project changes, and governance activities.
  • Supporting implementation, testing, cutover, and transition activities.

What We're Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in IT projects and program delivery.
  • 10+ years of experience managing large-scale programs, projects, or integrated delivery schedules.
  • Experience working with Airport or Aviation solutions
  • Strong experience in:
    • Project & Program Management
    • Stakeholder Management
    • Customer Relationship Management
    • Risk & Issue Management
    • Financial and Budget Management
    • Governance and Reporting
    • Change Management
  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and customer-facing engagements.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, or equivalent Project/Program Management certification.
  • Experience working with Airport or Aviation solutions.
  • Exposure to passenger processing or airport operations systems.
  • International project delivery experience.
  • Experience working in multicultural and multi-country environments.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on high-impact airport transformation programs.
  • Collaborate with leading aviation customers across the region.
  • Influence strategic initiatives and customer outcomes.
  • Be part of a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative team environment.
  • Grow your leadership capabilities while working on complex global programs.

What we can offer you

  • · 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose. 
  • · 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture. 
  • · 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities, and daily interactions. 
  • · 🤗 A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being. 
  • · 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits. 
  • · 🌟 A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best. 
  • · 🌈 A diverse, equitable, and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment. 
  • · 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.



Diversity & Inclusion


Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 


Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams


Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

AI & Automation Developer

Microsoft Copilot Studio | Power Automate | Microsoft Teams

Location: Remote | Must be available during Eastern Time business hours
Schedule: Full-time
Base Salary: $90,000–$100,000, commensurate with experience
Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

About the Opportunity

Professional Physical Therapy is seeking an AI & Automation Developer to build practical tools that simplify everyday work across our clinics and corporate teams.

In this role, you will develop conversational agents, automate repetitive processes, and connect employees with the information and systems they need through Microsoft Teams. You’ll work closely with our technology leadership and business partners to turn operational challenges into reliable, easy-to-use solutions.

Your primary focus will be Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and integrations with internal systems. You will also use Microsoft SQL Server to support those solutions, with opportunities to deepen your technical skills through mentorship and hands-on development.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys asking, “Could we make this easier?”—and then building the solution.

What You’ll Do

  • Build conversational agents: Design, develop, test, and maintain Microsoft Copilot Studio agents that help employees find information, submit requests, and complete routine tasks through Microsoft Teams.
  • Automate business processes: Create Power Automate workflows that reduce manual data entry, repetitive support tickets, and administrative work.
  • Connect systems and data: Use APIs, connectors, and SQL Server to exchange information between agents, workflows, and business applications.
  • Improve access to knowledge: Configure agents to retrieve information from approved internal sources and provide relevant, grounded responses.
  • Build reliable workflows: Incorporate data validation, duplicate checks, conditional logic, approval steps, and escalation paths so requests are handled accurately.
  • Identify opportunities: Partner with technology, operations, compliance, and other teams to understand their processes and prioritize useful automation projects.
  • Support secure implementation: Apply appropriate permissions, access controls, and human review when solutions interact with sensitive information or update business records.
  • Own solutions beyond launch: Troubleshoot issues, maintain documentation, help employees adopt new tools, and improve solutions based on feedback and performance.
  • Measure results: Track outcomes such as time saved, fewer support requests, improved data accuracy, and employee adoption.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on experience building an agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio, with the ability to explain what you built, how it works, and the problem it solves.
  • Experience creating workflows in Microsoft Power Automate, including triggers, conditions, connectors, and error handling.
  • Experience publishing or integrating agents and workflows within Microsoft Teams.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL, including queries, joins, table relationships, and basic database normalization.
  • Familiarity with APIs, JSON, and connecting applications or data sources.
  • An understanding of how to validate information, prevent duplicate records, and handle exceptions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate a business request into a clear technical approach.
  • Curiosity, initiative, clear communication, and an interest in learning new tools.

We value demonstrated ability over a fixed number of years of experience. Relevant work completed through employment, internships, academic projects, or independent development is welcome.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, and evaluating the accuracy of AI-generated responses.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Power Apps, Dataverse, or Microsoft Graph.
  • Experience working in a healthcare setting is preferred, particularly with healthcare systems, workflows, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Exposure to C#/.NET, Python, MySQL, or SQL Server Reporting Services.
  • Experience supporting solutions used by employees in a production environment.

Why Join Professional Physical Therapy?

You’ll have the opportunity to build tools that directly improve how our teams work, contribute ideas, and see your solutions put into practice. You’ll partner with experienced technology leadership while developing your skills in automation, integration, and applied AI.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; a company-matched 401(k); pet insurance options; and employee discounts.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disabled/Veterans.

jobs.title: VP of Customer Success
jobs.excerpt: About VouchedVouched is the identity trust layer for businesses that need to know who they are dealing with across every touchpoint, every interaction, and every channel.
jobs.description:
About Vouched

Vouched is the identity trust layer for businesses that need to know who they are dealing with across every touchpoint, every interaction, and every channel. We deliver consumer-grade technology built for the future of identity, enabling businesses to verify the people they serve through a full spectrum of methods: physical IDs, Digital IDs, and consumerized AI agents. Our platform is obsessed with the consumer experience: fast, intuitive, and built to meet people where they are.

Identity used to be a solved problem at the front door — verify the human once, let them in, and you’re done. That world is over. Today, AI agents browse your site, call your APIs, and initiate transactions using real user credentials, acting on behalf of humans who may have no idea what their agent is doing in their name. Vouched was built for both worlds: the human identity problem that has always existed, and the agent identity problem that is just beginning.

About the Role

Vouched is at an inflection point. Our IDV product serves customers across fintech, healthcare, auto, notary, and beyond. Our KYA product — Know Your Agent — is building the trust infrastructure for the agentic web and is in active deployment. Both products are growing. Both require a CS function that can keep pace.

We’re looking for a VP of Customer Success who is wired around one metric: NRR. Not satisfaction scores as a vanity exercise. Not QBRs as theater. Net Revenue Retention as the honest signal of whether customers are getting value, staying, and growing with us.

This leader will own the full post-sale motion — from onboarding through renewal and expansion — across two differentiated product lines, a growing customer base, and a CS team that is small, capable, and hungry to be built into something excellent. You’ll inherit a solid foundation and a team that cares deeply. Your job is to build the playbook, run it with discipline, and flex it as the market moves — because in identity, the market always moves.

This is not a role for someone who needs a mature organization to operate in. It is a role for someone who thrives when the environment is fast, the product is evolving, and the team is counting on you to have a clear point of view and share it early.

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Own NRR. Set the target, track the signal, diagnose the gaps, and build the team around closing them.
  • Define and execute the CS playbook — onboarding, adoption, health monitoring, renewal, and expansion — and hold the team accountable to it while staying willing to rewrite it when the market requires.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a CS team of CSMs and implementation specialists. Coach proactively, not reactively. Invest in people before they need saving.
  • Build the systems and habits that surface risk before it becomes churn. No firefighting after the email arrives — you want to be the reason the email never comes.
  • Partner with Product on the feedback loop from customers to roadmap. Partner with the CEO and leadership team on customer health as a company signal.
  • Own the customer journey from contract through renewal — onboarding timelines, adoption milestones, check-in cadences, escalation paths, and executive sponsorship for accounts that need it.
  • Operate in Pigeon, Vouched’s homegrown CRM, and help shape how the CS team uses it to manage forecasting, renewals, and account health at scale.
  • Represent the voice of the customer inside Vouched. When something isn’t working for customers, you’re the one who says it clearly and early, before it shows up in churn.
  • Build the renewal outreach motion: 90/60/30-day cadences, templated touchpoints, risk flagging, and a clean handoff protocol so CSMs are never caught off guard at renewal.
  • Report customer health and NRR trajectory to leadership with honesty and specificity. No vanity metrics, no spin.

What We’re Looking For

  • You have built or significantly scaled a CS function at a SaaS company, and NRR was your number. You know how to own a metric end to end.
  • You have a strong point of view on what a great CS playbook looks like — and you’ve run one at a company where the product, market, or team was changing faster than you’d like.
  • You’re a builder and a coach. You get energy from developing the people around you, not just from landing the deal or saving the account yourself.
  • You communicate proactively. You surface problems when they’re small, share context before it’s asked for, and give your team and leadership enough runway to act. You do not sit on bad news.
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Vouched serves two distinct product lines — IDV and KYA — each with its own customer profile, use case, and maturity curve. You can hold both.
  • You know how to balance rigor (playbooks, processes, forecasting) with adaptability (the customer who doesn’t fit the playbook, the product that just changed, the market that shifted overnight).
  • You’ve worked with enterprise, mid-market, and SMB customers and know how to calibrate your team’s motion for each segment.
  • You have experience with CRM and CS tooling, and you’re not precious about which tool — you care that the data is clean and the team is using it.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • NRR is up. You know what moved it, what you’d do differently, and what comes next.
  • The CS playbook is documented, staffed, and running. Every CSM knows their accounts, their health scores, and their renewal dates — and they knew them 90 days out.
  • No account churns without the team seeing it coming. Escalations are handled early. Customers who leave do so gracefully, and you understand why. Last impressions are just as important as first impressions
  • The team is stronger than when you arrived — better coached, better resourced, and more confident in how to do their jobs.
  • Product and Sales trust CS as a strategic partner, not just a support function. The feedback loop from customers to roadmap is real.
  • Pigeon reflects the truth of the customer base — health scores, renewal pipeline, and expansion signals are accurate and useful.
  • CS owns the expansion motion end-to-end

Benefits

  • Flexible paid time off
  • Healthcare
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • 401k
  • Equity compensation
  • Flexible remote, work-from-home arrangements
  • Parental leave

Competitive base salary, performance-based bonus tied to NRR targets. Details shared in the first conversation.

Client Success Executive (CSE)

Altera Digital Health - US Remote

At Altera, we believe healthcare technology should empower clinicians rather than burden them. We aren’t just looking for a "digital revolution"; we are focused on the steady, purposeful evolution of healthcare, helping our partners reach the "summit" of what patient care can be through smarter data, seamless interoperability, and human-centered AI.

Position Summary

The Client Success Executive (CSE) is a strategic partner and advocate for clients, responsible for ensuring their success, satisfaction, and growth. This role blends relationship management, operational execution, and strategic insight to deliver exceptional client outcomes. The CSE works cross-functionally to align internal efforts with client goals, drive performance, and foster long-term partnerships.

Core Responsibilities

Client Advocacy & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the internal advocate for assigned clients, ensuring their goals and feedback are represented across teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, acting as trusted advisors to drive client satisfaction and NPS.
  • Serve as the escalation point for client issues, ensuring swift and effective resolution.

Strategic Engagement & Planning

  • Lead Strategic Partnership Reviews to assess performance, align goals, and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and execute customized success plans based on client segmentation and strategic objectives.
  • Manage quarterly Client Leadership Council (CLC) meetings and summits to foster collaboration and innovation.

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Monitor and track KPIs that align with client goals and internal toolkits.
  • Drive Net Promoter Score (NPS/KLAS) improvement initiatives at the client level.
  • Analyze client data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for optimization and upselling.

Operational Execution

  • Oversee day-to-day client operations, ensuring a seamless and positive experience.
  • Complete SSOs (where applicable) and ensure timely delivery of client commitments.
  • Partner with finance and clients to ensure account health and contractual accountability.

Growth & Expansion

  • Identify and drive lead generation opportunities within existing client accounts.
  • Apply segmentation strategies to tailor engagement, service delivery, and growth plans.
  • Cultivate reference accounts and support client advocacy initiatives.
  • Provide ongoing feedback from a site visit with Client Success Leader.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 2–4 years of client-facing experience with a track record of exceeding expectations.
  • Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with strategic planning, KPI tracking, and cross-functional collaboration.

Compensation

Base salary: $80-90k USD
