jobs.description:
About Tereina

Tereina is on a mission to revolutionize B2B payments. We are a well-funded, early-stage startup building cutting-edge solutions that transform how businesses move money. Our platform handles cross-border payment processing, counterparty management, bank account administration, and compliance workflows for eterprise customers worldwide.

We are building a modern portal application using a service-oriented architecture with Spring Boot microservices, a Spring Boot BFF (Backend for Frontend), and a custom frontend built with SAP UI5 Web Components, React and TypeScript. We are currently evolving our UX with a clean, data-rich design language focused on advanced search, tabular data views, and dashboard analytics.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will be a key technical leader responsible for shaping the user experience of the Tereina Portal. You will own the frontend architecture, drive the implementation of our new design system, and work across the full stack to ensure our UX vision is realized with production-quality code. You will partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to deliver enterprise-grade interfaces for payment operations, counterparty management, and compliance with workflows.

This role demands deep expertise in modern frontend technologies, a strong eye for design quality, and the ability to influence architecture decisions across the portal and its supporting BFF layer. You will mentor other engineers on UX best practices and help define our standards for accessibility, performance, and component reusability.

Key Responsibilities

Framework Development

These are the responsibilities focused on building the underlying systems, architecture, and shared infrastructure:

  • Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture of the Tereina Portal, including the component library, state management patterns, and data-fetching layer built on our existing frontend infrastructure.
  • Design System Implementation: Lead the implementation of our evolving design system, translating UX designs into reusable, accessible components using SAP UI5 Web Components and TypeScript. Establish patterns for dashboards, data tables, search interfaces, and detail views.
  • BFF Collaboration: Work closely with the BFF layer (Spring Boot) to shape API contracts, optimize data-fetching patterns, and ensure the portal proxy controllers deliver exactly what the frontend needs. Influence the design of search proxy endpoints and OpenAPI specifications.
  • Performance & Accessibility: Champion frontend performance optimization (lazy loading, caching strategies, efficient re-renders) and WCAG accessibility standards across all portal views.

Rollout & Adoption

These are the responsibilities focused on shipping features, driving usage, and working across teams:

  • Search & Data Views: Architect the frontend implementation of our new standardized search framework, integrating table-based server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering via our REST filter contracts. Implement column configuration, saved searches, and spreadsheet exports.
  • Dashboard & Analytics UX: Build rich, interactive dashboard experiences including payment summaries, held-payment alerts, trend charts, and failure-analysis views.
  • Implement data visualizations that surface actionable insights for enterprise payment operations.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product, Design, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into UX solutions. Drive UX technical decisions and advocate for user experience quality in architectural discussions.
  • Mentorship: Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on frontend best practices, code quality, component design, and UX engineering principles. Lead code reviews, establish coding standards, and help shape the engineering culture as the team grows.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend development and UX engineering
  • Expert proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
  • Expert-level React experience, including deep knowledge of hooks, state management patterns, and component architecture, with a track record of building complex, data-rich web applications
  • Hands-on experience with headless table libraries (TanStack Table preferred) including server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering
  • Proven ability to build responsive, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) interfaces for enterprise applications
  • Experience with BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns and REST API integration, including OpenAPI-generated clients
  • Solid understanding of authentication flows (OAuth2/OIDC, session-based auth) and security best practices (CSRF, CSP)
  • Experience with AI agent frontends — streaming UI, conversation management, and integration with Spring AI, LangChain, or MCP backends
  • Experience with data visualization libraries and building dashboard interfaces with charts and analytics components
  • Strong system design skills with the ability to influence architecture decisions across frontend and API layers
  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional agile teams
  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required; all engineering collaboration, documentation, code reviews, and stakeholder communication are conducted in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP UI5, SAP UI5 Web Components, or enterprise UI frameworks in regulated industries
  • Familiarity with Spring Boot BFF architectures and Java/Kotlin backend services
  • Background in fintech, payment processing, or B2B financial platforms
  • Experience with SheetJS or similar client-side data export libraries
  • Knowledge of JPA Specifications or similar backend query patterns and how they map to frontend filter UIs
  • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications with organization-scoped data access
  • Track record of leading frontend architecture decisions and establishing engineering standards

Why Join Tereina?

  • Shape the Product: Own the UX of a platform that processes millions in B2B payments.
  • Your work directly impacts how enterprise customers manage counterparties, execute payments, and maintain compliance.
  • Technical Voice: Your opinions on API design, BFF contracts, and component architecture will directly influence how our stack is built. You won't just consume APIs – you'll help shape them.
  • Modern Stack: Work with a thoughtfully chosen technology stack that values simplicity and pragmatism over hype. We adopt new tools where they add real value.
  • Early-Stage Impact: Join a well-funded startup where your contributions shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.
  • Full-Stack Exposure: Collaborate across the entire stack, from frontend components to BFF orchestration to backend service APIs.
  • AI-Forward Culture: We embrace AI as a tool for innovation and efficiency. We are looking for team members who are curious, adaptable, and excited to leverage AI in their work.
  • Team & Growth: Work with a collaborative, diverse team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and work-life balance.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about building performant, secure, and user-friendly web applications and want to shape the future of payments technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Tereina embraces AI as a tool for innovation, efficiency, and growth. We're looking for team members who are curious, adaptable, and excited to leverage AI in their work—no matter the role. Tereina is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Our Platform:

Our mobile apps are Swift and Kotlin. Our frontend is built with React. Our backend uses Elixir and increasingly more and more Python. GenAI has significantly impacted our system architecture, requiring us to adapt and evolve. We are in the midst of a shift from existing products augmented with AI to a full AI-first platform.

You Are:

A Mobile Principal Software Engineer who will lead our mobile team and evolve it to meet the shifting demand of a full AI-first platform — on a timeline measured in weeks, not quarters. You're deeply hands-on with AI coding agents, and you've used them to ship serious work, not just autocomplete. You're as comfortable architecting a thin mobile client backed by a powerful API as you are dropping into our Python backend (with AI assist) to add what mobile needs. You'll shape our participant experience across mobile with heavy influence on the web too.

You're deeply product focused, energized by solving business problems, not just writing code. You ask "why" before "how," and you partner with Product and Design as a peer — shaping problems, not just taking specs. You know when to ship a scrappy prototype to test an assumption versus when to invest in a foundation built to last, and you can explain that call to a PM or designer. You can hold multiple projects in your head at once, spotting where they'll collide, depend on each other, or share a chance for reuse.

You bring Principal/Staff-level scope as a product engineer — 10+ years of experience evolving apps and standing up new ones across product and technical dimensions. You have a proven track record of leading technical improvements and mentoring other developers, as collaboration and empathy are cornerstones of our culture. You thrive setting your own direction with minimal input while staying aligned to company goals.

Most of all, you're energized by the prospect of doing in months what used to take years. If this sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

The Job

  • Drive a thin-client architecture for the participant experience, pushing business logic to the backend so the apps stay simple

jobs.title: Product Designer (Intl. - Full-time)
jobs.excerpt: Spate is a trend intelligence platform for consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food and beverage.
jobs.description:
Spate is a trend intelligence platform for consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food and beverage. We analyze anonymous, aggregated public consumer data to spot emerging trends early and explain why they're growing, so brands can make product and marketing decisions with confidence.

Our founders, Yarden Horwitz and Olivier Zimmer, started Google's Trendspotting division and called trends like turmeric, cold brew, and face masks before they went mainstream. Spate is Y Combinator-backed, and more than 200 brands use it, including Sephora, L'Oréal Paris, Estée Lauder Companies, Unilever, P&G, and e.l.f. Our data regularly appears in The New York Times, WWD, British Vogue, and The Business of Fashion.

About the role

We're hiring our first dedicated product designer, full-time, to shape Spate's core product: the dashboard where brand teams explore trends, build reports, and work with our AI assistant.

Our platform will change a lot over the next year or two as we rebuild around LLM-powered features. We already ship an AI Assistant, AI Reports (an LLM-powered dashboard builder), and in-dashboard summaries and analysis. We need someone who can work out what those experiences should be, not just how they should look.

Our users are brand innovation teams, product marketers, social media teams, and agencies. Most aren't data analysts, so much of the job is turning dense trend data into something clear and actionable.

You'll join the Frontend & UX team, four people including you, and report to our frontend lead. The role is fully remote, and we're hiring in the UK, central Europe, and Latin America, where many of our team already work. You’ll need to be based between US Central Time (UTC−6) and Central European Time (UTC+1). We require you to be available for core collaboration hours of 9:00 AM–12:00 PM Eastern (2:00–5:00 PM UK, 3:00–6:00 PM CET or your local equivalent).

This is a remote, Full-time employee position.

What you'll own

The product, not just the screens. At Spate, product design and UI/UX design happen together. Features aren't fully defined and then handed to a designer. You'll help decide what we build and why, and stay involved from the first conversation to launch. You'll work with our frontend lead to choose the right deliverable for each problem: a written proposal, a user flow, a prototype, or a full Figma spec.

Finding problems worth solving. Find user pain points on your own, through customer calls, interviews, feedback, and usage data. Then take them from problem to proposal: frame the problem, explore options, and make the case for a direction. Leadership sets the overall direction and can help point you at problems, but you won't need our input to get started.

How our AI features work. Decide when something should be a chat, a report, or an inline summary. Define how we show where an insight came from, and how we handle loading, uncertainty, and wrong answers. Help shape the voice and structure of AI-generated insights, because in an LLM product the words are part of the UX.

The design system. We have a Figma library and a React component library that are only loosely in sync. You'll own the system's principles and the Figma side, and partner with our frontend engineers to make the two a single source of truth. The goal is that everyday design decisions are answered by the system, so engineers can ship UI that feels like Spate without waiting on design. This includes data visualization standards and patterns for AI features.

The feedback loop, with our frontend lead. Co-own product metrics, user feedback tracking, and quality evaluation for our LLM features. A big part of this is defining what a good AI answer looks like for our users, and turning that into rubrics we can measure.

Requirements

What we're looking for

We care more about mindset than years of experience. You're driven, you care about making a good product, and you have a growth mindset. You value autonomy and self-direction.

  • 3+ years of product design experience, ideally owning features end to end in a B2B or SaaS product.
  • Strong product opinions. You think about what to build and why, not just how it looks, and you're comfortable defending and revising your ideas.
  • A portfolio that shows how you framed problems, not just how you solved them. At least one case study should start from a fuzzy problem with no spec.
  • Experience designing data-heavy products such as dashboards, analytics, or reporting tools.
  • You've worked within or contributed to a design system, and understand how components and patterns scale.
  • Real curiosity about AI products, ideally with some hands-on exploration.
  • Strong written communication in English. We're remote, so your proposals and decisions need to stand on their own.
  • Fluent in Figma, with AI tools in your everyday workflow.

Nice to have

  • Experience as the first or only designer on a team.
  • You've built or substantially evolved a design system that engineers adopted.
  • Experience designing AI features, or writing evaluation rubrics for LLM output.
  • Depth in data visualization.
  • Familiarity with consumer goods, beauty, food, or marketing and insights tools.
  • Comfort building quick functional prototypes with AI tools to test ideas against real outputs.

Your first 90 days

  1. First 30 days: Learn the product and the people who use it. Review customer calls, feedback and usage data, and audit the Figma library against our React components. Ship one small, real improvement.
  2. By day 60: Publish a map of our users' top pain points and goals. Take one meaningful feature from pain point to agreed proposal, with prototypes.
  3. By day 90: Have the design system's first principles documented and in use. Start co-owning metrics, feedback tracking, and LLM evals with our frontend lead.

How we work

Contributors at Spate work flexibly, with few meetings, a lot of impact, and real say over the direction of their work. Leadership sets product direction and priorities, and you shape how we get there. That means bringing proposals rather than waiting for briefs.

This isn't the right place if you need every decision approved or every project precisely spec'd before you start.

Our aesthetic is cool, smart, data-driven, and approachable. We want a designer who can hold that line while the product changes quickly.

This role does not include:

  • Writing production code. Figma is your main tool, and our frontend engineers build.
  • Brand and marketing design, such as the website, sales decks, or client reports.
  • Our API and MCP server, which another team owns for now.

This role does not include:

  • Writing production code. Figma is your main tool, and our frontend engineers build.
  • Brand and marketing design, such as the website, sales decks, or client reports.
  • Other product surfaces like our API and MCP server.

Compensation

  • Salary: €70k-€80k.
  • Full-time, fully remote.

Recruitment Process

  1. Video interview (30 min). About you, in your own words.
  2. Assessment (10 min). A quiz designed to assess your problem solving abilities and approach to work.
  3. Intro call with our frontend lead (~20 min). Your background, how you like to work, and whether the role fits.
  4. Case study (60 min). Work through a solution to a real-world problem and record your process.
  5. Case study review (45 min). Walk us through your case study, focusing on how you framed the problem and arrived at your solution.
  6. Conversation with our CEO (45 min). Product vision, how we work, and your questions.

jobs.title: Staff Fullstack Engineer - Platform - App Core Usage | Canada | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You enjoy engineering work where correctness, reliability and business impact matter. You find value in improving an established system, removing a recurring operational problem or making a billing workflow easier to understand and support.

You take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support. You can turn an ambiguous request into manageable increments, make sound trade-offs and follow through without needing each step prescribed. You ask useful questions, seek feedback and raise uncertainty or blockers early.

You adapt as priorities change, learn unfamiliar systems and technologies, and contribute where the squad needs you. You bring a strong backend specialty while remaining willing and able to work on frontend features and supporting infrastructure.

You reason about how a service behaves in production: how it is deployed, where its data lives, what happens when dependencies fail, and how the team detects and recovers from problems.

You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. In a distributed team, you make decisions, progress and risks visible so colleagues can contribute across time zones. You work independently while staying connected to the squad.

As a Staff engineer, you bring technical depth and sound judgment while remaining close to implementation. You collaborate constructively with other experienced engineers, welcome different perspectives and help the squad reach decisions and move forward.

We embrace thoughtful use of AI-assisted development. We value engineers who use these tools to support exploration, implementation, testing and documentation while taking responsibility for the quality and correctness of the result.

Requirements

  • Substantial experience designing, delivering and operating production backend systems, with the depth and judgment to lead complex work hands-on.
  • Strong experience building and operating production backend systems in Go, our primary backend language.
  • Professional experience contributing to frontend applications using TypeScript and React, or comparable technologies, and willingness to work across the stack as priorities change.
  • Experience reasoning about distributed systems, including partial failures, retries, consistency and interactions between services.
  • Experience with relational databases, including data modelling, schema migrations, query performance and safe production changes.
  • Practical experience deploying and troubleshooting containerised services and jobs in Kubernetes.
  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure through code and working with CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration and controlled rollouts.
  • Ability to investigate production problems using logs, metrics and traces, and turn findings into lasting improvements.
  • A record of delivering projects end to end, clarifying requirements, making trade-offs and following through after release.
  • Experience working remotely, with clear asynchronous communication and dependable collaboration across time zones.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar domains and technologies, adjust your approach as new information emerges, and take ownership beyond your main area of expertise.
  • Experience writing readable, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, maintain and operate.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call and take responsibility for the production behaviour of the systems you build.
  • Experience supporting colleagues through code reviews, mentoring and constructive technical discussions.

Bonus Points For

  • Usage metering, billing engines, pricing and rates, financial reconciliation or customer-facing cost management applications.
  • Reducing operational toil and automating workflows with recurring exceptions or manual interventions.
  • Systems with auditability, traceability or financial-control requirements.
  • MySQL operations, replication, database upgrades and performance tuning.
  • Terraform, Jsonnet and Kubernetes deployment configuration.
  • Argo Workflows or comparable deployment and job-orchestration tooling.
  • Cloud infrastructure involving managed databases, object storage, service accounts and access controls, particularly on GCP.
  • Data synchronisation pipelines and BigQuery integrations.
  • Cloud marketplace integrations across AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Integrations with business platforms such as NetSuite or Salesforce.
  • Observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or OpenTelemetry.

In Canada, the compensation range for this role is $186,368 - $223,642 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Required

            • Smart contracts

jobs.excerpt: What’s in it for you?  Ready to make a serious impact?
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you?

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the team & opportunity

Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it’s also what makes it a target. The Trust & Safety team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down.

We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows.

Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can’t rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust & Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build.

In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust & Safety team.

A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly

On a typical day, you will be working on:

  • Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic.
  • Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends.
  • Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives.
  • Responding to active abuse, including during on-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones.
  • Building tools that help our Trust & Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action.
  • Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own.
  • Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team.

What do we need from you?

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems.
  • Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows in a service-oriented architecture.
  • Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one.
  • Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked.
  • An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it’s supposed to be used.
  • Good judgment about trade-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers.
  • A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments.
  • Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners.
  • Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically.
  • Availability to take part in an on-call rotation for critical services.
  • Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time.

Nice to have

  • Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention.
  • Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance.
  • Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third-party risk and verification services.
  • Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML-backed decisions in production.
  • Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user-generated content.
  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis.

Base salary is just one component of Calendly’s total rewards package. All full-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program.

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing Product & Technology organization at Hard Rock Digital. In this role, you will help build and scale the internal developer platform that powers our gaming and entertainment products—making it faster and safer for every engineering team to ship.

This is a platform engineering–focused role: rather than only maintaining infrastructure, you’ll design and build self-service workflows, golden paths, and developer tooling on top of Backstage, our internal developer platform (IDP) of choice. You’ll partner with product engineering teams to understand their pain points and turn them into paved-road, self-serve capabilities—provisioning, CI/CD, environments, observability, and more—so teams can move independently without sacrificing security or compliance.

You’ll also model what it means to operate at the pace of AI-enabled engineering: fluently using AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, and LLM-powered workflows to design platform capabilities faster, automate toil, and raise the bar for the entire team.

What will you do?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering, you will:

Delivery Manager

Location: Remote in US or Canada | Travel: Regular 

Company Overview

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As a Delivery Manager, you own delivery on a cross-functional project: leading the team from kickoff through release, coordinating onshore and offshore contributors, and serving as a key delivery partner to the client. You bring the discipline to keep work on track, the judgment to navigate everyday trade-offs, and the ownership to make sure the project lands.

Why This Role Matters

Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils’ promise of “production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days” turns into actual project plans, sprint cadences, and shipped work. On the projects you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that builds when the team consistently ships on time. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep the team pulling in the same direction.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of cross-functional projects, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams
  • Manage releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models
  • Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers
  • Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget
  • Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication
  • Lead stakeholder working sessions and delivery forums with confidence
  • Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences
  • Support Senior Delivery Managers and Client Partners in identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence
  • Mentor delivery coordinators and team members on your project, sharing knowledge and supporting their growth
  • Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement
  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements
  • Participate in interviews for project team members and contribute input to hiring decisions

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership
  • Strong understanding of agile delivery practices (e.g., Scrum, Kanban)
  • Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations
  • Ability to deliver multi-platform digital systems in agile environments
  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills
  • Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms
  • Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)
  • Scrum Master or equivalent certification preferred
  • Experience in regulated environments (e.g., utilities, government, finance) is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
  • Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise
  • Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account management) that builds client trust

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You’d rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.
